tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //spya chi/hā sdu 77/mesbya 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
lang tsho'i 'bab chu/che ring gnam mgon gyis brtsams/mirigasadagoskrun khang /

'brog phrug snying dus can zhig gis bshad pa'i 'brog mi'i gtam rgyud/(sngon 'gro'i tshab tu/)bstanagayar rgyas/tshe ring gnam mgon ni srid 'dzin gyi bya ba phrag tu khur pa'i 'go khrid mi sna zhig red la/ dus nam yang smyu gu'i kha lo bsgyur mkhan gyi rtsom pa po zhig kyang red/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang / 'gan 'khri lci ba'i srid 'dzin las ka gnyis ka 'thus shor med pa'i sgo nas legs grub byung mkhan gyi skye bo ni lo rgyus thog thon ma myong pa zhig min yang nyung nyung red ces bshad na ma 'grig pa med/ kho bos 'dod tshul ltar na/ tshe ring gnam mgon ni nyung nyung de'i gras su tshud pa'i brtsams sgrung sger gnyer ched las pa phul du byung ba zhig red snyam/ (rtsom rig gi thad )yang snying tshe ring gnam mgon gyi brtsams sgrung la dge skyon gang yod khong gi btsams sgrung phyogs bsgrigs 'di thengs shig bklags na shes thub/khong ni dus rabs gsar pa'i nang 'char longs byung zhing / rang mi rigs kyi skad yig bkol spyod byed cing / rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad grub 'bras che tsam thob pa'i rtsom pa po zhig red/ khong gis dus skabs gsar di'i

bod yig rtsom rig gi lo rgyus thog bzung ba'i gnas bab ni sus kyang bston du med ces rtsom rig smra ba'i mkhas dbang du mas mgrin gcig tu gdeng 'jog byas/ rags rim tsam smras na tshe ring gnam mgon gyi btsams sgrung la mngon gsal gyi rang gshes 'bur du thon pa ste/khong gi bcoms sgrung gi brjod gzhi phal che ba byang rigs 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba yin zhing / 1 khong gi brtsams sgrung khyon yongs nas 'tsho bar rkang pa brtan po btsugs nas rtswa thang dang phyugs rigs la brten nas 'tsho gnas byed pa'i 'brog pa'i lo rgyus dang / 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs mtshon yod/ 2 spyi tshogs kyi 'khor yug mi 'dra ba'i khrod kyi bsam blo'i 'gal 'du dang rang gshes mtshon yod/ 2 lhag par du gsar rnying rig gnas mnyam 'phrad las byung ba'i 'brog pa'i sems khams kyi 'pho 'gyur dang / 'tsho spyod kyi gnas stangs gtsigs cher bzung nas mtshon yod pas/ nang don rgya che la gting zab pa'i sgo nas dus rabs kyi rjes su dam por 'brangs yod/brjod snying gi thad dus rim gnyis su dbye chog ste/ 1 〈lang tsho'i 'bab chu 〉lta bu'i ngos nas bshad na/ 'brog khul gzhon nus deng rabs rig gnas kyi mtshon rtags lta bu'i grong khyer gyi 'tsho bar dad zhen re smon byed par zhib tu bkod nas/ spro ba 'bum gyis dga' 'bod dang skul lcag btang nas srol rgyun rig gnas la ldan pa'i skyon cha ther 'don gyis gsar dar rig gnas kyi legs cha dang len bya rgyu'i bsam blo mtshon yod/ 2 〈ca thang gi skyo glu 〉lta bu'i ngos nas bshad na/ rang nad rang gis bcos pa'i thabs bzang po'i thog nas rig gnas gsar rnying dang / yang sgos srol rgyun rig gnas la bskyar zhib byas nas rtswa thang gi las dbang la bsam zhib zab mo byas thog rang mi /gas la sha zhen chen po'i sgo nas rjes su lus pa'i lo rgyus dang rig gnas/

sbyi tshogs bcas kyi 'byung rtsa sngog 'don gang thub byas yod/tshe ring gnam mgon gyi brtsams sgrudro nang dmigs gcisal gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i mi sna klu mo mtsho dang / tshe ring chos sgrol sogs ni brtsams sgrub gi nang rtog bzo byas pa'i mi sna 'ba' zhig yin mod/ de dang de 'dra ba'i mi sna gson po ni 'brog khul gyi rtswa thang steng nga tsho'i mthong chos su gyur pas/ de dag gi gnas bab dang / myong rgyus/ 'brel ba'i snang brnyan gson po zhig bzhengs thub yod pas/ de dag la la ni deng rabs bod yig brtsams sgrung thad dpe mtshon 'os pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan du brtsi rung ba zhig yin/thog mar rang mi rigs kyi skad yig gi thog nas gsar rtsom byas pa ni/bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rgyud 'dzin byas pa zhig yin pas tshig sbyor snyan 'jebs ldan zhing dpe don gnad du khel ba/ go bde kha skad can gyi lam du song yang go mi bde ba'i yul skad kyi dri mas ma gos pas bod kyi skad yig gcig gyur tshad ldan gyi rang bzhin la srung skyob byas yod/brtsams sgrung khyon yongs kyi sgrig gzhi skabs don gyi dgos mkho dang yongagasu mthun zhing / gsar gtod dang 'tshol zhib sna tshogs byas pas dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos du ma grub yod/gzhan yang / tshe ring gnam mgon ni yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i rtsom po zhig yin pas/ bcoms sgrung de dag gi snga phyir bltas na phyi ma phyi ma rnams snga ma snga ma dang bsdur na thod rgal dang gsar gtod kyi rkang rjes gsal po zhig mthong rgyu yod/tshe ring gnam mgon gyis srid 'dzin las ga'i brel zing gi khrod nas khom pa phra mo tsam yang brtson len byas pa'i 'bras bur spyi tshogs yongs kyis gdeng 'jog thob ste brtsams bya mi nyung ba zhig la snga rjes su rlung rta bum pa'i rtsom rig bya dga' dang / dus rabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig bya dga'/ gangs

rgyan bum pa'i rtsom rig bya dga'/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi mi gsar bya dga' sogs thob/ khong gi brtsams sgrung kha shas bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i rtsom zlog slob gling gi deng rtsom gyi slob gzhi 〈deng rtsom gces bsdus 〉nang bdams da/ dbang rtul ba kho bo'i ngos nas bshad na/ da res tshe ring gnam mgon gyi bcoms sgrung gces bsdus 〈lang tsho'i 'bab chu 〉lta bu'i dpe deb de khyon yongs nas rgyas bshad byed pa'i spobs pa zhig ga la ldan/ sgos su shog lhe re zungagi nang du 'dus mi thub pas khyon yongs nas rgyas bshad byas na de'ang dpedeb rkyang pa zhig tu grub rgyur gor ma chag pas/ de ni rtsom rig gzhung lugs smra ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi 'os 'gan lags/da lam grogs kyi dwangs ma khong gis bskul ngo ma zlog par sngon 'gro'i tshab tu 'bri khul byas kyang rgya che ba zhig dang / gting zab pa zhig ma mchis pas/ klog mkhan mkhyen ldan ma dang / sku zhabs lhan rgyas nas 'bol khri bde mo zhig gi steng du thugs sems rnal du phab nas myong rol byas na rnyed par dka' ba'i bsam pa'i rgyags phye zhig longs su spyod thub la/ byang rigs 'brog khul gyi thun mong min pa'i rtswa thang gi yul ljongs dang / khyad du 'phags pa'i 'brog las mi rigs kyi yul srol rig gnas cha rgyus lon thub/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 2༷nyin dbus 'gyur lha ldan zhing gi rang shag tshangs sras 'du gnas nas phul ba dge'o/ /4

dkar chagartswa thang gi skyo glu/ (1)klu mo mtsho/ (35)lang tsho'i 'bab chu/ (63)dus kyi 'gyur khug (81)bla ma bsten pa/ (92)rkang lam gya ma gyu/ (97)g.yang mo mtsho (112)pa sangs bu khrid dang bde chen chos sgron/ (119)lang tsho'i mig chu/ (126)brag steng gi rtswa/ (146)gcong rong gi bsru brid/ (159)brtse dung gis bskyur ba'i lo zla/ (193)phyi bltas/ (226)skra gzhug (261)pha ma'i shul bzhag (295)

rtswa thang gi skyo glu/gcig6 a tsi tsi/ lci ba sgrug mkhan gyi rlangs 'khor de gtsang po'i nang lhung 'dug bla chad pa lta bu'i skyes pa zhig gis dbugs hal bzhin de ltar smras/6 ga re/mi nyal khri'i steng dkyil krung byas nas blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis dpe cha 'don bzhin pa'i a mye khra rgyal hob ste langs bas/ lag tu 'dzin pa'i dpe cha'ang dbang med du shor nas shog lho gang sar 'thor/ 66nga tsho'i bu mo gang byas 'dug skyes pa des skad 'dzer bzhin drag tu bos pas khang pa'i nang du'ang skrag dgos pa'i brag ca zhig 'khor/a myes khra rgyal hon thor nas bsdad/ gyang ngos sasbyar ba'i shog khra de dag mthong dus khra rgyal rgad po'i mig mthar mchi ma nyilu nyil du gyur/ de dag bu mos sbyar ba red/ shog khra de dag bu mo'i lang tsho ltar rnam par bkra/thams cad kha sang gi 'ja' tshon bzhin yal tshar/ smyo gang yin nam/ shi dgos pa'i rgad po nga shi rgyu med par bu mo chung chung / thams cad gzhi nas red/ 7 a myes khra rgyal gyis de ltar khor lab byas/ gal srid mi gzhan gyi tshab byas nas shi chog na a myes khra rgyal gyis the tshom spu tsam med par bu mo'i cho~X tu

gshin rje chos rgyal gyi sar 'gro nges red/ a myes khra rgyal gyis mgo bo yar bkyag nas bu mo 'das ma'i pha ste rang nyid kyi bu la lta dus/ kho ni lag gnyis kyis mgo bo skyor nas bsdad 'dug66de min gyi mi gzhan gang byas 'dug mi tshe ring chos sgrol ma gtogs gzhan gson mgo thon mkhan gcig kyang 'dusamo gcig pu mi shi ba gang yin nam/mi ‘ mi tshos mo 'dre mo yin pa'i rtags red zer/ ra 'dre mo/ tshe ring chos sgrol/ ngo ma 'dre mo red/mi sku skya phyed sngo phyed du gyur ba'i rgan po de gdod nas tshe srog mi ldan pa'i 'jim sku zhig ltar hon thor nas 'gul med du lus/gnyis/lo mang po'i sngon du tshe ring chos sgrol ni lo bco brgyad la nye ba'i na chung bu mo zhig yin zhing / gang nas bltas kyang lha mo mi yul du byon pa lta bu'i mdzes ma zhig red ces shod dka' yang skabs de'i brnyan dpar steng gi dmag chas gyon pa'i 'khyab ston mkhan de dag las ldab brgyas mdzes pa yod/skad cha rnying pa zhig bshad na pho brgya sems pa shor sa dang mo brgya snying rlung langs ༵ lta/ /me tog gas khengs pa'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang kung hre yongs kyi yul dmag sbyong brdar byed kyi yod pas da lo gsar du yul dmag rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs pa'i tshe ring chos sgrol gyi lus kyi ba spu re nas dga' ba'i me tog re baXd nas shang thog tu 'byor/ kung hre'i kri pu'u hru'u ci khra rgyal gyis tshe ring

chos sgrol mthong ma thag kung hre'i 'go khrid mtho shos kyi nyams rbad de shor nas mig zim zim gyis tshe ring chos sgrol gyi gdong la lta bzhin kha'ang btsum mi thub par so ser po phyi ru mngon nas na chung bu mo de'i dkar 'jam gyi lag pa nas 'chang 'chang byed bzhin kho ngo mas tshe ring chos sgrol bud med yul dmag gi sdod khang du skyel rogs byas/ khra rgyal ni de dus lo bzhi bcu las grol tsam dang deng dang mi 'dra bar mthar phyin pa'i lha med smra ba zhig dang gung khran tang mi zhig red/tshe ring chos sgrol gyi gom pa rlung ltar yang zhing mo'i sems kyi nang du ling ling gar la rol ba'i snang ba rgyas/ dung so dkar po mu tig star la sgrig pa lta bu dag nam yang skyes pho mo kun gyi mig mdun mdzes rgyan du mngon/ mo ni rnam rig shin tu bkra ba'i bu mo zhig yin pas/ nyin shas kyi sbyong brdar byas pa brgyud/ me mda' rgyag rgyu dang / 'ur rdo 'phen rgyu/ zhabs bro rgyag rgyu/chab srid kyi dri lan 'debs rgyu sogs kyi thad kun gyi yang rtser song stabs/mi rnams kyis yid smon bya yul du gyur/ mo de ltar mgyogs po yar rgyas 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo zhig ni kung hre'i drung yig pho gzhon phun tshogs rdo rje'i zur khrid la brten nas byung ba red/ phun tshogs rdo rje ni dus rgyun rgya chas rnying pa gtsang rkyang zhig gyon nas brel ba 'tshub 'tshub tu gnas/ khong la cung legs pa'i bod yig gi chu tshad ldan pa ma zad/ rgya'i skad yig kyang thar thor shes pas shang de'i cha nas shes yon can zhig yin pas pho rgod las la snrol zhes pa ltar khong ni shang gi las byed nang nam yang mi khom pa'i mi zhig da/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi sems kyi zhing nas brtse dung gi lcang gsar dal gyis skyes/ mos phun tshogs rdo rje mthong thengs rer snying gi bu chung ldig ldig tu 'phag nam yang kho'i sems rtsa 'khol po'i zur khrid nyan par 'dod kyatā kho

dngadangos su 'phrad dusarda mur skrag snang zhig skyes nas ngo gdong gangs ri dkar por ngo tsha ba'i sprin dmar gyis btum nas rang dbang med par myur du phyogs gzhan la kha bsgyur dgos byung / de dus mo ni gom pa'i 'degs 'jog mi shes pa'i byis pa zhig ltar gyur nas gnam sa ji 'dra'i kha zheng che'ang mig blta sa'i gnas kyang mi rnyed/ dgong mo zhig tshe ring chos sgrol rmi lam gyi zhing du phun tshogs rdo rje dang lhan du me tog gis khengs pa'i rtswa gseb tu 'byor ba mthong / phun tshogs rdo rjes mo pang du blangs nas mig gnyis brtse sems kyis khengs bzhin mo'i gdong la blta/ kho'i pho nyams kyis phyug pa'i mchu 'dab mo'i dmar 'jam gyi ngo gdong phyogs la bsrings/ tshe ring chos sgrolagyi snying drag tu 'phag ste lus kyi gong bu bzhus nas brlan bsher gyi chu mor gyur pa'i snang ba rgyas/ glo bur du khyi skad drag tu 'tshub nas dben 'jamagyi khor yug meg med du bcom pas tshe ring chos sgrol gyi dga' bdes khyab pa'i mi lam de ru mtshams bcad/ de nas mos de'i thog bsam blo btang napa rmi lam gyi zlobras bu sgug kyang blun pos gla ro sgug pa'i dpe bzhin 'bras bu 'a/ sna ḍā py-i /nas dal du 'phags pa'i nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od snang gis yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gsal thing thing du bzos shing tshang mar skye stobs kyi tshe srog gsar pa sbyin/ de nyin yul dmag thams cad khag bgos nas ri la spyang ki gsod du song / skabs der spyang kha tsha bas 'brog pa'i phyugs rigs dkar nag la skyi g.ya' ba'i 'jigs snang ster/rgyab la me mda' khur ba'i tshe ring chos sgrol yang bu mo gnyis dang lhan du glang ma dang spen ma sogs thar thor skyes pa'i spang gseb cig tu slebs/ kho tsho gsum ka dogs zon chen pos mig gnyis chen po ldir/ ngo gdong nas yid dpang 'phrog pa'i dmar mdangs rgyas/

glo bur du spyang phrug khrid pa'i spyang ltogs sheg 'dur rgyag bzhin brgyugs yong / bu mo gsum pos mnyam du mthong bas tshe ring chos sgrol gyi ngo gdong nas dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas shing me mda' blangs/ bu mo gzhan gnyis kyi gdong nas de tsam gsal rgyu med pa'i sdug gi sprin nog 'khor nas me mda' len rgyu'ang brjed nas hon thor te 'gul med du lus/tsa kho gnyis mgyogs tsam gyis/ tshe ring chos sgrol ni glog brnyan nang gi dpa' mo zhig ltar sa la 'gyel/ jikhro phe/ pheng /mi me mda' rgyag thengs gnyis kyis spyang ma bu khrag dmar gyi da du dzikāgal so/nga / 9 tshe ring chos sgrol dga' tshor chen pos gnam mchongs sa mchongs byas nas rgyugatho rogs pa bu mo gnyis phan tshun lta res shig byas pa dang lce'ang kha nas na/ 6 khyod 'dir sgugs/ nged gnyis kyis mi 'bod chog bu mo gnyis po'i 'tshab 'tshub kyi rnam 'gyur dang 'gro lugs rim bzhin tshe ring chos sgrol gyi mig nas yal/tshe ring chos sgrol gyi lag tu me mda' bzung nas spyang ro'i g.yas g.yon du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas/ de dus mos ma'o kru'u gis bud med yul dmag la bstod pa'i snyan rtsom de yid la wa ler shar/ snyan rtsom de'i nang don phun tshogs rdo rjes 'grel bshad byed myong / snyan rtsom de rang nyid la bris pa ltar tshe ring chos sgrol gyi sems tsha sob sob tu gyur/ mos rang nyid kyi byas rjes la ha las nas kha nas rang dbang med par gsar brje'i glu chung gtong thal/rang nyid ni glog brnyan nang gi gtum drag gi dgra bo las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' mo zhig dang 'dra snyam/ 5

rim bzhin ston gyi chu mo bzhin sngo zhing dwangs ba'i mkha' dbyings su gar yong shod thabs bral ba'i sprin dmag gi 'du 'god 'tshub nas bar snang gi khams de rdza ma'i zhabs ltar nag rkyang bzos/ de nas 'brug sgra ldir ldir du bsgrags shing glog gi lce zhags ring mos gnam sa lhan du bcings/ lha 'dre khros pa'i rtags mtshan la grags pa'i ser ba skya tha ra ra babs/ dug mda' lta bu'i ser ba'i gong bu de dag gis me tog dang rtswa ljang thal ba'i rdul ltar bcom/ de dus gnyis skyes kyi bya rigs brapa gseb tu yib/ a bra dang tsi tsi sngar nas khung bu'i tshang du 'dzul zin/ tshe ring chos sgrol la nam mkhar lding ba'i gshog pa dang sa la 'dzul ba'i sbar mo med pas gab sa dang bros sa ma rnyed stabs ser rdung drag pos cung tsam min na dran med brgyal/ mo'i mgo la spang po rdog rdog grangs las 'das pa bzhag mgo btums nas bzod bsranakhyas/ yud tsamaring / mo bsam rgyu dran rgyu med par bzos/ rang byung khams chen po'i gtum spyod kyi mdun du spyang gsod kyi dpa' mo de'ang nyam chung nus med gcig tu mngon/ra tshe ring chos sgrol/ ga par yod/’ skyes pa'i skad gdangs shig lhang lhang du zlok+ta sdug/ sa rdo rje'i snyan 'jebs skad gdangs kyis tshe ring chos sgrol la sngar med kyi re ba dang dga' ba ster/ lha phun tshogs rdo rje/’ khong gnyis 'bod res byed pa'i skad gdangs lhan du 'dres nas brag ri mthon por brag ca 'khor te rang byung khams chen po'i mche gtsigs sder mo bgrad pa'i gtum spyod kya khyo shā sdor+sha ༵ kāswā/ /’ phun tshogs rdo rjes char gos khyer nas 'byor bas spyir btang min pa'i dga' tshor zhig gis tshe ring chos sgrol gyi mig nas mchi ma shoX bzhin 6 a jo phun tshogs mizhes bos nas kho'i lus la 'tham/ de dus na

chung bu mo'i ngo tsha dang la rgya gcig kyang ma lus par brjid du thal/ de nas gzhon nu pho mo gnyis dam du 'khyud res byas pas phun tshogs rdo rje'i skyes pa pho'i lus shugs kyis tshe ring chos sgrol la na zug cig ster yang de ni dgun dus me phung gi 'gram du slebs pa'i dro skyid kho na ru snang / khong gnyis grang rlung dang ser rdung med pa'i drod 'jam nyi 'od 'og tu gnas pa ltar pho mo'i brtse dung gi dga' bde'i khrod du gnas shing ser rdung drag po'ang rim bzhin gangs rākhyag chu la bsgyur ba'i brtse dung gis yid 'phrog nas je chung dang je nyung du (khyordo / ba'i bza' mo e byed/ mi 6 en/ mi bde skyid kyis rab tu myos pa'i tshe ring chos sgrol mig zim zim gyis phun tshogs rdo rje'i pang du bsnyes skyor zhig byas/ nam mkha' sprin nag je srab tu song nas ser ba babs mtshams yongs su chad pas sprin gseb nas nyi ma'i bu'i 'dzum mdangs bstan/ tshe ring chos sgrol bsu mkhan mi tsho gcig slebs/ stag bsad pa'i dpa' rgod wu sung grong tshor log pa ltar mo la dga' bsu chod med thob/ sgos su kri pu'u hru'u ci khra rgyal gyis mo khong gi nyal khang du khrid nas spyang gi bsad pa'i gnas tshul zhib tu dris pa dang/ da dung deb blangs nas zin bris kyang bkod tshul byas/ de nas khra rgyal gyis mo dang nye bar bcar thog mo'i dpung pa'i thog lag pa bzhag cing mo'i nag snum gyi skra lo'ang 'chang 'chang byed bzhin 6 khyod ni 'brog dbul 'brog 'bring 'og ma'i khyim du skyes pa'i gsar brje'i yul dmag bzang po zhig red ’ ces bstod bsngags byas/ khra rgyal hru'u ci'i mdzo'i mig lta bu de dang kha nang nas 'thor yong ba'i kha chus tshe ring chos sgrol sdod bzod mi bde bzos pas mos da nga 'gro gi yin ’ zhes bshad nas shar rer phun tshogs rdo rje'i sdod khang du song /phun tshogs rdo rje mgo bo gug nas smin mtshams su gnyer ma'i tsho/ bu

bsdus nas gang zhig la mno bsam byed bzhin mchis/ tshe ring chos sgrol rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab kyis nang du slebs pa mthong yang kha ya tsam mi byed la da dung smin mtshams kyi gnyer mdud ma zhig tshe ring chos sgrol yang de mur ci bya gtol bral du gyur nas ngo gdong gi 'dzum mdangs yal te langs na langs mi shes pa bsdad na sdod mi shes par gyur/ tsa sdod/ khyod ja blugs nas thungs/ sna gang byas pa red/ lus po mi bde ba 'dug gam/mi tshe ring chos sgrol gyi mig gnyis che ru song ste lus yongs nas dngangs 'tshab cig skyes/66bud med kyis spyang ki bsad dus/ mi tshos khyod la gang zer gyi yod na/ phun tshogs rdo rjes dbugs ring zhig btang /66ga re/’ tshe ring chos sgrol ha las hang sangs/ mig ldir/ kha gdang /rang nyid kyi rna la yid ma ches pa ltar ngo gdong dri tshig gis khengs/ yud tsam song rjes tshe ring chos sgrol gyis spobs pa chen pos/ 6 nga ni dar dmar 'og tu 'tshar longs byung ba'i gzhon nu red/ bsam blo rnying pa dang rmongs dad kyi shod tshul la skrag dgos don gang yod/mi 6 goms srol zer ba de mi rnams kyi rus pa'i gting du 'thim yod pas snang chung bzhag na ga la 'grig khyod yul 'dir 'tsho ba skyel dgos dus spyang ki bsad pa de nor ba red/’ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis ci'ang mi smra bar cung tsam bsdad rjes mgo skra phar dbyug tshur dbyug 'ga' byas te/ lha ngo ma ngas mi nor bzhag kha nas mar le ring lugs/ don du bzo bcos ring lugs zer ba de dang red/ lhan/’ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis slar yang ring rgyu med pa'i mgo sku de dbyug dbyug gis hob ste yar langs nas phyir thon rtsis byas/8 6 ngas khyod la yag yag byas nas bshad pa yin/ ma gzhi ngas de sdug pa

brtsi gi med/’ phun tshogs rdo rje'ang 'tshab 'tshub ngang langs byung /6 shod mi dgos/ stag gi ri mo phyi/ mi'i ri mo nang zhes pa ngo ma bden/ ’tshe ring chos sgrol phu 'tshub 'tshub kyis sgo nas thon/nyin shas kyi rjes la/ kung hre'i las byed dang yul dmag yongs kyi tshogs chen 'tshogs nas kri pu'u hru'u ci khra rgyal gyis kung hre'i gtan 'bebs khyab bsgrags byas/ gtan 'bebs kyi nang don gnyis te/ gcig de sngon kung hre'i drung yig phun tshogs rdo rjes rmongs dad kyi lta ba bzung nas tshe ring chos sgrol gyis lug gsod spyang ki tshar bcad par dkrog gtam bzos pas kho'i kung hre'i drung yig gi go sa med pa bzos nas 'brog me'i nang phyir bslog rgyu/ gnyis/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis spyang ki gnyis tshar bcad nas mi dmangs kyi ched du byas rjes bzhag pa ma zad/ phun tshogs rdo rje'i dkrog gtam ther 'don byas pas phun tshogs rdo rje'i tshab byas nas kung hre'i drung yig bya rgyu red/de'i phyi dro rang la/ phun tshogs rdo rjes rang nyid kyi nyal gdan rta la bkal nas kha ya byed mkhan mi gcig kyang med par khu sim mer log nyin shas rmi lam du btang ba'i bu mo des mtha' mjug kho pa dri ngan bro ba'i skyag lud nang g.yug pa red/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis kho log 'gro skabs zur zhig nasag ler bltas pas/ sems kyi gting nas shod dka' ba'i skyo snang zhig skyes/ rang nyid kyi byed stangs la bsam gzhigs zab mo mi byed ka med byung /mos phun tshogs rdo rjer 'grel bshad cig byed 'dod/ phun tshogs rdo rjes tshe ring chos sgrol ma mthong ba'am yang na ma mthong mdog byas pa gang yin mi shes kyang khos tshe ring chos sgrol la lta tsam yang ma byas par rta kha khrid nas phyin/kung hre der skad grags yod pa'i gzhi rim las byed de'i chab srid kyi mdun lam de ru yongs su mtshams bcad pa'i bzhi shad cig brgyab/tshe ring chos sgrol mig hrig hrig gis rim bzhin je chung je chung 'gro cho'i

phun tshogs rdo rje'i rgyab gzugs la lta/ glo bur du ser ba'i nang slebs pa'i phun tshogs rdo rje yid la 'khor bas skyo snang gis khog pa khengs nas mchi mas mgrin pa brnangs/ da lta rang nyid sngon thon byas pa'i dga' tshor gar med du yal/ gnam sa lhan du sbrel ba'i mtshams su phun tshogs rdo rje yang rim bzhin mo'i 'dren byed nas yal/ mo'i sems don gyis dben pa'i stong lhang lhang du gyur/ 6 gang la bltas yod/mi kyi pu'u hru'u ci khra rgyal mo'i rgyab tu langs 'dug6 ā/ nga / mi ma ring chos sgrol gyi kha nas skad cha ci'ang ma thon pas rtab rtob kyis mgo shig brad tsam byas/lha khyod kyis gang bsam ngas shes/ khyod kyi byed stangs rbad de 'grig pa red/ ngo gnongs dgos pa'i bya ba ci'ang med/ ’tsa en/’ tshe ring chos sgrol mgo bo smad nas bsdad/6 'gro/ nga'i nang du/ ngas khyod la skad cha kha shas shod rgyu yod/mi khra rgyal hru'u ci'i bza' zla dang bu phrug 'brog pa'i nang yod pas shang thog tu kho gcig pu red/khra rgyal hru'u cis sha dang gro bton nas tshe ring chos sgrol gyi mdun du bzhag ste/ 6 de ring nas khyod ni shang gi las byed cig yin pas 'brog pa dkyus ma dang 'dra sa med/ khyod kyi sdod khang ni phun tshogs rdo rje'i khang pa na/’ 66nga la yon tan med pas las kur dka' ngal chen po yong sa red/’ 6 da skyon med/ ga ler goms yong / ngas thams cad bslab chog mi khra rgyal mig zim zim gyis tshe ring chos sgrol gyi 'gram du bsdad/ mo'i lag 'go nas bcangs te 6 ngas thengs ma dang po khyod mthong dus gang bsam yod khyod kyi/ ṭī shes/’

6 ci bsam byung /mi 6 khyod nga'i bza' mo bya dgos snyam/’ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi ngo mdog glo ba ltar dmar por gyur/ de dus mun nag gi yol bas thams cad rab rib tu bzos pas khra rgyal gyis shel yol brgyab nas mar me spar/ cung tsam ring khang chung 'jam thing du gnas pas tshe ring cho~X sgrol gyi rna lam du khra rgyal gyi dbugs kyi rgyu ba myur nas myur du song ba'ang khra byel/ 'dod chags kyis bzi nas lus po la kha'i dar lcog bzhin ling ling du 'dar bzhin tshe ring chos sgrol gyi chas gos 'og nas mo'i dkar zlum gyi nu mar 'chang / 6 nga'i snying sdug ces brjod bzhin mchu'ang tshe ring chos snyel gyi phyogs su bsrings/ 6 de 'dra ma byed/ khyod bza' zla yod mkhan zhig 7tshe ring chos sgrol gyis ga ler kho'i lag 'og nas e thar byas/6 nga la yid ches gyis/ ngas sang nyin rang bza' mo dang kha bral te khyod dang chang sa brgyab chog 〉zer nas tshe ring chos sgrol pang du blangs nas mo'i ngo gdong gang sar myos pa ltar 'o byas/tshe ring chos sgrol gyi lus sbrid sman brgyab pa ltar rim bzhin khra rgyal gyis yongs su kha lo bsgyur thub pa'i rtsed chas shig ltar gyur pa ma zad/ rang dbang med par khra rgyal gyi mgrin pa nas 'khyud/ mi ring bar/ kho gnyis pho khebs nang du mdza' gcugs gser thag gis bcings pa'i khyo shug ltar gyur/de nas bzung tshe ring chos sgrol kri pu'u hru'u ci khra rgyal gyi zur bsten chung mar gyur bas/ de ni kung hre'i las byed tshang mas shes pa'i gsang ba zhig tu gyur/ de ring tshe ring chos sgrol gcig pu khu sim mer nang du bsdad pas yid la mi shar dgu shar byung / slar yang dmag khungs nas log pa'i kung hre'i1 sdu rdzi

des mo la mig zur blta bzhin yod pa yid la shar/ khos khra rgyal chus thog tu song ba'i skabs dang bstun nas tshe ring chos sgrol gyi nang du 'dzul nas skad cha tshig re gnyis bshad rjes shog chag cig bzhag ste phyir thon/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis myur du kha phyes nas lta dus/ 6 khu byug dbyar la dga' dga'/ dga' mkhan mi 'dug ma gsung / nga yis khyod la dga' dga'/ su yis 'gran pa mi 'dug ces bris 'dug tshe ring chos sgrol dgod tsam byas rjes yi ge lcags thab nang g.yug de dus mo'i sems yod tshad khra rgyal gyis bslus zin/rjes su tshe ring chos sgrol gyis de'i skor khra rgyal la bshad pas/ skabs der khra rgyal gyis 'dzum tsam byas pa las khros pa'i rnam 'gyur ci'ang ma bstan mod/'on kyang de nas bzung dus rgyun khra rgyal gyis mthong che ba'i rta dzi de mthong med du gyur/ mtha' mjug rta dzi pho gzhon de rta'i gzan chas brkus pa'i skyon gyis 'brog pa'i nang phyir bslog gzan chas rkus pa'i rgyab kyi gsang ba'i rgyu mtshan shes mkhan khra rgyal dang tshe ring chos sgrol las med/ rta rdzis kyang rgyu mtshan ngo ma ma rtogs pas rang nyid kyis rta chas rgya ma lnga brkus nas za rgyu ma ldang ba'i rang gi sring mo la sprad par 'gyod pa tshad med skyes pa'i bzo bstan glo bur du tshe ring chos sgrol gyi che ru 'gro ba'i grod pa'i nang nas tshe srog gi 'gul skyod byed pa tshor bas mo'i lus hril por spyir btang min pa'i brel zing zhig gis khyab/ mu mthud blo rnal du phab nas sdod ma thub pas mos slar yang khra rgyal gyi khang pa'i sgo rdung / deng skabs khra rgyal gyis grod pa ldir ba'i tshe ring chos sgrol g.yol gang thub byed/ chang sa rgyag rgyu phar ri'i ri la zhog khra rgyal zhes bos nas sgo rdung yang sgo'ang mi phye/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis sems sdug dang khong khro yod tshad khu tshur thog bsdus nas sgo mo drag tu brdungs pas khra rgyal 'u thug nas sgo phyes/ nye char gsar du kung hre'i slob churdo ༵ las bgos byas pa'i bu mo de mgo skra zang zing du gyur nas sgo phyir thon

pa dang mgo bo smad nas shar rer rgyug song / khra rgyal gyis rnam 'gyur grang shur shur ngang ra nga la gzhung las yod/ khyod las ka gang yod ces smras/dus rgyun lug las gshes ka 'jam pa'i tshe ring chos sgrol rab tu khros/6 las ka edri/ nga'i grod khog mthong gi mi 'dug gam/mi ༷sa/ /byes nga la skad cha gsal po zhig shod/ ga 'dra byed kyi yin/’ khra rgyal u tshugs kyis 'dzum tsam byas nas 6 'di ngas khyod la pham kha med pa bzos chog khyod sdod dang / //pa /sdo /sdong mnyam du sdod 'dod kyang / bza' mos gtan nas khas len mi 4byed/ rdad gnyis la phru gu gsum yod/ mi6 phu gu skyes tshar dus ngas pha'i 'os 'gan bsgrub nges yin/ mtha' mjug nga khyod dang mnyam du sdod rgyu gtan 'khel yin/’ tshe ring chos sgrol ci'ang mi smra bar bsdad/ khong khro'i me lce ga ler zhi/khra rgyal ni 'dod chags kyis bzi ba ltar dbugs hal hal gyis grod pa ldir ba'i bud med de dang 'khyud/nyin shas song rjes la/ tshe ring chos sgrol nyal khri'i thog khu sim mer bsdad nas grod pa'i nang gi phru gu la bal gyi stod gos bslas/ mo'i brtse dung ma lus lcags thur gyi rtse mo nas skud pa'i thog thim pa byas/ glo bur du/ sgo drag tu rdung ba'i sgra rna lam du lhung /tshe ring chos sgrol gyis sgo phyes te lta dus/ ngo nag po sol ba'i mdog ldan pa'i bud med cig khu tshur bsgrengs nas langs 'dug yogazhang 'tshong ma/dpa' yod na thon shogal ngar skad ldir ldir du sgrog byis pa mang sdi /ga

dpung rogs ltar rjes su ha ha ho ho'i ngang slebs/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis sems gting nas tshod dpag byas pa ltar de ni khra rgyal gyi bza' mo red/ khra rgyal gyi bza' mo bzang skyid kung hrer 'byor nas gang sar ngu skad kyis bkang dus/ chus kyi hru'u ci'ang kung hrer bsdad yod/bzang skyid kyis ma lag myur pos tshe ring chos sgrol gyi skra nas 'then/ tshe ring chos sgrol yang khros nas shugs kyis lus po bskor 'then zhig byas pas bzang skyid zur du sgyel/ bzang skyid myur du yar langs nas phar lta tshur lta byas pas chus kyi hru'u ci de ru 'byor ba mthong bas 6 gzhang tshong ma des mi gsod kyi 'dug ces skad shugs chen pos ngus pa dang byis pa zhig ltar slar yang thal ba'i nang du 'gyel nas 'gre slog brgyab/lha ma ngu/ log 'gro/ skad cha yod na ga ler shod/’ bzang skyid kyi rna ba'i lam du mi rnams kyi kha ta bslab bya gtan nas mi 'gro bar 6 gzhang 'tshong ma 'dis nga'i rgad po 'phrog song / nga tsho bza' nyob su la brten dgos red ’ zer te ngu shugs che ru btang nas sa steng du 'gre ldog brgyab/ lus kyi gos ma lus thal rdul 'gos nas skya lhog lhog tu bzos/tshe ring chos sgrol yang zur zhig tu skad shugs dma' pos ngu bzhin mchis mi mang che bas bzang skyid dang gdung sems mnyam skye byed pa las spyang ki gsod mkhan gyi bud med der blta tsam yang mi byed/ tshe ring chos sgrol sems pham pa dang lhan du ngo tsha nas skad shugs chen pos ngus nas shar rer rba rlabs drag tu 'khrug pa'i gtsang po'i 'gram du rgyugasmyo khra rgyal/ khyod kyis bza' mo phar khrid/ wa ye/ tshe dbang khyod song nas tshe ring chos sgrol nga'i sdod sar khrid shog de ni chus ud hru'u ci pa sangs kyi bka' red/14khra rgyal gyis da dung ngu bzhin pa'i bza' mo khrid nas log song / de

dus mi rnams ngo mtshar gyi glog brnyan mtshams bzhag pa ltar so so'i khyim du log kha shas kyis tha na yid phang pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig kyang bstan/chus kyi spyi zhabs pa tshe dbang gcig pu dbugs hal bzhin mdun du rgyug pa'i tshe ring chos sgrol gyi rjes 'den/dus rgyun rgyal ba byams pa'i bzo ldan pa'i 'dzum dmul dmul gyi skyes pa de swākā tram̐ /lja /sna ngo mdog dmar nag tu gyur 'dugatshe ring chos sgrol nyam chung gis chus ud kyi hru'u cir lta tsam byas shing khums khums kyis sa ru bsdad/ skabs der/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi sems nang rgyun du pha mar brtsi ba'i dpon po der gdong pa bstan mi shes pa'i snang ba zhig skyes/ mo'i mig nang mchi ma nyil nyil du gang bas mtshan mo'i mkha' dbyings kyi 'od 'tsher ba'i skar ma chen po zhig ltar snang /lha ga 'dra byas pa red/ gsal po shod dang / tshe ring chos sgrol gyi kha 'gul tsam gyis lan rgyag pa'i bzo zhig bstan yang kha nas skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma thon/6 bzang skyid kyis bshad pa de e bden/ ’66de/’ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi mig nas mchi ma nar nar du 'bab bzhin mos rang nyid dang khra rgyal bar gyi 'brel ba khab skud pa gcig kyang ma lus par hrusakhyo rdo lda kāsha theg/ rgyug ngos len yi ge zhig bris shog so tshe ring chos sgrolta log rjes/ hru'u cis tshe dbang btang nas khra rgyal de ru sa/ khra rgyal gus gu/ zhum zhum gyis hru'u ci'i sdod khang du 'dzul nas lag tu khyer ba'i mar grod ril de hru'u ci'i mdun gyi sgrog tse'i thog tu bzhaki /sa

ra 'dir gsol mar phran bu zhig yod ces bshad nas hru'u ci'i zur du bsdad nas mgo shig brad tsam dang lce mo snar tsam byas/zu sprad pa red dam btsong pa red/’ lha phul ba yin/ mi khra rgyal gyi ngo mdog rbad de 'gyur yang u tshugs kyis kha bgrad bgrad kyis dgod tsam byas/tsa mar ril 'di mngar chas btum pa'i mde'u e red/ ’66de 'dra ga la yin/ nga la nor 'khrul yod/ 6 nor 'khrul yod na tshig gcig kyang sba gsang med par mar shod dang / ’tsa gtso bo tshe ring chos sgrol zer ba'i bud med der rag las yod/ ’4shog bu'i nang du me btum thub kyi ma red/ khyod kyis sba gsang gang byas 'dug na tan tan las sla po 'jog gi min/’ phyi ru grang rlung ldang ba'i dus der khra rgyal ni 'ur 'ur me 'gram du bsdad pa bzhin ngo gdong nas rngul chu nar nar du bab pas sku'ang rlon par gyur zhing mgonas rlangs pa 'thul/ kho'i klad pa rdo bzhin mkhregs pa 'di ngang gis brtul bas khos ci byas thams cad ngos len byas/de nas nyin shas kyi rjes su khra rgyal gyi go sa phab pa ma zad kung hre'i las byed nang nas kyang phyir 'bud byas/nyi ma de nyin nas bzung / de sngon tshe ring chos sgrol gyi spyang gsod byas rjes la gzengs bstod chen po byed myong mkhan gyi khra rgyal gyis kyang tshe ring chos sgrol ni spyang ki bsad mkhan 'dre mo yin lugs gang sar bshad/ tha na deng gi dus su khra rgyal rgan po ni tshe 'di phyi dang las rgyu 'bras kha nas mi bral ba'i chos pa zhig la 'gyur yang da dung nyam chung gi bud med tshe ring chos sgrol la dma' 'bebs rgyu'i kha las de bskyur med/16

gsum/tshe ring chos sgrol ni kun yid cig car 'phrog pa'i mdzes ma zhig nas tshang mas rnam rtog byed pa'i 6 'dre sor mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig ni/khra rgyal las khungs nas phud rjes/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis rang skyon rang brjod nan po byas rjes sngar bzhin kung hre'i las byed nang du bzhag zla shas song rjes/ tshe ring chos sgrol la byis pa zhig skyes kyang nyin gsum ma 'gor bar tshe ma zin/dus kyi byed por lha 'dre lta bu'i nus mthu ldan pas tshe ring chos sgrol sems gting gi rma kha rim bzhin sos su bcug la yid skyo ba'i gnas tshul thams cad ma byung ba bzhin yid kyi me long ngos nas phyis/ byung bzhin pa'i skabs la shi'ang mi 'gyod pa'i bya ba zhig yin yang dus bzhi'i brje po kha shas byas rjepa de ni brjed la nye ba'i dran gso zhig dang dgod slong byed cig tu 'gyur tshe (/nga chos sgrol ni sngar bzhin skyes pa tshos thob par 'dod pa'i mdzes ma zhig yin/ mo la thengs dang po'i brtse dung pham nyes su song ba'i bslab bya yod pas mo thob par bya rgyu ni de 'dra'i las sla po ga la yin/yangs pa'i rtswa thang ni rin po che'i za 'og tu mngon la/ me tog dkar dmar dang rtsi shing sna tshogs ni za 'og gi thog rnam par bkra ba'i ri mo ru grub/bsil bsil 'jam 'jam gyi rlung bus me tog gi dri zhim gang sar 'khyer/ sngo lhang lhang gi mkha' dbyings su rab dkar pad+ma'i chun po'i rjes la 'gro ba'i chu 'dzinagyi phung po dal gyis rgyu/ de dus stag lta bu'i pho gzhon zhig shadi /ba

chung la las bgos byas pas/ na chung bu mo rnams la gleng gzhi gsar pa zhig mang du song ba red/pho gzhon de'i ming la bkra shis stobs rgyas zer zhing pha yul grong khyer nas red/ kho thog mar rtswa thang du 'byor dus rtswa thang gi mtha' mi mngon pa'i yul ljongs dang rab tu gtsang ba'i mkha' dbugs/ gang sar mthong rgyu yod pa'i phyugs dkar nag gi 'phag 'tshag bcas kyis ri mo'i 'jig rten nang slebs par ltar blo rbad de tshims nas ngo gdong nas shod mi shes pa'i dga' tshor zhig snang mod kyang / gsar pa kun rnying pa dang ngo mtshar kun rgyun ldan la 'gyur dus pho gzhon de'i gdong pa'i thog gi 'dzum mdangs rim bzhin yal/ ma bos pa'i mgron po ste kher rkyang gi sdug bsngal zhig kho'i don lnga snod drug dang ba spu'i khung bu re re bzhin thim nas nyi ma lo las ring ba'i sdug mgo thog tu bab/nyin gung gi zas zos rjes bkra shis stobs rgyas sgo 'gram gyi rdo leb thog bsdad nas chung dus kyi gnas tshul 'ga' phyir dran byas pas thams cad glog brnyan bstan pa bzhin mig mdun du khra lham med shar bas rang dbang med par khor dgod shor/66rgan lags/ khyed gcig pur dgod gnang gi e yod/ 66o/ su/ ga re/mi bkra shis stobs rgyas kha skyengs/ ngo tsha/ mdun du langs pa ni sa cha 'di'i thog gi bu mo mdzes shos de yin pa mthong dus rang nyid kyi lkugs rtags la brjod mi shes pa'i gnongs 'gyod cig skyes/66bzhugs dang / bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis 'tshab 'tshub kyis yar langs nas rang nyid sdod pa'i rdo leb de tshe ring chos sgrol la gzur/khong gnyis chu tshod gcig tsam skad cha bshad rjes phan tshun bar thog mardi /sa mnga' byung ba ma zad/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi re ba ltar rjes su bkra

shes stobs rgyas kyis mo la yi ge bslab rgyu byas/ de nas bzung bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis zhar zhor ga dus yin na'ang tshe ring chos sgrol la yi ge bslabs/khong gnyis bar 'brel 'dris dam zab byung bas phan tshun bar rgyus rtsam pa las zhib pa byung / bkra shes stobs rgyas kyi pha ma grong khyer nang gi las byed yin zhing slob grwa thon rjes khos rang nyid kyi mi tshe'i phugs 'dun 'grub ched rtswa thang du yong ba red/ rang nyid kyis 'tshol snyeg byed pa'i yul la dngos su slebs skabs bsam yul las 'das pa'i dka' ngal du ma 'phrad dus rang gis rang la 'khang ra yang byed myong / 'on kyang tshe ring chos sgrol dang rgyun du 'grogs pa nas bzung kho'i kheng rkyang gi sdug bsngal rnams rim bzhin nyi 'od kyis ba mo skam pa ltar gar med du bzos/ ngo ma/ khos brtse ba chen pos rang nyid rtswa thang la yong nas thob pa'i grub 'bras che shos ni tshe ring chos sgrol dang ngo shes pa de yin zhes tshe ring chos sgrol la bshad/ de'i rkyen gyis tshe ring chos sgrol gyi sems gting nas shi la nye ba'i brtse dung gi ljang bu de dpyid kyi char rlung dang 'phrad bzhin tshe srog gi 'gul skyod byas/de ni tshe sngon gyi las rlung drag pos ded pa'am yang na hru'u ci 'bum brtan gyis rkang btsugs nas bkod sgrig byas pa gang yin mi shes kyang khong gnyis lhan du glan chu rtswa thang du hwa go rlung krung dbyang gi kru'u zhi byas par dga' 'bod dang 4mi bzhi ngan tshogs la dgag pa rgyag pa'i yig cha brgyud bsgrags byed du song /yangs pa'i sa gzhi chen por lo legs kyi nyams 'gyur cig cad mngon pa ste sha shed rgyas pa'i phyugs rigs dkar nag gcig las gcig dzigagacig las gcig mdzes/ rtswa thang gi kha dog ni rin chen dang po'i khu bas lan brgyar byug pa bzhin ser lham mer snang / ston kur skye ba'i me tog 'ga' da dung ma rnyid ma skam par su las kyang mdzes pa'i 'chor sge/ zlom

bzhin dal bur ldang ba'i ston rlung gi khrod du ling ling ngang gar la rol/bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis rta rkyang po gling sgrung nang gi rta pho kyang rgod 'dra ba'i ming yang rkyang tsha zhes pa zhig bcibs/ de ni 'bum brtan hru'u cis rang nyid kyi rta bkra shis stobs rgyas la g.yar ba red/ bkra shes stobs rgyas slob grwa'i dge rgan yin pas dus rgyun gsham skyod mi dgos stabs kho la rta med/tshe ring chos sgrol gyis rang gi sger rta g.yu bya zhes pa'i rgod ma lug las gshis rgyud 'jam pa de bzhon/ mo ni gnas la 'gro ba'i bu mo zhig ltar ngo tsha smin pa'i sprin dmar zhig gis mar dkar las 'jam pa'i gdong gi ri bor 'khyud/mchu sgros pad 'dab rnam par bzhad pa'i gseb nas rab dkar mu tig gi so phreng mngon par shar zhing lus kyang 'gog mi thub pa'i 'dzum bag gi me tog lhag lha/ zlo /ṭā /stobs rgyas kyis blo rtse bsgrims nas lag gnyis kyis srab mda' dam du bzung / rta pho'i rmig lcags kyi dbyu gus sa yi rnga bo che dal nas mgyogs su rdung bas na/ bkra shes stobs rgyas kyi lag mthil nas rngul chu thon/ngo'angabyu ru'i mdog ltar dmar po gyur/ kho ni grong khyer nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i gzhon nu zhig yin pas lcags rta la goms kyang tshe srog ldan pa'i rta pho bzhon pa'i go skabs ga la mchis/ thag ring nas rta pa 'ga' 'gro ba mthong nas bkra shes stobs rgyas 'og gi rta pho de brel ba langs nas 'tsher sgra dang bcas par 'drog 'go byas/ glog 'khyug pa'i myur tshad kyis tshe ring chos sgrol de mur rjes su bskyur/ bkra shis stobs rgyas kyi rna 'gram du rlung bu 'ur 'urabyed cing mdun gyi yul ljongs kun skad cig nyid la mig lam nas yal/a tsi tsi/ khos ji ltar rta srab dam gyis bzung yang kha dgag ma thub/ rta ske nas thon pa'i g.yer dril gyi sgra'ang rim bzhin mgyogs nas mgyogs su song nadī spyad kyi bar mtshams med par gyur/ spang 'bur zhig gi 'gram du bkra

shis stobs rgyas rta thog nas lhung / ngo tsha zhig gis bkra shes stobs rgyas kyi lus hril por khyab pas rtas g.yug pa'i na zug kun brjed nas 'tshab 'tshub kyis yar langs/ rta pho'ang 'drog mtshams bzhag nas bkra shes stobs rgyas la phyir lta byed bzhin 'phya dmod kyi bzo zhig dang bcas par rtswa yi zas la rol bzhin ci'ang med pa ltar bag phebs su gnas/ngo gdong rngul chus khengs pa'i tshe ring chos sgrol 'byor zhing de mur rta las bab/ 6 ci byas byung / lus por skyon byas e 'dug mo'i mig gnyis nas sems khral dang 'tshub cha zhig ngang du shar/ 6 gang yang byas mi 'dug bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis ci'ang med pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas par da dung na zug ma zhi ba'i lus por brdab brdab byas/tshe ring chos sgrol gyis dbugs ring zhig btang rjes blo bde po'i 'dzum mdangs shig bstan nas/ 66de 'dra skrag byung /’ bkra shes stobs rgyas ngo mdog dmar por gyur nas bsdad/denas tshe ring chos sgrol gyi u tshugs 'og khong gnyis rta brje res byas/bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis tshe ring chos sgrol gyi rgod ma der bzhon/der lcags rta bzhin bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis yongs su kha lo bsgyur thub/ khong cung blo mi bde ba'i ngang nas tshe ring chos sgrol la zur lta zhig byas/sems su rang nyid skyes pa pho gzhon zhig gis gcun mi thub pa'i rta pho de bal las 'jam pa'i bu mo zhig gis gcun thub e yong snyam/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la da lta smyo ba lta bu'i rta de da lta rgod mo sngon mo dang gom pa gshibs nas dal dal gyis bskyod/dzid res ga re byas pa yin nam/mi smyo de khyod kyis rta bzhon ma myong bas red/mi 6 ngo tsha/ rta'ang bzhon mi shes/ khyod ngo ma las sla po ma red/ 9 21

6 rta bzhon rgyu las sla po red/ yon tan sbyang rgyu de khag che/ nga ni lkugs ma red/ mi6 yon tan bkra shis stobs rgyas kyis bstan bzhig tsha pos tshe ring chos sgrol la mig brda zhig byas te/ 6 da byas na nged gnyis cis kyang kha bral thabs med pa red/’ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi ngo las me las dmar ba'i mtshams sprin 'tshub bzhin rta pho la lcags tshan zhus nas bkra shis stobs rgyas de mur rgyab tu bskyur/glan chu rtswa thang la sngar nas kung hre'i las byed mi sna yong gi yod pa'i brda tho 'byor bas ru khag gi khang chung zhig gtsang ma bzos nas sgug rtswa thang du pho mo so sor nyal dgos pa'i gna' srol da lugs gang yang med pas shang gi las byed gnyis po'ang lhan du khang pa gcig nang bkod sgrig byas/ dus rgyun kun la dang dod che zhing tshang mar skyon 'don rgyu dga' ba'i bkra shes stobs rgyas kyang kha zur nas 'dzum mdangs shig bstan nas khu sim mer bsdad/ don du kho'i sems nang la brjod mi shes pa'i snang ba zhig ster yang de ni sems gting gi 'dun pa zhig yin pas ci'ang mi smra/ khos rang nyid la kun las byams pa'i bud med de dang lhan du nam yang gnas par 'dod/ tshe ring chos sgrol ni grong khyer gyi lugs srol rgyus med la rig gnas kyi slob gso thob ma myong ba'i 'brog mo zhig rang yin pas de la pho mo so sor sdod dgos pa'i skad cha ga la yod/de nas bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis sgo 'gram du nyal sa bzos shing tshe ring chos sgrol khang sbug tu blo bde pos nyal/ zla phyed tsam ring / khong gnyis las ga'i thog ram 'degs gang legs byung bas chab srid kyi las 'gan khag gzengs su thon pa'i ngang legs grub byung ba ma zad/ khong gnyis kyi nyal sa'i bkā sprag kyang nye nas nye ru song nas thams cad lhan du 'dres/ shang thog tu

slebs dus khong gnyis gnyen sgrig gi dpang yig blangs nas khrims mthun gyi bza' tshang la gyur/'tsho ba ni bu ram gyi khu ba las grub bzhin bde skyid dang mngar zhim gyis khengs/ dus tshod ni de 'dra'i 'gro mgyogs pa lā/ red ang / dgun gsum gyi gangs 'khyags dpyid kyi drod rlung gis bzhus nas slar yang rtswa thang gi skyid shos yin pa'i rdzogs ldan dbyar dus shar/ de dus de sngon gyi kung hre'i ming la shang zhes bsgyur/bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis gna' sha rkang pa zhig khyer nas gzhas gtong bzhin rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab kyis nang du log sha mog sog bzos/ 6 sus sprad byung /’ nang las la mgo 'khor ba'i tshe ring chos sgrol dgye dgye byas nas zla bo 'dzum gyis bsus/6 slob phrug gcig gi phas bskur 'dug bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis sha gtsab/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis gro brdzis/nyal khri'i thog tu tsog bur bsdad pa'i byis pa mgo chen po de'ang pha ma gnyis la phyogs nas dga' bas kha brda lag brda byed/ na chung gi bza' mi gnyis shod mi tshar ba'i skad cha'i khrod du las kur rol/ dgong mo mun pa rub dus gzhi nas sha mog sog tshos/ khong gnyis lhan du bsdad nas sha mog mog za bzhin 'di khyod kyis bzos pas nga 'dra/ 'di ngas bzos pas khyod 'dra zhes phan tshun ku re smra bzhin ha ha ho ho'i khrod du gnas/ltojos nas yud tsam song rjes bkra shis stobs rgyas kyi grod pa cung mi bde bar gyur/ des na/ khos chu khol phor pa gang btung nas snga tsam nyal/tshe ring chos sgrol gyis kho la nyal gos bkab rjes zur gnyis nas mnan mnan byas rjes mo rang bzhu mar 'og tu bsdad nas khu sim pos bkra shes stobs rgyas la bal gyi stod gos bslas/ khong gnyis kyi bu snga sa nas gnyid du yur zi13/

bkra shes stobs rgyas kyi grod pa'i nang 6 'dzam gling dmag chen ’ langs bzhin yod pas na zug sngar bas che ru song / mu mthud bzod sgom ma thub par a ra ra zhes sdug skad dbang med shor/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis myur du lag nang gi las ka bzhag nas sman pa btsal yang stabs ma legs pa zhig la de nyin shang gi sman pa rang yul du ma la lta ru phyin pas shang thog la bsdad med/tshe ring chos sgrol gyis dud tshang re re bzhin gyi sgo brdungs nas sman e rnyed dang na zug 'jag thabs e thub byas/ shang thog gi mi tshang ma zang zing du bzos/ sman 'dra min sna tshogs thob pas myur du na zug che nas che ru 'gro ba'i bkra shis stobs rgyas kyi kha la ldud/ 'on te phan pa ci'ang ma thon/ bkra shis stobs rgyas kyi grod pa'i nang gri dang mdung gis 'dzing mo rgyag pa bzhin na zug gtong / bkra shis stobs rgyas kyi lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas rngul chu phrum phrum du thon nas gnam sa thams cad a slog brgyab pa ltar gyur/ mtshan mo'i chu tshod gnyis pa tsam la bkra shes stobs rgyas kyis tshe ring chos sgrol gyi lag 'go nas dam du 'jus nas tsa nga'i bu zer bzhin tshe srog gi rgyu ba chad nas 'brug stong dus gcig bsgrags kyang go rgyu tshor rgyu med pa'i bem gzugs su gyur/ de dus kho'i bu gnyid kyis bzi nas kha nas 'dzum mdangs shig bstan/de las bltas na/ kho'i rmi lam gyi zhing du shar ba ni dngos yod kyi ldog phyogs shig yin nges red/tshe ring chos sgrol gyis gnam sa gas pa'i ngu 'bod byed bzhin sngar nas rnam shes kyi drod yal ba'i ro dang 'thams nas mi glod/ shang gi las byed rnams sngar bas 'tshab 'tshub zang zing du gyur/ yun ring sprin nag gi 'du 'god 'tshub pa'i bar snang nas sngar med kyi drag char zhig babs nas dus rgyun gtan nas 'phrad thabs med pa'i gnam sa /spras lhan du sbyar/ ldir ldir gyi 'brug sgra ni bar snang dbyings kyi skar

ma'igo la zhig gas nas thal rdul du 'gro ba ltar snang la 'khyug 'khyug byed pa'i glog zhags ni dmar lam lam du dbyug pa'i gdon 'dres tshe srog 'khyer ba'i dug gi lce mo ru mngon stabs skye bo mang po'i lus kyi ba spu zing nas snying kha nang du lhung ba'i snang ba ster/ skyi g.ya' ba'i mtshan mo der shang thog gi bsam blo yod pa'i mi tshang ma skrag snang gi khrod du gnas/6 shi po brjed sla mizhes pa'i gna' dpe las ma 'das par zla ba gcig tsam song rjes bkra shis stobs rgyas zhes pa'i mi zhig zas dug drag pos mnar du bcug nas 'chi bdag gis 'khrid pa'i 'khun sgra brjed pa ltar tshe ring chos sgrol phud pa'i mi gzhan dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang rang nyid la dbang ba'i 'tsho bar rol/ tshe ring chos sgrol ngus drags nas mig chu zad pa ltar mchi ma'i rgyun chad kyang mig gnyis skrang zhing sbos nas zum la nye/ skra yi lhas ma dbyar gyi rtswa ngan ltar zang zing du snang / gnam sa'i bar mi shong ba'i sdug bsngal drag po rang nyid gcig pos bzod sgom bya rgyu las med/rdzong thog tu tshogs 'dur song ba'i shang gi hru'u ci 'bum brtan shang thog tu phyir log khong gis tshe ring chos sgrol la mo'i khyo bo 'das po'i pha ma gnyis shang thog tu yong rtsis 'dug ces bshad/tshe ring chos sgrol hon thor nas lus/ sems gting nas gnong 'gyod drag po zhig ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes/ gal srid rang nyid kyis de dus khong la ltas ngan gyi gna' sha'i mog sog de za ma bcug na gnam sa zhig pa'i bar chadade ga la yong snyam/ pha ma rgan rgon gnyis pos rang nyid kyi mig 'bras ltar gces pa'i bu de mi yul las kha bral dus ji 'dra'i sdug bsngal drag po zhig gis mnar med dam/ gal srid sdug bsngal de dag rang nyid gcig pus dang du len rgyu yod na mos sdug bsngal gyi ri bo rgyab tu blangs nas khe ru mas sdug bsngal gyi mya ngam thang chen 'grim nges red/ 'o tsi/ pha ma gnyis sbyizlos

dus gang gis sne len byed dgos sam/ sha'ang med/ deng gi dus su rang nyid la sha nyo byed kyi dngul ni med/ lo shas kyi dngul gsog phran bu gshin po'i rjes 'jug la song / gang byas na drag tshe ring chos sgrol mu mthud rkub sa la btsugs thabs bral/ mo'i sems la lug gcig nyo dgos snyam/ de nas mos dud tshang re re bzhin sgo brdung nas dngul g.yar rgyu e rnyed bltas/dus rgyun mthun po yod pa'i mi de tshos 'gag rtsar thug dus rang nyid la snying rjekhyed kyi med pa tshor/ rjes su 'bum brtan hru'u cis rang nyid tha mag nyo spyad kyi dngul de skar gcig ma lus par tshe ring chos sgrol la g.yar/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi mig gnyis nas mchi ma nyil nyil du gyur/tshe ring chos sgrol gyis da dung gzhan nas nyal khri g.yar/ nyal gzan g.yar/ za chog chog btung chog chog sdod chog chog byung rjes cung blo bde nas rang nyid kyis gtan nas mthong ma myong ba'i sgyug po dang sgyug mo sguganyin gnyis par/ rgan gon gnyis slebs 'dug de dus tag tag tshe ring chos sgrol bsdad med/ mo 'brog pa'i nang du rgan rgon gnyis sne len byed spyad zho phran tsam e thob byed du song / rgan gon gnyis kyis thad kur 'bum brtan hru'u ci btsal/ hru'u cis khong gnyis la ja lto sprad rjes tshe ring chos sgrol gyis kho tsho sdod chog chog za chog chog byed lugs bshad/ rgad po de'i ngo gdong nag rog ger ci'ang mi smra/ rgad mos myur du 6 nged gnyis 'dre mo de'i nang sdod kyi min/ mos khyo ga zos pa red mi ces ngar ngar sdang sdang gis bshad/hru'u cis ji ltar go skon slob gso byas kyang mgo brag las mkhregs pa'i gon gon gnyis po'i blo mi 'gyur/ hru'u ci thabs zad nas khong gnyis la khang stong zhig bkod sgrig byas/tshe ring chos sgrol gyis 'brog pa'i nang nas bu khrid cing zho'ang khyer nas 'ardo// de dus mo'i ngo nas yun ring yal ba'i 'dzum mdangs shig slar yang

mngon/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis bu'i a mye dang a yas 'byor ba shes dus 'tshab 'tshub kyis dus rgyun tshogs 'du 'tshogs sa'i shang gi khang chung de'i nang du 'dzul/6 dka' e song / rgan rgon gnyis po des dgod mi shes pa ltar mig gnyis ngar ngar hur hur gyis mo la bltas pas tshe ring chos sgrol skrag nas rang dbang med par gom pa 'ga' phyir 'then byas rjes shod rgyu'i skad cha ma rnyed/ slar yang gom pa kha shas mdun du spos nas blo khog chen pos bu la 6 khyod kyi a mye dang a yas red ’ ces bshad pas dus rgyun bstan gshig tsha ba'i gyis pa de'ang ngo gdong la khros pa'i rnam 'gyur las med pa'i mi rgyus med gnyis mthong dus ci'ang smra mi phod par ma'i gdong la lta tsam lta tsam byed pa las skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma thon/66'dre mo khyod/ nga'i bu zos 'dug rgad mo de langs nas phu thung g.yas brdzis g.yon brdzes kyis sdug bsngal gyis zang zing du gyur pa'i tshe ring chos sgrol gyi skra nas bzung / tshe ring chos sgrol hon thor nas mche gtsigs sder bgrad kyi rgan mo de'i rgyag rdung yongs su dang len byas/ de dus byis pa chung chung de ma'i phyogs su langs nas rang nyid kyi ma nyes rdung byed mkhan gyi rgan mo de'i rkang pa nas 'then/ rgan po de myur du langs nas byis pa pang du blangs/ byis pas ji ltar ngus nas thar thabs byas kyang gtan nas ma thar/rgan mos gzhan la nyes rdung btang bar blo ma tshim par rang nyid la mi gzhan gyis rgyag rdung phog pa ltar sngar bas skad shugs chen pos ngus nas tsu 'dre mo/'dre mo rgad mo de'i kha nas skya 'tshub 'tshub byed pa'i mchil ma dang lhan du dmod tshig rgyun mi chad par thon/shangagi mi chos tshor bas rgan mo de tshe ring chos sgrol gyi lus nas par 'then/ da lta nga rgyal gyis myos pa'i rgad mo de ngal nas lus po'ang 'a/lha mi

thub pa ltar sgyid lug gis zur zhig la bsdad nas mo rang gcig pu ngus/ tshe ringachos sgrol yang mi rnams kyis g.yas skyor g.yon skyor byas nas mo rang gi khang pa'i nang du bskyal/ mi mang po zhig mo dang gdung sems mnyam skye byas te kha ta slob gso dang bslab bya byas/ ngo ma/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyis khong gnyis la de lta bu'i dri ma med pa'i gangs dkar kyi sems shig bstan yang mo la thob pa ni gtum drag gi rgyag rdung dang gdong 'dre khros pa'i rnam 'gyur red/chang lan chu yis 'jal zhes pa'i dpe de de 'dra'i don la gnas/tshe ring chos sgrol nang du log rjes rang nyid kyi bu dang 'thams nas drag tu ngus/ bu'ang rang dbang med par mig chu nar nar du shor/ ma bu gnyis kyi mig chu lhan du 'dres nas tshe ring chos sgrol gyi kha nang du lhung bas sdug bsngadī sdis khengs pa'i 'tsho ba ltar de ni mngar zhim dang bral ba'i tshwa khu dang skyur de/ phyi/ nyin/ rgan gon gnyis po slar yang hru'u ci'i nang du yong nas khongaganyis thengs 'dir yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni pha med pa'i bu de khrid rgyu'i chen du yin zhes bshad/ hru'u cis rgan rgon gnyis kyis kha sang gi byed stangs la khong khro za ba'i thog de ltar smras dus sngar bas khong khro langs nas/zu de gtan nas 'grig gi ma red/ hru'u ci'i ngo mdog dmar nag tu gyur//gaXnyis che rnyi ldir nas khra gor gor gyi mig gnyis gdong thog nas thon la ba' phyung ma ba sna la/ sa thabs shes mi 'dug gal srid phru gu dogrong khyer nang khridan phyogs gang ci'i cha rkyen legs pas rjes su'ang slob grwa yag por 'gro chog pas khong la mdun lam yag po zhig thob nges red/ de ltar na nged kyi bu shi mkhan de'i bdag med kyi rnam shes kyang blo bde rgyu red ’ ces zer nas rgad po swā ༵ la nye/

tsa rgan sku mkhyen/ de 'dra las thabs shes mi 'dug mi gad mo de hru'u ci'i mdun du pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas sems sdug chen pos ngus/hru'u cis rgan gon gnyis kyi mig chu mthong dus ngar yang rim bzhin zhi nas 〉tshab be 'tshub bes rang nyid kyi mdun du pus mo btsugs pa'i rgan mo de yar t+t+waṃ/ nga tshe ring chos sgrol dang skad cha zhig byed/ mos mos mthun 'dugan byis pa khrid/ mos blo ma mthun na khyed gnyis kyis rnyog gra ma shod/khyed tsho grong khyer nang gi mi nga tsho lung kyog gi mi dang bsdur na mthong rgya shes rgya yo/ mkhan red/ rang sdod sar mi zhog mi bsdad sar rang sdod shes pa da sa/6/ de rang byed kyi yin/ rgad pos rgad mo khrid nas log song /hru'u cis tshe ring chos sgrol gyi khang pa'i nang du 'dzul/ byis pa de bye ril gnyis sprad pas dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang phyi ru rtse mo rtsed du song /6 khyod sems ma skyo/ kha sang rgan rgon gnyis kyi byed stangs 'grig ma song / ngas khong gnyis la bshad pa yin/ de khong gnyis kyi sems nang sdug che bas byas pa red/mi tshe ring chos sgrol ci'ang mi smra bar mgo bo dud nas skad cha nyan/66ma gzhi khyod kyi 'dod pa red/ rgan rgon gnyis kyis bsam na bu de grong khyer du khrid na/ rjes su cha rkyen yod sa'i slob grwar btang chog pas kho la mdun lam yag po zhig yong nges red/mi 4min/ nga la bu 'di med na 'tsho ba ji ltar bskyal dgos/’ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi snying gris gtsab pa ltar gyur nas yid skyo ba'i mig chu lhung lhung du shor/chu ma ngu/ khyod kyis ma btang na 'grig gi red/ ngas khong gnyis la bshad chog hru'u cis tshe ring chos sgrol la da dung sems gso'i tshig sgri sdus

bshad rjes phyir logade nas nyin shas kyi rjes la/ rgan gon gnyis la bu ma thob pas phyir log rtsis byas/ khong gnyis tshe ring chos sgrol gyi sgo 'gram du chu tshod gcig tsam ci'ang ma smras par tsog bur langs rjes rta khrid nas rang nyid kyi bu'i tshe srog bor sa dang tsha bo 'tshar longs byed sa'i sa cha de dang kha bral bar btsamasdo/ dus tshe ring chos sgrol gyis bsam gzhigs nan tan zhig byas te bu a mye dang a yas kyi 'gram du bskyal nas smyo bu 'di khyod gnyis la rtsis sprod kyi yin ’ zhes bshad/6 a wa gan rgon gnyis kyis rang nyid kyi rna bar yid ma ches par re zhig hon thor nas bsdad/tshe ring chos sgrol gyis bshad zin pa'i skad cha bskyar zlos byas/rgan rgon gnyis kyi sems gting nas 'phyur ba'i dga' rlabs kyis mig mtha'anas mchi ma lhung lhung du shor/ rgad mos 6 yag byung ’ zer ba dang /bzod thabs bral ba'i 'gyod gdung drag po zhig sems khong nas lhog lhog tu rgyas te tshe ring chos sgrol la 'thams pas kha zhe gnyis med kyi mig chus tshe ring chos sgrol gyi gdong pa brlan par byas/ tshe ring chos sgrol ni bla 'khyer ba ltar rnam 'gyur ci'ang med par lha khang nang gi 'jim sku zhig ltar lus/don gyi rdog kha bstan na/ tshe ring chos sgrol gyi sha las chad pa'i bu de ngu 'bod kyi khrod du pha 'das po'i skye yul du khrid/ de nas bzung tshe ring chos sgrol dang 'grogs pa ni gzugs med kyi sdug bsngal dang nyin ltar rang nyid kyi rjes la bsnyegs pa'i grib gzugs tsam red/de nas lo mang po song ba'i skad cha zhig bshad na/ grong khyer nang slob grwaX /gro bzhin pa'i bus rtswa thab thog kher rkyang du lus pa'i skyed ma la rang

nyid kyi par zhig bskur nas rang nyid kyi brtse ba'i sems mtshon par byas/par de tshe ring chos sgrol gyi dga' grogs skyo grogs su gyur pas mo'i lus dang gtan nas bral ma myong /ri khro bo shi ba ni tshe ring chos sgrol 'dre mor 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan choganyis pa cad/ de nas mi mang pos/ tshe ring chos sgrol 'dre mo yin pas rlangs 'khor ri las zag kyang gdon 'dre'i rdzu 'phrul gyis ma shi bar go ba blangs/ tha na rlangs 'khor 'gyel ba dang lhan du mos gos kyi thu ba gshog pa byas nas sa bde sar skya ling se 'phur song zer/ yong khungs mi gsal ba'i gtam yan dag gshog pa skyes pa ltar du dud tshang re re bzhin sgo mo brdung /bzhi/'tsho ba nyams len du yong ba'i rtsom pa po kun grol rnam rgyal gyis lam thog tu dal gyis skyod bzhin yid kyi me long gi ngos su mngon pa ni skyo gar 'ba' zhig 'khrab pa'i tshe ring chos sgrol gyi snang brnyan red la rna yi brag ngos su 'khor ba ni tshe ring chos sgrol ni 'dre mo red ces pa'i skyi g.ya' ba'i skad gdangs red/ kho rang nyid kyi lte phrag 'pho sa'i pha yul du log thengs rer dgod bro dgos pa dang / ya nga dgos pa sogs kyi bya ba du ma glog brnyan bstan pa bzhin kho'i mig mdun du 'char/ da lta khos gang mgyogs shes 'dod pa ni tshe ring chos sgrol gcig pu ji ltar byas te gson mgo thon pa de red/ des na kho'i gom kha shang srid gzhung gi gnas yul du bsgyur/shang gi khang par slebs la nye ba'i chu 'gram zhig tu byis pa kha shas rtsed mor rol bzhin gnas/ de'i 'gram du rgas nyams dod pa'i bud med /ga

g.yeng nas bsdad 'dug kun grol rnam rgyal gyis zhib tu lta dus/ de ni tshe ring chos sgrol yin nges red/ ma gzhi chung dus nas mthong ma myong rung gzhan gyis shod tshul ltar na mo'i ngo gzugs 'gyur mi 'dug 'on kyang / mo'i ngo gdong lo tshod dang mi 'tsham pa'i dka' sdug gis brkos pa'i gnyer ma chu ris ltar shar shur du mngon la/ mig gnyis ni bla srog dang bral ba'i bem gzugs ltar snang / mi rtag bya ba du mas de sngon spyang ki gsod phod pa'i bud med de denge skabs blo kha chos la phyogs pa'i a ne+e dge ma zhig ltar lag pas phreng ba bgrang bzhin kha nas mug mug gis ma ṇi drangs/ gang zhig de sngon gyi ldog phyogs la 'gyur dus 'gyur med kyi shod srol la yid ches dka' zhing 'gyur ba'i 'gro phyogs kyang sngon dpag mi shes/6 tshe ring chos sgrol ma red dam/’ kun grol rnam rgyal gyis kha brda byas/tshe ring chos sgrol skrag nas 'phag thung zhig shor/ mos gzhi nas rang nyid 'gram du mthong ma myong ba'i mi zhig slebs pa shes/ 6 khyod su yin/’ 6 nga a rgyal tshang gi bu/ ’2 lha sar yod pa'i kun grol ma red dam/ ’6 yin/ de rang yin/mi smyo nga'i bu lha sa'i nor srid slob grwar yod/ khyod kyis e shes/’ smyo ming la gang zer/ rjes su nga lta ru 'gro gi yin/mi smyo bkra shes 'bum/ ra shes song / khyod bde mo e yin/mi 6 ba bde mo yin/ dkon mchog gi bka' drin gyis ma shi tsam byung /'on kyang lci ba sgrug mkhan gyi rogs pa gzhan tshang ma oṃ ma ṇi patre hūṃ hri/’ 6 khyod bsod nams che ba'i rtags red/ ’32 nga la bsod nams e/mi mo'i cung nang du rdib pa'i mig nang mchi ma

mer meshā ga zlogro / ran song / khyod kyi bu la lan 'dra bskur rgyu e yod/mi 6 med/ nga bde mo red ces shod rogs/mi kun grol rnam rgyal brel 'tshub kyis phyin/ mi rnams kyis brjod na mo 'dre mo yin pas rlangs 'khor nas lhung yang ma shi ba red zer/ yang / tshe ring chos sgrol rang nyid kyis bshad na mo ma shi ba dkon mchog gi bka' drin yin zer/ don du mo gcig pu ji ltar gson pa yin/ 'o na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung skyob byed po zhig gnas sam/ de ni kun gyi skyabs gnas su sbyir pa'i sangs rgyas sam/ tshang ma'i skrag sa 'dre bdud e red/ de yin mi da/ 6 bu/ sgug tsam gyis dang /’ kun grol rnam rgyal gyis phyi mig lta dus tshe ring chos sgrol dbugs hal bzhin rgyug yong gi 'dug mo'i lag gnyis kyi nang du lug gi grod pas btums pa'i mar ril zhig khyer 'dug66'di nga'i bu la sprod rogs/ lhad ma 'dres pa'i 'brog mar yin/mi tshe ring chos sgrol gyi ngo gdong nas bde skyid kyi 'dzum mdangs bstan bzhin dal dal gyis log song /kun grol rnam rgyal gyi mig mdun du/ grod pas btums pa'i mar ril de 'o ma'i snying po 'bri mar min zhing de ni da dung ldig ldig tu 'phag pa'i snying dmar mo zhig 'dra la/ de'i nang gi lhan ma 'dres pa'i 'brog mar de ni ra ris gtsog sgrib kyis ma sbag pa'i gangs dkar gyi sems te mas bu la bcangs pa'i brtse sems kyi dwangs ma red/smug rlangs kyi khrod du gnas pa'i ri lung kun cha 'byed dka' ba'i rab rib kyi khrod du gnas shing / rtswa thang gi phyogs gang sar thar thor du //sa

pa'i 'brog pa'i sbra gur ni skabs re gsal la skabs re mthug tu 'gro ba'i smug rlangs kyis btums/ bsam gzhigs kyi rgya las ma grol ba'i kun grol rnam rgyal yang smug rlangs kyi seng ras dkar po'i 'og tu rab be rib be'i la lung dang 'o chu bzhin dbyer med du 'dres/

klu mo mcho/gcigame tog kha gyes pa lta bu'i lung gshong chen po de ni nor lug myur du 'phel ba'i 'brog sa ches phul du byung ba zhig red/ ngal dub kyis mnar ba'i klu mo mtsho'i mig mdun du thag ring gi shar phyogs nas mthar thag ring gi nub ri'i khrod du yal ba'i rlangs 'khor gyi gzhung lam skya thing thing de shar dus mo'i sems kyi yol ba'i ngos su dga' ba dang spro ba'i me tog cig car du bzhad/gzhung lam 'di ni dben thing thing gi rtswa bang dang 'ur chil chil gyi grong khyer lhan du sbrel ba'i khrag rtsa red/ klu mo mtshos bskal ba du mar bsgugs pa'i sems gting gi mdza' bo 'phrad pa ltar lus kyi dka' sdug ma lus de ma nyid la gzugs med du yal nas gar la rol ba'i glu ma ltar rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab kyis rgyug de nas lam zur gyi rdo pha bong chung chung de'i thog tu ngal gsos nas shar phyogs kyi lam sne la bltas te lha yi pho nya lta bu'i rlangs 'khor zhig glog 'khyug pa ltar skad cig nyid la mdun du slobs rgyur sgug des mo gu dog pa'i ri grong de nas dga' bdes khyab pa'i grong khyer du bskyal snyam/ 'on kyang mos glog 'od kyis khyab pa'i grong khyer la rgyus mnga' phran bu tsam yang med la/mos lag khyer glog bzhu'i 'od las glog ces pa de ci yin mi shes/ swā/ ri

dkar po sa la 'phos 'dra'i thog brtsegs can gyi khang chen/ smug chil chil gyi snum lam/ dngos zog ci rigs byur bur gtams pa'i tshong khang / de bzhin pho gzhon mo gzhon tsho la dbang ba'i 'khrab ra dang rol rtsed khang de dag ni pa sangs bkra shes dang kho'i rogs pa kha lo ba dgod bro po des mo la bshad pa red/ de dus pa sangs bkra shis kyi snyan cha dod pa'i skad cha mo'i rna lam du grags shing kha lo ba de'i bstan bshig tsha ba'i byed stangs mo'i mig lam du shar/de ni na ning gi gnas tshul red/ char pa zhig babs nas mtshams chod tsam la ri lung gang sar smug zhag gis btums pa'i khrod nas rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig ri lam kyag kyog brgyud nas shar lung gong ma'i grong tshor slebs/grong tsho'i nang gi khyi thams cad gnam sa gas 'dra'i ngar skad sgrog bzhin sngar nas mthong ma myong ba'i dngos po ya mtshan der rgol bar brtsams/ 'on te 'ur sgra 'byin pa'i ngar lcags kyi rta pho des gnam mchongs sa mchongs byed pa'i khyi rnams btang snyoms su bzhag nas grong tsho'i nang rdu shar rer song /klu mo mtshos kyang lag gi bal las bzhag nas mi tshogs lhan du rlangs 'khor gyi 'gram du lta bar rgyug rlangs 'khor kha bkag nas sgo phyes song / de'i nang dulog tshom can gyi kha lo ba zhig dang mgo skra su lu shig shig gi pho gzhon zhig 'dug de'i dus grong tsho'i nang gi lta rgya thos rgya che shos yin pa'i a mye lha chen brel ba'i ngang slebs byung / khong gis grong khyer nang gi gus lugs ltar pho gzhon gnyis por lag pa btang nas dga' bsu zhus pa dang de nas khong gnyis rang nyid kyi khyim du gdan drangs/klu mo mtshos sbra zur nas rgyang lta byas dus/ a mye lha chen tshang gi sbra 'gram du ras gur khra khra zhig phub pa dang / rlangs 'khor nang gi pho gzhon gnyisapos brel 'tshub ngang yar 'gro mar 'gro byed/ mi rnams kyis zer na pho gzhoX gnyis po de grong khyer nas rtswa thang thog tu dmangs glu bsdu bar yong ba

red/ glu de dag sgra bsdu 'khor lo'i nang blugs nas grong khyer du khyer rgyu red zer/ grong khyer nang gi mi rnams kyis kyang shar lung gong ma'i glu pa dang glu ma rnams kyi snyan pa'i glu dbyangs go rgyu red/ skad cha de dag go dus klu mo mtsho'i snying ldig ldeg tu 'phag lung pa 'di'i nang klu len mkhan mang po'i nang nas klu mo mtsho las mkhas pa zhig gtan nas med/pho gzhon mgo skra su lu sheg shig de a mye lha chen dang lhan du bsam grub tshang du slebs/ bsam grub ni klu mo mtsho'i pha red/2 rgan lags 'di'i ming la pa sangs bkra shes zer/ khong 'dir dmangs glu bsdu ru yong ba red/ khyed kyi bu mos gzhas kha shas btang na e 'grig a mye lha chen gyis bsam grub la bltas nas dgod tsam byas/6 de/ mi bsam grub kyis dka' ngal che ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan nas 6 nged tshang 'tsho bar dka' ngal che bas las ka ma byas par gzhas kho na btang nas bsdad na e 'grig klu mo mtshos zur nas bltas bsdad/pa sangs bkra shis kyis bsam grub la tha mag rkang gcig sprad de 'dzum tsam byas nas phu gzhas gtong gla sprad chog 2 ga tshod sprod kyi red/mi ra gzhas gcig la sgor mo gcig mi en/’ bsam grub kyis dbugs ring zhig btang nas cung tsam ci'ang smra/ 6 'grig ma song ngam/mi a mye lha chen ngo gdong mi legs pas cung ma 'dod sasgo rjig mo / /nyi/sa gnang na e 'grig bsam grub kyis mgo shig brad nas shin tu gnyod chung gi rnam 'gyur zhig bstan/tsa 'grig sgor mo gnyis sprad chog 37

6 lags so/’ klu mo mtsho ngo tsha nas de mur sa 'og tu 'dzul na snyam/ pha bsam grub ni ngo ma mi nor sred can zhig red/ don du khong tsho'i nang la 'tsho ba dka' ngal ci'ang med/ na ning shang nas phyug po'i dud tshang gi dpe bzang yang sprad/nyin gnyis pa'i phyi dro klu mo mtsho ras gur khra khra de'i nang la gzhas gtong du song / pa sangs bkra shis kyis glu la nyan bzhin rab tu mos nas mgo bo yang yang kyog kyog byed/ kha lo ba des kha'ang cung gdangs nas mig zim zim gyis klu mo mtshor bltas nas glu nyan/ klu mo mtsho'i sems kyi gting nas sa phyogs gang sar 'gro myong ba'i kha lo ba de ha las tshul la bltas nas rang nyid kyi glu yag po byung yod nges red snyam/ glu gtong mtshams bzhag rjes/ pho gzhon gnyis po des grong khyer nas khyer ba'i shing tog dang bye ril sogs bton nas klu mo mtshor sne len byas/66khyed rang grong khyer nang du yong na mdun lam chen po yod nges red/’ pa sangs bkra shis kyis de ltar smras/6 de ma gtogs shing bzang pags pa'i 'og tu rul rgyu red/’ kha lo ba de mig chen po gdangs nas de ltar smras/de nas pho gzhon gnyis po des klu mo mtsho la grong khyer nang gi gnas tshul gang mang mang bshad/ klu mo mtsho'i mig mdun du glo bur du sngar med gyi 'jig rten zhig shar ba ltar mo'i 'dren byed zung ches cher gdangs shing sngar med kyi 'od 'tsher/6 wa ye/ nyi ma bzhud song / dgong las byed kyi min nam/ ’klu mo mtsho'i pha bsam grub rlung 'tshub 'tshub kyis gur chung de'i nang 'dzul/ pa sangs bkra shis kyis de ring gi gzhas gtong gla sgor mo nyi shu rtsa gardiswā bsam grub kyi lag tu bzhag bsam grub kyis dngul la lta bzhin de

sdir khro ba zhi nas mig gnyis thig gcig tu gyur/ zu sang nyin mu mthud btang ga 6 thugs rje che/mi pa sangs bkra shis kyis bsam grub pha bu gnyis sgo 'gram du bskyal/gnam mtha'i sprin dmar po des nub kyi gangs ri dkar po der dar gyi mgo ras g.yog pa ltar snang zhing bag ma chas nas nye ba'i mdzes ma zhig dang 'dra/ rtswa thang gi mtshan mo der khyi rnams grod pa 'grangs nas nam mkha'i skar mar zug pa'i sgra las thams cad khu sim par gyur/ klu mo mtsho lug khyu'i 'gram gyi gur chung de'i nang nyal sa tsha sob sob cig bzos nas nyal bar btsams/ deng sang gur chung de'i nang nyal mkhan mo gcig pu yin zhing mtshan mo lug srung ste dogs zon che tsam byed dgos pa smos med yin yang rgyun du gnyid kyi dra ba las mi thar bar sdod kyi yod/ de ring mo spro ba rab tu rgyas pasaganyid kyi g.ya' tsam yang med/ grong khyer nang nas yong ba'i pho gzhon gnyis po des bshad pa'i grong khyer gyi gnas tshul de dag yid la 'khor dus de dag la yid smon zhig ngang gis skyes pa dang / de rjes rdzong du 'bru rigs nyo ru song ba'i lhun grub dbang 'dus kyis bshad pa'i skad cha dag yid la 'khor/kho la gzhan las ring ba'i gzugs byad dang kun gyis smon dgos pa'i pho nyams kyis phyug yod/ dkar nag gsal ba'i 'dren byed de kho nas bu mo mang po'i yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog yod nges/ 'on te kho ni blo gu dog pa'i mi zhig red/ khos klu mo mtshor skyes pa gzhan dang skad cha shod pa sogs byed mi chog zer myong / de ni skyes pa pho'i mda' mdung shong ba'i blo khams ga la yin/'on te kho ni mi brtan po zhig red/ snga dro yas dang phyi dro mas zer mi srid/glo bur du/ khyis wang wang zhes zug pa dang mi'i rdog sgra thos/ klu sdi snatsho

dogs pa chen po zos te lus po 'khums 'khums byas/ de'ang khyi rdung du yong mkhan yin nges red/ ngo ma/ bcings 'grol btang nas dus tshod ring po 'di ltar phyin na'ang / bud med kyi lus sems la gnod pa'i srol ngan 'di da dung med pa bzo ma thub/ glo bur du shar lung gong ma'i rgan gzhon tshang mas go myong ba'i skad cha zhig yid la 'khor/ zer srol la gsar brje thog ma byed dus las byed mi snas shar lung gong ma'i 'brog par bsam 'char gang yod kyi skad cha dris dus mi zhig gis tsa gung khran tang gi kha la nyan le nyan le/khyi rdung 'gro ba'i lugs srol de gcig pu ma bsgyur rogs ’ zhes bshad/ yang kha cig gis zer na skad cha de shod mkhan mo'i pha bsam grub red zer/tag tag mi zhig gur nang nas 'dzul byung / 6 su yin/mi nga'i rdog sgra shes kyi mi 'dug gam/ de ni lhun grub dbang 'dus kyi skad gdangs red/6 lhun grub/ klu mo mtshos dga' snang chen pos tsog tsog byas/ zla 'od kyi 'og tu lhun grub dbang 'dus kyi ngo gzugs sngar bas yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig snang / lhun grub dbang 'dus kyis klu mo mtsho'i sngas 'gram du bsdad/ khos rdzong nas mo la stod gos khra khra zhig dang ngo snum shel sbug gang nyos 'dug de nas khos klu mo mtsho'i lag gnyis rang nyid kyi brang la sbyar nas 6 nga ga tshod dran byung mi zhes dris/ klu mo mtsho gces lang shor ba'i byis pa zhig ltar 6 gtan nas dran ma byung mi zhes lus stod skyom skyom byed bzhin bshad/ lhun grub dbang 'dus kyis gzab nan chen pos 6 khyod la bsam nag byed mkhan e gda'/ ngas yan par mi 'jog ces smras/ tsa sus khyod kyi lag nas nga 'phrog phod kyi red/mi mdza' gcugs kyis bcings pa'i ngang pa zung gis mtsho mo'i nang rkyal rtsal sbyong zhing yun ring shub shub smra bzhin dus 'da' ba byas/nyin gnyis par/ klu mo mtsho sngar bzhin gzhas gtong rogs byed du sodwa 0/ thog ma byis pa mang po zhig gur sgo nas bltas/ de nas bud med mi

nyung ba zhig ltad mor 'byor bas/ gur chung de'i phyi nang kun 'ur zing gis khengs te sgra bsdu 'khor lo'i nang gzhas blugs thabs bral/ pa sangs bkra shis yar langs nas mi rnams la phyir log rogs zhes bshad pa ma zad rgyu mtshan yang bshad rjes mi mang che ba phyir log 'on te byis pa kha shas gtan nas mi 'gro/ pa sangs bkra shes kyis bye ril 'ga' sprad de phyir log dgos pa'i kha brda byas/ byis pa gnyis da dung mi 'gro/ kha lo ba de khros nas gtum spyod kyis byis pa gnyis phyir phud nas gur sgo brgyab/ byis pa gcig brel ba chen pos rgyug song / byis pa gzhan de da dung gur rgyab tu bsdad/ klu mo mtshos gzhi nas gzhas gtong 'go tshugs/6 gi hi hi/ 'brug sgra grags pa lta bu'i ngar skad bsgrags pa dang lhan du gur gyi sgo mo gri yis bcad/ skra gzhug nag po brgyab pa'i pho gzhon zhig gis sdug /yas pas gri bzung zhing nga rgyal chang gis rab tu myos te lus 'dar sig ga t+pā/na grub/mi klu mo mtsho rang dbang med par sdod gnas nas langs/6 mi ngan de tshos ga re byed kyi 'dug da res byis pa de gnyis la ma mngag na/ ’6 kho re/ su mi ngan red/ skad cha gtsang ma shod shes kyi med dam/mi kha lo ba og tshom can des dpung pa phur nas mar thon/ kho'ang rgyag res la goms pa zhig yin nges red/6 ga re bu mo na chung bslu brid/ da dung skad cha rgyags pa/ lhun grub dbang 'dus gri khyer nas mdun du mchongs/klu mo mtshos dkyil du bkag pas yong la nye ba'i dmar 'dzing gi mtshams bcad/ 2 lhun grub khyod myos pa ma red dam/ ngas khong tshor gzhas gtong ba las/mi klu mo mtsho ngu la nye/ru khyed rang sems khral mi dgos/ nga tshor gzhas nyan rgyu las gakāswā gyi

dmigs yul med/ mi pa sangs bkra shis 'dzum dmul dmul gyis de ltar bshad/6 gzhas gtong mi dgos/mi lhun grub dbang 'dus kyis klu mo mtsho'i dpung saklu na zlo shāḥng k+to sdishā khri/ /ya byed pa las grong khyer nang la 'gro/ pho gzhon stag 'dra 'dra ga tshod btsal btsal red/mi de ni kha lo ba des lhun grub la ngar slong ba'i skad cha red/klu mo mtsho phyi bltas shig bslog nas ngu ma dgod cig byas/de'i phyi dror/ rlangs 'khor ser po de rtswa thang thog gi 'bar 'bur mang ba'i lam chung brgyud nas khyar khyor ngang log song / de nas pho gzhon gnyis po'i snang brnyan rta nor lug gis khyab pa'i shar lung gong ma'i rtswa thang nas yal/der bzhag pa ni sngar byung ma myong ba'i sgrung zhig dang tshon mdog rnam par bkra ba'i 'dun pa zhig yin nges/gnyis/klu mo mtsho dran shes kyi gnyid las sad de shar phyogs gzhung lam gyi sne mor lta dus thal 'tshub skya chil chil byed pa mthong / mi ring bar g.yu mdog can gyi rlangs 'khor zhig mdun du 'byor bas mos lag pa gnyis ka g.yugs nas rlangs 'khor gyi kha bkag klu mo mtsho'i mig gi yul du gsal ba ni mig shel nag po brgyab pa'i pho gzhon zhig red/ kho'i lus la khug ma mang po yod pa'i stod gos shig gyon 'dug gos mig shel phud rjes/ mig gnyis kyi thog la rkang btsugs nas bris pa lta bu'i rdzi ma mthug po zhig dang / 'gram pa ga~X g.yon du skyes pa'i spu rdzob ni dbyar gyi rtswa thang la lo legs byung ba ltar/

mthong myong myong zhig 'dug6 a tsi/ nga tsho'i glu ma/mi 6 rgan lags red 'dug nga grong khyer nang khrid rogs/mi klu mo mtshos gzhan gyi skad cha ci'ang shod ma thub/tsa khyod kyi dga' rogs ngar ma de khrid med dam/mi de sngon pa sangs bkra shis kyi rlangs 'khor gtong mkhan kha lo ba des rnam 'gyur ya mtshan zhig bstan nas de ltar bshad/klu mo mtsho ngu ma shes dgod ma shes khro'ang ma shes par/ 6 dbyug shog7ces bshad de kha phar bskor/ 6 rtsed mo yin/ shog dang / nga bu mo mdzes ma zhig dran pa'i sgang yin/ mikhos rlangs 'khor gyi sgo phyes/ klu mo mtsho rlangs 'khor nang bsdad pa thengs dang po yin/ rgyab snyes can gyi rkub bkyag 'bol shig shig de'i thog bsdad ma thag skyid thag chod de dga' mchongs brgyab pa dang / de nas rlangs 'khor je mgyogs je mgyogs su song bas mig mdun gyi ri lung thams cad rlangs 'khor dang ldog phyogs su rgyug sos cha rgyus yod pa'i spang ri dang brag ri/spang thang dang chu bo sogs skad cig nyid du yal 'gro ba mthong skabs klu mo mtsho'i sems gting la brjod mi shes pa'i skyo snang zhig ngang du skyes pa dang /rang lus gnang mkhan drin can pha ma gnyis po yang wa ler dran/6yi ye/ ga re bsam blo gtong gi yod/ mi kha lo ba des klu mo mtshor //༷krin chung chung zhig sprad nas/ 6 ga lu thungs/ shing 'bras kyi khu ba klu mo mtshos da bar mthong myong med pa'i lcags krin de'i kha gtan nas phyed mi shes pas ga lu zhes pa'i shing 'bras kyi khu ba de'ang btung thabs bral/6 lhos ang zhes kha lo ba des lcags krin thog gi phyi la cung 'bu/ zlo'i

lcags leb de nas 'then tsam byas song bas btung chog chog tu kha phyes/ klu mo mtsho kha skyengs nas dgod tsam byas/smyo grong khyer nang gang byed du 'gro gi yin/mi klu mo mtsho'i kha 'gul tsam byas pa las gtam ci'ang ma thon/mo'i lag gcig gis gwa lwa lcags krin bzung zhing lag gcig gis de'i thog la sen mos brad brad byas/ mos bltas na nang gi btung rgyu las phyi'i lcags krin de rin gong che nges red/ gal srid 'brog khul la yod na bed spyod 'dra min gtang chog snyam/6 khyod kyi dga' rogs de dngos gnas ngar ma zhig 'dug klu mo mtshos sngar bzhin lan ci'ang ma btab/6 dbyug shog shod 'dod med na/ ba'i gnas tshul bshad dgos/ nga sngon ma rlangs 'khor chung chung gtong mkhan red/ de dus khyod kyis shes kyi red/shin tram̐ nas ngas rlangs 'khor 'di gtong gi yod/ o/ nga'i ming la tshe bkra /kā sde(shā/ bkra shes/ klu mo mtsho'i kha nas dbang med du thal/ mo'i ming po dang ming gcig red/6 ma red/ tshe ring ma red tshe red don du tshe ni nga'i rus ming dang bkra shes ni nga'i ming red/ri 6 tshe zhes pa'i rus ming batsho'i lung par med/ ’tsa bod rigs kyi rus ming nang tshe zhes pa ga par yod/ nga'i pha rgya rigs yin pas rus ming tshe zer/ nga mi rgya ma bod la/ ming yang rgya ma bod/ nga'i pha ma gnyis ka rgya nag la log pa red/ 'on kyang ngas rang nyid kyi lte khrag 'pho sa'i sa cha 'di dang kha bral mi nus/ nga la sha mar med na 'tsho ba skyel thabs bralaslo/ da dung khyod 'dra ba'i bod rigs kyi mdzes ma de tsho dang kha bral mi phod/

khyod kyis pa sangs bkra shis dran gyi e 'dug kho da lta dpon po chung chung zhig byas nas bsdad yod/ khos ltag sgo phyes nas nga la rlangs 'khor 'di btang du bcug pa red/ de tsho nga'i gnas tshul red/ da khyod shod res redakaklu mo mtsho kha 'gul tsam byas pa dang sbrags dbugs ring zhig btang /lo gcig lhag tsam las ma song yang mo la bsam yul las 'das pa'i bya ba du ma byung / de ni mi kha shas kyi mi tshe gcig la'ang 'phrad mi srid/ klu mo mchos cha rgyus med pa'i pho gzhon der glo bur du yid ches skyes nas skad shugs dma' pos ngus/ mos rang nyid kyi myong ba thams cad gzhan la brjod par 'dod/deyang lhun grub dbang 'dus kyis mo la bcangs pa'i brtse dung mos shes kyi yod pa ma zad/ pha bsam grub nas kyang mos lhun grub dbang 'dus dang 'brel ba byas par bkag 'gog byed ma myong / gzhi rkang lhun grub dbang 'dus tshong rgyag gi 'jon thang mi che'ang 'brog pa'i las ka kun la mkhas zhes tshang mas bsngags brjod byed/ pha bsam grub kyis klu mo mtsho kho dang mnyam du 'tsho ba bskyal na skabs 'gar rab mdzes dar dkar nang btum nas a sngon dbyings la skyel ba dang skabs 'gar gcer bur bshus nas ljan ljin 'dam rdzab nang dbyugs pa lta bu'i bya ba gtan nas yong mi srid snyam/ klu mo mtshos pha'i bsam tshul de rtogs kyi yod pas sems kyi nang du dga' spro dang gdeng tshod kyis khengs/ 'on kyang lhun grub dbang 'dus kyis da dung brel ba mi byed pas/ klu mo mtsho'i sems gting nas brjod par dka' ba'i 'tshab sha zhig rgyas/ mayi dag gis bu mo'i sems kyi gsang ba'i mthil brtol ba ltar klu mo mtsho'i mgo skra byil byil 'ga' byas te/ 6 lhun grub kyis khyod mna' mar ga dus len rtsis 'dug 66min/ nga mi tshe gcig a ma dang kha bral gyi min/ 45

66kha snyan po yod/ dngos gnas gang bsam gyi yod na/’ ngo tsha nas gdong pa dmar por 'gyur ba'i klu mo mtshos 6 a ma wa zer bzhin sgo nas thon/ 'on kyang mo'i sems nang la grong tsho de'i nang gi pho gzhon dzig shos de'i bdag po rang nyid yin snyam pa'i spobs sems shig rgyas/de nyin sbra thog nas du ba sngo long long du 'phyur/ tshang mas bro bcud ldan pa'i dgong lto gra sgrig byed bzhin pa'i sgang red/ klu mo mtshos nor lug ded nas khyim du log lhas ra'i nang mi rnams brel ba chen pos nyin hril po ri la bsdad pa'i phyugs rigs dang phyugs rdzi sgug6 lhun grub dbang 'dus/ lhun grub/mi byis pa lce bde 'ga' klu mo mtsho'i rjes phab nas ha ha ho ho zhes dgod/6 skyag phrug 'di tsho/ / klu mo mtsho khros pa'i tshul gyis byis pa de tsho rjes 'ded byas/ byis pa rnams 'phur ba ltar bros/ mo'i kha zur nas bde skyid kyi 'dzum chung mngon bzhin kha phyir bskor/klu mo mtshos 'dzum chung dpul dmul gyis lug lhas ra'i nang bcugam khra dag dang khong tsho'i nang gi mna' ma gnyis brel ba chen pos thon byung /mo shar rer nang du song / sbra 'gram du rta mthong ma myong ba zhig btags 'dug dus der/ pha bsam grub dang rgad po nag lheb cig lhan du phyir thon byung / rgad po nag lheb des klu mo mtshor bltas nas 'dzum dmul dmul byed/klu mo mtsho mgo bo smad nas nang du 'dzul/6 a mye bsam grub/ skar ma bzang ba zhig bltas nas mgyogs tsam rten 'brel byed rogs/’ zu nga ni brgya cha brgya'i mos mthun yod/ ’klu mo mtshos sgo 'gram nas grags pa'i gtam gleng de dag thos/ klu mo mardo /ba 'gram du bsdad nas a mas gra sgrig byas pa'i thug pa las phor pa

gang blugs/ 'on te blo bde bar sdod mi thub/ sems nang dogs 'char gyis khengs/ su rten 'brel byed dgos sam/ bsam grub skad shugs chen pos ma ṇi 'don bzhin nang du 'dzul/ thab 'gram du dkyil krung byas te lag gis phreng ba rdograng bzhin klu mo mtshor 6 khyod kyis da lta'i god po de su yin e shes/ //de ni ༵/ misna grong tsho'i dbang rgyal red/ skad grags yod pa'i phyug po red/ e shes/mi klu mo mtsho mgo bo 'phred du g.yug g.yug byas nas mi shes pa'i bzo bstan/6 khong tsho'i nang la bu rgod po gnyis yod/ gcig gis tshong rgyagagacig gis 'brog las gnyer/ da dung bu mo gcig yod pa de rdzong gi las byed red la/ rdzong dpon gyi bza' zla'ang red/ shes e song mi zhes zer nas pha bsam grub kyis mig btsum ste ma ṇi bgrangs nas bsdad/klu mo mtshos pha'i skad cha nyan rjes dogs pa che ru song nas sngar bas sdod bzod mi bde bar gyur/ phor pa'i nang du blugs pa'i sha tshil mang ba'i thug pa de'ang sa rdo las bzos pa ltar bro ba med par gyur/ des na mos thug pa btung 'phro bzhag nas lhas ra'i nang phyugs zog gi khrod du song / mo 'bri mo'i 'og tu 'o ma 'jo bzhin pa'i ma khra dag gi 'khris su bsdad nas skad cha dris/ mas 'dzum sheg shig gis smyo bkra shis pa'i bya ba red mi ces ma gtogs gzhan gyi zhib don ma bshad/ klu mo mtsho'i khog snying 'bus bzos pa'am mgo skra mes 'tshig pa ltar sngar bas 'tshab be 'tshub ber gyur/de'i phyi nyin klu mo mtshos gsang ba thams cad rtogs/ pha ma gnyis pos mo pha yul dang sa thag ring ba'i ru sna grong tsho'i dbang rgyal tshang la sprod rgyu byas pa red/ nyin de nas klu mo mtsho phyugs 'tsho ru'ang 'gro mi dgos pa shās/
