sems khral bya yul de dngos su byung dus mo la gzhan gyi thabs shes ci'ang med pas yud tsam ring skad shugs chen pos ngus/ de nas 6 nga 'gro gi min/ nga min mizhes yang yang bshad/pha ma gnyis pos bu mo'i ngu skad la de tsam do snang mi byed/nyin gung za ma za ran dus kyang klu mo mtsho da dung ngus nas bsdad/ a mas zu bu mo dngos gnas 'gro mi 'dod pa e yin zhes zer skabs/ pha bsam grub kyis mu ma dga' dga' mdog byed pa de pho gsar dmag la 'gro ba'i dus/ ma sdug sdug mdog byed pa de bu mo gnas la 'gro ba'i dus zer ba thos e myong / khyod kyis bu mor kha ta bslab bya zhig gyis zer/ma khra dag sbra sgo nas thon te klu mo mtsho'i 'gram du bsdad nas zang zing du gyur pa'i mgo sku dag byil byil byas te 6 da dung phru gu'i snang ba/ ngu rgyu ci gda'/6/ nga 'gro gi min/ //sbya ṭ+wāṃ kā/ dang kha bral mi 'dod/ ’6 bu mo chen po chags dus pha ma dang kha mi bral mkhan zhig ga par yod/rjes su pha ma dran dus blta bar yong chog //r+sha sdin/ nga mi 'gro thag chod yin/’ zu a ma khyod kyis shes kyi red/ nga dang lhun grub dbang 'dus bar gyi 'brel ba/ mi4lhun grub dbang 'dus dang dbang rgyal gyi bu gnyis bsdur na gcig gnam dang gcig sa/ gcig rta dang gcig bong bu/ gcig lug dang gcig ra /spya/mi

66rang sems la med pa'i lug las rang sems la yod pa'i ra dga'/lar nga cha med rgyus med kyi lung par 'gro gi min/’ 6 dus tshod ring tsam phyin na goms kyi red/ nga 'dir yong dus sa rgyus mi rgyus ci'ang med/ deng skabs yag po mi 'dug gam/ 6 ga tshod bshad kyang nga 'gro gi min/ a ma nga ma gtong rogs/ : klu mo mtshos ma la 'thams nas ngu 'bod byas/ ma khra dag gis ci byed mi shes par dbugs ring zhig btang nas 6 de ni gtan 'khel ba'i bya ba zhig yin stabs bsgyur thabs med/ a ma'i kha la nyon/ khyod skyid po yong nges red/’ 6 nga 'gro gi min/ klu mo mtshos rang nyid kyi mgo thog tu bzhag pa'i ma'i lag pa phar dbyugam khra dag cung khros nas lha pha ma gnyis kyis khyod da lta'i bar gsos/chen po chags dus pha ma'i kha la mi nyan/ sde'i bu mo'i nang de 'dra byed mkhan ga par 'dug skyag lang shor drags pa red/ 6 nga gtan nas 'gro thabs med/’ klu mo mtsho sa thog tu skyes pa'i me tog kha 'byar der lta bzhin mgo bo'ang dgye dgye mi byed/ 6 ngas ga re byas nas mo skyes pa red/mi ma khra dag ngus te mig chu'i phreng ba sna gshong g.yas g.yon nas lhung /klu mo mtsho 'tshab nas 6 a ma ma ngu /’ 6 khyod 'gro'am/ 6 nga 'gro thabs med/mi ma khra dag sngar bas skad shugs chen pos ngus/6 skyag phrug 'tshar dus phan mi thogs/ ngas de ring khyod kyi rkang pa de ma bcag na/ mi pha bsam grub rab tu khros nas rgyug pa zhig khyer nas thon byung /mas klu mo mtsho 'bud tsam byas pas mo gnyid sad pa ltar gyur nas spyas/

pha bsam grub kyis mo'i rjes 'ded byas kyang rjes ma zin pas sngar bas khros nas 6 'dre mo khyod de ring nas log mi dgos/ 'gro sa yod na song zer te bsam grub rgad po phyir logaklu mo mtsho shar rer song bas cung ma 'gor bar ri zur yol te khong tsho'i nang gi spra'ang mig lam nas yal/ pha ma gnyis pos rjes 'den ma byas/ ha lam cung tsam song rjes log yong rgyu'i gdeng tshod yod mdog red/ 'on kyang klu mo mchos sems thag bcad zin/ mo ni lam bzhud kyi 'grul pa zhig ltar shar rer song / lam gyi g.yas g.yon du rna bar gzan pa'i skad ngan 'byin pa'i a bra 'ga' phar lta tshur lta dang phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed pa las gzhan gyi skad sgra gang yang thos rgyu med/ lhun grub dbang 'dus dang grong tsho gcig yin mod kyang deng gi char khong tsho'i nang 'brog sa gzhan du gnas spos te bar thag rta pas nyin phyed kyi lam yin pas/ mo'i sems la lhun grub dbang 'dus brag dkar mo'i yar zur du phyugs 'tshos yod nges red snyam/nyin mo'i dkyil 'khor nub ri'i spyin dmar gyi gseb nas rim bzhin nub/ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi bu mos mun nag gi mdza' bo bsus/ thams cad dben thing thing du gyur pas rgyang ring gi chu sgra lhag par gsal/ rim bzhin lam yang gsal po mi mthong bar 'gyur/ klu mo mtsho mu mthud mdun la bskyod ma phod par brag rtsar zhig la 'khums 'khums byas nas bsdad/ brag steng nas bab pa'i chu thigs 'og gi rdo thog tu lhung / klu mo mtshos de'i 'og tu kha gdangs nas bsdad/ mngar zhing bsil ba'i chu rgyun khog pa'i nang du sim pas lus thog gi dka' ba cung zhi ba'i snang ba byung ba dang / chu thigs rdo thog tu lhung ba'i sgra de gna' snga mo'i gdangs kyi 'gyur ba nyung ba'i glu dbyangs shig ltar klu mo mtsho'i rna bar sngar med kyi bde ba zhig ster te kho mo rmi lam gyi zhing khams su khrid/50

6 ha ha he he/ glo bur gyi dgod sgra des klu mo mtsho mi lam gyi zhing khams nas dkrogs/mig gdangs nas lta dus/ mo dang bar thag gom pa bcu yan man gyi sa ru me lce dmar 'ur 'ur byed/ 'gram du bu mo gnyis ha ha ho ho'i ngang bsdad 'dugame lce'i 'od snang gis brgyan pas bu mo gnyis po'i ngo mdog mtshams sprin ltar dmar mdangs rgyas/ glo bur du klu mo mtsho'i lus kyi ba spu ma lus zing nger langs/ slar yang chung dus go myong ba'i 'dre gtam skyi g.ya' ba dag dran gsos/ des na mo'i sems la mdun gyi bu mo gnyis po 'dre mo yin pa the tshom med snyam ste/ klu mo mtsho rang dbang med par rkang lag bkum bkum byas/rgyun ldan du gyur ba'i dbugs kyi 'byin rngub kyang byed mi phod pa gyur/ 'dre mo 'di gnyis kyis ji ltar byas nas sha za khrag 'jib yong snyam nas klu mo mtsho'i sems la 'jigs snang chen po skyes/ slar yang pha ma gnyis kyi byams brtse'i bzhin ras yid la 'khor 'khor byas/ ngo ma/ 'di ni pha ma'i bka' dang ldog pa'i rgyu 'bras min nam snyam/ de nas lhun grub dbang 'dus kyi skad gdangs rna lam du grags/ gal srid da lta khong dang mnyam du gnas na thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i blo stobs dang thabs shes rnyed rgyu red snyam/ de dus tag tag mo'i mig lam du 'dre mo gnyis po des khug ma nag po zhig gi nang nas tsam pa lta bu zhig bton nas phor pa'i nang blugs shing lce ldag byas pa mthong / dngos gnas com pa 'dra/ mo cung blo bde bar gyur/ 'dres kyang rtsam pa bzas na mi sha za e yong snyam/ de nas klu mo mtsho'i rna lam du 'dre mo gnyis kyi gtam gleng yang gsal lhang lhang gis grags/smyo de ring nged gnyis bros nas nyi ma ga tshod red/’ 6 brgyad tag tag red/ ’6 nga a pha a ma dran gyi 'dug 51

6 had/mi shin tu yid skyo ba'i bzo zhig bstan/tshinged gnyis lkugs pa rang red/ lan yang ma bzhag par bros yong bas pha ma gnyis kyis sems khral ga 'dra byed kyi med dam/mi mdun gyi gzhon naganyis po'ang pha yul nas bros pa'i nyam chung bu mo gnyis yin pa las lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul gtan nas min pa shes dus da lta'i 'jigs skrag kun theg med du yal nas bu mo gnyis po dang spyir btang min pa'i gdung sems mnyam skye byung / khong gnyis po la'ang rang nyid lta bu'i bar chad yod nges red snyam/rākhong gnyisdug/’ klu mo mtsho hob ste langs nas shub shub smra ba'i bu mo gnyis po'i gas sdus zlo tsi/ su red/ 'dre red/mi bu mo gcig de ru dran pa brgyal/ bu mo gcig phyir bros kyang rkang pa rdo la thogs nas der 'gyel/ bu mo des brel ba chen pos kha phyir bskor nas klu mo mtsho'i rkang 'gram la phyag 'tshal nas tsa nga ma za rogs/ tshe thar gtong rogs mi zhes ya nga ba'i ngu 'bod byas/ de ni bu mo ma yin pa skad gdangs sgom la cung 'gag pa'i skyes pa'i skad red/ klu mo mtsho ci bya gtol bral gyis lan ci'ang smra ma shes par lus/ skyes pa'i skad rgyag pa'i bu mo des da dung mo'i rkang rtsar phyag 'tshal bzhin mchis/klu mo mtsho'i sems rim bzhin dal lhod du gyur nas ra khyod skrag mi dgos/ nga yang 'grul pa yin 'dre min/mi mi des mgo bo ga ler yar bkyag nas yid de tsam mi ches pa'i ngang 6 dngos gnas 'dre min nam/mi tsa khyed gnyis dang gcig pa yin/ 7 klu mo mtsho dgod tsam byas/des klu mo mtshor yongs su yid ches nas 6 'brug mo ’ zer nas brel ba chen pos zur du 'gyel ba'i bu mo de'i 'gram du rgyug klu mo mtshos 6 mgyogs tsam phye bdug gyis :zer/52tsam pa mes 'tshig pa'i dri ma brlan zhing bsher ba'i mkha' rlung nang

gang sar khyab/ 'brug mo zhes pa'i bu mo de rim bzhin dran pa sos te/ mig gnyis ga ler bltas byung /tsa skrag dgos mi 'dug khyod dang 'dra ba'i bu mo mdzes ma zhig 'dug thog mar phan tshun 'dre la 'khrul ba'i gzhon nu gsum po me phung gi 'gram du bsdad nas so so'i gnas tshul lhug por smras/ gzhon nu gnyis pos klu mo mtshor smras don/ khong gnyis ka bud med kyi chas spras rung skad sbom pa de bu red/ rgyu mtshan ni rlangs 'khor 'tshol bde ba'i ched du yin zer/khongaganyis chung 'dris kyi byams pa yin zhing phan tshun blo sems 'o chu bzhin 'dres nas shi bral las gson bral mi byed rgyu'i mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bu'i dam bca' bzhag mod kyang phyogs gnyis po'i pha mas rtsa ba nas mos mthun ma byas stabs 'u thug nas lha sar bros 'gro mkhan yin zer/ klu mo mtshos kyang rang nyid kyi gnas tshul bshad pas/ bros byol du yong ba'i gzhon nu pho mo gnyis pos mgrin gcig tu zu ma byung na nged gnyis ltar byed rgyu red mi ces gros 'go bton/ klu mo mtshos thabs zad pa'i tshul gyis mgo bo g.yug g.yug byas/gzhon nu gsum pos dkyil du lhab lhub tu 'bar ba'i me lcer lta bzhin bshad mi tshar ba'i gtam gleng ci dgar byed pa dang / klu mo mtshos me lce ltar dmar la mdzes pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'tsho bar 'dun pa drag po skyes bzhin yod/rba rlabs kyi ral pa dkar po nam mkhar g.yo zhing rlabs sgra'i ngar skad bar snang la khyab pa'i chu 'gram der klu mo mtsho gzhon nu gnyis po dang kha bral/khong gsum ku'i ngo gdong la bltas na khong tshor rjes su bod gangs can gyi yul gru ga ge mo zhig la 'phrad nges yin pa'i yid ches yod bzo 'dugabrag dkar mo'i yar zur phyugs rigs dkar nag gis khengs/ klu mo mtshos g.yas lta g.yon lta byas nas lhun grub dbang 'dus btsal/ 'on te de ringagi phyugs dzi bu mo chung chung gnyis las gzhan mi mthong / a'o/ 5rdo ni

lhun grub dbang 'dus kyi sring mo 'o 'dzoms dang 'o ril gnyis red/ bu mo gnyis pos mo ngo shes nas 'gram du rgyug yong /6 lhun grub rdzi bor mi yong ba gang red/ 6 khong dgon par rab byung sgrub par phyin song mi zer/me grwa pa byas pa e red/mi klu mo mtsho rbad de ha las nas bsam rgyu dran rgyu da pa/ tagyu ༵༵/ chos lugs kyi byed sgo zhig spel gyi yod tshod 'dug zer/ klu mo mtshos de la lan ci'ang ma btab par 'dam bag gi sku ltar hon thor nas lus/ cung tsam ma phyin par mig chu lhung lhung shor bzhin bu mo gnyis la kha lan yang ma byas par rkang lam phra mo ded nas ri khrod kyi dgon tshubacu de la kha gtad nas song / dgon pa chung chung de'i phyogs bzhir bsang gi du ba sngo chil chil byed cing / bod gangs can las gzhan gang du'ang thob dka' ba'i dri zhim des klu mo mtsho'i sna bar tshor snang drag po sprad kyang dga' sdug gi snang ba ci yang ma byung / de ring dgon chung 'dir chos lugs kyi byed sgo zhig spel bzhin yod nges red/ dgon pa'i phyogs bzhir dad ldan mang tshogs kyis khengs/ ngo ma/ cha 'phrin shin tu mi dar ba'i lung khug 'dir/ de ring ji ltar byas nas chos lugs kyi byed sgo yod pa shes sam/ klu mo mtsho'i gdong par dga' sdug gi rnam 'gyur ci'ang med par mi tshogs kyi dkyil du 'dzul/6 rin po che gsung chos gnang bar phebs kyi 'dug 5ltos dang skyabs su mchi'o/’ 'tshang kha brgyab nas mdun phyogs su bskyod/ lo na bgres pa'i bla ma zhig gis bzhugs khri'i thog bzhugs pa dang grwa dmangs kyi gral du lhun grub dbang 'dus bsdad 'dug mos thog mar skad shugs chen pos lhun grub ces 'bod par 'dod/ spen na yang mos lag pa brang khar sbyar ba'i dad ldan mdī /gas la lta bzhin skad 'byin pa'i blo stobs med/ 'tshang kha'i khrod du klu

mo mtsho mi tshogs kyi mdun gral du bskyal/ klu mo mtshos gdong pa sgam brling ldan pa'i lhun grub dbang 'dus la lta bzhin bla khyer ba ltar had de lus/ glo bur du lhun grub dbang 'dus kyi mig gnyis klu mo mtsho'i dwangs gsal chu mig dang 'dra ba'i mig chen po gnyis dang 'phrad/ kho'i gdong gi mkha' nas mi skyid pa'i sprim pa lheb gcig mngon/ kho'i mig gnyis pog ler klu mo mtsho dngas bral nas ci'ang ma byung ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas thal mo snying khar sbyar nas dbu mdzad kyis skul ba'i zhal 'don de grwa dmangs dang mnyam du skyor nas bsdad/ klu mo mtsho blo snying gas pa lta bu'i sems sdug drag pos mnar te mig chu phyi ru mi mngon yang sems kyi gting nas yun ring bzhur sbyangs bas/ mos nus shugs gang yod bton te mi tshogs kyi khrod nas phyir gsum/tsa ngo ma/ khyod la rlung rta mi 'dug tshe bkra shis kyis mgo bo kyog nas klu mo mtshor lta tsam byas/klu mo mtsho mig ce rer rlangs 'khor phyi logs kyi 'jig rten la lta/mtha' yas pa'i bye thang gis mo la re ba dang dga' ba ci yang ster mi thub/ de ni tshe srog dang bral ba'i mya ngam thang chen po zhig red/ mos bsam blo gtong bzhin sngar med kyi skrag snang zhig skyes pas mgo bo de rang dbang med par tshe bkra shes kyi phyogs la bsnyes nas bsdad/6 khyod grong khyer nang slebs rjes gang byed bsam gyi 'dug ’klu mo mtshos mgo bo 'phred du g.yug g.yug byas/6 khyod kyi cha rkyen la bltas na pa sangs bkra shes kyis rogs dī spyad

mdog kha po red/mi tsa gang ltar khyed gnyis la re rgyu las med/ ’6 nga e/ sangs rgyas rang mgo ma thon par phyi ma'i yar 'dren zer ba khag po red/ ha ha ha/ rtsed mo yin/ ngas rogs pa thub na los byed/ ri lung mang po mig btsum thengs rer gar med du bskyur/ klu mo mtsho tshe bkra shes la bsnyes nas gnyid du yur/ tshe bkra shis kyis klu mo mtsho'i dkar dmar ldan pa'i ngo gdong la lta bzhin de ro bcud ldan pa'i ku shu dmar po zhig ltar snang bas khos ku shu de'i bro ba myong ba'i 'dun pa drag po zhig skyes/6 a ra ra/ mi nangs 'khor 'gul skyom chen po zhig brgyab/ cung tsam shān gā a slog thebs/ tshe bkra shes skrag nas gdong pa nas rngul nag bar da / /mo mtsho'ang hob ste gnyid sad/ mos rang nyid tshe bkra shes la bsnyes nas gnyid du yur ba shes dus ngo tsha nas rna rtsa bar dmar por gyur/tsa de ring tog tsam min na/’ go/ 66ga re byas song /mi klu mo mtshos rlangs 'khor 'gyel grabs byas pa ha ma zu gang byas ma song / bag leb zo dang /mi tshe bkra shis kyis mdun gyi lcags sgam nang nas bag leb blugs pa'i 'gyig khug cig bton nas rang nyid kyis bag leb gcig blangs nas zos pa dang tsha shel gyi phor pa zhig kha phyes nas hub chen po zhig brgyab/ 6 chu thungs/ 7 tshe bkra shis kyis phor pa klu mo mtshor bsrings/zu nga kha sgom gyi mi 'dug 66btsog snang byas pa ma red dam/mi 56klu mo mtshos chu hub gang btungs nas bag leb bzas/

2 khyod kyis byas na nga mi gang 'dra 'dug sna yag po gda'/’ 6 byas na khyod nga'i mna' ma byas na ga 'dra 'dug 6 khyod bza' mo yod mkhan/mi 6 nga la dgos pa ni khyod lta bu yin/mi klu mo mtshos lan ci'ang ma brgyab/ mos tshe bkra shes kyi bstan gsheg tsha ba'i rnam 'gyur de mthong dus yongs su yid ches byed thabs bral/mun pa nub nas sa gzhi ma lus rab rib tu gyur/ rlangs 'khor gyi glog spar/ lam zur gyi smag mun lhag med bcom/ yud tsam song rjes rlangs 'khor de grong rnal chung chung zhig tu 'byor te shar rer khang pa ltar pa kha shas yod pa'i ra ba zhig gi nang du 'dzul/ 6 do dgong 'dir sdod dgos/ sang nyin snga po grong khyer nang slebs kyi red/mi cung ma 'gor bar tshe bkra shis kyis rgad mo zhig khrid nas slebs byung /rgad mo des khang pa zhig gi sgo phyes/ nang du me'ang gtong rogs byas/khang pa'i nang nyal khri gnyis yod cing / nyal khri'i steng ras khra khras bzos pa'i nyal chas gtsang ma re bzhag 'dug da dung lag 'khyer glog bzhu'i shel tog gi bzo 'dra ba'i shel ril chen po zhig thog la btags 'dug me rgyag mkhan rgad mo des klu mo mtshor zhib tu bltas rjes tshe bkra shis la lta tsam dang dpog dka' ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan nas phyir log song /klu mo mtsho nyal khri'i 'gram gyi sa thog tu bsdad/2 sa thog ma sdod/ nyal khri'i thog sdod/mi 6 btsog pa bzo 'gro gda'/ phabatsog pa bzos na bzos dngul ni sprad tshar/ ’2 dngul ga tshod red/ ’57

6 nyal khri rer sgor mo bcu/mi tsa sang nyin nyal chas khyer 'gro chog gi red dam/mi 66ga par khyer chog gi red/ 6 a tsi dngul mang po de 'dra/ de las phyi logs la nyal na dga'/’ 6 dngul mang na ngas sprad kyi red/ khyod sems khral mi dgos/ mi gong tshad chen po de 'dra yin dus klu mo mtsho nyal khri la khong khro za ba ltar lham yang ma phud par nyal khri'i thog tu nyal/ tag tag da lta me rgyag rogs byed mkhan gyi gad mo de nang du 'dzul byung / 6 a tsi/ ltos dang / lham yang ma phud par nyal khri'i thog nyal/mi rgad mos klu mo mtsho'i gdong par mdzub mo btsugs nas smyo gtsang sbra med mkhan/ sgor mo lnga chad pa rgyag gi yin/’ klu mo mtsho ha las nas lan ci'ang rgyag ma thub/6 dngul sprar shog rgad mos klu mo mtshor ngar ngar dzig dzig byas////zlozlo me/ /rno grong khyer nang gzhang btsong du 'gro'am/ ’6 ga re/ su gzhang btsong mkhan red/’ klu mo mtsho rab tu khros pa'i stag mo zhig ltar tsham tshom med par rgad mo de'i thog la mchongs te rgad mo'i brang thog nas 'dzin/rgad mo bsam yul las 'das pa'i bya ba de'i mdun du mig ce rer bltas nas lus song /tshe bkra shes myur du mar yong nas klu mo mtsho phar khrid/ gzhi nas rgad mo des 6 mi gsod kyi 'dug ces skad cor brgyab/ g.yas g.yon du mi sdod mkhan med pas su'ang yong mkhan ma byung / —66a ma lags/ skad ma rgyag der bzhugs dang / rim bkra shis kyis rgad mo ༷/ sne len gang drag byas/

rgad mo'i ngo gdong yag tu song 'dugatshe bkra shis kyis tha mag rkang gcig rgad mor sprad nas me'ang spar //kā sdus te 6 a ma lags/ de ring nyes chad ma gtong rogs/ mos ci'ang zu de ring bu'i ngo la bltas nas bskyur shog de ma gtogs bzo lta sprad dgos 'dug ’6 yag byung /mi tshe bkra shes kyis rgad mo de'i rkub la thug thug 'ga' byas/6 pho gzhon 'di tsho/’ rgad mos tha mag zur 'then byed bzhin 'dzum ril ril gyis phyir thon song /ja lto tshar rjes klu mo mtsho dang tshe bkra shes so so'i nyal khri'i thog tu nyal/gsal la mi gsal ba'i glog 'od de'ang rim bzhin mi gsal bar gyur nas byibar 'od kyi rgyun chad/ mi gnyis las med pa'i khang chung de 'jam thing nger nga / 6 nga'i glu ma/ nga yong gi yin/’ 66ga re/ ngo mi tsha/ klu mo mtsho dogs pa za ste ske rags kyang ma bshig par nyading/ gcig pu zhe drag 'khyags kyi 'dug tshe bkra shis klu mo mtsho'i nyal khri'i 'gram du slobs/ klu mo mtsho zur du bud nas kho pa de'i 'gram du nyal/klu mo mtshos gzhan gyi 'gog rgol ci'ang ma byas par kha gyang rtsar gtad nas bas/ tshu/ ra bskor shog ska rags mi bshig gang yin/’ klu mo mtshos lan ma byas par bsdad/smyo khyod kyis nga'i bza' mo byed mi 'dod dam/ nga'i bsam blo lhad med yin/’ 59

6 de rjes su ga ler shes kyi red/ klu mo mtsho kha tshur bskor/tsa ngas mna' skyel chog jo shag klu mo mtsho khu sim mer bsdad/ tshe bkra shis kyi 'dod chags drag tu rgyas nas klu mo mtshor dam por 'thams te 'o bskyal bar bcoms/ klu mo mchos mgo bo phar g.yol tshur g.yol kha shas byas rjes 'gul tsam yang mi byed/tsa khyod kyis mgo ma skor/ / klu mo mtsho dbugs hal bzhin de ltar smras/6 nga la yid ches byos/ mitshe bkra shis kyis klu mo mtsho'i dkar zlum gyi nu ma phur phur byas tshe 'dod chags kyi me lce lhab lhub tu 'bar te slar bzod mi thub par klu mo mtsho'i ska dgas bshig par bcoms/ skabs der klu mo mtsho gnyid sad pa ltar gyur nas tshe bkra shes shugs kyis phar phud pas kho nyal khri'i thog nas lhung ste zur gyi rkub bkyag 'gyel ba'i sgra che tsam grags/6 wa ye ga re byed kyi yod/ sdod ma tshugs na bde srung mi sna 'bod kyi yin/’ da gin gyi sgo phye mkhan rgad mo de'i skad red/ nang gi gzhon nu gnyis po cung tsam 'jam thing nger song / rgad mo'i gom sgra je ring je ring du song bas log zin pa gsal po red/ tshe bkra shes slar yang klu mo mtsho'i thog la mchongs nas ska rags 'og nas lag pa brgyab/6 khyod kyis nga la rtsed mo min na grong khyer nang 'byor dus nga'i thams cadakhyod kyi red/mi klu mo mtsho ngu ngag gis de ltar smras/ tsa snga phyi med/ gang ltar khyod nga'i red/’ tshe bkra shis kyis shugs kyis klu mo mtsho'i ska rags bshig pasami ga mo mtsho bzod thabs bral ba'i khong khro langs nas ska rags kyi sne mo tshe

bkra shes la gzhus/ tshe bkra shis kyi gdong par phog pas 6 a tsha zer bzhin nyal khri'i thog nas babs/ klu mo mtshos skad gdangs dma' pos drag tu ngus/6 ma ngu / ngas nor ba red/ tshe bkra shis yun ring klu mo mtsho'i nyal khri'i 'gram du langs/ de nas ci'ang ma smras par rang nyid nyal sar song /rnam par bkra ba'i nyi 'od kyi 'og tu/ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi bu mos rtswa thang gi lu ba bklubs shing me tog gi 'phyang 'phrul btags/ shag shag tu rgyu ba'i chu mo'i rlabs dkar nang nya chung gser mig can rnams spro skyid kyi rtsed dgar rol/ gang sar skye stobs dang mdzes sdug gis khyab pas rlangs 'khor nang du bsdad pa'i gzhon nu pho mo gnyis kyis mdang dgong gi mi skyid pa'i gnas tshul lhag med du brjed nas lus sems kun la lha yi bdud rtsi sim pa ltar dga' bdes khyab/ phan tshun bar shod mi tshar ba'i skad cha dang brjod gzhi mchis/rlangs 'khor 'ur 'ur gyi 'khun sgra 'byin bzhin grong khyer gyi nye sar slebs/5ltos dang / grong khyer/’ klu mo mtsho mig ldir nas lta dus ri'i zhol du nam mkha'i skar tshogs sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i grong khyer chen po mtha' mi mngon pa zhig mthong / grong khyer gyi mkha' thog tu du zhag smug chil ler mchis pas de las 'tsho ba'i dro skyid tshor/ rlangs 'khor rim bzhin grong khyer gyi mtha' ru slebs/ klu mo mtshos bltas na grong khyer ni nam mkhar snyeg 'dra'i khang pa las grub pa zhig red/grong khyer gyi lam thog tu dbyibs 'dra min gyi 'khor lo che chung dkā /ga

log 'dra min gyon pa'i mis khengs/ da dung khang pa tshang ma'i nang mi yod nges red/ klu mo mtshos glo bur du grong khyer nang mi mang po 'di 'dra gang nas yong min la dogs pa skyes/ rang nyid kyang mi'i rgya mtsho 'di'i thigs pa gcig chags rgyu red snyam dus mo'i sems nang spyir btang min pa'i dga' tshor zhig skyes/ 'on kyang grong khyer gyi rba rlabs drag pos yangs pa'i rtswa thang nas bros pa'i rtswa thang ltar dwangs gtsang lhad med pa'i bu mo 'dir dga' ba'i rmi lam dang / skyo ba'i mig chu sogs ci zhig ster min ni da bar sus kyang tshod dpag mi thub/62

lang tsho'i 'bab chu/spra dang spre'us bzung ba'i nags gseb tu dus rgyun smra shes don go ba'i rigs kyis dben pas gal srid mgo nag mi zhig tshang tshing nags khrod du 'byor na nyam dman gnyer ma'i gdong can rnams ha las nas mi la mjug ma mi 'dug ces 'phya smod byed par grags/ de dang 'dra bar grong khyer gyi 'du 'dzi dang grong rdal gyi 'khrug long yongs su bral ba'i dben gnas lung kyog khul la gal srid kho tsho'i rgyun chags goms srol dang tha dad pa'i mi zhig slebs sna/sna trī dī na gnas tshul zhig byung na de la ha las shing ya mtshan skye rgyu ni sa khul glu gar tshogs par yod pa'i bstan sgrol rang nyid kyi pha yul glang dmar grong tsho la gnyen 'phrad du 'byor/ grong mi rgan gras rnams kyi gsung tshul ltar na mo ni grong tsho de'i nang rgyal khab kyi las kur zhugs pa'i mi gcig pu de rang yin tshod 'dug rgyun du grong tsho stod smad bar gsum dang / grong mi rgan dar gzhon gsum/ gnas tshul che 'bring chung gsum/ mdor na mthong tshad dang thos tshad la jus gtogs bya rgyur dga' ba'i bud med khag cig bde 'grub tshang gi lug ra'i 'gram du rub rub byas te smra sgo nas rgyun mi chad par gtam smra ba'i tshul de ni lcang gling gru bzhir 'dus pa'i byi'u chung tshogs dang kun nas mtshungs so/ 6 khyed tshos mthong e byung / ngag brdo/ gyi

bu mo de/ a ma ma/ mi lo sum cu yol tsam gyi bu mo des ha las mdog gis mjing pa khum tsam dang / dpung pa rong tsam byas te de ltar bshad/6 a tsi/ mo'i rkang 'og la rwa co skyes bzhag mi bud med sna chen des kha chu gzhan gyi ngo gdong la 'thor ba ma 'dzems par rang nyid kyi mthong thos gleng song / 66de'i 'gro stangs kyang mi bud med gdong pa nag cing sha skam po des rkub phar g.yo tshur g.yo byas pa'i tshul der bltas na phal cher bstan sgrol gyi 'gro stangs la lad mo byed kyi yod pa 'dra/ 6 'gro stangs la lta dus yag po zhig yin sa mi gda'/ gcig byas na bud med de tsho'i kha nas gtam yag po zhig thon rgyu med pa 'dra/ de min na bstan sgrol zer ba de skyon gyi phung po yin nges red/ gang ltar kho tshos bstan sgrol gyi mgo'i spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i rting pa bar zhib cing phra ba gleng song / yin na'ang 'jig rten gtam dper 6 mi nag nag bzo mkhananag mo red ’ ces pa de bud med yongs rdzogs la bshad na mi bden yang bde 'grub tshang gi lug ra'i 'gram du rub rub byas pa'i bud med de tshor bshad na ma 'tsham pa mi 'dugagacigabade 'grub tshang gi bu mo dung mtshos lug lug ra'i nang bcug rjes brel ba chen pos khyim la 'dzul te tsa a pha/ bstan sgrol slobs 'dug gam ’ zhes dris/ pha bde 'grub mgo yar bkyag ste rang gi bu mor lta dus gzab mchor spras rgyu dang ngu rgyu la dga' ba'i bu mo de dngos gnas chen po 'di 'dra chags tshar bzhag ngo ma dang dod byed pa'i na tshod la slebs 'dug rang nyid kyis rgyunami sa dung mtsho bu mo chung chung zhig la rtsi rkyang byas pa de rbad de snang chung shor

bzhag dung mtsho'i gdong dbyibs dang ngo mdog lhag par dkar nag gsal ba'i mig khra sgor sgor gnyis/ gang nas bltas kyang mo'i a ma lo chung dus ltar mdzes shing yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig 'dug des na bde 'grub kyis rang gi shing shun lta bu'i ngo gdong la phur tsam byed kyin rang dbang med par dbugs ring shor song / dung mtshos a pha'i byed stangs de ci yin don ma rtogs pas/ 6 a pha/ ci byas song zhes dris nas lag pa brkyangs te a pa'i thod pa la thug tsam byas te tsha ba yod med bltas/ 6 o'o/ bstan sgrol slebs bzhag lhe a pha/ nga bstan sgrol thug tu 'gro gi yin/ mi dung mchos am phrag sbug nas shel sgo chung la sgor ba de bton nas blta tsam byas rjes lto'ang za khom med par phyi ru 'gro rtsis byas/ 4dung mtsho/ 'gro mi chog 4ci red/’ bde 'grub kyis nyin mo bud med rnams kyi kha nas go ba'i ya mtshan gyi gtam de tsho chad lhag med par dung mtshor bshad/ dung mtshos skad cha de rnams bden min la the tshom yod kyang deng skabs kyi bstan sgrol ni sngon rang nyid kyi grogs mo gzhas la dga' ba de rang min pa gsal po yin pas mo'i sems su skyo snang dang 'jigs snang zhig ngang du skyes/ 'on te bstan sgrol gyi da lta'i rnam pa mthong 'dod che ba'i dbang gis mos a pha'i mdun du rdzun zhig bshad rjes lkog tu bstan sgrol la lta bar phyin/dung mtsho'i mig mdun du shar ba'i bstan sgrol ni kho tshos bshad pa lta bu skyi g.ya' dgos pa'i bdud mo'i gzugs 'dzin pa zhig ma yin par de las ldog ste glog brnyan nang gi mtshar sdug yid du 'ong ba'i gzhon nu ma zhig dang 'dra/ mo'i sku nag snam 'od 'tsher ba de lan bu ma bslas par sob sob su lu can du bzos nas rgyab tu 'phyang ba na stod gos me tog mdog ldan gyi thog tu mdzes par bkab 'dug pas brag thog nas 'bab bzhin pa'i dbyar gyi 'bab chu skye stobs ldan pa zhig dang 'dra/ mo'i 'jur ta'i 'og tu tāzlos

gnas rwa co 'dra po zhig skyes 'dug kyang / bstan sgrol gyis lham de gyon na lus po sngon ma las drang zhing ldem par gyur nas gom pa spo dus kyang zhabs bro rgyag pa bzhin ldem ldem du mngon pas 'brog pa'i bu mo'i ljid tig tig gi gom pa spo stangs dang he bag shin tu che/bstan sgrol gyis rtsig zur nas mor rgyang lta byed bzhin pa'i dung mtsho mthong song / 66o/ dung mtsho ma red dam/mi bstan sgrol dga' spro chen pos dung mtsho'i 'gram du rgyug nas mo'i lag pa gnyis po dam por bzung ste mo la g.yas lta g.yon lta byed bzhin par dung mtsho'i lus po dkrug dkrug byas rjes smyo dung mtsho/ gang byas song mi zhes skad shugs chen pos bos/ bstan sgrol gyis shing tog ka ra sogs bton nas dung mtshor sbyin/ dung mtshos brel ba chen pos 6 rgya nag skyid po 'dug gam zhes dris pa na/ 6 nga las ka rgya nag la med/ nag chu la yod/ skad cha de go dus dung mtshos mig gnyis hu rer gdangs te bltas nas bsdad/ dung mtsho'i blo la rgya nag dang / nag chu/ lha sa/ pe cing sogs kyi bar du mtshungs rtags 'bri rung ba'i don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ bstan sgrol gyis dung mtsho'i khra chung mig gnyis nas skabs de'i mo'i bsam blo rtogs nas 'dzum tsam byas te/ 6 ma red/ ma red/ rig gnas med na mi zer nas yul lung de tsho'i khyad par zhib cing phra ba dung mtshor bshad song / dung mtsho rang nyid blun rtags bstan par ngo tsha po byung yang mo'i mig gnyis nas sngar mthong ma myong ba'i 'jig rten gyi ltad mo mthong ba lta bu'i 'od 'tsher gyi 'dug ri bo'i rgyab dang glang dmar rtswa thang spra zad mtshams su tha dad pa'i lung pa mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa gzhi nas /nga/ mtsho'i mig gi lta phyogs rim bzhin bstan sgrol gyi lham phyogs la spoX/6 lham 'di ting ka ring ba/ phra ba/ rno ba/ gom pa spo dus rting ka mi

chag pa ya mtshan/ bstan sgrol gyis lham de gyon nas zhabs bro rgyag thub pa de bas ya mtshan che/ mos ro bcud ldan pa'i shing tog ka ra za khom med par mgo sgur nas bstan sgrol gyi rkang pa la mig hur rer bltas/ bstan sgrol gyis 6 ga 'dra 'dug nga'i lham mdzes po 'dug gam/’ dung mtsho ci shod 'di shod med par yud tsam nas tsa ngas gyon tsam byas na e 'grig mi ces lan btab/ra 'grig dang 'grig ’ ces skad cha'i sgra ma yal gong bstan sgron gyis lham phud de dung mtshor sprad/ lham de gyon ma thag dung mtshor 'gro rgyu lta zhog langs stangs kyang mi shes/ 'on te mos dogs zon chen pos ga ler phar 'gro tshur yong lan 'ga' byas pas rim bzhin lham de mi bde ba med par gyur 'dugabastan sgrol gyis 6 lham de gyon dus khyod sngon ma las yid du 'ong ba chags 'dug dga' rogs kyi blo la bab nges red ces bsngags brjod byas/dung mtshos ra dga' rogs ’ zhes pa'i skad cha de go ma thag de ring gi bya ba zhig yid kā 'khor nas dung mtsho'i ngo gdong chos dmar byug pa bzhin dmar por gyur zlo zhi/ nga dwangs pa'i kun gsal bu mo'i pang du zho gsar srung 'dra'i sprin gsar dal bus rgyu bzhin rta mchog bdun gyi khri la bzhugs pa'i snang sbyin bdag po'i gser zhal chu 'dzin yol ras gseb nas bstan te dkar dmar me tog khra chil bzhan cing phyugs rigs dkar nag sos dal gyi bcud ldan rtswa la rol ba'i yangs pa'i rtswa thang la bltas 'dug dung mtsho'i snang ba shin tu skyid pas snang med ngang mdza' glu zhig kha nas thal/ mos glu mtshams bzhag ste nub phyogs kyi g.yu gos gyon pa'i ri tshogs la lta bzhin lag gnyis kyis skra lo byil byil byas pa na thag ring nas pho gsar zhig gis btang ba'i brtse dung gi ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i mdza' glu zhig grags byung / 6 o/ bkra shes/’ bde skyid kyi me tog zhig dung mtsho'i sems gting du yib pa'i tshul gyis ༷/ba

rgya lhug por grol/ bkra shes kyis glu len bzhin mo la kha phyogs nas yong /de'ang dung mtsho'i re ba dang yongs su mthun mod/ 'on kyang / lang tsho'i dpal 'bar ba'i gzhon nu ma ngo tsha'i rkyen pas mo dal bu'i ngang phyogs gzhan zhig la skyod khul byas/ bkra shes kyis tsa dung mtsho/ sgug dang / 〉 zer nas rgyug byung / 6 las ka yod dam/’ 6 las ku bkra shis yid rab tu myos pa bzhin mig gnyis mo'i ngo gdong la ce rer bltas/ 6 las ka med na/ mi dung mtsho mu mthud mdun du song / tsa sgug dang / mi bkra shis kyis gom pa kha shas mgyogs su btang rjes khos shugs kyis khengs pa'i skyes pa pho'i lag pa gnyis kyis dung mtsho'i dpung pa dam por mnan te lha khyed nga'i bza' mo e byed/mi skad cha de dung mtshos lo mang sgug pa'i gtam bzang zhig yin yang / mo sdibasader khro ba'i tshul bstan te thag ring gi phyogs la dmigs med du rgyug nga / rting ka mtho ba'i 'jur rta de'i bzo lta lham gzhan las ngo mtshar che ba ma zad/ des gyon mkhan gzugs ring du 'gro ba/ lus po drang du 'gro ba/gom pa spo dus kyang dung mtshos nyin mor 'phrad pa'i gnas tshul rnams bsam blo gtong bzhin rab rib rmi lam gyi zhing khams la zhugs/mtha' yas pa'i glang dmar rtswa thang ni lang tsho dar la bab pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig dang 'dra zhing / rnam bkra'i me tog gi mgul rgyan/ sngo ldem chab rgyun gyi ska rags/ da dung shag shag chu phran gyi glu dbyangs/ cang shes rta pho yi 'tsher skad/ stobs ldan nor g.yag gi ngur sgra/ g.yang dkar ra lug gi 'ba' ldir bcas mnyam du 'dzoms pa'i khrod du dung mtshos rting ka mtho ba'i 'jur rta gsar rkyang zhig gyon nas bkra shis dang lag pa sbrel nas phu thung lhab lhub kyis 'phur 'gro gi 'dug don du ngo mtshar rnam par bkra ba'i gzugs ba/spya de lta bu ni lo gcig dus gcig gi glog brnyan nang du ma gtogs ga

par mthong rgyu yod/tho rengs skar chen gyis skul bas dung mtsho gnyid dang bral te khra chung migaganyis gdang pa na dus rgyun med pa'i snying stobs shig dang spro snang zhig gis dung mtsho dang 'grogs pas mo'i kha nas gzhas gtong bzhin gos lham gyon nas spro ba chen pos nyin gsar pa de'i las la zhugs rgyu'i 'go btsams/gnyis/ rīkhyedakyis dung mtsho ni bsam rgyu dran rgyu med pa'i 'brog mo glen ma zhig yin gyi red ma bsam/ ma gzhi mo rig gnas slob sbyong byed myong med pas mos rig pa'i gzhung lugs shig khyer nas gnad don la dbye zhib byed pa'i nus pa med kyang / dung mtsho la rang bzhin spyang grung 'dzoms pa'i klad pa zhig yod/ dung mtshos nyin la bsam rgyu dang mtshan la rmis rgyu ni rting ka mtho ba'i 'jur rta gsar pa zhig yin stabs mos ji ltar byas nas de lag tu thob rgyur bsam gzhigs zab mo byas tshar/ gal srid dgun kha bkra shis tshong la 'gro zhor mngags na mo'i bsam don ha lam 'grub mdog red/ 'on te/mos mdzub rtsis shig rgyag dus yun ring po de 'dra sus sgug thub/ gtan nas sgug mi thub/ gal srid bstan sgrol la thabs shes byed rogs zer na lham zhig rag mdog kha po red/ 'on kyang / kha sang mo'i shod tshul ltar na mo rang la lhamade rang las med pa 'dra/ bag yod tshul ldan gyi mi zhig gis 6 khyod kyi lham de ngas gyon mi zhes skad cha shod pa'i gdong pags mthug po de 'dra ga la yod/ dung mtshos gnam mtha'i sprin dkar la lta bzhin bsam blo zhib tu gtong dus mo'i dwangs shing gsal ba'i 'dren byed zung nas glo bur du thabs shes gsar pa zhig rnyed pa'i dga' spro'i 'od 'tsher/ 6 red/ da ga rakā /da/

rkang thang du nyin phyed ma zin tsam song na rlangs 'khor 'gro sa'i gzhung lam yod/ rlangs 'khor gyi kha lo ba de tsho grong khyer nas grong khyer bar phar bskyod tshur yong kho na byed kyi yod stabs kho tshor rting ka mtho ba'i 'jur rta 'khyer rgyu yod nges red/ kho tsho la rin du ci sprad na lham btsong yong ngam/ o'o/ dran song / grong khyer nang mar ha cang dkon po yod pa grags/ gal srid a pha la mar phran bu sprod rogs zhus na mi sprod pa ga la srid/ des lham de 'dra zhig nyo thub nges red/’ dung mtsho'i blo la 'jur rta rting ka mtho po zhig lag tu thob rgyu'i gdeng tshod kyis khengs te dga' thag chod nas skad gsang mthon pos ki brgyab cing gnam mchongs sa mchongs byas/ 'gram gyi lug mang po zhig skrag nas 'drogs tsam byas rjes ya mtshan gyis phyi bltas byas 'dugadung mtshos rlangs 'khor gzhung lam 'gram du brel ba chen pos 'ur 'ur skad sgra 'byin pa'i ngar lcags kyi phung po las grub pa'i 6 srog chags de sgug nas bsdad/ rgyab tu bzhag pa'i sgye mo'i nang mar rdog gnyis yod/ nyin byed dbang po na chung bu mo'i 'dod don la bsam gzhigs tsam med par shar nas nub tu brel 'tshub ngang bskyod kyi 'dug dung mtshos ske ring bsrings nas rgyang du yang yang bltas/ mo brel ba los byed/ rdzi bo med pa'i lug khyu ni lta mkhan med pa'i byis pa bzhin nyen kha'i khrod du gnas yod/ jag rkun/gcan gzan/ de ltar lug khyu la sems khral byed bzhin pa'i skabs der glog zhags 'khyug pa la 'gran pa'i rlangs 'khor sngon po zhig 'ur sgra 'byin bzhin slobs byung / mos lag pa gnyis ka g.yug nas rlangs 'khor kha 'gog rgyu'i re babaton/ skra nag po/ ngo smug po/ ma dkar po yin yang dregs pas nag por gyur pa'i lag shubs/ kha lo ba des rlangs 'khor gyi sge'u khung nas mar bltas byung / khos 'brog mo me tog 'dra ba zhig kho'i mdun du langs nas yokā ༵ mthong dus kho'i mig zim zim du gyur nas so ser po phyi ru thon bzhin

rlangs 'khor nas bab byung / 66'brog mo mdzes ma de 'dra ba zhig lung stong du 'phrad pa nga'i bsod nams red/ rlangs 'khor nang du mo mi blugs su blugs/’ dung mtsho'i skad cha nyan rjes/ kha lo ba de phar lta tshur lta byas pas lam 'og gi sa cha kong kong de mthong / mig gnyis myur du 'khor bzhin 6 lam thog la skad cha shod bde po med/ 'og tu nged gnyis tshong sgrig tu 'gro zhes bshad pas dung mtsho'i yid la dogs pa ci'ang med par kho'i rjes su song /kha lo ba de dung mtsho'i 'gram du bsdad nas mig gnyis zim zim gyis dung mtsho'i ngo la bltas/ dngos gnas gcan gzan gyis sha mthong ba rang red/khos lag shubs nag po de zur gcig la g.yugs rjes 6 mar rdog gnyis kyis rting ka mtho ba'i 'jur rta nyo mi thub mi ces bshad/ dung mtsho la de min gyi sprodargyu ci'ang med pas 'tshab 'tshub kyis 4ye/ 'o na 〉zer ba las gzhan ci'ang kha nas ma thon/ kha lo ba des dung mtsho'i rnam 'gyur la blo rab tu tshim nas smyo skyon med/ nga'i kha la thengs gcig nyan na ngas lham sprad chog ’ces bshad cing / mig gnyis dmar por gyur nas dung mtsho'i dkar dmar 'tsham pa'i ngo gdong dang / ras gos 'og nas 'bur du thon pa'i nu ma zung la ce rer bltas te kha chu'ang dbang med du 'dzar byung / 6 khyod smad gos phud dang / ngas lham sprad chog mi kha lo ba de ngang rgyud thung thung las mi 'dug mi des de lta bu'i ku re bshad dus dung mtsho ngo tsha rab tu smin nas ci'ang shod ma nus par mgo bo sgur/ khos rtsed mo yin pa thag chod/ de ma gtogs nyin cidakar po la/ sdig pa'i bya ba/ 'on te kha lo ba de 'dod sred can zhig yin pa gdon mi za/ dung mtsho bsam blo zhib tu gtong khom med par mi nag po des mo'i lag pa dam por bzung nas mo la 'o byed par bcoms/ dung mtsho gzhi nas rab rib rmi lam las gnyid sad pa ltar gyur bas mos lus shugs yod tshad bton nas 'phag kyang rlangs 'khor kha lo ba'i stobs ldan lag 'o/ /sa

ga la thar/ de na dung mtsho thabs zad 'u thug pas mthe bong ker ker gyis kho la de ltar mi byed rgyu'i re ba bton/ mi nag po de chags pas rab tu myos stabs ci'ang mi nyan par dung mtsho'i phyi gos kyi ska rags bsheg byis pas a ma mthong ba bzhin mo'i nu mar kha brgyab/ lag pa gcig gis smad gos kyi ska rags bcad song /des na 2 gi hi hi mi zhes pa'i bar skad cig grags byung / mi nag po de tshor snang ci'ang med par lus/ de bkra shes kyi skad red/ glo bur du mo la rdzogs rgyu med pa'i stobs shugs shig byung bas shugs kyis mi nag gi ngo la sen gcus sheg brgyab pas mi nag de 4a tsha tsha mi zhes pa'i skad ngan dbang med du shor/ slar yang bkra shes kyis ki sgra gnam sa 'gul ba zhig bsgrags byung /mi nag po des mgo yar bkyag nas lta dus pho gsar skra gzhug nag po brgyab pa zhig ngar gyis mchongs yong gi 'dug mi nag po de rgyag res thengs mang rgyag myong bas 'tshab snang spu tsam med par dal bu'i ngang yar langs shing rlangs 'khor phyogs su phyin/ bkra shis kyis kho'i lam bkag ste gri shubs nas gri bton te gnam la 'phyar/ de mur mi nag po des ha cang mgyogs po'i ngang nas bkra shis kyi grod pa la rdog rgyag gcig zhus/ gnad la phog stabs bkra shis gri rgyag khom med par sa la 'gyel song / mi nag po des khrel dgod dang bcas te mar yod pa'i sgye mo de rlangs 'khor nang blugs rjes myur du rlangs 'khor btang / thal 'tshub nam mkha' khengs pa'i khrod nas rlangs 'khor de ring du gshegs so/ dung mtsho rab tu khros pas 'ur rdo blangs nas ki brgyab kyang long long thal 'tshub ma gtogs rlangs 'khor sngon po de mo'i mig lam nas yal tshar/bkra shes kyi lus la skyon chen po gang yang byung mi 'dug pas yar langs te dhika 'og nas shor ba'i dgra bo'i rkang rjes la yud tsam bltas/ dus

mtshungs dung mtshos pus mo sa la btsugs te mig nas mchi ma phrum phrum babs byung / bkra shes kyis mchi mas khebs pa'i dung mtsho'i gdong la lta bzhin mo ni sngar bas yid du thong zhing mo'i gzugs stobs kyang chung du song ba ltar mngon pas de bas gces skyong dgos pa'i nyam chung me tog cig dang 'dra/bkra shis kyi lus hril po'i khrag rgyun nang du skyes pa pho zhig gis thams cad bzod sgom thub la thams cad ji mi snyam pa'i blo stobs sheg dang gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i brtse sems shig gis khyab song bas khos phar rgyug nas dung mtsho yar bslangs shing byams brtse chen pos mo'i zang zing du gyur ba'i skra tshogasade dag 'jag 'jag byas/ dung mtsho'i grang shur shur gyi sems la re ba'i drod kyi bde ba rnyed pas mo'i mig zur nas mchi ma'i thigs phreng lhung bzhin bkra shis la lta tsam byas rjes ci'ang ma bshad par mgo bo bkra shes kyi brtan zhing bde ba'i brang ngos la bzhag 'dir gang byed du yong ba yin/mi dung mtshos 'jom zon med par skad cha ngo ma drang po bshad/ bkra shis kyi ngo nas byams brtse'i 'dzum zer skad cig nyid la yal zhing ma dga' ba'i sprin shāg rab tu rnyikhrisasna nas the tshom med par dung mtsho pang nas phar phud de/6 da ༷ /shā sna r+shan gyi bye ṭā/ sdug po gang yang byas med/ 6 de las sdug pa gang yod/ ’6 bstan sgrol rig gnas yod mkhan gyis lham de 'dra gyon 'dug tsa mo la ha las rgyu gang yod/ rgan gras tshos mo bdud mo 'dra po 'dug zer/ mi kho tsho'i kha la nyan rgyu ci yod/ tsa 'o/ khyod kyis bdud mo'i kha la nyan 'dod dam/ dung mtsho blo shin tu pham nas gtam ci yang mi smras par mchi dilha ngo

gdong gsher bar gyur/ yud tsam nas bkra shes kyis 6 da ma ngu/ nor ba shes na 'grig ces sems gso byas/ dung mtsho ni rang gis nor ba shes te ngu ba ga la yin/ mos rang nyid la brnyas bcos phog pa'i skabs 'dir rang la dga' ba'i mi des gdung sems mnyam bskyed byas na ci ma rung snyam yang /re ba dang 'bras bu gnyis tag tag go ldog nas snying tsha po'i thog chu grang mo bshos na dung mtshos slar yang bkra shis kyi lag pa 'jus nas 6 de ring gi gnas tshul 'di mi su la'ang ma shod rogs zhes re ba byas par bkra shes kyis ga ler mgo kyog tsam byas nas khas blangs/de'i dgong mo'ang dus rgyun dang 'dra bar dung mtsho bstan sgrol gyi gam du 'brog glu btang du song / bstan sgrol gyis 'brog glu de dag sgra sdud 'phrul byisa~X nang blugs nas glog 'od kyis mdzes par brgyan pa'i grong khyer la khyer sa /sta/ na sgrol gyis dung mtsho'i mig gnyis skrangs nas dmar por gyur ba dang ngo la mchi ma lhung shul yod pa mthong bas/ 66de ring gang byas song / bstanasgrol gyis a cor rlon pa zhig dung mtsho la sprad de 6 nga la shod dang /gcig byas na ngas khyod la rogs pa thub yong /’ dung mtsho'i mchi mas khengs pa'i 'dren byed zung bstan sgrol gyi byams brtse ldan pa'i ngo gdong la lta bzhin par dogs pa yongs su bral ba'i yid ches shig ngang gis skyes te de ring nyin mo 'phrad pa'i bya ba tshang ma sba gsang med par bstan sgrol la bshad/ bstan sgrol gyis skad cha de rnams thos pa dang rab tu khros te rgya bod 'dres pa'i skad cha'i thog nas rlangs 'khor kha lo ba der dmod mo mang po byas shing / dung mtsho'i mgo la byil byil byas te/ 6 sems ma skyo/ lham de 'dra zhig ngas khyod la sprad chog mi ces bshad/ bstan sgrol gyis de mur ko sgam nang nas shog sgam khra lha /zo lta dod po zhig bton nas dung mtshor sprad/ dung mtshos myur du kha

phyes nas lta dus rting ka mtho ba'i 'jur rta gsar kyang dmar 'od 'tsher ba zhig 'dug a ma ma/mi dung mtsho dga' spros rab tu myos nas gnam mchong sa mchong byas shing dga' tshor chen pos bstan sgrol gyi ske la 'tham/khyim du slobs rjes mos mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i lham de nang mi rnams kyi mdun la ngom ngom byed 'dod kyang a pha'i bka' bkyon la 'jigs nas gzhan gyis ma mthong bar sbas bzhag nyin gnyis par mos lham de am phrag sbug la bcug cing bkra shis kyi mdun la ngom ngom byed bsam/ 6 khos gshegashe btang e yong / btang na btang mi gang yin mi shes par de nyin gom pa kha shas kyis kyang bkra shis dang 'phrad snga phyi 'dug bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la rgyal mtshan tshang gi lug dzi la bkra shes slebs mi 'dugakho'i tshab la sring mo sgrol ma skyid slobs bzhag dung mtsho brel ba chen pos mdun du song nas sgrol ma skyid kyi dpu/ pa nas 'jus te tsa bkra shis ga par phyin song zhes dris/ 6 bkra shis lung pa gzhan la mag par 'gro rtsis yod pas de ring nas lug rdzi nga yin zer/ gnam g.ya' dag nas 'brug skad grags te dung mtsho'i sems gting la gnas pa'i bde skyid kyi ljang bu dang brtse dung gi me tog rnams ya nga snying rje med pa'i bar chad ser bas mig med du bcom song / skabs shig ring dung mtshos ci'ang shod mi thub par 'jim brnyan bzhin had de lus/ rim bzhin mo'i mig rtsa mchi mas brlan song /sgrol ma skyid kyis rgyu mtshan ma rtogs pas 'tshab 'tshub kyis dung mtsho bskyor nas na gi yod med skad cha dris/ cung ma 'gor bar sgrol ma skyid kyis dung mtsho'i nad ngo ma rtogs pas mthong chung gis khrel dgod cig byas te 66o'o/khyod mna' mar 'gro ran bzhag ces go rgyu chen po yod pa'i skad cha tsher ma lta bu de mo'i dmar dmar skyung ku'i mchu to lta bu de nas thon/ dung mtshos de la lan ci'ang ma btab par gom pa mgyogs su spos te lug khyu'i rjes la balha/sa/

dgong mo dung mtshos lug khyu ded de rgyal mtshan tshang gi sgo 'gram brgyud skabs/ gnyen ston gzab mchor gyis legs par brgyan pa'i bkra shes mthong / bkra shes ni byi bas byi la mthong ba bzhin zur zhig la g.yol song /kho'i stobs kyis khengs pa'i mig gnyis 'od dang bral te/ nyin mang po gnyid bral ba dang 'dra/ dung mtshos phyi tshul la ha ma las mdog gi rnam 'gyur ston zhing / kha nas mgo mjug med pa'i gzhas gtong bzhin lug khyu'i rjes la bral med 'brangs/ yud tsam phyin rjes mo phyir bskor nas bkra shes kyi phyogs la lta tsam byed dgos byung / bkra shis ni 'gul ba spu tsam med par mo la rtse gcig tu bltas nas 'dug des na mo'i sems cung lhod du phyin yang cung tsam rang red/ dung mtsho lug rjes su mu mthud mdun du 'gro dus skyo ba'i gdangs la drangs pa'i skyes pa'i glu zhig mo'i rna lam du grags/ de ni/ bkra shis kyis do dgong mo zla 'od kyis brgyan pa'i chu khug der shog ces pa'i gsal brda red/smyo nyen/ blo med nus med kyi skyes pa des ci zer/ nga mi 'gro ’ snyam/ 'on te dus la slebs dus mi 'gro ga la nus/zla ba gsar pa'i bsil sbyin 'od snang gis khyab pa'i lung kyog ri grong de sngar bas 'jam thing thing du snang / ri khrod nas babs pa'i chu phran de kha na rgyu med pa'i lo brgyad byis pa zhig dang 'dra bar nam yang ca co 'byin zhing long long rba rlabs 'khrug pa'i ri gsham gyi gtsang po la kha gtad nas rgyug 'gro/rang byung khams ni de ltar zhi lhod rtsod bral yin rung bkra shes dang dung mtsho gnyis kyi sems ni cis kyang zhi lhod du gnas thabs bral/smyo dung mtsho/ nga la thabs shes mi 'dug mi6 thabs shes mi 'dug e/ gnyen sgrig rang mos ma red dam/ min ning shang gi las byed pa zhig gis gnyen sgrig rang mos yin pa'i srid jus khyab bsta/sa byed myong /

66de grong khyer nang gi lugs srol red/ nga tsho de 'dra ga par yong gi red/mi ha go song / khyed kyi sems la nga mi 'dug ma nga la yid ches mi 'dug gam/ ngas a pha la nyin mang po bshad pa na/ tsa a pa'i kha la ma nyan na 'grig gi red/’ 6 dpe mi srid/ bu phrug gis pha ma'i kha la ma nyan pa/’ yi de 'dra yin na/ khyod kyis nga la mgo skor btang dgos don gang na/ mi dgongs pa ma tshom/ da dung a pa'i kha la ma nyan na a pha rang shi rgyag gi yin zer gyi 'dug bkra shis kyis sor gdub cig blangs nas dung mtsho'i mdzub mor brgyus te 66de nam yang dran rten byed rogs/ khong khro gtan nas ma za zer bzhin dung mtsho'i lag pa gnyis po dam por 'jus/ skabs der dung mtsho'i khong khro thams cad skad cig ring zhi zhing bkra shis kyi brang khar dal bus mgo bsnyes/ bkra shes kyis dung mtsho'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mchu sgros dang chu mig ltar dwangs shing gsal ba'i 'dren byed la lta bzhin mo'i sked pa nas dam por 'jus/skabs der bkra shes kyi yid la 'gyod gdung dang / brtse sems kyi la rgya yod do cog glo bur rgyas pa'i chags pa'i gdung bas bskrad de lus hril po tsha 'ur 'ur byas/ khos dbugs hal bzhin dung mtsho'i ska rags kyi mdud pa 'grol ba la rtsom/ 6 chag7 dung mtsho glo bur du rig pa dwangs gsal du gyur nas chags pas gdung ba'i bkra shis kyi gdong la 'gram lcag tsha thag chod cig gzhus shing bkra shis bskyur nas brgyugs song / zla 'od 'og tu babs pa'i mchi ma'i char rgyun ni dwangs gsal shel gyi phreng ba ltar lhad med dwangs /shāng

dang phyi gsal nang gsal zhig tu mngon la de dag dmigs med mdun du /gas 'gyu ba'i gzhon nu ma de'i rgyab tu bskyur ba'i lam bu'i thog tu bkrams gan sdu ga tsi/ dga' sdug gan ta mgo sbrel ’ zhes pa'i 'jig rten rgan po'i kha gtam de bden srid na da ni brtse dung gi nyam nyes phog pa'i gzhon nu ma de la bde ba dang skyid pa'i 'tsho ba rol ba'i skabs shig rnyed dgos/nyin gnyis par/ dung mtshos rting ka mtho ba'i 'jur rta de sngas 'og la sbas te lug 'tsho ru song /dgong mo lug khyu lhas rwar bcug ste dung mtsho sbra gur 'gram du slebs tshe mo'i gcung po lo brgyad byas pa zhig yod pa khos shing dmar po zlum zlum gnyis bzung nas rtsed mor rol bzhin 'dug ci yin mi shes kyang dung mtsho dngangs skrag skyes te lus kyi ba spu rnams gyen du zing / tsa de gnyis ci red/’ 66a phas sprad byung / mo brel ba chen pos sbra gur nang du 'dzul te sngas 'og la bltas pas rting ka mtho ba'i 'jur rta cha gcig po de gral star 'grig pos sngas 'og la bzhag yod/ lag tu blangs nas lta dus tsa a ma ma/ lham gyi rting ka/ shās ci'ang byed khom med par khro ba'i ngu skad thal te/ 6 'di sus bcad nga /’ 66ngas bcad pa yin/ mo'i pha bde 'grub kyis de ltar bshad/tsa sus gcod zer/mi pomi ma bcad na 'dre lham des rkang pa bcag yong / rting ka bcad na yag ༷shāg 'a /sna/ yag po mi 'dug nga'i lham gyi tshab khyer shog mi dung mtshos ngu skad sngar bas che ba bsgrags pas grong pa'i byis pa rnams gcig rjes gnyis maḥhā kyis sbra gur gyi sgo rtsar langs nas ltad mo bltas/ mig rtsa dmar por

gyur pa'i bde 'grub kyis rgyug pa zhig khyer nas dung mtsho'i 'gram du slebs/phra gu rnams ni bde 'grub kyi gson pa'i tshe srog dang bde ba'i rtsa ba yin pas sdus rgyun sen 'thog tsam yang brgyab mi nus pas de ring rgyug pas ga la brdung phod/ 6 a ra ra ’ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la bde 'grub kyi lag tu thogs pa'i rgyug pa de gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis dung mtsho'i lus la gzhus pa dang kha nas phu da khyod song / nga tsho'i khyim la khyod mi dgos zhes pa'i ngar skad dang bcas te yang yang sgrog byung / dung mtsho'i a ma slebs rjes dung mtshor 'thams nas tsa nga'i bu mo brdungs nas ci byed/ khyod la mi dgos na nga la dgos/mi a mas bde 'grub la ma 'dod pa'i skad cha mi nyung ba zhig bshad pas da gzod rgyug pa sa la bzhag a mas dung mtshor sems gso byas kyang skad cha de tshos na chung bu mo'i snying gi ser ga ga la 'grig thub/de'i dgong mo dung mtsho nyal ba'i gnyid dang bral te yid la sngar song gi bya ba rnams khra lam mer 'khor/ sngar 'das pa'i bya ba la phyir 'dang byas pas rig pa de bas dwangs gsal du gyur te 'dren byed zung nas mchi ma'i chu rgyun rgyun mi chad par zags te sngas mgo brlan pa gyur/ mos sngar byas kyi bya ba la bsam bzhin bsam bzhin de dag mig chu dang sdug bsngal las bral rgyu med pa shes te mu mthud 'dang rgyag ma byas/ da lta'i gnas bab la bsam tshe brtse ba'i bkra shes dang 'grogs pa'i skabs dang bral/ byams pa'i a phas rgyug pas brdungs/ da dung yid la ring mo nyid nas smon pa'igaces nor 'jur rta de'i rting ka bcad/ a tsi/ 'dod pa btsal ni mi rnyed/ mi 'dod thog tu babs pa/ da phyi 'byung ci 'dra byed der bsam gzhigs yun ring byas kyang yid la 'thad pa'i thabs shes ma rnyed/ rna bar glo bur du nyin shas gong lha 'dzoms kyis bshad pa'i gtam zhig grags byung ste/ 6 dung mtsho/ khyod lha sa la e 'gro/ 'gro na nga gnyis mnyam du 'gro mi de ga rang red/ 7snang

nyin lha 'dzoms btsal nas lha sar 'gro rgyu'i gros byed/ de ltar bsam tshe dung mtsho'i blo cung bde ru song ste gzhi nas gnyid kyis gzi bar gyur/ skabs der tho rengs skar chen nam mkhar shar ba de ni sems can thams cad dga' skyid hā 'tsho bar rol rgyu'i smon lam rtse gcig tu 'debs bzhin pa ltar gnas

dus kyi 'gyur khug de ring ni rang skyong ljongs skabs drug pa'i srid gros kyi gros tshogs thengs bcu drug pa sngar bzhin rgyal kha'i ngang grol rgyu red/ g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis 'dzum dmul dmul ngang za khang nang 'dzul zhing dal bu'i ngang don yod sprul sku'i 'gram du bsdad/ g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis rang nyid kyi mdun du bsgrigs pa'i sna 'dzoms tshal rigs la lta bzhin thams cad rtswa red snyam pa'i snang ba 'char/ rtswa ste dud 'gro'i zas/ rtswa thang stong la ga tshod dgos na'ang yod/ glang chu rtswa thang la rtswa dang me tog shin tu mang / bgrang bya sum cu yud tsam zhig la 'das zin/ dus kyi chu rgyun/ de dus khong gi khyim la gser dngul dang phyugs zog gi 'byor ba med kyang pha 'das pos khong la gso rig gi lag rtsal byang chub pa zhig bslab pas khong dang ma rgad mo gnyis grod pa ma ltogs tsam dang / lus po ma 'khyags tsam byung /bsam yul las 'das pa'i bya ba zhig gis khong gi mi tshe hril por 'gyur ba shugs chen byung ba ste/ nyin zhig cham tha dpon tshang gi gsol dpon a grags rta pho lcag gis skul nas srang stod grong du 'byor/ dpon bsod nams lhun grub glo bur nad kyis mnar bas g.yung drung 'gyur med myur du yong dgos pa'i brda btang / dngos gnas nad kyi mdun du tshang ma 'dra mnyam red/ nad ces pa de dbang shed can gyis dmag la brten nas pha /lha du

'bud mi thub la 'byor ba can gyis gser dngul la brten nas bslu brid kyang byedami thub/ deng skabs kyi skad cha zhig bshad na 6 ltag sgo ’ 'gro sa med/g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis 'tshab 'tshub ngang sman gra sgrig byas rjes a grags kyis khrid pa'i rta la bzhon nas thal 'tshub kyi khrod du lam kyag kyog mang po bcad nas cham tha dpon tshang gi gnas yul glang chu rtswa thang du 'byor/ yul der sbra gur las khang pa mngon rgyu nyung rung cham tha dpon tshang la gsum brtsegs can gyi thog khang shin tu rngam brjid che ba zhig yod/ yul de'i g.yog pho mo tshos sman pa 'byor ba mthong rjes sa mchongs gnam mchongs byed pa'i khyi rnams bkag ste g.yung drung 'gyur med thad kur dpon gyi na tsha lta ru khrid/skabs der dang dod che zhing rgyan gos legs pa'i lus phra ma zhig g.yog mo 'ga' dang bcas sems sdug chen pos yong gi 'dug phra zhing ldem pa'i lus la gos chen rgya dmar gyi phyu pa gyon zhing / sha rtsi dkar la dkri ga che ba'i 'dren byed zung skyo snang gis khengs yod kyang shin tu yid dbang 'phrog par mchis/mo ni dpon bsod nams lhun grub kyis shin tu rtsa cher brtsi ba'i bu mo snang sgron zhes pa de red/ skabs der g.yung drung 'gyur med dang snang sgron gnyis gcig mig gcig la blta ba dang skabs 'khel bas g.yung drung 'gyur med kha skyengs te mgo phur tsam byas nas myur du skas la 'dzegs/ g.yung drung 'gyur med la kun gyis dga' po byed pa'i gzugs byad cig ldan/ de'ang pha mas gnangab red/ g.yog mos 6 sras mo phebs dang mi zhes bshad de snang sgron khyim nang khrid/ g.yung drung 'gyur med ni gso rig gi lag rtsal la mkhas pas dbyin bsod nams lhun grub kyi nad kyang nyin re las nyin re bzhin drag ba da zlorno zhi/ ga gsol dpon a grags kyis lug sha khog gcig dang thud spus leX shig 'khyer nas g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi sar yong ste 'di sras mos

skyel bar btang byung zhes shod bzhin mig chung chung gnyis deb tsam byas te phyir thon/ snang sgron gyis lta rtog 'di lta bu byas pa g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi bsam yul las 'das/ tsha ba'i gdung bas mnar dus bsil bsil rlung bu zhig ldang ltar g.yung drung 'gyur med spro ba rab tu 'phel/ snang sgron dang rang nyid dbar gang sa ci thad nas gnam sa lta bu'i khyad par yod pas mo phal cher dpon tshang zhig gi mna' mar bsu nges/ snang sgron ni sems bzang gtong phod can gyi bu mo zhig red/ na ning dpon tshang gi lde mig rnams snang sgron gyis bdag po rgyag gi yod pas 'khor g.yog rnams la 'bab yon che zer/de'i rkyen gyis 'di lo a grags la lde mig nyar du bcug pa red/ g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi bsam blo zang zing du gyur te/ sman brdung rgyu de'ang da dung rdung tshar med/ 6 thag thag ces snang sgron gyis sgo brdungs te nang du 'dzul byung / dngos gnas 66ma mthong mthong na bsam bsam/ mthong na ma mthong bsam bsam/mi rang red/ g.yung drung 'gyur med ni rdo tsha po'i steng gi grog ma ltar rtab rtob por yar langs shing / gdan thog gi thal rdul lag pas deb tsam byas rjes 66sras mo bzhugs ’ zhes bshad/ snang sgron gyis cung dga' ba'i ngang 'dzum tsam byas te 6 khyod rang sdod mices bshad de ngo tsha smin pos mgo bo smad cing yud tsam ring ci bshad 'di bshad med par lus/ 6 ngas sman rdung rogs byed chog ces mo'i spus legs phyu pa thal rdul 'go rgyu yang ma 'dzems par sar bsdad de sman rdung 'go btsams/ g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi sems nang thog mar dpon gyi bu mos g.yog gi rogs pa byas na ga la 'grig snyam/yang bsam blo zhig btang dus mo rang gi phas za rgyu'i sman red/ bu phug gis cipha mar bkur sti byed byu ni mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug dang mthun/ snang sgron gyi sman rdung stangs ni zlos gar 'khrab pa ltar sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur ldan zhing / lus kyi dgye sgur gyi stangs stabs dang dbugs kyi dal lhod byisam

zhing / brang steng gi nu 'bur zung yang 'gul tsam 'gul tsam byed kyi yod/mos mgo bkyag tsam mi byed kyang mo'i khra zhing sgor ba'i mig dang de'i thog gi gral ltar 'grig pa'i rdzi ma rnams g.yung drung 'gyur med la ltad mo ston pa ltar mig mdun du mthong dus ci nas kyang bkag mi thub pa'i 'dun pa drag po zhig skyes/ 6 sras mo 'o brgyal song /pa sman brdungs zin pas g.yung drung 'gyur med la gzhan gyi skad cha 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig ma rnyed/ skabs der a grags yar 'dzul zhing / khos snang sgron la mtho dma' dbye ba med par g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi mdun du bsdad yod pa mthong dus rnam 'gyur shin tu mi legs par gyur zhing g.yung drung 'gyur med la ༷ khyod da lta dpon gyis shog gsungagi 'dug ces brjod song bas snang sgron gyis g.yung drung 'gyur med la lta tsam byas te sgo las don/ zu sras mo 'dir ci byed par yong ba red dam ’zhes dris pas g.yung drung 'gyur med ni shod mi shes pa'i khong khro zhig gis kho la lan ci'ang ma btab/ kho'i rgyu nor dang dbang cha phran bu la bltas nas gnya' dma' po byed dgos don ci yod snyam/de ni dpyid char zim zim 'bab pa'i phyi dro zhig red/ snang sgron gyis sgo yang ma rdung par shar rer 'dzul byung / snang sgron gyi gdong mdog ha cang skyo bas/ a tsi/ ga re byas pa yin nam/ g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis myur du yar langs te 4sras mo snyan gyi 'dug gam mizhes dris pas/ snang sgron gyis ngo tsha mdog gis mgo bo dud tsam byas te 6 nga la rtsa zhig lta rogs ’ zhes mo'i dkar zhing 'jam pa'i lag pa de tshur bsrings byung / g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis mo'i lag pa reg nas ci shod 'di shod med par yun ring lus stabs snang sgron gyis dgod tsam byas nas lha nad ci red mi ces dris pas g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis zu shes ma song / khyed rang ci na gi 'dug 7ces phar dris/ lha dngos gna~X shes kyi mi 'dug gam ’ zhes snang sgron gyis mig gi zur mda' g.yung

drung 'gyur med la 'phangs shing 6 byas na 'gro gi yin zhes 'gro rtsis byas/de'i tshe g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi blo sgo hob ste phyes shing lus hril por skyes pa pho zhig la yod pa'i blo stobs shig ngang du skyes te 6 nga do dgong yong gi yin dā zhes kha nas thal bas snang sgron ngo mdog dmar por gyur nas gom stabs mgyogs pos phyi ru thon/g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis snang sgron gyi khang pa'i sgo dal bus phye skabs nang gi sgo lcags brgyab med pa mthong bas sems gting nas dga' lhang lhang byas/ skabs der nang logs nas shub shub kyi sgra zhig rna bar thos/ ga ler nyan dus mo'i 'khris la a grags slebs yod pa shes shing / de nas zhib tu lta dus/ rab rib kyi a grags mngon/ khos pus mo sa la btsugs nas snang sgron gyi nyal gzan 'then tsam 'then tsam byed cing kha nas zhu ba 'then gyi 'dug g.yung drung 'gyur med ni khang pa'i zur du dbugs kyang gtong ma phod par bsdad/ 'on kyang khong gi sems nang gal srid lhag mi srid pa'i gnas tshul lhag na ci byed/ a tsi/ mgo skor 'og tu tshud pa'i sems bzang can gyi lu gu de yid kyi me long ngos su lhang nger shar/ chu tshod gcig tsam phyin rung spyang ki sha la rngam pa ltar a grags da dung ma log skabs der snang sgron nyal sa las langs shing kha nas 6 khyod kyis nga nyal du ma bcug na nga a pha 'bod kyi yin ’ zer ba las mo rab tu khros pa rtogs thub/ g.yung drung 'gyur med khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar te ga ler gri mgo nas 'chang / a grags skrag nas 6 sras mo gzim ā/ nga 'gro gi yin/ dpon la ma zhu rogs/thugs rje gzigs mizhes bshad de 'tshab be 'tshub be'i ngang bros/ cisnang sgron ni shin tu g.yung ba'i lu gu zhig bdag po'i mdun du 'byor ba ltar 'gul tsam yang mi byed la/ dbugs kyi rgyu ba shin tu myur/ snang sgron gyis g.yung drung 'gyur med mthong ma thag dga' thag chod nas rang nyiswā gis

gces par 'dzin pa'i lang 'tsho'i me tog de khong la 'bul ba 'dod/ 6 khyod kyis nga mna' mar len rogs mi zhes glo bur du brjod pas g.yung drung 'gyur med ni ha lam rang gi rna bar rang gis yid ma ches pa ltar dang gzhan yang dpon gyi bu mo g.yog po'i mna' ma la bsu ba de ni mi lam rang red snyam/'on te snang sgron gyis rang nyid la lhag bsam 'di lta bu bcangs yod na nga ni g.yang nas mchongs dgos kyang 'gyod pa ci/ de ltar nyin drug tsam dga' spro'i ngang 'das rjes/ a grags kyis khrel dgod cig byas te 6 g.yung drung 'gyur med/ dpon gyis khyod shog zer gyi 'dug ces lan sprad/dpon bsod nams lhun grub dus rgyun lha sku ltar gyi 'dzum dmul le ba'i rnam 'gyur de de ring rbad de bsdus shing mig khro tshugs su bltas te lha khyod kyis snang sgron la gang byas pa yin nam :zhes dris/ snying la tsher ma btsugs 'dra'i skad cha des g.yung drung 'gyur med khros te 66ngas mo mna' mar bsu 'dod mices brjod pas dpon ha las par gyur nas smyo sprang gog khyod kyi ham pa la ang / mi ༷wa ye mi shog dang ces brjod ma thag gdon 'dre lta bu'i mi gsum nang du 'dzul byung / smyo kho la rta lcag brgya tham pa gtong ’ zhes bshad/lcag tshan zhu mkhan pho rgod gnyis pos snying rje spu tsam med par lcag tshan gzhu thengs re la g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi snying rtsa chad pa ltar du gyur/ khrag gi thigs pas sa gzhi dmar por gyur/ skabs der bud med cig ngu 'bod kyi khrod rgyug yong ba'i sgra zhig g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi rna bar grags/ 6 kho la khag med/ lcag tshan nga la gtong rogs ’ zhes snang sgron gyis rang nyid kyi lus pos g.yung drung 'gyur med bkab/ a grags kyis snang sgron ji ltar 'then yang snang sgron gyis g.yung drung 'gyur med la dam por 'khyud pa las gtan nas ma glod/ dpon bsod nams lhun grub la gnas tshul snyan seng zhus pas lhaswā rdon gtong mtshams bzhag ste myur du btson 'jug byed dgos pa'i

bka' phab/ skabs der g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi sems nang a tsi/ de sngon chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan skabs sman pa'i spyi tshogs gnas babs shin tu mtho bas 6 lha rje zhes pa'i mtshan snyan yang thob mod/ 'on kyang deng skabs zhes sems rab rib tu song / de nas mi ring bar dpon gyi nad sdug tu phyin pas g.yung drung 'gyur med btson grol mi byed thabs med byung /mi rnams kyis snang sgron btsun ma byas nas dgon par phyin pa red zer/g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis gtam 'di thos dus bsam yul las 'das pa zhigabyung rung nyis shas song rjes snang sgron btsun chas gyon pa de mthong dus yid la gdung ba bzod mi thub pa zhig byung / 'on kyang bsam blo zhib phra zhig btang dus re thag rbad de chod/ rang nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa byed mkhan zhig yin pas btsun ma'i sdom pa gshig na dpag med kyi sdig pa bsags rgyu yin zhing tshe phyi ma thar sa ga la yod/srid gros kyi gsol ston la zhugs pa'i g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis de ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i gsol ston bskyur nas dran shes kyi rgya mtsho kho nar rkyal du rol bas na 'gram du bzhugs pa'i don yod sprul skus kho'i dpung pa bcag tsam byas te 6 em rje lags/ zhal lag mchod dang mizhes bshad pas g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis mgo bo kyog tsam byas pa dang sbrags 4 lags so/lags so mi zhes bshad pa las khos tshal de rnams slar yang rtswa red snyam/ bod byang phyogs kyi ri klung thams cad ljang thing nger gnas yod/ de las g.yag gi rgyu ma zhig mer bsregs nas zos na zhim po ga 'dra med dam/ de'ang na ning ste/ 'brog khul du yod pa'i sring mo'i nang du rgyun du za bsam pa'i rgyu ma mer bsregs nas bzas pas zas dug phog ste tog tsam min na phyi ma'i lam du bskyod grabs yin/ 'on kyang de dus khong rang skyong ljongs srid gros kyi u yon dang sbra stod rdzong srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa yin stabs myur du rlangs byiltor

yong nas sman khang du bskyal zhing nyin mtshan gnyis ring dza drag sman bcos byas rjes nyen kha las thar tsam byung / gal srid rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs yin na o rgyan pad+ma mkhyen/ rdzong rig gnas gsar brje'i gyen log gi 'go gtso dpon mā shang zhes pa de sung stod du rig gnas gsar brje'i me lce spar du yong zhing zla ba gcig tsam bsdad/ kho sung stod du 'byor rjes kyi bya ba dang po des g.yung drung 'gyur med rbad de ha las pa ste/ khos tshogs chen gzab rgyas shig bskong tshogs byas nas bod kyi 'brog pas mchu bsdams nas lugagasod pa ni rbad de rmongs dad red ces khyab bsgrags byas shing rjes su lug gsod dus ske gcod dgos pa'i bka' phab/ g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi bod sman gyi bya ba der dmangs kyis brtsi bkur thob pas dpon mā shang shin tu ma dga' bar phrag dog gi me lce 'bar zhing gnod sems kyi du ba 'thul/nyin zhig ru khag gi tud krang lha lung brel 'tshub chen pos g.yung drung 'gyur med sar rgyugs yong nas dpon mā shang glo bur du na 'dug myur du yong dgos zer/ dpon mā shang ni a ra dang u ru zer 'gre log rgyag bzhin 'dug stabs dngos gnas nad ljid po phog pa 'dra/ rjes su dpon mā shang gi shod stangs dang rtsa yi 'phar stangs la lta dus mkhris nad 'dra bas sman phul/'on kyang bsam yul las 'das par dpon mā shang gis 66ga re/ mgo skor gtong mkhan/ ga re'i rtsa/ lag pas reg tsam byas pas ga re shes kyi red dam ’ zhes hob ste yar langs byung / 6 nga la nad ci'ang med/ khyod la tshod lta byas pa yin/ a ma'i ro/ khyod kyis mi ga tshod la mgo bskor btang med dam/mar phyin nas bsam blo yag po gtong shog g.yung drung 'gyur med sgo don ma thagadapon mā shang bsam don 'grub song bsam ste ha ha zhes gad mo bgad/nyin de nas g.yung drung 'gyur med sman pa rdzun ma red ces grong tsho yongs la khyastu byisgrags byas/ dpon mā shang dus rgyun mkhris shed che ba'i mi zhig yin

stabs de dus kho rang gi nad de mkhris pa red ces pa nor 'khrul med kyang skabs de dus zhal dang kha thug pas bden pa bshad sa ga la yod/nyin gnyis pa'i zhogs pa snga po nas dpon mā shang gis kho yong dgos pa'i bka' btang / khang pa'i nang 'dzul ma thag a grags khang pa'i nang nas mar thon byung / a grags dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs lha lung tshang du mag par yong ba red/ mi des skad cha yag po zhig bshad med pa thag chod/6 khyod kyis de sngon log spyod pa'i bu mo dang mnyam du sdod rtsis byas pa ma red dam mizhes brjod/ ngo ma red/ de'ang 'das zin pa'i bya ba zhig red/ 'on te g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi ngos nas bshad na thung thung min pa'i mi tshe'i brgyud rim nang sus kyang bsrub thabs med pa'i lo rgyus shig yin/snang sgron dgon pa las log yong / 'on kyang snang sgron gyi gnas bab ni a sngon dbyings nas dog mo sa la lhung ba dang 'dra bas sus mo dang mnyam du sdod phod/ rang nyid kyi rus pa dkar po nag nog 'dres 'dod byed mkhan med/ las ka ci'ang mi shes pa'i sras mo zhig da lta rang kha rang gso thub pa'i ngal rtsol pa zhig tu gyur pa ni ci nas kyang dga' 'os pa zhig red/rta bdun dbang po rim bzhin nub phyogs chu lha'i phang du phyogs pas ri bo'i rtse mo kun gyis mngon mdzes gser 'od kyi dbu zhwa mchod/ g.yung drung 'gyur med glang chu rtswa thang du 'byor zhing / snang sgron de sngon dpon tshang gi phyags ma blugs sa'i khang chung zhig gi nang bsdad yod pa las khang pa gzhan rnams gzhung bzhes kyis dbul po rnams la bgos/ khos ga ler sgo brdungs/snang sgron gyis sgo phye bas g.yung drung 'gyur med mthong ste ha las nas re zhig ci shod 'di shod med par 'jim sku ltar lus/ de nas ngu ngag dang bcas ra yar phebs mi zhes bshad/ sha rtsi sngon las nag tu phyin yod cing / 'dren byed zung nas shod mi shes pa'i skyo mdangs shig mngon gyi 'dug mo'i kāhā du

lpags gdan gcig dang rdza snod gnyis/ phor pa kha shas shig las rgyu nor ci'ang mi 'dug g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis snang sgron sras mo'i skabs kyi rgyas spros kyi rnam pa dag yid du 'khor te snying rje drag po skyed/ snang sgron gyis ja sla po phor pa gang blugs rjes 66da nang bya skya gas khang pa'i thog kha nas skad rgyag gi 'dug pas nga'i sems nang phal cher mgron po zhig yong rgyu red bsam byung zhes bshad de mgo bo smad/ skabs der g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis 6 khyed deng sang ga 'dra yod mi ces dris/ 66nga ji zhes snang sgron dbugs ring nar nar 'byin bzhin slar yang 6 zing 'khrug skabs nga'i a pha gar song mi 'dug ’ ces ngu skad dang sbrags brjod/ de rjes mgrin pa brnangs te mchi mas ngo gdong brlan par byas/ g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis lag pas mo'i dpung pa'i steng du bzhag nas 6 nga dang mnyam du 'gro zhes tshig thag chod pos bshad pas snang sgron ha las nas g.yung drung 'gyur med la bltas nas bsdad/ yud tsam phyin rjes 6 yag byung / ngas khyed thag zhor 'breng 'drud byas na ga la 'grig ces mgo bo g.yug da nga gnyis gzhan la zhed mi dgos mizhes brjod pas snang sgron gyi mig chu btang shul gyi ngo gdong nas bcos min gyi 'dzum mdangs shig shar te byis pa zhig dang 'dra bar kho'i brang kha'i steng du dga' tshor chen pos bsnyes/ g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis de ltar zla ba rjes mar snang sgron dngos su bsu rgyu'i gtan 'khel byas rjes srang stod grong du log khros snang sgron mna' mar len gyi yod pa'i skad cha de gshog pa skyes pa ltar gang sar khyab/ de nas bzung g.yung drung 'gyur med la slob gso dngaskyon brjod byed mkhan rgyun ma chad pa byung ste kha cig gis sems bzang pos mjug 'bras shod cing / kha cig gis chab srid kyi langs phyogs brtan po dgos lugs sogs kyi slob gso ga tshod brgyab kyang khos de dag thams cad rna brdo /ba kyi lhags par btang /

kha chad byas pa'i nyin der g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis rogs pa zhig khrid nas glang chu ru 'byor/ snang sgron sgo 'gram du langs 'dug g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis dga' spro'i ngang rta las bab dus mo'i ngo mdog shin tu skyo bas nad kyis mnar ba min nam snyam ste rtab rtob ngang mdun du song nas skad cha dris/ de'i tshe snang sgron gyis blo 'gyod chen pos tsa khyod log song / nga rang gcig pu mi tshe skyel rtsis yod ces mgo bo dud/ snang sgron gyi skad cha de g.yung drung 'gyur med kyi bsam yul las 'das te 6 ga re/ kha sngon khyed rang gis khas blangs pa ma red dam mi zhes cung zad blo ma bde bar gyur/ 'on kyang snang sgron gyis zhu ba nan po brgyab cing mthar nang du 'dzul nas sgo dam por mnan/ g.yung drung 'gyur med ni ha las shing hon thor nas sgo 'gram du krong nger langs pa las ci bya gtol bral du gyur/ cang mi 'gor bar kho pa'i mtha' 'khor du mi tshogs kyis khengs shing tshang ma ca co'i brel bar rol 'dugaskabs der g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis 6 khyed tsho mi ma red mi ces skad sgra bar snang mthongs su bsgrags/ kho pas khrid yong ba'i rogs pa de yang thabs shes zad de 6 da skad ma rgyag nga tsho log 'gro zhes brjod ma thag g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis rta bzhon te smyo ba ltar rgyug rgyun du rta la shin tu brtse ba'i g.yung drung 'gyur med kyis de ring rta'i shi gson la'ang jus gtogs mi byed par rta'i kha nas lbu ba 'phyur bzhin srang stod grong du phyin/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam yang ma song bar snang sgron tshe las 'das/don yod sprul skus g.yung drung 'gyur med la lto za dgos pa'i dran skul thengs gnyis pa de byas/ khong gis kho'o tses tshal sna kha kha shas bzas kyang de dag thams cad 6 rtswa 7yin snyam/ de yang gtso bo kho pa rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs btson 'jug byed dus bro ba gtan nas med pa'i ri skyes sngo tshal sha stag bzas pas so/ /91

bla ma bsten pa/de ring nyin gsum pa red/ thub mchog rgad pos mi ring bar brag ri dmar po lha 'dre'i 'phrul gyis spos yong ba lta bu'i gna' bo'i dgon chen de mig mdun du mngon rgyu red snyam nas sems gting nas brjod mi shes pa'i dga' dad kyi spu long rab tu g.yos/ khos gzugs mdzes pa'i rta pho'i thog tu gzab 'chor gyis brgyan pa'i bu skal bzang dbang grags bskyon pa dang /rang nyid rkang thang du rta kha khrid/ dus kyi ral gri non pos kho'i ngo gdong gtsab gdan ltar bzos kyang lo zla'i rkang rjes su gyur pa'i gnyer ris kun nas bde skyid kyi 'dzum mdangs wa ler shar/ kho'i mig mdun du shar ba'i dbyar dus kyi re stod rtswa thang ni gna' bo'i lha sgrung du bshad pa'i g.yu yi mtsho mo zhig dang 'dra la gang sar rgyu ba'i dkar po lug gi khyu ni rab tu 'thor ba'i rlabs dkar kyi zegs ma dang mtshungs/ khos phyi bltas shig byas nas rta thog gi bu la lta tsam byas pas/ lo bdun la slebs pa'i bu chung sha rgyags la mig che zhing rna gnyis thur du dbyangs pa 'di ngo ma sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku mi yul du byon pa ltar du mngon/ zad mi shes pa'i bde ba dang spobs pa zhig kho'i lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga re re bzhin nas nang gi don lnga snod drug la sim/ lung pa 'dir rang nyid las gzi brjid che ba zhig su yod snyam nas ltag pa dgye dgye byapa spras mig gnyis gnam sa lhan du sbrel sa'i ri tshogs la bltas/

lus la gyon pa'i gos gsar dang mig mdun du mngon pa'i rtswa thang dang me tog gis rol rtsed la dga' ba'i gyis pa 'dir dga' ba dang bde ba spu tsam yang mi ster/ skal bzang dbang grags mgo bo gug cing thams cad la yid thang chad pa lta bu'i sun snang zhig mngon/ kho'i mig chen po gnyis lha yi bzo bos ngal ba brgya phrag gis ched du bskrun pa lta bu'i mdzes sdug ldan yang de ring de las blo rig bkra ba'i gzi 'od dang lo chung byis pa'i mtshar snang sogs ci'ang mngon mi thub/ mdun gyi rtswa gseb nas sngo zhing dwangs ba'i chu phran zhig lhung lhung me tog 'thu bzhin 'bab mod kyang chu mo'i shag sgra ni byis pa 'di'i rna lam du na mnyam byis pa zhig gi ngu skad dang 'dra/ kho'i ngo gdong du yid skyo ba'i sprin gyi 'du 'god 'tshub cing mig gi nam mkha' nas mchi ma'i char rgyun bab/ phyi gsal nang gsal gyi mchi ma'i rdog po de thams cad gsal pa'i me loḥ du 'gyur nas sngon byung gi bya ba 'ga' kho'i mig mdun du rab ba du sna zhi/ /skal bzang dbang grags dang grogs po lhun dbang shang la bros nas shang slob chung du 'gro rgyu'i tho 'god byed par song / tho 'god byed par sgor gcig dgos pas rgan lags skra skya phyed sngo phyed byas pa zhig gis sprod rogs byas/ nyin gnyis par rgan lags des khong tshor ka kha bslabs/ skal bzang dbang grags shes mgyogs pas rgan lags kyis yang yang bstod bsngags byas/ de'i dgong mo don de pha thub mchog gis shes 'phral rgyun du kho la dpral ba'i mig ltar gces kyang da res rab tu khros nas skad cha'ang shod mi thub par lus/ phyi nyin slob grwa tshugs mtshams/ pha thub mchog sha rer shang slob chung du song ste dge rgan de dang kha rtsod brgyab nas nga'i bu bslu brid byed mi chog ces yang nas yang du smras/66log cig khyod grwa pa byed dgos zhes sngar nas bshad ma byung nga/3/ ’

skal bzang dbang grags kyis tshig gcig shod khom ma byung par byi'u khras bzung ba ltar pha yis pang la 'khyer nas rta thog la bsdams/skal bzang dbang grags kyi mchi ma rim bzhin skam/ skra skya phyed sngo phyed byas pa'i rgan lags de yid la 'khor dus gnam sa gnyis la gdong pa bstan mi shes pa'i snang ba drag po zhig skyes nas yud tsam ring mig btsum nas bsdad pas/ rgyang ring nas grags pa'i phyugs dzi ba'i glu sgra de sbyang ltogs kyi ngu skad ltar kho'i rna bar gzan pa'i sgra zhig tu gyur/6 a pha nga gcin pa gtong dgos/ mithub mchog gis myur du bu rta thog nas blangs te sa la bzhag thag ring gi ri zur nas gser 'od chem chem byed/ de ru sde gsar sku phreng rim byon gyi gdan sa dge ldan bkra shes rab gling zhes pa'i dgon pa chen po zhig gnas/pha thub mchog gi sems la rang nyid kyi bu'ang der mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ldan pa'i grwa pa rtse gra zhig la 'gyur nges red snyam/ khos da dung nam yang brjed mi srid pa ni lo bdun sngon gyi nyin mo de red/ khong tsho'i nang gi dus rgyun sus kyang do snang mi byed pa'i sbra chung chung de'i thog la 'ja' zugabu skal bzang dbang grags skyes/ thag ring nas phebs pa'i bla ma zhig 'byor nas byis par kha btags g.yogs te lo bdun la song dus sde gsar sprul sku'i mdun la grwa pa byas na rjes su sangs rgyas bstan par phan thogs chen po yong gi red ces bshad/ bla ma'i dgongs 'dun mngon du 'gyur ched thub mchog gis dka' ba grangs med khyad du bsad/ sems khral gyi khrod du bu skal bzang dbang grags da lo lo bdun la gson pas dgon par rtsis sprod byed pa'i dus yin/ a'o/ sde gsar sprul sku'ang sku na gzhon/ da lo gzhi nas dgung lo bco lnga yin skad/ de ring rin po ches skal bzang dbang grags la gang gsung grakāswā yod dam/ mdang dgong rin po che la bkra shis rten 'brel gyi rtags

mtshan 'dra byung e yod/ yang na/ rin po ches snga sa nas dar dkar gra sgrig byas nas ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas bstan pa la phan thogs che ba'i slob bu zhig 'byor rgyur sgug yod nges red/ thub mchog rgad po ji tsam bsam blo gtong na de tsam dga' ba rgyas nas byis pa zhig ltar gnam mchongs sa mchongs byed bzhin bu pang du blangs te 'gram par 'o zhig bskyal nas rta thog tu bzhagaskal bzang dbang grags ni tshor snang ci'ang med par hon thor nas bsdad/thag ring gi ri zur nas rlangs 'khor sngon po zhig glog 'khyug pa ltar rgyug 'gro/mtshams der skal bzang dbang grags kyi yid la rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i 'dam bag gi rlangs 'khor de dag 'khor/ na ning grong khyer nas 'khor zhag la slobs pa'i a zhang gis bod rang gis rlangs 'khor bzo mi shes zer/ de dus skal bzang dbang grags kyis rang nyid rjes su nang sa'i slob grwar phyin nas bod rang gi rlangs 'khor bzo mkhan byed kyi yin zhes shod myong / de dag ni dngos med kyi rmi lam ltar ring nas ring du yal/ rang nyid dang nye nas nye ru 'gro ba ni a ma dang sring mo med pa'i dgon pa red/ skal bzang dbang grags kyis glo bur du gon 'khogs chos sde gsar sprul sku mngon shes yod ces smras pa yid la dran/ de ltar na rang nyid grwa pa byed mi 'dod pa'i bsam blo bla mas shes nas rang nyid la gang zer yong snyam dus skrag snang zhig skyes pas yid kyi rta pho'i kha de myur du bkagade ru byis pa dang bud med med pas bkra shis rab gling dgon pa khu sim mer gnas/ grwa rgan kha shas shig dgon pa'i nye 'gram gyi spang thog tu bsdad nas gleng mol la mgo 'khor nas bsdad 'dug thub mchog gis rta thad kur sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi grwa shag la khrid/ sangs rgyas bkra shis de sngon khong tsho'i lung par yong myong /6 ya ya/ dka' e thal/mi ngo mdog dmar mdangs rgyas pa'i grwa ༵ byer

ma zhig thon byung /6 dka' ma song / rgan lags/mi sangs rgyas bkra shis kyis thub mchog pha bu gnyis nang du khrid nas sne len byas/ thub mchog gis ja'ang btung khom med par brel ba chen pos 6 rgan lags/ sde gsar rin po che bzhugs e yod/’ 6 bzhugs med/ na ning nas grong khyer nang slob grwar phebs pa red/slob grwa chen mo ma thon bar log gi min gsungs byung /mi 6 ba'i bu mi thub mchog rgad po'i ngo mdog rbad de log6 khyod kyi bu grwa pa byed bsam pa e yin/ chung chung de 'dra dgon par nyar gyi ma red/ 6 de sngon thag ring nas phebs pa'i bla ma rtsa chen zhig gis nga la bka' mngag gnang byung /mi 6 'on kyang 'di ru sde gsar rin po che'i gtan 'bebs yod pas lo chung chung 'di 'dra gtan nas bsdu mi srid/ rin po che bzhugs yod na dang po slob grwar song zhes gsung nges red/ ’smyo de de/ thub mchog rgad po rdo tsha po'i thog gi 'bu grog ma bzhin 'tshab be 'tshub ber gyur/skal bzang dbang grags kyis ga ler pha la mig zur zhig bltas rjes sems gting nas skyes pa'i 'dzum chung zhig kha zur nas mngon byung /

rkang lam gru ma gyu/rgyab tu lcags kyi chu zom 'khur ba'i bud med cig sbrul 'khyog pa lta bu'i ri lam brgyud nas la brgyab/ skya thing nger gnas pa'i rkang lam gya ma gyu de ri khrod kyi dge ma'i dgon chung der thug lus la dmar ser btsun chas spras pa'i dge ma de pha bong rkub bkyag lta bu zhig gi mdun du 'byor/ mo'i kha zur nas 'dzum chung zhig mngon/ chu zom pha bong gi steng la phab/ phu thung gis sna gdong g.yas g.yon nas hril hril ngang 'gril yong ba'i rngul chu phyis/ mo'i lus la ched du bzos pa'i dkar dmar gyi mdzes rgyan dang ring du bzhag pa'i nag snum gyi skra lo ma mchis kyang / ngo gdong zla ba ltar dkar thog lang tsho'i dmar mdangs rgyas/ ri mtho po'i chu mig ltar g.yo lhad med pa'i mig gnyis nag khra sgor rer gnas/ da dung me tog gi 'dab ma lta bu'i mchu sgros/mdun gyi gangs ri las bcad pa lta bu'i sna gdong / sked skabs phra ba'i gzugs byad bcas nas gdod nas yod pa'i na chung bu mo'i mdzes chos shig wa ler mngon yong / mos rkub bkyag 'dra ba'i pha bong der mgo bo gtugs/pha bong de ni 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i btsun mo skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mo chu 'khur dus ngal garmi sa yin skad/ su zhig chu len du song na de ru ngal gsos nas gsol ba smon lam 'debs gsol yod/ dang thog pha bong gzhan ltar mdog skya sgong sgong de yun ring po'i nang mi'i yan lag dang 'phra/ chos/

deng gi char smug ril ril snam 'od 'tsher ba zhig tu gyur yod/lo lnga'i sngon du/ mos 'di ru chu zom 'khur ba'i rig 'dzin chos sgron dang 'phrad/ rig 'dzin chos sgron gyi nags tshal ltar skyes pa'i rdzi ma mthug po'i 'og tu che rgyu med pa'i mig gnyis nas byams brtse'i 'od snang bkra/ kha sha mthug po de 'gul tsam 'gul tsam byed dus yongs su blos 'gel chog pa'i snang ba zhig ster yong /6 bu mo gnas bskor ba yin nam/ rig 'dzin chos sgron sems 'khur chen pos mo la bltas 'dugaphu yin/ gnas bskor/ lto slong mkhan yin/’ mo'i kha nas 'tshab 'tshub kyis skad cha dag thon/ byams brtse'i tsha rlabs shig mo'i spyi bo nas rkang mthil bar glog brgyab pa ltar khyab nas drin can ma yum gyi mdun du slebs pa'i snardo zlong ༵ ci/ zer/’ 6 pad+ma lha mo/sa 6 pad+ma ltar btsog sgrib mi 'gos pa'i mi zhig byed dgos/ 'o na pha yul gang nas yin/ rogs pa med dam/’ — pha yul kong po nas yin/ rogs pa med/ gangs ri bskor du phyin pa zin/ 6 rogs pa med pa snying stobs chen po red/ de nas rig 'dzin chos sgron gyis mo la rdo pha bong 'di'i ngo mtshar gyi gtam rgyud bshad/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal pos stod gangs ri'i shel rdzong phab dus 'brug mos 'di ru chu len skabs ngal gso myong /pad+ma lha mos pha bong la mgo bo gtugs nas gsol ba smon lam btab rjeswā zlog 'dzin chos sgron gyi rjes su 'brangs nas dgon pa'i nang slebs/
