rig 'dzin chos sgron ni dgon pa'i 'gan 'khur ba yin zhing de min da dung dge ma gsum 'dug rig 'dzin chos sgron gyi grwa shag nang med du mi rung ba'i mkho rdzas re gnyis phud 'jig rten mi la mkho ba'i khra chil chil gyi dngos rdzas ci'ang mi 'dug rig 'dzin chos sgron gyis tsam sgam pad+ma lha mo'i mdun du bzhag pad+ma lha mos myur du rtsam sgam kha phyes dus/ g.yas kyi che ba'i nang du rtsam pa dang / g.yon gyi chung ba'i nang du mar phyur blugs 'dug pad+ma lha mo'i grod pa sngar nas ltogs skad 'byin pas/ mos myur du ja phor pa kha shas tsha 'thung byas pa dang / mig btsum thengs gcig la spags phor pa gang zos/ngo ma/ skyes nas de lta bu'i mngar zhim gyi tsam pa dang ja yod pa ma shes/ mo'i lupa hril ༵ tsha sob sob tu gyur/ zad la nye ba'i lus kyi shed shugs rim ba na /ga shādzi/ na chos sgron gyis pad+ma lha mo'i rtsam khug blangs nas nang du rtsam phyur blugs rtsis byas/ skabs der/ pad+ma lha mo'i sems kyi gting nas 'jig rten gyi 'khri ba bcad pa'i btsun ma'i 'tsho ba la sngar med kyi 'dun pa zhig skyes pa dang / phrag dog gi mtsho la lhung ba'i 'jig rten par zhe mer/ mdun du langs pa'i btsun ma rig 'dzin chos sgron la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes te/lus kyi ba spu zing zhing mig nang dad pa'i mchi ma ko ro ro gyur/ mgrin pa shig shigagis 'gul yang ci'ang smra ma thub par rig 'dzin chos sgron gyi mdun du pus mo btsugs/6 gang byas song /7 rig 'dzin chos sgron gyi mig chung chung gnyis 'tshub langs nas che ru song / 6 nga 'di ru dge mar nyar rogs/ pad+ma lha mo'i mig skyi srab mo'i 'og nas mchi ma dbyar gyi chu 'go bzhin brtol yong /66'di ru khyed kyi pha yul dang thag ring / dge ma byas na pha yul ༵ ༵da

chog gzhan gyi dka' ngal mchis na ngas rogs pa byed chog rig 'dzin chos sgron gyis pad+ma lha mo yar skyor nas gdan thog tu sdod bcug6 nga la pha ma med/ gnyen nye med/ log sa med/ ngu skad kyis mgrin ༵ //dāḥ /sna pad+ma lha mo'i ngag gi phreng ba'i rgyun chad/pad+ma lha mo ngu skad lhang lhang gis thams cad rig 'dzin chos sgron la bshad/ rig 'dzin chos sgron gyi mig tu'ang 'od 'tsher 'tsher gyi mchi mas gang / lag pas zang zing du gyur pa'i pad+ma lha mo'i mgo la byil byil byed bzhin mo dang gdung sems mnyam skye byas/ 6 dang po dgon pa'i nang lo phyed tsam tshod lta byas nas sdod/ snang dag med na dge ma byed chog tshang mas pad+ma lha mo'i snying rus dang dad sems la ha las/ zla ba gnyis ma song bar/ rig 'dzin chos sgron gyis pad+ma lha mo'i skra phud blangs nas ming la rig 'dzin bzang mo zhes pa'i chos ming btags/sngar gyi pad+ma lha mo deng gi rig 'dzin bzang mo dran shes kyi gnyid las sad/ mos slar yang 'brug mo'i pha bong la mgo bo gtugs rjes/ rgyab tu chu khur nas ltag pa dgye dgye dang lus po sgur sgur gyis ri lam ded/ dngul dkar zhun mas lan brgyar byug 'dra'i gangs kyi ri nas mig gdang dka' ba'i dngul 'od cig lam lam 'tsher/ gangs rin po che dang bar thag mi ring ba'i sa cha 'dir glang chen gyi mche ba gnam la ker ba lta bu'i gangs dkar gyis khengs/ gangs dkar dbu zhwa zad mtshams rdo hrag hrug gis khengs pa'i rdza sngon po yin zhing / de'i 'og tu me tog dkar dmar gyi 'ja' shar ba'i /dā zlo byin pa de dag ri gsham gyi mtha' yas pa'i spang thang dang yug gcig 1)didi'i rgyud la gnas ri mang bas bzo ci'ang med pa'i rdo pha bong re dang

gad pa re la'ang sangs rgyas dang bla ma'i mdzad pa dang 'brel ba'i ngo mtshar gyi gtam rgyud re yod/rigasham gyi spang ljongs thog khur po 'khyer ba'i gnas bskor 'ga' dal gyis bskyod/ khong tsho'i gom pa spo stangs la bltas na thag ring nas yong ba 'dra/ gangs rin po ches khong tshor mi zad pa'i spobs pa ster ba ma gtogs/ de lta bu'i thag ring gi rkang bgrod sus byed thub/ sa bab shin tu mtho ba'i lung pa 'dir mi las gzugs ring ba'i skyes dngos med/ pad+ma lha mos ches mngon gsal dod po'i mi gzugs la lta bzhin/ pha yul gyi nyi 'od sgrib pa'i tshang tshing nags tshal dag yid la 'khor/ sems gting nas glo bur du brjod mi shes pa'i skyo lhang lhang dang stong seng seng gi snang ba zhig rgyas/tshang tshing nags tshal gyi dkyil du gnas pa'i lung pa de rgya gar dang bod kyi sa mtshams su gnas shing / pad+ma phu zhes pa'i lung chung der khyim dud khong tshang las med/ pad+ma lha mo'i pha ma gnyis la bu phrug mo las med pas mo ni khong gnyis kyi dpral ba'i mig dang khog gi snying yin/ khong tshos zhing kha mi chung ba zhig btab pa phud/ ri la rin gong che ba'i sman rtswa sna tshogs sgrug rgyu yod/ da dung ba mo dang phag pa'ang gsos/ des na 'tsho ba'i thad phun sum tshogs zhes smra dka' yang dka' ngal ci'ang med/ de nyin mgron po yong ba'i snga ltas la brtsi ba'i byi'u des snga dro gcig ring 6 krag krag mi gi skad snyan 'byin/ pad+ma lha mo'i pha rgad pos og tshom la 'chang 'chang byas nas 6 de ring rtsa che'i mgron po zhig yong nges red/ gtsang spra byas nas sgug dgos zhes bshad rjes thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzo zhig kyang bstan/8 rgad po smyo lab ma rgyag pad+ma lha mo'i ma rgad mo 'dzum tsam byas pa dang yid ches med pa'i bzo zhig bstan/pad+ma lha mos pha la yid ches/ sems gting nas mgron po dag ༵༵ du

'byor rgyu'i 'dun pa zhig ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes/ de ni mngon shes can gyi bla ma zhig yin nam/ yang na sman rdzas nyo sgrub byed mkhan gyi tshong pa bag dro po zhig yin srid/ de min na rgyal khab las khungs nas yong ba'i las don mi sna zhig yin nges red/ pad+ma lha mo mgrin pa kyog nas thag ring nags gseb tu yal ba'i rkang lam phra mor blta/ phyi dro nyi ma bzhud la nye ba'i skabs/ khur po 'khyer ba'i mi gnyis khong tshang gi phyogs la slebs yong / pad+ma lha mo'i bsam yul las ring du 'das/ mo nang du 'dzul nas sge'u khung nas phyi la bltas/rgad po dga' ba rab tu rgyas nas phyi la rgyug nas mgron po bsus/ gzugs stobs che zhing pho nyams dod pa'i gzhon nu gnyis 'dug gnyis ku'i mgo la dreg pas tshos pa'i skra gzhug chen po re mchis/ mi 'dra sa ni gcig gi ngo gdong du rtswa ngan skyes pa lta bu'i rgya yis gang / gcig shos kyi ngo gdong ni rtswa mi skye ba'i thang red/ rgad pos gzhon nu gnyis po rtsa che'i mgron por brtsis nas khang pa'i sdug tu sdod bcug pad+ma lha mo sdod mi shes la 'gro 'ang mi shes par gyur/ lo bco brgyad la slebs pa'i bu mo zhig gi snying ldig sdig tu 'phag ngo ma/ dus rgyun mo skyes pa dang 'phrad pa'i skal pa dben/kho gnyis kyis bshad na/ rgya yod pa de'i ming la a bzang zer ba dang /rgya med pa de'i ming la khams chen zer/ pha yul khams sde dge nas yin zhing /khongaganyis ku'i nang mi kun rkyen ngan gyis tshe ma zin pas gnas bskor dang chos mjal kho nar 'gro nas mi tshe skyel rgyu'i sems thag bcad pa yin zer/stod kyi gangs rin po che dang lho gnas mang po mjal ba'i gnas tshul bshad/nyin shas kyi rjes/ glo bur du pad+ma lha mo la tsha ba drag po rgyas nas rig pa za ri zi rir 'gyur/ de dus a bzang dang khams chen gnyis res mos kyis mo rgyab tu 'khur nas rgyug ma 'dur gyis ri gsham gyi sman khang du song / khab brdidī ཿsa pad+ma lha mo'i rig pa grung du song / de dus kyang a bzang dang

khams chen gyi skra mtshams nas bzhur ba'i rngul chu skam mi 'dugade nas bzung / pad+ma lha mos pho gzhon gnyis las bka' drin zhig tshor ba dang spyir btang min pa'i 'du shes kyang lhan du skyes/ pha rgad pos nyin ltar kho gnyis la 'dzum gyis bsu/zla phyed kyi rjes su a bzang dang khams chen 'gro rtsis byas/ pad+ma lha mo'i yid kyi rdza ri dmar por glo bur sprin gyis g.yogs shing snyan 'jibs glu yi mgrin lam mi skyid mchi mas brnangs/ rgad pos kho gnyis kyi lag mgo nas bcangs te 6 khyed gnyis la log sa'i nang med/ nged tshang la mi ni dgos/lo shas 'di ru bsdad na ga 'dra 'dug ces lhag bsam zol med kyis bshad/a bzang gis de mur 6 'grig gi red ’ ces bshad pa dang pad+ma lha mo la bltas nas 'dzum tsam byas/ yud tsam song rjes/ khams chen yang mgo bo kyog tsam byas nas mos mthun byas pa dang mig zur gyis pad+ma lha mo la blta tsam byas/pad+ma lha mo'i kha nas rang dbang med par glu chung zhig thon/ 6 ltos dang /nga'i bu mo dga' 'dug rgad pos 'dzum dmul dmul gyis de ltar bshad pas/ pad+ma lha mo'i glu mtshams chad/ ngo tsha nas gdong pa dmar rkyang chags nas sgo phyi la thon/a bzang dang khams chen las la brtson zhing ya rabs/ pad+ma lha mo'i pha ma gnyis kyis khong gnyis la rang nyid kyi bu lta bu'i 'du shes dang brtse dung yod/ pad+ma lha mo nyin ltar khong gnyis kyi grib gzugs ltar 'bral med du gnas/ de dus khong tsho'i 'tsho ba sbrang rtse las grub pa ltar mngar zhim gyis khyab/ pad+ma lha mos sngar song gi bya ba dran gso byed bzhin dal bu'i ngang mdun duskyod/ brag ri lta bu'i rdo 'bum chen po de mo'i mig nang du tshud/ mo rdo 'bum gyi 'gram du ngal gsos rjes/ mig cer nas chos yig 'dra min1 sdu/sa

pa'i rdo dkar dmar la bltas/ de dag ni gab lan med pa'i gab tshig ltar don ci'ang mi rtogs/ 66ga re'i dge ma/ ci'ang mi shes mkhan/’ pad+ma lha mosakhir lab dang bcas par mgo bo g.yug g.yug byas/ gangs rin po che 'og gi gnas shig la 'di lta bu'i rdo 'bum zhig yod nges red snyam/ de mur lus la thal rdul 'khrig nas rdo la yi ge brko bzhin pa'i a bzang yid la 'khor/ pad+ma lha mos mig btsum nas bsdad/lo gsum gyi sngon du/ gangs 'khyags 'khyer ba'i rlung chen po zhig gis steng gi gnam dang 'og gi sa dbye ba 'byed mi shes pa bzos/ rus zug rgyag pa'i dgun dus der/ pad+ma lha mos me tsha po zhig brgyab nas chos yig kha phyes te 'don e shes byas/ glo bur du/ sgo drag gis brdung byung / sgo phyes nas lta dus/ a bzang red/ lus thog tu gangs bab nas byis pas bzos pa'i gangs kyi mi zhig dang 'dra/ kha spu dang mig spu/ de bzhin 'gram pa g.yas g.yon la skyes pa'i rgya yi thog tu'ang gangs las grub pa'i skya sob sob kyi me tog skyes/64ngas lo gnyis btsal ba yin/ a bzang gi 'dren byed zung nas spyir btang min pa'i dga' 'od 'phro/pad+ma lha mo'i blo ngor thog ma a bzang nang du khrid nas ja tsha po zhig blud rgyu dran tsam byas kyang de mur ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su gyur/ rjes su rim bzhin rig pa dwangs gsal du gyur pas snga bsam phyi bltas byas/ ngo mdog kyang la kha'i mtshams sprin lta bu nas gangs mtshams kyi rdza ri ltar 'gyur/ mos a bzang nang du 'dzul ma bcug tsham tshom med par/ 6 mi sdig can/ nga'i mthong sar ma yong mi zhes bshad de shugs kyis sgo brgyab nas byis pa zhig ltar ngu//༵ bzang mo'i sgo 'gram du dgong mo gcig bsdad/

zhogs pa/ a bzang yong nas pad+ma lha mo'i mdun du pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas 'gyod bshags byas/ 'on kyang mos mig ma bltas/ sems ma g.yos/ blo thag gor mo rdo bzhin bcad/ rjes su rig 'dzin chos sgron sogs dge ma gzhan rnams slebs nas skad cha 'jam rtsub du ma bshad de a bzang dgon pa nas phyir phud/de rjes a bzang dgon pa'i nang bstud mar thengs kha shas yong nas 'grel bshad dang 'gyod bshags byas kyang tshang mar 'bras bu ci'ang ma thon/a bzang yong mkhan mi 'dug kho gshog pa skyes nas gnam la 'phur ram/ sbar mo skyes nas sa la 'dzul/ gsang don sus kyang ma rtogs/ pad+ma lha mo blo mi bde bar gyur/ mchi mas sngas mgo ma lus rlon pa bzos/ mig gnyis dmar sbos su gyur pa dge ma gzhan gyis tshor/lo phyed kyi rjes su/ gangs ri bskor nas log phebs pa'i rig 'dzin chos sgron gyis pad+ma lha mor gangs ri'i mthil du a bzang mthong lugs bshad/khos deng skabs nyin mtshan dbyer med ngang gnyid chag zas brjed kyis rdo brkos nas bsdad thog rdo khri rdo zhig brkos nas rdo 'bum zhig bzhengs te de sngon rang nyid kyis byas pa'i las ngan la sdig bshags dang pad+ma lha mor dgongs sel zhu rgyu'i bsam blo bshad/ de ru gnas mjal du yong ba'i mang tshogs tshos a bzang ni thag ring nas phebs pa'i dka' ba spyod mkhan gyi grub thob tu brtsis nas dad pa dang mthong chen byed kyi yod/ de nas bzung /pad+ma lha mo'i sems kyi rdog khres sa la lhung nas blo bde bar 'gyur/ sems kyi gting nas de sngon dang nyid dang sha khrag 'dres pa'i skyes pa de lam 'gro rgyug pa'i smon lam btab/pad+ma lha mos chu khur nas kyag kyog gi ri lam rkang 'og tu mnan/ ngo ma/chu thag ring bas chu len thengs rer chu tshod gcig lhag tsam 'gor ༵ sbyad/

mos mgo bo dgye dgye byas nas rang nyid gnas sa'i dgon pa la lta dus/des mo la 'jig rten nas bral ba'i dben thing thing gi snang ba zhig dang dpog par dka' ba'i lkog gyur gyi mtshar snang zhig ster yong bas mo'i lus sems gnyis lha yi bdud rtsis myos bzhin bde lhang lhang du gyur/ de mur/ mo'i rkang pa 'phrul gshog skyes bzhin bde yang du song / pad+ma lha mo'i mig gnyis 'gul med du lus/ kho gang 'dra byas nas dgon pa'i nang slebs sam/ a bzang 'dzum dmul dmul gyis dgon pa'i nang nas phyir thon byung /6 pad+ma/ a bzang dga' snang chen pos tshur rgyug cung tsam min na pad+ma lha mo'i lus la 'tham/pad+ma lha mo mgo bo gug nas myur du dgon pa'i nang du rgyug a bzang ni dran shes kyi sa bon zhig ltar sngar song gi lo zla 'dren byed kyi lam du shar/thams cad mi rtag rtswa rtse'i zil pa zhes pa bden don du grub/ lo der/pad+ma lha mo'i pha ma gnyis ring du 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten mi yul dang snying ltar gces pa'i bu mo bcas bskyur nas 'jig rten phyi ma'i byed pos btsan gyis khrid/ shi ran khar/ pha rgad pos a bzang dang khams chen gyi lag 'go nas 'chang 'chang byas nas re ba che ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig ngang du shar/ de dus pho gzhonaganyis po'i mig nas mchi mas gang / rgad po'i re ba chud zos su mi gtong rgyu'i rnam 'gyur yang bstan/khong tsho'i khyim tshang de a bzang dang khams chen/ mo rang bcas las grub/ skyes pa gnyis pos pad+ma lha mor sngar med kyi byams skyong byed/ mos skyes pa pho gnyis kyi lang tsho'i me 'bar ba'i mig nas spyir btang min pa'i brtse dung zhig tshor/khams chen gyis zhin gcig a bzang med pa'i dus dang bstun nas/glo sdonā du mo pang du blangs nas 'gram par 'o byas pa dang / da dung dbugs

hal bzhin pad+ma lha mos shugs kyis kho'i lag 'og nas thar thabs byas/khams chen gyis myur du mo'i lag 'go nas bcangs nas/ am phrag nang nas byu ru chung chung cha gcig blangs nas kho'i sems yin zhes bshad/ pad+ma lha mo'i ngo mdog byu ru ltar dmar kyang du gyur kyang / khams chen gyi byu ru gtan nas ma blangs/a bzang gis kyang mo la thengs mang po rang nyid kyi snying gtam bshad/pad+ma lha mo med na kho gson mi thub ces bshad/ a bzang dang khams chen gnyis ka yang rtser son pa'i pho rgod red/ mos cis kyang blang dor mi shes/tha na bod kyi gna' srol ltar skyes pa gnyis kyi bza' mo byas na e 'grig snyam/'on te de sngon gsham skyod du yong ba'i las don mi snas rgyas par bshad myong ba'i khrims lugs kyi nang don yid la shar/ gnyen sgrig bca' khrims nang shug gcig khyo mang byed mi choganyi ma dang zla ba/ lo las grub pa'i dus kyi lha mo de skad cig skad cig gis shi nas yal zhing myur nas mgyogs su skyes shing 'byor/ nam mkha'i dbyings la grangs las 'das pa'i skar tshogs kyis khengs tshar ba dang / sa gzhi chen pos mun nag gi gos gyon/ pad+ma lha mo blo mi bde bar ci'ang mi mthong ba'i mun nag gi 'jig rten la bltas nas yun ring bsdad/ a bzang dang khams chen da dung log mkhan med/ zhogs pa snga po nas sman rtswa bkog tu song ba red/ pad+ma lha mo nang du 'dzul nas lto dag yang bskyar tsha po bzos rjes/ de mur sgo nas phyi la bltas/ sems gting nas skyes pa gnyis bde bar gnas pa'i smon lam btab/ nags gseb nas me 'od sngo lam lam byed/de'i ming la 'dre me zer/ skyi g.ya' ba'i gdon 'dre'i gtam rgyud du ma zhig pad+ma lha mo'i yid la shar/ mo'i snying 'bus zos pa ltar sngar bas blo mi bde bar gyur/ 107

nam dkyil tsam la/ a bzang log 'dug kho ngu bzhin 8 khams chen gzig gis zos song mi zhes bshad rjes mchi mas mgrin pa brnangs/ 6 khyod ji ltar byas nas log pa yin/’ 8 nged gnyis nags gseb tu kha 'thor bas/ nga slebs dus/ kho gzig gis zos nas ha lam gos lham las lus mi 'dug nga thabs zad nas log yong ba yin/’ nyin gnyis pa/ khong gnyis thag ring dgon par song nas khams chen gyi don du dge ba chen po sgrub/ rjes su a bzang dang pad+ma lha mo bza' tshang la 'gyur/ brtse dung zab mo'i gser thag gis khong gnyis lhan du sbrel/ zhogs par a bzang ri la sman rtswa 'thu ru 'gro ran khar pad+ma lha mo pang du blangs nas 'o byed/ dgong mo phyir log rjes kyang thog mar de ltar byed/ brtse dung gis khong gnyis la dpag med kyi bde skyid ster nas byung tshar ba'i sdug bsngal kun byung ma myong ba ltar brjed/ de nyin lo gsar gyi tshes gcig yin/ a bzang gis a rag mang du 'thung / ngo gdong dkar po zla ba'i mdog ldan de dmar po glo ba ltar gyur/ mig chen po gnyis chung nas chung du song nas skud thig tsam zhig las gdang mi thub par 'gyur/ skad cha je mang dang bskyar bzlos je mang song / pad+ma lha mos byams brtse chen pos kho la yang yang bltas/yud tsam song rjes/ a bzang gis 8 us mus zhes ngus/ pad+ma lha mo 'tshab 'tshub kyis rang nyid kyi khyo ga'i 'gram du bsdad nas sems khral chen pos 6 ci byas song ’ zhes dris/6 nga mi ma red/ nga nga mi zer nas rang nyid kyi mgo skra brad nas sngar las che ba'i ngu skad brgyab/6 ci byas song / nga la shod dang /’ pad+ma lha mos a bzang gi lag 'go nas bcangs/108

66ngas de nyin bskyabs na khams chen gzig gi kha nas thar nges red/ 6 ga re/ pad+ma lha mo ha las nas 'jim sku ltar 'gyur/ rang nyid kyi rna bar yid mi ches par gyur/6 thams cad khyod kyi don du yin/ de min ngas kho mi skyob ga la srid/’ pad+ma lha mo smyo ba ltar gyur nas a bzang gi skra nas 'then te ngus/ a bzang ni tshor ba ci'ang med bzhin lan ci'ang ma bslog de'i dgong mo/ pad+ma lha mo gnyid ma khug khams chen g.yol thabs med pa ra mig mdun du shar yong /rig pa rab rib tu gyur nas gnyid kyi g.ya' phran bu byung ba na/ de sngon rang nyid kyis ma blangs ba'i byu ru gnyis po de khrag gi thigs pa rgyag pa'i khams chen gyi snying grangs las 'das par gyur nas khang pa'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du gang / pad+ma lha mo skrag thag chod nas mgo bo btum yang da dung de dag tshang ma dmar dmar rjen rjen gyis mthong yong / gnam sar mi shong ba'i sdug bsngal dang skrag snang zhig gis mo dbugs 'byin rngub mi thub par 'gyur/phyi nyin/ tho rengs skar chen shar ba dang lhan du pad+ma lha mo langs a bzang la skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma bshad par pha ma'i bzhag pa ma lus mchil ma'i rdzas bzhin bskyur nas dge sgrub sdig spong byed pa'i gnas bskor gyi lam du bzhu/da/ gangs can gyi sa gzhi chen po gom pas 'jal/ lha ldan zhing gi jo bo rin po che/ gtsang gzhis ka rtse'i bkra shes lhun po'i dgon pa 6 rig 'dzin bzang mo/ chu phab rjes nga'i nang du shog rig 'dzin chos sgron 'dzum dmul dmul gyis mo la bltas 'dugapad+ma lha mo'i ngo mdog rbad de 'gyur/ 6 lags so/ pad+ma lha mo 'byor bas/ rig 'dzin chos sgron yar langs nas mo sdod du bcug pa ma zad/ ja gang blugs/ 109

pad+ma lha mo'i yid kyi klong nas dogs 'char zhig langs/ gang byas pa yin nam/ dus rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i sne len/snye thug e byung / a bzang ’ 66mthong byung / pad+ma lha mo mgo bo smad nas bsdad/smyo khos khri rdo bzhengs tshar bas/ da lta grwa pa byed du 'gro rtsis 'dug pad+ma lha mo rkang mthil nas 'tshub cha zhig langs nas lus hril por khyab/ngo ma/ pad+ma lha mos don dngos thog rang nyid kyis ci zhig thob par 'dod min mi shes/ des na/ mo'i ngo gdong nas ngo tsha ba'i dmar mdangs shig rgyas nas gangs dkar la mtshams sprin gyis bklubs pa ltar gyur/66ngas grwa pa ma byed ces bshad pa yin/ rig 'dzin chos sgron gyis pad+ma lha mo'i gdong la bltas nas 'dzum tsam byas/pad+ma lha mo hon thor nas bsdad/6 khri rdo bzhengs/ gnas mang po de 'dra bskor dus/ khos rjes su snying rje med pa'i bya ba gtan nas byed mi srid/ pad+ma lha mos ci'ang ma smras par bsdad/ 'on te mo'i snying gi bu chung drag tu 'phaspyangs kho la khyod khrid nas pha yul kong smad du log nas khyed kyi pha ma'i lasaka'i rgyun 'dzin nas 'tsho ba yag po skyol zhes bshad pas khos khas len byas song / ’6 de ga la 'grigs/ nga ni 'dul khrims srung dgos pa'i dge ma yin/’ che khyed a bzang dang mnyam du 'tsho ba bskyal na dge ma byas pa las dge ba / 6tsang min/ 11rdo de ni lha bla ma'i lung bstan red/’

6 lung bstan/ pad+ma lha mos yid ma ches pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/6 ngo ma lung bstan red/ da lta nas khyed la dge ma'i sdom pa med/’ 6 byas na ngas de ltar byed chog rgyu mtshan ci yin mi shes/ brjod mi shes pa'i dga' bde zhig pad+ma lha mo'i lus hril por khyab/ pad+ma lha mos thag ring ri tshogs kyi khrod nas mngon pa'i gangs rin po che'i dbu rtse la rgyang lta byas/ dngul gyi mchod rten gsham 'dra'i gangs dkar ti se'i dbu rtse nas bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i gzi dpal zhig lam lam du mngon/mo'i lag gi pad mo brang khar sbyar nas rtse gcig tu gsol ba smon lam btab/pad+ma lha mo'i mig zim zim gyis btsum/ mo'i yid kyi ngor kong smad kyi tshang tshing gi nags tshal dang / nags gseb kyi ri zhing / g.yur du za ba'i shing 'bras/ spu sdug bkra ba'i bya rigs/ gtum drag che ba'i gcan gzan/da dung de ru yod pa'i 'o mas phyug pa'i ba mo/ mchu ring ba'i phag pa sogs lham mer shar ba dang mo'i dmar srab kyi mchu sgros de mdzes sdug ldan pa'i me rdokā /lha/ po zhig la 'gyur nas yid dbang 'phrog pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig 111

g.yang mo mcho/gcigamun nag gi yol ba nag pos rim bzhin sa gzhi chen po g.yogs/ rgyun du bar snang nas mig kem kem gyis lta ba'i skar ma'i tshogs de de ring chu 'dzin nag po'i khug ma'i nang du blugs zin/ brag dmar kha zhes pa'i mtho sgang gi ri grong chung chung de gnyid la yur ba'i dus la slebs kyang / brag chu zhes pa'i chu bo chung chung de gcig pur gnyid kyi skal ba dang bral bas nyin mo las che ba'i shag sgra sgrog bzhin nam yang gang rgyu med pa'i bdud mtsho'i pang du rgyug grong tsho'i shar zur du gnas pa'i lha bdag tshang gi sbra chung gi ser ga nas gsal la mi gsal ba'i 'od snang phran bu phyi ru mngon/ lha bdag pha bu gnyis so so'i gnas su nyal zin/ pha sbug gi thab 'gram du nyal zhing / bu mo g.yang mo mtsho sgo 'gram na btags pa'i lug gu dang mnyam du nyal/ khang sbug tu rdo gru bzhi kha shas brtsigs pa'i thog la ko sgam nag po du dreg gis chos pa zhig bzhag cing de'i sgang la ras ser pos dkris pa'i chos dpe 'ga' bzhag yod pa dang mchod me kong gang yang spar 'dug11sbya bco lnga la slebs pa'i g.yang mo mtsho gnyid kyi g.ya' yang med par

dmar sbos su gyur pa'i mig gnyis chen por gdangs nas bsdad 'dugamos phyi nas ldang ba'i rlung bu'i khrod du 'dar 'dar sig sig dang 'od je chung du 'gro ba'i mchod me'i 'od la lta bzhin mig rab rib tu gyur/ mo'i rna 'gram du grags pa ni pha rgad pos ma ṇi 'don pa'i sgra skabs skabs drag la skapasare skabs dal zhing skabs skabs gsal la skabs skabs ci'ang go rgyu med pa /ya/nga mo mtsho'i 'dren byed zim zim du gyur/ ma ṇi 'don pa'i sgra de rim bzhin slob grwa'i nang dpe cha klog pa'i snyan dbyangs la 'gyur/ mo'i dbugs kyi rgyu ba lhod du song nas dga' ba brgya phrag gis btums pa'i rmi lam gyi grong du slebs/ mo'i dmar srab kyi mchu sgros rim bzhin bzo 'gyur nas nam yang mi yal ba'i 'dzum mdangs su grub/ de sngon dpar ris nang mthong myong ba'i gnam gru de dngos dngos rjen rjen gyis khong tsho'i skar gsar slob chung gi sgo ra'i nang lha yi pho nya bzhin dal gyis bab cing / de ni g.yang mo mtsho rgya nag gi slob 'bring la bsu ru yong ba red/dge slob tshang ma dga' mchongs rgyag bzhin lhab lhub tu g.yo ba'i dar dkar bzung nas mo la skyel ma byas/ g.yang mo mtsho dngul gyi skas rim brgyud nas lha yi pho brang lta bu'i gnam gru'i nang slobs/ de mur gnam gru mkha' la lding song / mtho ru mtho ru song nas sprin dkar gyi gseb tu slebs/ sprin dkar po lug gi bal las 'jam/ sprin dkar po gangs kyi mdog las mdzes/der me tog dkar ser dmar ljang gi char si li li bab cing sman spos kyi dri zhim lhang lhang du 'thul/ e ma/ mngon par dga' ba'i bde chen gyi zhing khams/ dung gshog ngom pa'i gnam gru dang lhan du 'dab skyes bya yi rgyal po thang dkar dang / rgas nas dbu skra dkar ba'i bya go bo/ skad snyan po'i rgyud mangs dkrol ba'i khu byug lus sol ba las nag pa'i pho rog dang kha ta1 rdo/sa

brtsis na grangs las 'das pa'i bya dang byi'us rang rang gi gshog rtsal ngom nas ling ling gis bskyod/de nas grong khyer lha yul gyi bkod pa lta bu zhig g.yang mo mtsho'i mig mdun du mngon/ de ru khang pa sna tshogs brag dmar kha'i rdo las mang /'khor rigs sna tshogs 'brog pa'i ra lug las 'bor che/ phyogs kun dang 'brel ba'i gzhung lam ni pa ṭa'i ri mo du ma lhan du bsgrigs pa las kyang mtshar/ nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar bkra ba'i glog shel las dkar dmar khra gsum gyi 'od chem chem byed/ g.yang mo mtsho brang zheng ldir nas ngo mtshar ba'i 'jig rten de'i pang du mchongs/6 wa ye/mi gsal la mi gsal ba'i skad gdangs des g.yang mo mtsho'i bde ba'i rmi lam gyi mtshams bcad/ mos rang nyid kyi gsar du 'bus pa'i nu 'bur gyi thog tu lag pa chen po zhig gis mnan nas phur phur byed pa tshor/mos drin can a ma'i pang du slobs pa'i snang ba zhig skyes pas/ kha nas 66a ma ’ zhes thal/ de mur mo'i brang thog gi lag pa phyir bskums nas 'jam thing sbyar song / g.yang mo mtsho gnyid kyis bzi nas slar yang rmi lam gyi lam sne na/ 6 nga lha dpal yin/’ lag pa chen po zhig g.yang mo mtsho'i gzhon nu ma'i brla bar du brkyangs/ g.yang mo mtsho gnyid dngangs sad brgyab nas tsog pur langs/ lha dpal ni phas mo la len rtsis yod pa'i mag pa red/6 phar song /’ de nas g.yang mo mtshos shugs kyis lha dpal phyir phud thabs byas kyang lha dpal de bas btsan thabs kyis mo'i yongs su 'tshar skyes ma thub pa'i gzugs po kho'i ri bo lta bu'i lus 'og tu mnan/ g.yang mo mtsho lo brgyad byis pa zhig ltar ngus kyang pha rgad po ni dbugs med pa ltar 'gul tsam yadi /4 byed/ sdug gis khengs pa'i ngu 'bod lhang lhang du grags nas brag

ca'ang 'khor bas/ lha dpal dbugs ring nar nar gyis yar langs song /g.yang mo mtsho dgong mo gcig ngus/ mchi mas sngas mgo ma lus chu nang zag pa ltar bzos/ zhogs pa langs dus/ mig gnyis skrang nas lta mi bzod par gyur/ gdong par sa khra bris pa lta bu'i mchi ma'i shul gyis khengs/gnyis/thams cad kyis lha bdag rgad po'i sems kyi 'khyags rum bzhu ma thub/slob chung lo rim drug pa'i slob ma g.yang mo mtsho slob grwa nas 'then nas lha dpal dang gnyen sgrig dgos zer/slob grwa'i 'go khrid dang dge gon yong nas g.yang mo mtsho sbyangs 'bras lesdus pas mdun lam yag lugs bshad kyang / lha bdag rgad po'i sems ma ga sa/g.yang mo mtsho'i re 'bod dang mchi ma la lha bdag rgad pos ya ma nga /snying ma rje/bla mas rtsis brgyab pa'i gnam la skar ma bzang / sa la dus tshod bzang ba'i gnyen ston gyi nyin de thug zhon kyang tshang ma'i bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la g.yang mo mtsho gnam la 'phur rjes dang sa la 'dzul shul med par gyur/6 rogs pa byed rogs/ grong pa khyim mtshes/’ lha bdag rgad po 'tshab nas ngo mdog rbad de log66dgon pa'i nang dge ma byed du song ba min nam/ kha la spu rdzob kyis khengs pa'i skyes pa zhig yud tsam bsam blo btang rjes de ltar smras/6 yang na grong khyer nang bros pa e yin/’ gdong la dkar dmar gyi byug rdzas mthug po byug pa'i bu mo cig gis dogs pa chen pos smras/ 115

mgo skra skya phyed sngo phyed du gyur pa'i rgad mo zhig sems khral chen pos 6 rang shi ni rgyag e srid ’ ces smras rjes lce snar tsam byas/de nas gros bsdur byas pa brgyud/ mi khag bgos nas g.yang mo mtsho btsal du song /lha bdag rgad po mi tsho gcig khrid nas shar rer dge dgon du song /rgad po dbugs hal bzhin mdun du rgyug kha nas 64gal srid sdom pa blangs tshar na dpe bsags song zhes yang yang smras/ ri rtse'i brag khug tu gnas pa'i dge ma'i dgon pa khu sim mer gnas/ dmar ser gos kyis brgyan pa'i gnas de bde sdug kun las bral bzhin thams cad btang snyoms la gnas/g.yang mo mtsho der yong ma myong / lha bdag rgad po'i ngo gdong nas dga' skyo zung gi rnam 'gyur zhig shar/khag bgos nas song ba'i mi tshogs re re bzhin lha bdag rgad po'i nang du 'byor/ sus kyang g.yang mo mtsho gson pa'i lus dang shi ba'i ro ma rnyed/dus rgyun gtam mang ba'i lha bdag rgad po lkugs pa bzhin mgo bo lag pas 'chang nas bsdad/lha bdag rgad po'i tshe srog gi snying bcud shor ba bzhin/ grong tsho dang mi ring bar yod pa'i bdud mtsho zhes pa'i rba rlabs kyis mche ba gtsigs pa'i gnas der yang yang bskor bskor byas/ mtsho rlabs brag ngos la brdab pa'i lhas lha bdag snying rtsa drag tu 'phar bcug pas lus lcang lo bzhin sig sig sa 'a//sa/ der/ lha dpal ga ler lha bdag gi 'gram du slebs nas/ru rgad po sems ma skyo/ bu mo slob grwar 'gro myong bas shang thog tu zhu gtug rgyag tu song ba min nam zhes smras/11/ yin srid/ rgad po'i mig gnyis nas re ba'i 'od mdangs 'phro

tsam byasnang/ srid gzhung gi gzhung don khang du/ sha rgyags drags nas gos nang shong dka' ba'i shang krang des lha bdag gi skad cha mjug ma sgril gong 6 khyod kyi bu mo slebs byung / bud med dang byis pa'i khe dbang srung skyob byed rgyu'i khrims kyi cha nas mo chang sa rgyag gi min zer/ 'on te ngas mo kha grag rgyu med sa bzos yod/ lo bco lnga chung chung ma red ces bshad nas shang krang des lha bdag la snying nye ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig kyang bstan/6 da lta ga par yod na/ 66log ma byung ngam/ de nas bzung g.yang mo mtsho mthong byung zer mkhan gyi mi gcig kyang ma thug lha bdag rgad pos 'gro lam sna tshogs brgyud nas bu mo btsal mod kyang 'bras bu ci'ang ma thon/ gsum/dus tshod lo gcig las ma song yang / lha bdag gi mgo skra ma lus ba mos gtses pa'i rtswa chung bzhin dkar rkyang du gyur/ ngo gdong du pha yul gyi rtswa med pa'i lung shur lta bu'i gnyer ris nyin re bzhin mang du 'gro/ kho nyin ltar sngo mer mer gyi bdud mtsho la bltas nas hon thor/ gting du rdib pa'i mig gnyis ni sngar nas tshe srog gi rgyun chad pa ltar re ba'i 'od snang phran tsam yang mi mngon/ mtshan mo'i skar 'od kyi 'og tu/ mi mang pos g.yang mo mtsho mthong zer/mo'i ske la ske dar dmar po btags/ rgyab la dpe khug 'khyer te slob /lta sgo

ra'i nang du shar rer 'dzul/ slob khang gi sgo 'gram du slebs ma thag du ba sngon po zhig la 'gyur nas 'ja' ltar yal/slob phrug kha shas kyang 'dre la 'gyur ba'i g.yang mo mtshor skrag nas slob grwar 'gro ma phod zer/gtam yan je mang je mang du song bas/ lha bdag rgad po'i na tsha sdug nas sdug tu song / mjug tu bdud mtsho la lta ba'i nus pa'ang med par gyur/118

pa sangs bu khrid dang bde chen chos sgrol/btsun chas gsar rkyang gyon pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig dgon pa'i sgo 'gram gyi rdo bkyag thog tu hon thor nas langs 'dug dkar nag gsal ba'i mig chen po gnyis cung dmar por gyur zhing mig lcibs spangs nas dmar sbos su gyur/ mo'i 'dren byed phyogs sa ni ri gsham du gnas pa'i mthong la mi mthong ba'i grong tsho de yin/6 bde chen chos sgrol/’ 6 wa ye/ bde chen chos sgrol zhes ngar skad dang bcas par gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis bos pas/ brag dmar po'i 'og tu dmar ser chag ger gnas pa'i dge ma'i dgon pa der 'jags dka' ba'i brag ca zhig lhang lhang du 'khor/sna mo re/ khyod 'on pa red dam/’ lo na rgan tsam gyi btsun ma ngo mdog smug khrig se can zhig ngar 'tshub 'tshub kyis rgyug nas mig ce rer ri gsham gyi grong la g.yeng ba'i btsun ma gzhon nu de'i rna nas bzung /6 a tsha tsha/ ci byed le red/’ lang tsho dar la bab cing rang byung gi mdzes chos du ma ldan pa'i gzhon nu ma des gzhi nas rang nyid kyi ming la bde chen chos sgrol zhes btags pa dran/ de ni zla ba gcig las ma song ba'i chos ming red/ de sngon mo'i ming la pa sangs bu khrid zer/ khong tsho'i nang 11 ༵ mo

gsum las bu med/ pha mas mo'i ming la pa sangs bu khrid ces btags nas khyim rgyud 'dzin mkhan gyi bu zhig khrid rgyu'i re ba byas kyang de nas mo'i ma la phru gu ma byung / des na mi kha shas kyis ku re'i tshul du mo'i ming la pa sangs mtshams gcod ces 'bod/ bde chen chos sgrol gyis lo na rgan tsam gyi btsun ma de'i bkod sgrig bzhin phyags ma ring po de bslangs nas dgon pa'i sgo ra'i nang gad rgyag 'go tshugs/ gad rgyag stangs rim bzhin dal nas dal du song nas/ rjes su sa steng la gad snyigs yod med kyang mi lta bar phyags ma gang byung sa thog tu 'drud/ mo'i dran shes kyi rta pho dus dang yul gyi dra rgya gtor nas gang sar rgyug mo'i spun che ba chung nas slob grwar song bas/ deng skabs rdzong thog tu las ka yod cing khyo ga rgya dang kha spu mdzes pa'i sman pa zhig red/lo shas kyi sngon la pa sangs bu khrid der bu dzir bsdad myong / gcen mos rgyun du las bzo pho gzhon mang po zhig gis mo mna' mar bsu rgyu'i re ba byed lugs shod dus mo'i snying ldig ldig zer 'phag ngo ma mo'i sems gting nas nam yang dal lhod du gnas pa'i las byed pa de tshor dad smon byed/ de nyin/gcen mo phru gu khrid nas sde 'khyam du song / sma ra mdzes pa'i sman pa de mo'i 'khris su bsdad nas mo'i lag mgo nas bzung ste mig zim zim gyis mo la blta bzhin/ 66gcen gcung gnyis brje po bslog na yag po ga 'dra med dam zhes bshad pa dang / lag gcig mo'i nu ma'i thog bzhag nas phur phur byed pa dang kho'i 'gram pa'ang mo'i gdong la sbyar/ de dus mos shugs kyis kho'i lag 'og nas thon/ nyin gnyis par mos gang yang 'grel bshad ma byas par pha ma'i 'khris su logalo gnyis kyi rjes su/ mo'i gcen mo chung bar mag pa blangs/de dus mo'i sems la khor rkyang gi snang ba zhig shar mod kyang / mos tsha tsha /dri 'ur gyis las ka byas nas pha ma rgan sgon gnyis la sri zhu sgrub/ zhogs

pa langs snga shos ga dus yin na'i mo red/ mo'i sems la rang nyid kyang mi ring bar khyim tshang 'di las bral nas khyim tshang gzhan zhig gi mna' ma byed rgyu red snyam/6 khyod nang bzhin las ka byed mkhan e yong / khyo ga dran pa e red/ lo na rgan tsam gyi btsun ma de ngo mdog nag por gyur nas shugs kyis mo'i lag gi phyags ma 'phrog rjes mo rang ngo mas gad brgyab/6 khyo ga bde chen chos sgrol skyo gdung gi kher dgod shor/ ngo ma/ mo la khyo ga zhes pa med kyang sems 'o chu bzhin 'dres pa'i dga' grogs yod/de sngon mos gzhan gyi ngo sprod byas pa brgyud/ sde dpon gyi bu ser bdag dang dga' po byed myong / rjes su mos dmag khongs nas log pa'i dga' bzang dang mthun/ mo'i don du skyes pa gnyis dmar 'dzing ma byas tsam byung /mos dga' bzang la ser bdag gis ci zhig smras kyang lan mi bya rgyu'i re ba byas/ dus rgyun su la'ang mi skrag pa'i pho gzhon des mo'i ched du ser bdag gi mdun du dpa' zhum gnya' chag ngo ma mna' skyel chog ste/ mo'i dmar chung gi sems phyi nang med par dga' bzang kho na la phyogs/ rjes su ser bdag gis mo la 'jigs snang skul yang mos skrag ma myong / dga' bzang gi ri bo ltar 'gying nger langs pa'i lus de mthong ba tsam gyis mo la sems stong gi skrag snang zhi ba'i dpa' stobs ster/ ngo ma/ khong gnyis chung nas las 'gro yod/gcer bur rol ba'i byis pa'i dus su/ dga' bzang pha yin pa dang mo ma yin pa'i rtsed mor rol/ de ni mi yul du slebs nas thog mar skyes pa'i khyim tshang 'dzugs rgyu'i 'dun pa de yin nges red/tshes 'go'i zla 'od kyis ri lung kun rmi lam gyi zhing ltar rab rib tu bzos/ dga' bzang gis mo ni byis pa zhig ltar pang du bzung nas/ 6 ngas nam yang khyed dang kha mi bral zhes smras/ de nas mo'i lus la dastu sbyos

'khyud/ gzhon nu pho mo gnyis kyi lus sems gong bu gcig tu 'gril/ zor ba'i dbyibs kyi yar ngo'i zla gzhon de ngo tsha'i zol gyis phang phung sprin gseb tu byib/ brtse dung gis khyab pa'i dus der mos dga' bzang snying 'phag pa'i sgra ra ‘ ‘ chos sgrol/ gang bgad mo shor rgyu 'dug mo dang lo mtshungs pa'i bde chen bzang mo dga' mchongs rgyag bzhin mo'i 'khris su slebs/ dus rgyun khong gnyis shod mi tshar ba'i skad cha rnyed/ tha na khong gnyis lkog tu btsun ma'i sdom pa la ma bltos par skyes pa'i skor gling / de dus/ bde chen bzang mos bde chen chos sgrol gyi lus la g.yas lta g.yon lta 'ga' byas rjes/bstan bsheg gi rnam 'gyur zhig bstan te 6 skyes pa tshor gyong phog 'dug ’ ces bshad/ de mur rang nyid kyi skad chas rang nyid ngo tsha nas mo'i ngo dmar phig phig tu gyur/ bde chen chos sgrol dgod tsam byas pa las ci'ang ma smras/66khyed btsun ma byed don gang yin/ ga dus yin na'i shod kyi mi 'dugachos la dad pa che bas yin gyi red/’ bde chen bzang mos dri ba bton pa dang rang nyid kyis lan btab/ma gzhi mo chos dad can gyi dud tshang zhig tu skyes pas chos la dad pa losayod/ 'on kyang chung nas btsun ma bya rgyu yid la 'khor ma myong / gang yin mi shes/ mo'i sems la skra med pa'i bud med ni bud med ma red snyam/dkaradamar gyi mchor chas dang bral na bud med kyi mtshan nyid ma tshang snyam/na ning khong tsho'i nang mag pa blangs pa nas bzung / mo'i sems gting nas dga' bzang gis mo myur du mna' mar 'khrid rgyu sgug so rang nyid la dbang ba'i khyim tshang dang phru gu yod 'dod/ dga' bzang gis kyang da lo'i lo mjug la mo dngos su bsu rgyu yin zhes bshad rjes mo slar yang kho'i pang du blangs/de ni gdon 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin nam/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam sprul yin/122

ngo ma mi shes/ nyin gcig dmar ser btsun chas kyis brgyan zhing lag tu phreng ba 'bral med/ kha nas ma ṇi rdzogs med kyi sa mtha'i bla ma zhig khong tsho'i grong tshor 'byor bas skad grags chen po bzos/mo'i pha mas bla ma de khyim du gdan drangs pas/ bla mas khong tsho'i nang gi bya ba tshang ma dngos dngos rjen rjen bshad/ tha na ma gad mo'i na tsha chung chung de'ang rtogs/mo'i ma ha las nas lag gnyis brang khar thal mo sbyar nas yang yang 6 skyabs su mchi zhes smras nas bla ma'i rkang 'og la phyag 'tshal/rjes su 'gro ran khar bla ma des ma 'ongs sngon gzigs kyi tshul du/6 khyed tsho'i nang du bar chad du ma 'phrad la nye bas/ de dag sel dgos na bu mo 'di btsun ma byed dgos/ de ltar na rgad mo khyod kyang tshe phyi mar pho lus thob nges red/’ ces gsungs rjes/ yun ring po mig btsum nas go rgyu med pa'i kha 'don du ma bgrangs/nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa nas 'brug sgra grags pa bzhin pa sangs bu khrid ha las hon thor/ skad shugs chen pos 6 nga min/ nga min ’ zhes bshad/bla ma de phyi bltas yang ma bltas par bud song /de nas pa sangs bu khrid btsun ma byed rgyu las thabs gzhan med/dga' bzang gis khong gnyis mnyam du lha sar bros 'gro zhes gros 'go bton ༵༵ /ma byed sa/ngas bu khrid kyis ngo ma bar chad 'dra yong rgyur skrag nas cis kyang mi ring bar mos na chung bu mo'i dkar dmar mchor chas phud nas gnas chen po brag dmar dgu brtsegs kyi 'og tu gnas pa'i dge ma'i dgon pa der slebs/ nag snum gyi skra lo rtswa ngan bzhin bcad nas sems lha chos kho nar phyogs rgyur dam bca' bzhag lus po o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnastu /sa

byin brlabs pa'i gnas rtsa chen thog gi dgon pa khyad par can der bsdad kyang / rang sems rang gis ma chun par/ gzugs med sems kyi bu chung de nam yang dgon pa'i lcags ri mthon po brgal nas/ dga' skyo chags sdang du ma ster ba'i pha yul gyi ri grong du rgyug a tsi tsi/ gang byas na drag bde chen chos sgrol gyi ngo gdong nas spyir btang min pa'i 'tshub sha zhig skyes/mos mig g.yas lta g.yon lta byed dus/ rang nyid kyis kha ya ma byas pas bde chen bzang mo gar song mi 'dug bde chen chos sgrol gyis mgo bo bkyag nas dgon pa'i rgyab ri brag dmar po der lta dus/ brag rtsi dmar pos bkab pa'i brag dmar dgu brtsegs kyi 'gram du/ rang dbang ldan pa'i bya rigs sna tshogs gshog rtsal ngom nas ci dgar lding / 'ga' re mtho la 'ga' re dma'/'ga' re dal la 'ga' re myur/ 'ga' zhig dga' bde'i rtsed mor rol ba dang 'dra la/ 'ga' zhig spro skyid kyi bro gar 'khrab pa dang mtshungs/ de dus glo bur du de sngon rang nyid shang thog tu zhabs bro'i 'gran bsdur la song ba dran/ dga' bzang gi lag pa bzung nas zla 'od kyi 'og tu 'khrug cha dod pa'i sgor gzhas 'khrab pa dran/ mos gang dgar 'phur ba'i 'dab chags kyi rigs la'ang spyir btang min pa'i 'dun pa zhig skyes/ rang nyid la 'phrul gyi gshog pa zhig yod na ci mi rung snyam/ bde chen chos sgrol myur du rang nyid gcig pu'i 'jig rten stong seng seng gi sdod khang du song / dpe ras ser pos sgril ba'i dpe cha de mdun gyi dpe khri'i thog tu bzhag nas bklag par bcoms kyang / klad pa la lcags kyi sgo mo brgyab pa bzhin yig 'bru gcig kyang sems gting du mi 'gro/ a kha kha/ rang nyid ni chos skal med pa'i mi sdig can zhig min nam snyam/ lha bla ma yid la mi 'gro/ 'jig rten gyi 'khrib cis kyang mi chod dus/ skra breg pa tsam gyis 'phrad nye ba'i bar chad bzhi~X thub/ de mur mo'i yid blong blong por gyur nas dngangs skrag cig

gis sna rtse nas rngul chu 'dzag mu mthun sdod bzod mi bde bar hob langs shig byas te gdan thog nas mchongs/6 pa sangs bu khrid ces pa'i lhab lhang gi sgra zhig bde chen chos sgrol gyi rna yi bu gar lhung /bde chen chos sgrol mchongs ma rgyug gis dgon pa'i phyi logs su slebs/dga' bzang dang grong khyer nang gi pho gzhon zhig der langs 'dugadaga' bzang gi mig rtsa dmar por gyur thog ngo sha'ang skam rid du gyur/dga' bzang gis khro mig ldir nas/ 'gram gyi mi der 'dzub mo btsugs te smyo kho ngo shes kyi e 'dug thams cad bzo mkhan ser bdag red ’ ces bshad/pa sangs bu khrid kyis zhib tu lta dus/ de ring kho grong khyer nang dar ba'i dus chas kyis btums kyang / mi 'di ni de nyin btsun chas sprad pa'i bla ma mngon shes can de red/ de dus pa sangs bu khrid gnyid sad pa ltar gyur/mi der spyir btang min pa'i khong khro zhig langs nas/ kho'i thog mchongs nas 'dzing mo rgyag par bcoms kyang / dga' bzang gis kha bkag de nas mo'i dga' skyo zung gi mchi ma dbyar gyi chu 'go rdol ba bzhin dga' bzang gi gnam sa ltar yangs pa'i brang thog lhung /lo rgan tsam gyi btsun ma de mig btsum nas bsdad/da dung byis pa'i gdong dbyibs ma yal ba'i bde chen bzang mos lce snar nas rgyang lta byed baXn mchis/125

lang tsho'i mig chu/g.yu mtsho'i slob dkyil yig tshad kyi cha snyoms skar grangs 'dzin grwa yongs kyi ang dang po yin pas mo'i kha nas chad med kyi glu chung len zhing slob chung gi slob ma zhig ltar rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed bzhin khyim du log mtho rim slob 'bring la slebs nas yig tshad de ring las yag pa yong ma myong /brel ba chen pos a ma zhes 'bod bzhin nang du 'dzul/ sgrog tse'i thog tu sha skam dang kha zas sogs mang du bsgrigs/ a mas spro ba rab tu rgyas pa'i ngang nas pho gzhon zhig dang skad cha shod bzhin mchis/ pho gzhon de'i lus la deng skabs grong khyer du dar khyab che ba'i gyon chas gyon pa ma zad/ rang byung gi gzugasakhyad kyang shin tu legs/ bud med slob grwa bas dga' snang che ba'i glog brnyan 'khrab ston pa zhig gi ngo gzugs ldan/ de ring gang byas pa red/a ma myur du langs nas mo'i dpung pa nas 'jus te pho gzhon der ngo sprod byas pa ma zad/ 6 mgyogs po rgan lags la gsol ja zhus/ rgan lags kyi mtshan la dbang 'dus zer/ tshong pa chen po red ces bshad/ des na pho gzhon des kyang mgo bo kyog tsam gyis khong gi gnas tshul zhib tu bshad/ pha yul lha sa nas red 'dug tshong brgyab nas bgrang bya bcu tsam yol zhing tshong yang lam 'gro byung zer/ dbang 'dus kyi mig nas drod kyi 'od zer dang tsha bzhi snro6 lce mi mched rung shod mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig gis g.yu mtsho'i ngo sha

tsha 'ur 'ur byas pas mos ngo tsha g.yol ba'i thabs shes gzhan ma rnyed stabs sgo nas thon/ 6 nga 'gro gi yin/ nga nang du bsdad na g.yu mtsho zhed kyi yod pa 'dra/’ 66rgan lags tog tsam bzhugs/ smyo sang nyin yong gi yin/’ dbang 'dus zhes pa'i pho gzhon des shin tu 'dra chags pos g.yu mtshor 'dzum tsam byas te 6 bzhugs gnang yang /mi zhes bshad de shar rer phyin/g.yu mtsho'i a mas slar yang dbang 'dus kyi yon tan che ba'i che rabs bshad/6 rgan dbang 'dus lags dngos gnas tshong pa chen po red bzhag lha sar skad grags 'dug nga'i bu mo la mag pa de 'dra zhig thob na bsod bde red/’ 6 a ma/ g.yu mtshos kha kyog ste ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis a ma'i shod mtshams bcad/ 6 ngas mi shod/ mi shod/ a ma dgod tsam dgod tsam gyis mor bltas 'dug 'on te ya mtshan dgos pa zhig la g.yu mtsho'i rmi lam gyi nang du dbang 'dus rang nyid kyi sgrog tse gcig pa'i slob grogs byas nas bsdad gda'/dbang 'dus kyang nyin bzhin khong tsho'i khyim du yong nas sa cha gzhan pa'i ngo mtshar la dgod bro ba'i gnas tshul mang du bshad/ g.yu mtsho'i a ma ni snyan thag chod nas dbugs gtong ba'i khom pa'ang bral/ g.yu mtsho zur zhig tu lag tu deb bzung nas nyan 'jog med pa'i bzo bstan yang skabs 'gar rang dbang med par bgad mo shor/ de dus dbang 'dus bsam don 'grub pa ltar gyis mgo bo bkyag tsam byed kyi 'dug nyin zhig dbang 'dus kyis rgyu bal yin pa'i dpe gsar gyi stod gos shig khyer 'dug de g.yu mtsho'i lag la bzhag nas rngan pa yin zhes smras/ 6 min/ nga la mi dgos/ mi rgyu chung 'dug zer gyi yod dam/ 8 min/ ma gzhi khyed kyis nga la rgyu chen po 'di 'dra sprad dgos don ci yod/mi 6tsangs za sa btung sa 'dir byed/'di'ang ma blangs na sang nyin nas yong phod ma song /’ 6 bu mo/ 11snang

ngan mi shes mkhan/’ a mas g.yu mtshor len dgos pa'i bka' phab pa red/de nas gza' 'khor kha shas phyin rjes g.yu mtshos dbang 'dus kyis sprad pa'i stod gos de gyon nas slob grwar phyin/ mo slob khang nang 'dzul ma thag slob grogs tshang ma 'ur chil li song / 6 mi chung kha bde myur du yong nas gus btud dang bcas 6 tshong dpon gyi lcam phebs byung ’ zhes skad gdangs ring pos smras/ 6 bsod bde red/ 6 tshong dpon gyi bro ba ga 'dra 'dug 66stod gos 'di rgya gar nas nyos pa e red/ la la ha ha ho ho zhes dgod/ la las mor lta tsam gyis phan tshun shub shub byed/ dngos gnas thams cad kyis ha go tshar 'dug ma gzhi med pa ma gtogs tshang ma ha go rgyu chos nyid du zad/ 'ur chil chil gyi khrod du gyang zur gyi lhag pa bkra shes gcig pu nag rog ger bsdad 'dug bod yig dge rgan yar 'dzul byung bas slob phrug rnams 'tshab 'tshub ngang rang rang gi sdod gnas su 'ong / bod yig dge rgan gyis mu mthud snyan ngag gi slob tshan khrid/ g.yu mtshos mo'i mdun gyi ltar pa'i gyang 'gram du bsdad pa'i lhag pa bkra shes la lta bzhin dran shes kyi rta pho bgrang bya du ma'i sngon du rgyugade dus ni dma' rim slob 'bring gi lo rim gnyis pa'i skabs red/dgong mo zhig la slob khang nang du rang sbyong byed du yong mkhan mo dang lhag pa bkra shis las med/ khong gnyis mnyam du dbyibs gzugs kyi rtsis gzhi kha shas gros bsdur byas rjes lhag pa bkra shis kyis stod gos khug ma'i nang nas yi ge zhig bton te 'dar sig sig gis mo la sprad rjes kho'i ngo gdong glo ba ltar dmar rkyang chags 'dug lhag pa bkra shes kyis 66nga 'gro gi yin/ zhes bshadade rtab rtob kyis dpe khug khur nas phyin pas rkang pa sgo shing la brgyab nas tog tsam ma gtogs sa la 'gyel/ mos yi ge de kha phyes nas lta dus lhag pa di18 shes kyis mo la sprad pa'i mdza' yig red/ de dus mos de dag yid la

gtan nas 'khor ma myong ba ma zad/ mdza' yig ces pa ma rabs tha shal 'ba' zhig tu brtsi gi yod stabs mos tsham tshom med par yi ge de khong tsho'i 'dzin grwa'i kru'u ren rgan krang lags la phul/nyin gnyis pa'i snga dro'i slob gseng gi lus rtsal tshar rjes slob ma yongs kyi tshogs chen red 'dug slob ston kru'u ren dbang chen gyis skad shugs chen pos slob grogs tsho/ da lta ngas yi ge zhig klog gi yin/ 66mdza' brtse'i gser thag tshang mas bsam blo zhig thongs dang / 'di ni slob phrug cig gis 'bri rgyu'i yi ge red dam/’ gnam g.ya' dag nas 'brug sgra thos pa ltar tshogs ra hril po 'ur zing gis khengs/ de rjes slob ston kru'u ren gyis yi ge 'bri mkhan de mdun la rang 'gul gyis thon shog ces bshad/ slob ston kru'u ren gyis g.yu mtsho la bsngags pa dang zung 'brel gyis lhag pa bkra shis la skyon brjod tsha nan byas/ lhag pa bkra shis ni de ring ltar nag rong ger langs 'dugagayu sgron gyis mo'i dpung pa dkrug dkrug byas/ a tsi/ rgan lags kyis mor dri ba bton pa red/ 6 ya/ khyod rang shod dang /’ 6 ci/ mos dge rgan gyis gang dris ma shes/ 6 bsam blo gzhan dag la ma gtong /mar sdod/’ de ma thag mi chung kha bdes lag pa bkyag song / 66o/ lhag chung shod dang /’ 66g.yu mchos tshong dpon dran bsdad 'dug 6 ga re/ rgan lags gdong nag pos/ mi chung kha bdes mgo phur tsam phur tsam byas pa las ci'ang mi smra/ 6 bstan gshig ma slong / mar sdod/ slob grwa grol nas khyim du log pa'i lam thog tu red/ 6 tshong pa de khyod dang 'brel ba ci red/ g.yu sgron gyis g.yu mtsho la skad cha dris/ 6 a ma'i ngo shes red/ 8 spyi tshogs thog gi mi de tsho gzab gzab byed dgos/’ 6 ma gzhi nga mi de dang dmigs bsal gyi 'brel ba gang yang med/ lar a ༵༵ mi

yag po 'dug zer/ g.yu mtsho de tsam ma dga'/ 8 ngas skad cha zhig go byung / khyod la shod e dgos/ tsa ci/’ 6 khyed rang khong khro ma byed/ 6 shod dang /’ sems ma skyo ang /’ 6 shod dang / bu mo de rnyog gra tsha ba la/ 6 khyed kyi a mas chung dus gang byung ma byung byed kyi yod pa red/ khyed kyi a pha yang kha che'i mi red zer/ de dus kyi dpon po zhig yin mdog red/ 66ga re/’ g.yu mtshos 'khyags rom gyi phung po las me lce mthong ba dang nyi ma'i 'od zer las smag mun mthong ba bzhin mo'i dwangs gsal gyi 'dren byed zung chen po gdang / yud tsam song rjes mchi ma'i phreng ba shel gyi gong bu ltar 'od hrob hrob ngang lhung zhing ngu sgra sgrog bzhin g.yu sgron gyi thog tu mchongs nas 6 khyod kyi rdzun ma shod/ nga'i pha shi tshar ba red/’ ces shod bzhin g.yu sgron la 'gram lcag tsha thag chod cig gzhus/ g.yu sgron la ma nyes kha g.yog phog stabs rab tu khros nas g.yu mtsho bskyur nas brgyugs so/g.yu mtshos chung dus nas pha mthong ma myong zhing mo a ma la brten nas me tog dang mchi mas grub pa'i mi tshe'i lam du zhugs/ mo'i ngos nas bshad na a ma las legs pa/ a ma ltar drin che ba zhig mi 'tsho sa'i sa sgang gi thog la med/ a mas rang nyid kyi skyag g.yog gcin g.yog ji ltar byas min yid la mi dran rung mo slob chung la 'gro ran dus kyang a ma'i 'o ma nu gi yod/ 'o ma'i ro mchog ji ltar mngar zhim ldan min brjed ngas rkun pos khyer yang a ma'i nu ma nu rgyu las skyid pa zhig da dung tshor ma myong / g.yu sgron gyi skad cha des g.yu mtsho la glo bur du mgo la rdo zhus pa'i snang ba byung / g.yu mtsho dbugs hal bzhin khyim du 'byor/ dbang 'dus yar langs nas 6 g.yu mcho ngus pa 'dra/ga re byas song / zhes bshad/ che khyed rang da lta log phebs rogs/ ngas a mar skad cha zhig shod dgos yod/’ 66gsang ba red dam/ 6 red/ khyed dadi ni/la ba med/’ 64de ring ga re byas pa red/ rgyags gtam tsha ba la

de ni mo'i a ma'i skad cha red/ 6 byas na nga 'gro gi yin/ dbang 'dus cung kha skyengs nas log a ma/ nga'i pha dngos gnas shi song ba red dam/ 6 shi med na ga par 'dug 6 kha che'i mi ma red dam/ 6 ci smyo lab rgyag gi yod/ 88nga la drang po shod rogs/ a mas kha ci'ang mi grags par mgo bo sgur nas bsdad/ dbugs ring zhig btang ste/ 66khyed rang gi pha grongs mkhan de/ ma red/ ba'i zla bo grongs mkhan des sngon ma gzhas shig bcoms pa red/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gzhas de dug rtswar brtsis/grongs mkhan de'ang dug rtswa bkram mkhan la brtsis nas dmar srung dmag gi dpon po mā cun sogs yong nas rdo ril 'dra ba zhig tu bkyig nas khrid song /de dus nga bud med cig la thabs shes ci yod/ mchi ma bton rgyu tsam red/drag char 'bab cing 'brug sgra ldir ba'i dgong mo skyi g.ya' ba zhig la nga'i sgo brdung byung / nang du 'dzul yong mkhan ni dmar srung dmag gi dpon po mā cun red/ ngas kho ni kha sang bzhin grongs mkhan de'i gnas tshul 'dri rtsad byed mkhan red bsam byung / khos kyang thog mar grongs mkhan de nyes pa che lugs thar lam med lugs mang du smras/ kho mo ni rbad de skrag thag chod nas kho'i mdun du pus mo btsugs te gu yangs gtong rogs zhes ngus pa yin/runga'i kha la nyan na skyon gyi ma red/ sems sdug ma byed zer bzhin kho'i khrag dri bro ba'i lag pas nga'i ngo la byil byil byas pa ma zad/ de nas shod mi dgos pa red/ khyod kyis los ha go/ de nas bzung mā cun gyis kha mkhas tshig snyan gyis dgong mo rtag par nga la brnyas bcos byed du yong gi 'dug rjes su nga'i zla bo 'thab rtsod byas nas bkrong 'dug pas ngas ngus nas gang sar rgyug pa yin/ mā cun gyi nyes pa'ang ther 'don byas mod kyang tshang mas nga ni ma nyes kha g.yog byed mkhan zhig tu brtsi ba las kha ya byed mkhan su'ang mi 'dugakhyod kyi pha mā cun red/ go thos la kha che yin skad/ rjes su rlangs 'khorā spyang

mnyam du g.yang la zag pa red zer/ a ma'i ngo gdong ma lus mchi mas tshos 'dug g.yu mtsho rang dbang med par a mar 'thams nas drag tu ngus/ma bu gnyis kyi mchi ma mnyam du 'dres/ a ma'i mchi ma g.yu mtsho'i kha nang du'ang 'dzul/ de ni skyur mo red/ dka' sdug gi skyur mo dang mngar mo dang bde skyid/ 'od snang bcas kyi ched du bsags pa'i skyur mo red/ des na g.yu mtshos ma la 'khang ra byed thabs bral/ 'khang ra dgos pa ni rang nyid kyis da dung a ma'i drin lan phran tsam yang 'jal ma thub pa de red/de nyin phyi dro g.yu mtsho nang du 'byor dus dbang 'dus las ma bsdad/dang thog dbang 'dus kyis skad cha don yod la med pa kha shas bshad rjes lag pa stod gos khug ma'i nang brgyab ste 6 ngas khyed la gcig khyer yod/ 64ci red/ 66de/ dpe gsar gyi lag gdub cig 'dug mdzes pa la/ 6 shog dang ngas bskon rogs byed dgos/ dbang 'dus kyis lag gdub bskon rjes mo'i dkar 'jam gyi lag pa dam por bcangs/ g.yu mtshos ci byed mi shes par re zhig lus/ des na dbang 'dus kyis 6 g.yu mtsho/ nga'i snying tsha po de khyed rang la bstan e dgos/ zhes bshad de g.yu mtsho 'gram du sdod bcug g.yu mtshos kho'i tsha 'ur 'ur gyi 'dren byed la lta bzhin khong khro byed rgyu'i spobs pa zhi ste mgo bo gug des na dbang 'dus kyis dal bu'i ngang mo'i thod pa'i thog la 'o zhig bskyal/ g.yu mtsho gnyid sad pa ltar gyur nas dbang 'dus bskyur nas phyi ru rgyug rgyal sgo'i 'gram du a ma dang gdong thug6 'tshab be 'tshub be ga re byas song / na dbang 'dus kyis/ 6 ci byas song /’ g.yu mtshos da lta'i gnas tshul rab tsam bshad/ a mas 'dzum mdangs ston bzhin 6 mi de 'jon thang yod pa ma zad/ kun spyod kyang yagakhyod kyis khong thob na rtse gra red/’ 6 lhan/ g.yu mtsho shar re g.yu sgron 'ardoX n+d+ra phyin nas dgong mo'i bar ma log

dus tshod ni de 'dra'i mgyogs pa la/ de ring yang gza' spen pa red/phyi dro slob tshan med pas g.yu mtshos chu tshod gnyis tsam khrus brgyab/ de rjes mos dug log gtsang rkyang gyon nas shel sgo chen po'i mdun du rang gis rang la zhib lta byas/ snyan ngag dper brjod nang 'khod pa'i tsa ri'i smyug ma mngon sum mig dbang gis mjal ma myong yang rang nyid kyi lus po phra sa phra la sbom sa sbom/ 'bur sa 'bur la kong sa kong / tsa ri'i smyug ma ji ltar mdzes kyang de dag ga la ldan/ mig chen po gnyis dkar nag 'tsham zhing kri ga chen po gnyis kyis brgyan dus de bas mdzes/ kha sna thams cad bzo bkod mkhas pas 'phrul gyis bskrun pa ltar che chung mnyam la bsdur tshad lugs dang mthun/des na g.yu mtshos blo mgu thag chod nas shel sgo'i nang gi mdzes ma der sna gnyer zhig byas/ tag tag shel sgo'i nang du pho gzhon zhig thon te mo'i 'gram du yong / dngos gnas chung yo'o yi bcoms sgrung nang gi mdza' gcugs gser thag gis bcings pa'i pho mo gnyis 'dra/ g.yu mtsho'i ngo dmar rkyang chags nas shel sgo las g.yol/ ru nga la da dung khong khro za gi 'dug gam/byas na ngas kha sang gi skad cha de bshad med pa dang bya ba de byas med pa la brtsi rogs/ 6 sus khyod la khong khro za gi 'dug zer/ 6 de ring ngo shes kyis zhabs bro'i mtshan tshogs kyi pa se gnyis sprad byung / do dgong nged gnyis 'gro/’ tsa nga / 6 khyod las ka gzhan dag yod dam/ 6 med/ 6 dbyas na 'gro/ ga dus yin na'i deb kho na bltas bsdad na klad pa rul yong / skabs skabs skyid tsam byed dgos red/ mi g.yu mtshos zhabs bro'i mtshan tshogs skor gyi skad cha mang po go myong ba las dngos su 'gro ba'i go skabs ma thob pas de ring 'gro 'dod shin tu che/ 6 ngas khyed rang gi a ma la bshad tshar/ do dgong 'gro dgos/ klad pa ngal gso phog gi red/ smyo en/ g.yu mchos zhabs bro'i mtshan tshogs la 'gro rgyu'i khas len |sdu/

g.yu mtsho'i snying sdig ldig 'phags bzhin zhabs bro'i mtshan tshogs kyi sgo nang 'dzul/ a tsi/ rab rib 'od snang gis khyab pa'i khang pa'i nang phyogs gang sar rmi lam gyi zhing khams bzhin/ mo'i bsam yul ring du 'das/ 'od kyi thig le grangs las 'das pa zhig khang pa'i phyogs kun tu lding bas mos thog mar shog bu'i me tog grangs las 'das pa zhig rlung gis khyer ba red snyam/khang pa'i nang du sbrang si zhabs bro'i 'gyur khug dbyar rnga ltar grags pas gzhan gyi skad gdangs ma lus lkugs par bzos/ zhabs bro la rol ba'i pho gzhon mo gzhon rnams myos pa ltar gyis rkang lag bzhi ka dang lus po'i tshigs ma lus dkrugs nas dza drag gi zhabs bro brgyab/ khong gnyis kyi zur du pho gzhon mo gzhon khyu gcig sbi rag btung nas bsdad 'dug de las pho gzhon nag zing zhig gis dbang 'dus ngo shes kyi 'dug khong gnyis kyang kho tsho dang mnyam du shog zer/ g.yu mtsho ma phyin pas dbang 'dus kyang ma phyin/ des na pho gzhon nag zing des sbi rag shel dam gang khyer nas khong gnyis kyi mdun du yong / dbang 'dus la zhabs dag bkyag tshar rjes g.yu mtsho la sbi rag bkyag mos btung shes kyi med lugs bshad kyang u tshugs mthar skyel byas/dbang 'dus kyis tshab byas nas btung dgos zhes bshad kyang 'grig gi med zer/ pho gzhon nag zing des chang gzhas kyang btang byung bas g.yu mtsho 'u thug nas sbi rag dkar yol gang po mig btsum ste zhabs dag brgyab/ dus rgyun chang rag gtan nas mi 'thung ba'i bu mo de sbi rag btung rjes de ma thag ngo gdong tsha sob sob dang lus kyang yang thing thing du 'gyur/ dal zhing snyan pa'i rol dbyangs shig grags byung bas pho mo 'tham res kyi zhabs bro 'go tshugs song / dbang 'dus dang g.yu mtsho'ang mi tshogs kyi khrod du 'dres/drang por bshad na rab rib 'od snang gis brgyan pa'i 'khyab ra dang snyan 'ardo sdu lha yi sgra snyan grags 'dra'i bro glu bcas tshang mas g.yu mtsho'i yid

dbang 'phrog g.yu mtsho dang dbang 'dus gnyis ni pad+ma'i mtsho la rol ba'i ngang pa ltar lus bde bas khyab cing zhabs bro la ci dgar rol/ 6 nga khyim la skyel rogs/’ 6 dang po nga sdod sa la 'gro tsam byed/ 8 min/ phyi po chags 'dug 6 ngas skyel dgos/ nga sdod sa 'gram du yod/’ dbang 'dus ni nye 'gram gyi mgron khang las khang chung zhig glas nas bsdad 'dug66ngal gso tog tsam rgyobs dang / de nas ngas skyel dgos/’ dbang 'dus kyis 6 khe le ’ shel dam zhig kha phyes nas shel phor nang blugs te g.yu mtsho'i mdun du bzhag g.yu mtsho skom dad kyis mnar bas hub gang gis zhabs dag brgyab/ a tsi ga re byas pa red/ mo'i lus thams cad tsha zing zing du gyur te/ 'dod chags kyi spu long ma lus rab tu rgyas/ dbang 'dus kyang ngo tsha'i gos dang bral nas sha la rngam pa'i spyang rgan ltogs pa bzhin mo la 'o skyel ba dang / mo'i nu ma phur ba ma zad mo'i grang 'khyags 'gog byed/ ngo tsha srung byed/ mdzes rgyan spras byed du gyur pa'i gos kyang ma lus bshus te nyal khri'i thog la bzhag kho'i 'dod blo tshims pa byed rgyu byung / g.yu mtsho ni tsha sdug gis mnar skabs bsil g.yab kyi bde ba thob pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur las 'gog rgol phran tsam yang mi byed/ dus kyi pho nyas zhogs pa'i skya rengs bsus pas g.yu mtsho rmi lam gyi zhing khams nas hob ste chang dri bro ba'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du slobs/ mos dug log ma lus phud nas dbang 'dus dang mnyam du nyal yod pa mthong dus mdang gi gnas tshul gsal la mi gsal ba zhig yid du 'khor/ mo'i lus hril po gnongs 'gyod drag pos rab tu gdung bas rdog tho gcig dang khu tshur gcig gis dbang 'dus rmi lam gyi zhing khams nas dkrogs te/ 6 'gro/ spyi bde las khungs la/ khyod kyis mdang nub nga la dug sman sprad 'dug ces bshad nas myur du dug log gyon/ dbang 'dus dug log kyang gyon khom med par g.yu mtsho'i mdun du pus mo di/spras/

6 ngas khyed la dga' drags nas mdang nub kyi gnas tshul byung ba red/ khyed snga phyi ma gtogs nga'i ma red dam/’ 8 g.yo ma shod/ nga 'gro gi yin/ 6 tog tsam ma 'gro/ nga'i sems gtad sa khyed rang las med/ khyed kyis de 'drabyas na nga gson por bsdad kyang snying po mi 'dug ces bshad ma thag byang ldebs su bkal ba'i gri bton nas rang nyid kyi pho ba bsnun rtsis byas/g.yu mtsho yar rgyug nas kho'i lag nas gri 'phrog cing mo'i sems steng nas 'bar ba'i khong khro'i me lce theg med du gyur te mig la mchi zhags 'khor bzhin dbang 'dus kyi pang du 'gyel/de nas g.yu mtsho dang dbang 'dus mnyam du sdod rgyu gtan 'khel zhing a mas u tshugs byas te dbang 'dus khong tsho'i nang du spo bcug dbang 'dus dang g.yu mtsho khrims mthun gyi bza' tsho min yang bza' tshang lta bu'i 'tsho ba rol/ mtho rim slob 'bring nas thon tsam byung na bsam pa las slob grwa chen mor bskyod rgyu'i phugs bsam de g.yu mtsho'i klad pa'i nang nas rim bzhin 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur zhing / de sngon gyi zhogs sbyong dus tshod ni deng mig spu 'bri ba sogs mdzes mdzes byed rgyu'i dus su 'gyur/ dus rgyun gtam dpe dang legs bshad 'bri sa'i deb chung der deng skabs pho mo'i brtse dung mtshon pa'i skad cha dang gzhas tshig kho nas gang / g.yu mtsho'i bsam blo slob sbyong gi thog gnas mi thub pas mo'i sbyang 'bras ni mar ngo'i zla ba'i dpe zlar 'gyur/ nyin zhig khong tsho'i 'dzin grwa'i kru'u ren rgan bsod rgyal gyis g.yu mtsho kho'i nang du yong dgos pa'i brda byas/ rgan bsod rgyal ni lo shas sngon bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig tshan khag nas thon pa'i dge rgan gsar pa zhig red mod kyang rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi legs shing slob gso'i bya bar spro ba rab tu brtas/ khong gis dus rgyun g.yu mtsho la slob ma gzhan las lhag bzhi ཿ6 rtog dang gzigs skyong byas/ gang yin zhe na/ g.yu mtsho ni khong tsho'i

'dzin grwa'i nang gi bod yig yag shos yin stabs de las lhag pa'i grub 'bras thob rgyu'i ched du'o/ 'on te deng skabs g.yu mtsho'i chu bo thur 'bab kyi 'phel phyogs mthong dus sems khral mi byed pa ga la srid/ 66deng sang khyed rang sbyangs 'bras gang byas pa red/ 6 shes kyi mi 'dug 6 khyed tshong pa zhig dang 'brel ba chen po 'dug zer gyi 'dug de ga 'dra red/’ 6 mi de tsho jus gtogs tsha drags pa red/ nga'i a ma'i ngo shes yin pas nga dang 'brel ba med pa ga la srid/mi de las brgal ba'i 'brel ba med dam/mi med/’ g.yu mtsho khong khro zos pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan te rkub stegs nas langs/dngosaganas byas na mos myur du shog dzar las rtsa che ba'i dngos rdzas ci'ang med pa'i sprang gog de'i khang pa las kha bral bar 'dod/ thams cad 'gyur ba ni 'jig rten gyi chos nyid dang po de red/ de sngon g.yu mtshos rgan bsod rgyal gyi nang la 'gro 'dod che zhing khong gi skad cha'ang rna ba'i bcud ltar snyan/rgan bsod rgyal 'dzum tsam byas te 6 mar sdod/ gnas tshul med na yag po red/ gal srid khyod kyi bsam blo gzhan du ma g.yeng tshe slob grwa chen mor 'gro thub nges red/’ slob grwa'i za ma btang ba'i brda ting ting gis grags/ 8 za ma za ran/ de ring 'dir zo/’ ra rgan lags thugs rje che/ nga da lta nang la las ka yod/’ 64'grig ga nga'i skad cha sems la zhog mi g.yu mtshos 'dod la ma 'dod pa'i ngang mgo kyog tsam byas rjes lcags rta bzhon nas bya 'phur ba ltar khyim la kha phyogs/ dbang 'dus rgyal sgo'i 'gram nas mo sgug yod pa gdon mi za/khong tsho'i rgyal sgo'i mdun du rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig bsdad 'dugathog la drag brda gtong byed kyi glog dmar po de'ang mchis/ spyi bde las khungs kyi red 'dug tshod dpag byas na dbang 'dus kyi ngo shes yin gyi red/ci byas pa yin nam/ spyi bde'i mi sna kha shas kyis lag lcags brgya13 sna'i

dbang 'dus rgyal sgo nas khrid byung / dbang 'dus kyi ngo mdog thal skya ru 'gyur ba ma zad/ mgo bo gug ste dgye dgye yang byed mi nus/ spyi bde'i pho gzhon gzugs ring des rdog tho gzhus te dbang 'dus rlangs 'khor nang bcug bsam yul las 'das pa'i bya ba des g.yu mtsho lcags rta nas kyang 'bab khom ma byung bar 6 khob sgra dang bcas sa la 'gyel/ dbang 'dus la rdog rgyag gzhu mkhan des g.yu mtsho skyor rogs byas/ mo'i a ma rgyug yong nas g.yu mtshor 'thams nas 6 nga'i bu mo/ ngas nor song zhes brjod bzhin yang yang ngus/ spyi bde las khungs kyis ngo sprod byas pa ltar na/ dbang 'dus ni lha sar bu mo lo chung la btsan g.yem dang dngul sgor 'bor chen rku 'phrog byas te bros byol byas pa'i nyes can pa red/ de nas g.yu mtsho nyi ma kha shas slob grwar ma song / rjes su rgan bsod rgyal khong tsho'i khyim du yong nas mo la slob gso dang skyon brjod mang du byas te yin gcig min gnyis slob grwar yong dgos zer/ de nas g.yu mtsho slar yang slob grwar song / slob phrug mang che bas mo'i gnas tshul ha go nas slob grwa'i nang gi gleng gzhi gtso bo der 'gyur/ g.yu mtsho de bas mgo bo bkyag mi thub la dbang 'dus dang mnyam du skyelaba'i 'tsho ba'ang yang yang yid du 'khor/ ma gzhi rgan bsod rgyal gyis byung tshar ba thams cad klad pa'i nang nas gtsang phyags kyis blo rtse gcig sgrim ngang slob sbyong byed dgos pa'i bslab bya gnang mod kyang don thog la 'bab dus de 'dra'i las sla po ga par yod/de ni gsal la mi gsal ba'i glog 'od tsam las mun nag gos kyis grong khyer ma lus lhug por g.yogs te nam mkhar bsnyegs pa'i thog brtsegs can gyi khang bzang dang sa la 'byar ba'i lcags shog gi khang chung sogs cha 'byed mi shes pa'i dus red/ g.yu mtsho dang g.yu sgron dgong mo'i rang sbyong tshar nas go/ /zlos chen pos khyim du log glo bur du glog khra chil chil byas pa dang

snying gas dgos pa'i tsir sgra zhig dang bcas rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig khong gnyis kyi mdun du yal/ dang thog khong gnyis 'jigs skrag gis skad ngan shor bzhin bskor 'drogs shig byas pa dang de nas blo rnal du phab pas gnyis ka 'dzems zon med pa'i bgad mo shor/ ga re byas pa yin nam/ rlangs 'khor chung chung de kha phyir bskor byung / shar rer rgyug yong nas khong gnyis kyi mdun la kha bkag rlangs 'khor nas pho gzhon stag 'dra ba gsum thon/6 khong gnyis red 'dug slob grwa grol song ngam/’ 'jig rten bya ba'i bsru brid la de tsam cha rgyus med pa'i bu mo gnyis po mig ce rer gdang / gtan nas mthong myong mi 'dug sbrang si 'khrab gar 'gro/ phebs dang phebs dang /’ u tshugs chen pos g.yu mtsho rlangs 'khor nang bcug g.yu sgron skad ngan rgyag bzhin bros song bas pho gzhon de tshos rjed 'ded ma byas/ g.yu mtsho'i sems nang do dgong zhabs bro blo tshim pa zhig brgyab nas sbyangs 'bras zhan pa sogs kyi sems sdug cig car brjed rgyu red snyam/ rlangs 'khor grong nub kyi sger khang chen po zhig gi mdun du kha bkag khang pa'i sgo phyes ma thag chang dri 'tshub 'tshub byed cing sbrang si'i rol dbyangs kyang rab tu grags/ pho gzhon mo gzhon kha shas sbi rag btung bzhin sbrang si 'khrab/ dang thog pho gzhon mig shel can gzugs thung zhig yong nas rang nyid ngo sprod byas rjes g.yu mtsho la sbi rag bkyag gsum sgron zhabs dag yin zer/ g.yu mtshos hub gang gis zhabs dag brgyab rjes tshang mas bsngags brjod byas/ de nas sge'u khung gi ras yol dam du brgyab/ nang khul gyi brnyan 'phrin gtong gi yin zer/ de ni 'khrig spyod kho na brjod byar byas pa'i ma rabs tha shal gyi brnyan 'phrin zhig red/ g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du pho gzhon mig shel can gzugs thung de bsdad/ gzhan rnams kyang pho mo zung byas nas bsdad 'dug brnyan 'phrin gyi nang don ji ltar skyug bro'ang gzhon nu pho mo de dag ni sha rul1 ༵༵nga

ba'i sbrang bu ltar dga' bas rab tu myos/ 6 byed stangs 'di ha las gargyu ci yod/ sngon tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i 'dod pa'i bstan bcos nang 'di dag las ngo mtshar ba mang po bris yod/ e red g.yu mtsho lags/ mig shel can gzugs thung gis brnyan 'phrin la mdzub mo btsugs bzhin de ltar bshad/ g.yu mtsho de sngon dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis 'dod pa'i bstan bcos bcoms pa go myong yang tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i 'dod pa'i bstan bcos zhes pa ni de ring ma gtogs go ma myong / mig shel can gzugs thung des mo'i lus la 'byar zhing lag pa mo'i brla thog bzhag nas yang yang nyugades mo'i lus la gnas skabs kyi bde ba zhig byung bas g.yu mtshos ci'ang mi smra/brnyan 'phrin tshar rjes zhabs bro 'khrab dgos zer/ de nas kho pa tshos ma rabs kyi zhabs bro 'khrab pa ma zad phyi nyin zhogs pa snga po g.yu mtsho log rtsis byas stabs mig shel can gzugs thung myur du langs nas g.yu mtsho'i lag tu sgor mo brgya lor zhig bzhag mjug ma phebs shog sba'i sba'i/ mgazhi kho la nyams ci'ang med kyang nyams che mdog gis g.yu mtsho mar tsam bskyalazho/ gas pa g.yu sgron dang mnyam du slob grwar phyin/ g.yu mtsho dgong mo gnyid yag po ma byung stabs mkhris nad kyis mnar ba bzhin nyi 'od lhag par ser/ 6 mi de tsho su red 'dug 6 sngon ma dbang 'dus kyi ngo shes red/ 6 de tsho dang 'brel ba ma byed/ yag rgyu med red/’ 6 yag byung / bka' bkyon ma gnang / da lta a ma'i bka' bkyon myong tshar tsam yin/’ g.yu sgron gyis g.yu mtsho ma dga' ba mthong bas skad cha shod mtshams bzhagatshogs thun dang po rtsis rig slob tshan red/ g.yu mtsho myur du rmi lam gyi zhing khams su slebs/ mo mi mang po zhig dang mnyam du nyal 'dug de dag ni rnga ma /10 mche ba ldan pa'i gcan gzan red/ tsa yar longs/ khang pa 'di khyod

kyi nyal khang red bsam byung ngam/ sgrog tse 'di khyod kyi nyal khri red bsam byung ngam/ rtsis rig dge rgan rab tu khros pas dbu skra gzeng zhing lus po 'dar sig sig byed/ rjes su slob tshan gyi grol brda grags stabs rtsis rig dge rgan gyis mo la bskyon brjod byed rgyu mtshams bzhag slob tshan grol rjes lhag pa bkra shes kyis shog lhe zhig khyer nas g.yu mtsho la bod yig gi rtsom yig 'gran bsdur nang zhugs rgyu'i ming tho 'khod zer/ 6 min/ 6 khyed la bod yig chu tshad yag po de 'dra yod dus/ 6 shod mi dgos/ nga 'gran bsdur nang zhugs kyi min/ 66o/ cog lhag pas da dung mo la re ba byed kyi yod dam/ de ni mi chung kha bde red/ lhag pa bkra shis kyis mi chung kha bder sdang mig cig bltas te slob khang nas thon/g.yu mtsho 'dam rdzab nang zag pa'i glang chen zhig ltar 'dam rdzab las thar te yangs pa'i rtswa thang la slebs rgyu ni ha lam ri bong rwa yi spun zlar gyur/g.yu mtshos rgyun du slob byol byed pa ma zad/ mtshan mo ha lam mig shel can gzugs thung sogs dang mnyam du rol/ khong tsho dang mnyam du ma rabs kyi zhabs bro 'khrab pa/ ma rabs kyi brnyan 'phrin lta ba/ sbi rag btung ba/ tha mag 'then pa sogs kyis dus 'da' bar byed/ g.yu mtshos de sngon rang nyid slob grwa'i nang gi 'tsho ba dran dus tshwa ma btab pa'i zas zos pa'i snang ba skye ba dang / deng skabs kyi 'tsho ba dang / rgyu nor gyis phyug cing dngul chu rgyug rgyug bed spyod rgyu yod pa'i spyi tshogs thog gi grogs po dang grogs mo de tsho'i ma rabs kyi 'jon thang la yid chags/de nyin phyi dro'i tshogs thun gnyis par slob tshan dngos med stabs slob phrug rnams rang sbyong byed bzhin mchis/ skra bu mo las ring ba'i pho gzhon 'ga' slob khang gi sgo 'gram nas 8 g.yu mtsho/ g.yu mtsho/’ zhes 'bod/g.yu mtsho mgo bo sgur nas khong tshor kha ya ma byas/ pho gzhon gzugs /rdo de

'dzul byung / 6 zhe drag yin mdog ma byed/ tshang ma rgyus yod red/’ ces bshad de g.yu mtsho'i dpung pa nas 'then/ des na lhag pa bkra shis langs te 6 cog lags/ phebs gnang dang / 'di slob khang red/’ 8 slob khang yin pa shes kyi yod/ gzugs ring des khu tshur bsgongs nas lhag pa bkra shes kyi 'gram par gzhus/ lhag pa bkra shis khyar re khyor re bzos/ des 'dzin grwa'i slob ma yongs kyi khong khro'i me lce ches cher spar bas gcig rjes gnyis mthud ngang langs byung / ngar skad 'brug grags grags dang khu tshur char 'bab 'bab byas stabs g.yu mtsho 'tshol mkhan gyi pho gzhon de dag rtab rtob ngang bros/ g.yu mtsho'ang mig nas mchi ma bton bzhin de tsho'i rjes la rgyug g.yu mtsho'i byed stangs kyis slob phug rnams phu shor ba'i lhang bu ltar bzos la tshang mas kha nas 66gzhang tshong ma/ zhes g.yu mtshor dmod mo bar mi chad par rgyag gi 'dug 6 go thos la khyed slob grwa nas phyir phud byed rtsis 'dug zer gyi 'dugakhyed kyis rgan bsod rgyal lags 'tshol nas shod tsam gyis dang / lo gcig sdug rus byas na slob grwa thon gyi red/ slob thon lag khyer zhig yod na las ka 'tshol bde/ g.yu sgron gyi skad cha nyan rjes g.yu mtshos mgo bo kyog kyog byas shing dgong mo rtsed grogs rnams la blo dris/ 6 phud na phud bcug 6 skyid shos red/ 6 slob thon lag khyer zhig yod na phan thogs yod/ 8 phud mkhan gtso bo su red/’ 66rgan bsod rgyal/’ 6 nga tshos lam sgug byas nas skrag snang zhig bskul na/ 66de las de 'dra byas na yag gi red/ mig shel can gzugs thung gis mig chung chung gnyis myur du 'khor bzhin kha g.yu mtsho'i rna bar 'byar nas shub shub byas/ des na g.yu mtsho'i gdong nas mos mas/ sna 'dzum mdangs bstan pas mig shel can gyis shog bu brdal te smyu gu

blangs/ 8 rgan bsod rgyal lags/ khyod kyis kho mor yun ring pha ma lta bu'i byams skyong gnang bar thugs rje che/ kho mos cis kyang mtho 'bring gi slob thon lag khyer thob par 'dod/ gal srid nga slob grwa nas phud na nga'i grogs po de chos rgan lags kyi sku gzugs la gnod skyel rtsis 'dug ha lam rgan lags kyis mkhyen gsal la nga'i grogs po de tsho ni spyi bde las khungs kyis jus gtogs mi thub pa'i mi sha stag red/ rgan lags kyi sku 'tsho gsal bang thog 'phrin las yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i ched du/ gus mo g.yu mtshos/ ’66g.yu mtsho/ zha'o krang don gcod khang du shog zer/’ g.yu mtshos zha'o krang klad dmar yid du 'khor/ ma gzhi zha'o krang khros nas sgrog tse brdab pa'i dus med kyang kho'i kha nas thon pa'i zur za dang sun 'byin gyi skad cha de dag mtshon cha ci las kyang rno/ g.yu mtsho don gcod khang du 'dzul ma thag66a tsi/ de ring spyi bde las khungs kyis jus gtogs mi thub pa'i grogs po de tsho khrid med dam/ g.yu mtshos thams cad ha go song / mig shel can gzugs thung gi jus la ldog phyogs kyi nus pa thon yod pa gor ma chags/ 6 khyed kyi byed stangs de dag la gzhigs nas rgan lags mang pos khyed slob grwa nas phud rgyu'i bsam 'char btang yod mod kyang / rgan bsod rgyal gyis khyed la bsgyur bcos kyi go skabs thengs gcig sprad rgyu'i re ba bton pas nga tshos 'dzin grwa'i kru'u ren gyi bsam 'char la brtsi 'jog byed rtsis yod kyang /’ des na g.yu mtsho'i yid kyi me long gi ngos su rgan bsod rgyal dang khong gis rang nyid la gnang ba'i zol med kyi byams skyong byed tshul rnams glog brnyan gyi ri mo ltar khra lham mer song ba dang / slar yang kha sngon rang nyid kyis bzhag pa'i 'jigs snang skul ba'i yi ge de yid la 'khor dus mo'i sna khung skyur mo chags nas mig chu'i phreng ba mu tig gi do zhal skud pa chad pa lta ra gyur/66ma ngu/ ngu rgyu phyi drags pa ma red dam/ khyed rang la rgyab rtsa chen po ༵ byidra

yod dus khyed slob grwar nyar phod ma song / ma gzhi ngu rgyu phyi yod kyi ma red/khyed da dung lo chung chung red/ g.yu mtshos zha'o krang gi skad cha'i don ma lus rtogs/ mu mthud nyan ma bzod par zha'o krang don gcod khang nas thon/sgo 'gram du slebs dus mchi ma phyis shing ngu mtshams bzhag ste khyim la log pa'i lam la /sna /rtse/ gas can gyi slob khrid thog khang 'di rtsa ba'i cha nas shel las grub pa'i nyi 'od nus pa'i khang chen zhig yin pas nub ri'i rtse nas phyi mig gzigs pa'i rta bdun dbang po'i zer gyis rab tu brgyan pas mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba'i 'od dang ldan/ sge'u khung nas lag tu dpe deb bzung ba'i shes brtson gzhon nu rnams kyi lus thon tsam thon tsam byed/ de nas g.yu mtsho slob grwa'i lus rtsal thang du slebs/ lo rim dang po'i bu mo tsho gcig dga' spro'i thag mchongs kyi rtsed mor rol/ bu mang po zhig rkang rtsed spo lo'i thang du dza drag gi 'gran bsdur byed bzhin mchis/ g.yu mtsho dang 'dzin grwa gcig pa'i bu mo kha shas shig lag tu dpe deb bzung nas 'gran bsdur la lta bzhin mchis/ slob grwa'i dpe mdzod khang nas deb khyer ba'i dge slob mang po yar 'dzul mar thon byed/ rgan bsod rgyal lags kyang dpe deb tsho gcig khyer nas thon byung bas g.yu mtsho myur du slob grwa'i rgyal sgo'i phyogs su song / slob grwa'i rgyal sgo'i 'gram du slebs dus mos phyi mig bltas/ mos lo lnga tsam 'tsho ba skyel ba'i slob grwa 'bring ba 'di dngos gnas slob grwa'i sgo 'gram du bris pa bzhin mthun sgril dang dza drag gzab nan/ 'khrug po bcas kyi rnam pas khengs/ slob grwa'i khor yug ni spyi tshogs thog dang bsdur na gtsang sbra legs shing khang pa'i chags stangs tshar du dngar/ dngos gnas rang nyid slob grwa 'di'i nang lo du ma bsdad rung 'di lta bu'i dge mtshan du mas phyug pa de ring gdi /4sa rtogs/ slob 'bring mjug ma 'gril gong slob grwa nas kha bral dgos
mi bzod pa'i mo'i tho rengs 5

brag steng gi rtswa/dkyil lung grong tshor 'o mtsho'i sgrung gtam sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur/ che skra dkar nas chung so dkar gyi bar du 'o mtsho'i gnas tshul thar thor shod rgyu med pa gcig kyang med/ ma gzhi los yin/ 'o mtsho ni 'tsho ba'i zhing sa nas ring du 'phags pa'i 'brug mo dang a stag klu mo lta bu'i lha sgrung gi mi sna zhig min zhing grong tsho 'di'i lhas dmar brag 'og gnas pa'i grags grub tshang gi bu mo chung ba de red/ lhas dmar brag ni che rgyu med la chung rgyu'ang med/ mtho rgyu med la dma' rgyu'ang med pa'i brag ri dmar po zhig red/ de'i thog brag rtsi dmar po zhig gis gang sar g.yog pas brag dmar de'i mgo nag mis brtsi mi thub pa'i lo grangs dang dpag par dka' ba'i god po'i myong ba mtshon/ sim sim char pa'i khrod du rtswa chung khab rtse tsam 'ga' brag srubs nas dpa' ngar chen pos mgo bo bton pas de nas skye stobs dang gzi dpal zhig mngon/gcigagrags grub bza' tsho gnyis la phru gu lnga byung ba las gsum ni bu mo yin zhing de dag gi ming la 'o 'dzoms dang 'o skyid 'o mtsho bcas zer/ de ni gra/sdu /ba bza' tsho gnyis pos tshe sngon tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu 'dra

bas bu mo gsum po dud tshang gzhan gyi bu mo las skyes gzugs mtshar ba dang phyi nang bya ba kun la mkhas pas bu mo'i skor gleng skabs rgad po grags grub dga' thag chod kyi yod/ kho'i bu mo gsum po mna' mar len 'dod mkhan ni dri zhim me tog la 'khor ba'i bung ba'i tshogs ltar mchis/ bu mo che ba 'o 'dzoms shang krang tshang la mna' mar byin pa dang bu mo 'bring ba 'o skyid tshong dpon dgra 'dul la mna' mar byin/ bu mo chung ba 'o mtsho dud tshang phyug po zhig la mna' mar gtong rgyu'i gra sgrig yod/ rgad po grags grub kyis nye lam mgo bo gnam la btegs nas yun ring lta ba ni 'o mtsho'i skor la bsam blo gtong gi yod/ gal srid mgyogs tsam ma byas na deng skabs 'o mtsho dang 'brogarnam gyi bu rab brtan gnyis 'brel ba che bas gnas tshul mi lhag pa'i nges pa med/ bu mos rab brtan zhes pa'i sprang gog dang mnyam du phyin pa yin na de ni rgad po'i ngo tsha red snyam/de yang sa gzhi mun nag gi gos bklubs pa'i dus shig rab brtan gyis rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis shar rer 'o mtsho'i nyal 'gram du yong ste brel ba chen pos gos lham phud de 'o mtsho'i rum du 'dzul/ 6 khyod kyi phas khyod nga'i mna' mar mi gtong thag gcod red/’ ces rab brtan gyis dbugs ring 'byin gyin brjod pas 'o mchos blo khog chen pos 66'u thug na bros rgyu red/’ ces brjod/ skabs der lung pa'i khyi thams cad kyang gnyid dkrog pa ltar 'jam thing thing du gnas pa'i rtswa thang gi ri grong de khyi sgras khengs par byas/gnyis/shang gi rta rgyug dang dngos zog brje res skabs rgad po grags grub la 'o mtsho ster sa a ho tshang zhes pa'i dud tshang yag po zhig 'phrad pas thos sna'i

thog gi gnyer ma'ang nyung du song ba ltar du gyur cing sna tha sen mo gang po de'ang dus gcig la 'then/ zla ba mjug ma'i tshes bdun la bag skar bzang bas 'o mtsho dngos su bsu rgyu byas/ a ho tshang zhes pa'i dud tshang de'i cha rkyen dngos gnas rgad po'i blo la bab/ dud tshang de ni khong tsho'i shang 'og gi phyugs zog mang shos kyi dud tshang zhig red la de sngon rdzong thog tu phyug 'gyur gyi tshogs 'du la'ang 'gro myong / bod zla'i tshes bdun la sngo zhing dwangs ba'i nam mkha'i dbyings su bal las 'jam la gangs las dkar ba'i sprin dkar phung po 'ga' mchis pa rnams bag skar bzang po'i rten 'brel kha btags kyi tshul du byon/ 'on te bkra shes kyi nyin mo der a ho pha bu gnyis kyis rgad po gragasagrub rgyu mtshan tsam yang shod khom med par sde dang thag ring ba'i brag khug cig tu khrid/ a ho tshang gi bu ngag bzang gis grags grub shugs kyis rta thog nas 'then/ gri gri shubs nas bton/ rgad po grags grub kyi rtswa ngan zing 'dra'i og tshom yang grang rlung gis gtses pa'i rtswa chung bzhin 'dar sig sigakhyed/ 6 pha ro za rgyu/ mi ngag bzang gis grags grub kyi mgo la gri tshad tsam tshad tsam byas/ skabs der thag ring nas 'brog glu zhig lhang lhang du grags byung / ngag bzang gis grags grub la khu tshur 'ga' gzhus te rtar byizhonabacug rjes shang las byed la gang byung bshad na ltad mo yod ces dzig ga skusadri/ na can ngas ci'ang mi shod/ zhes grags grub kyis a ho pha bu gnyis la phyag kyang 'tshal/de nas shang thog tu 'byor rjes thog mar a hos shang krang la grags grub dang khong gnyis gros bsdur byas te 'o mtsho kho tshang la mna' mar sprad rgyu byas lugs dang / khong tshos rgyu nor mang dag 'gro song btang nas gnyen ston gyi gra /18 byas stangs/ de ring mgron po'ang bos tshar dus 'o mcho gar song med

lugs sogs zhib tu bshad pa dang / grags grub kyis khong tshor mthong chung 'di ltar byas te rgyu nor gyi gyong phog pa ma zad brgya sde'i 'phya smod bya yul du 'gyur song bas rgyu nor gyi gyong gun gsab pa'i ma tshad ngo tsha'i sems gso ma sprad na mi 'grig ces ngag bzang rab tu khros nas gdong yang dmar por gyur zhing sa la pur mdzog yang yang zhus/grags grub kyis 6 bden pa red/ 'on kyang rab brtan gyis 'o mtsho mgo bskor btang nas khrid 'dug pas nga la thabs ci yod ces smras pas ngag bzang mig zung rab tu bgrad de grags grub la sdang mig bltas pas grags grub kyis skad cha shod mtshams bzhag ste lag gnyis brang khar sbyar nas 6 rim pa gong ma'i bka' bzhin zhu rgyu yin zhes bshad de lce snar/gnad don de de nyin thag ma chod pas/ a ho pha bu gnyis dang grags grub shang thog la dgong sdod byas/ dgong mo phyi po chags rjes grags grub kyis thengs 'di'i gnas tshul brtag zhib byed po shang krang gzhon pa g.yang skyabs kyi mdun la mar ril zhig bzhag ste byis pa zhig dang 'dra bar mchi ma lhung lhung gis ngus/6 ci byas song /’ g.yang skyabs kyis dngangs skrag chen pos dris/de ring a ho pha bu gnyis pos mi med brag khug tu kho gsod rtsis byed skabs thag ring nas glu sgra zhig gis rgad po nga thar tsam byung zhes brjod kyin mchi ma 'phyin tsam byas/ g.yang skyabs kyis gnas tshul bskyar zhib byed rgyu khasablangs pas grags grub kyi kha zur nas de tsam mngon rgyu med pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig phyung /nyin gnyis par shang gis grags grub la sgor brgya tham pa'i dngul chad bcad pa dang gnyen sgrig rang mos kyi srid jus lag bstar byed rgyu las pha mas btsan shed byed mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pas grags grub kyis thamastu chod
