la lags so dang lags so zhes zhus/ shang 'go khrid kyis grags grub kyi rnam 'gyur la rab tu mgu zhing a ho pha bu gnyis la kho las mang ba'i dngul chad bcad/grags grub grong tshor log rjes bu gnyis khrid de rab brtan gyi pha 'brog rnam gyi sar dngul chad len du phyin/ bu chung ba skya rdo de tsam 'gro 'dod med pas grags grub kyis 6 sde'i nang gi bu tshang ma nang la dar 'dra ba dang phyi la gri 'dra ba yod/ khyod la ci byas pa red dam/ : zer nas btsan gyis khrid/'brog rnam ni shes bya yon tan med khar thos rgya mthong rgya chung ba/ dpa' stobs ci'ang med pa'i mi gnyon chung nus med cig yin stabs kha sang 'o mtsho dang rab brtan gnyis mnyam du bros pa shes dus shin tu skrag cing de ring yang gragasagrub pha bu gsum po 'di ltar ngar nas rang nyid kyi 'khris la yong ba mthong dus de bas bla 'dar/ 'brog rnam gyis gdan brdabs brdabs byas te rgad mo ja blug tu bcug grags grub kyis og tshom la byil byil dang sen mo'i thog sna tha gang blugs rjes lha ma gzhi ngas khyod la sdug po ster 'dod med/'on kyang rab brtan gyis nga'i bu mo mgo skor btang nas khrid pa de sde pa'i mi tshang mas kha gcig grags red/ des na nga la rgyu dang snyan grags kyi gyong ga 'dra byung yod med khyed kyis shes dgos kyi yod/ dngos gnas byas na gyong de dag khyod kyis 'khur dgos pa smos med red/ de ring nga la rgyu mtshan de'i rkyen pas shang nas sgor brgya tham pa'i chad pa bcad byung bas de khyod kyis tshab sprod dgos kyi red/ me de los yin/ drin can/ 'on te nga la ja nyo byed kyi dngul yang da/ 6 zog sprad na 'grig 15rdo lug sha bzan zhig e 'grig

6 rtse gra zhig dgos/ 'brog rnam gyis lug sprod rgyu khas blangs shing byams skyong chen po'i drin can zhig phebs pa ltar grags grub pha bu la ja yang yang bkyag skabs der god po grags grub mi chen zhig dang 'dra bar sgam brling ngang bsdad de spobs pa chen pos 'brog rnam tshang gi sne len dang du blangs/gsum/lo gnyis kyi rjes su 'o mtsho gcig pu rang yul du log mos de sngon cha che ba'i hor chas bskyur te deng skabs gsar dar gyi phyu pa phu med cig gyon/mo'i lus po sngar bas phra zhing ldem pa dang 'bur gzugs dod po zhig tu mngon/mo'i ras gos 'og gi nu 'bur zung ri bo chung chung gnyis dang 'dra zhing lus kyi g.yo 'gul dang bstun nas gar la rol/ mos da dung ca lag khra chil dgu chil 'ga' khyer 'dug 'brog rnam gyis mo slebs pa shes ma thag dngangs 'tshab chen pos grags grub tshang la yong nas rab brtan gar yod dris/6 tshong brgyab nas bsdad gda'/ 'o mtsho'i skad cha brtse dung dang la rgya'i g.ya' phran bu'ang med/6 'o na khyod gnyis/’ 6 nged gnyis 'brel ba ci yod/’ 'o mtsho'i gdong nas cung khros pa'i bzo bstan/more 'brog rnam gyis mu mthud skad cha 'dri mi bde bas/ ca rab brtan bde rin dazlo bye/ da skyid byed pa'i sgang red/’ 'brog rnam ha las nas 'o mtshor lta tsam lta tsam byas te log 1sprasas

der grags grub kyis 6 ltas ngan de zhum mdog kha po/ de nyin lug gcig blangs pa yin zhes 'jon mdog gis de sngon 'brog rnam gyi lag nas lug blangs pa'i gnas tshul bshad/ 'on kyang 'o mtsho dga' rgyu phar bzhag mo khros nas ngo dmar nag tu gyur zhing lus po'ang dkrug dkrug byas/ 6 nga rang mos yin/ khos mgo skor ga la gtong thub/ kho la 'gan med/’ rjes su 'o mtshos 'brog rnam la lug rin slog 'on kyang mos rab brtan gyi gnas tshul tshig gcig kyang ma bshad/ skog tu gyur pa'i gnas tshul de mi rnams kyis tshod dpag bya rgyu las thabs med par gyur/so de nas lo phyed phyin dus 'o mtsho sngar bzhin 'ur rdo khyer nas lug 'tsho ru nga / de nyin shar chung nang du phyugs 'tsho mkhan 'o mtsho las med/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la ngag bzang dang kho'i gcung po a 'bar gnyis mo'i 'khris su slebs byung /8 khyod gnyis ga par 'gro gi yin/ 'o mtshos kha brda byas/ngag bzang gis sdang mig cig bltas pa las ci'ang ma bshad/ a 'bar kha bde la lce myur bas 6 ga 'gro khyod la jus gtogs med/ ske rags khrol de nas nga tsho dgra med grogs med byed/’ tsa kha sang dngul chad red/ de ring btson khang nang 'gro rgyu red ’ ces brjod pas 'o mtsho'i 'dren byed zung nas zhum med kyi snying stobs shig mngon/de nas ngag bzang mchongs thengs gcig gis 'o mtsho sa la sgyel/'o mtshos ngag bzang gi lag par so brgyab nas khrag dmar chil ler thon/ 'on te mos 'gog rgol ji ltar byas kyang ma thub par 'dod chags dang nga rgyal gyis myos pa'i pho gzhon gnyis pos 'o mtsho'i phyi'i ske rags bkrol/nadi (2 smad gos phud de mo'i lus yongs dmar rjen du bton/ 'o mtsho ni pho

gzhon gnyis kyi dkyil du 'gul tsam yang byed mi thub par gyur/ngag bzang spun gnyis 'dod chags kyis tshim pas ha ha ho ho zhes bgad mo dgod bzhin dal bu'i ngang log song / de'i dgong mo grags grub tshang gi lug la lta mkhan med pas lug gnyis spyang gis bzas zin/ rgad po nismyo ba ltar yar rgyug mar rgyug byed/ 6 'dre mo des nga la gnod 'di 'dra skyel dgos don gang yin nam/ ’sna de 'dres khrid song ba 'dra/ de nas shang thog nas yong mkhan zhig gis 'o mtsho'i gnas tshul tshang ma bshad/ des na 'o mtsho'i ma gos mo slar yang sems khral gyi rgya mtshor lhung /6 da ci drag gyong ni lug red ces pa las grags grub la gzhan gyi snang ba spu tsam med/6 mgyogs se dud tshang zhig la mna' mar ma sprad na da dung rnyog gra chen po bzo gi red ces 'o mtsho'i a mas mgo bo g.yug g.yug gis bshad/6 de red/ ten/’ grags grub kyis dbugs ring zhig btang / 'o mtsho ni bu mo gzhan gnyis kyi yon tan ldan khar ya med dang blo khog che bas pha ma'i 'dod blo dang bstun min ni mi shes/ ngag bzang spun gnyis rdzong gi btson khang nang bcug shang hril por de'i skor gyi gtam gshog sgro skyes pa ltar gang sar khyab/ kha cig gis 'o mtsho ni 'dre mo 'khrul med red zer/mdor na 'o mtsho ni tshang ma'i zhed snang byed sar 'gyur/ de sngon mun rub nas mo'i nyal sa srung nas kha mkhas tshig snyan dang re ba byed mkhan gyi pho gzhon de tsho gar song cha med du gyur/ lo na chung ba'i bud med mang pos 'o mtsho'i byed stangs la 'phya smod byed/153

bzhi/mchog sprul rin po che yis spyan zim zim gyis phreng ba phyag tu 'chang /dbu g.yug g.yug gis 6 tshang ma yag rgyu mi 'dug ces bla ma thugs skyo ba'i tshul bstan/ 8 yang na don yod tshang gi bu tshe don gyi mna' mar sprad na sdug po yong gi ma red/ don yod ni mchog sprul rin po che'i zhang po red/6 de god po la 'dri dgos/’ 6 red/ khyed gnyis gros gyis/ tshe don mi rtse gra zhig yod/ 'o mtsho'i mig gnyis chen por gdangs te mun nag gi 'jig rten la lta dus sems la rang dbang med par skyi g.ya' ba dang khor rkyang gi sdug bsngal zhig skyes/ 'gre ldog mang po brgyab kyang mi dran dgu dran las gnyid kyi g.ya' tsam med par rig pa dwangs gsal du phyin/ ngo ma a ma ngu ba de ring las mthong ma myong / ma'i ngu skad kyi mdun du mos don yod tshang la mna' mar 'gro rgyu khas len byas/ 'on kyang don yod tshang gi bu'i ming tsam yang mi shes/a mas gang bzang bzang bshad/ 'o mtsho mi bsam dgu bsam gyi khrod du rim bzhin gnyid du yur nas rmi lam 'di 'dra zhig btang ba ste/ tshe don ni a ra dkar po sa la drud cing / lag tu 'khar rgyug cig kyang 'dzin nas ha ha ha zhes dgod/ de ni mi sems dkrug pa'i dgod sgra dang gdon 'dre'i ngu skad dang mtshungs/ 'o mtsho'i lus hril po rngul chus brlan/ lag pa khu tshur dam du bsgong / a ma ma/ zhes mo ni hob ste gnyid las 'drogs/15rdo don ni pho lo sum cu yol dus gzhi nas mna' ma blangs kyang kho'i blo

yid rbad de tshim/ sngon gyi las 'phros mdzes ma des kho sgug pa red snyam/ tshe don gyi kha nas rgyun chad med par glu chung len/ 'o mtsho'i 'dren byed gyi lam du shar ba'i tshe don ni gzugs bcu bzhi'i byis pa tsam las med kyang mgo su las kyang che/ lus hril po gzab mchor gyis brgyan yang 'dra ma chags pa'i bzo zhig las mdzes nyams spu tsam med/ sgos su glo ru btags pa'i dngul gri ring po de kho'i lus po'i ring tshad las ring du 'gal bas byis pas mi chen gyi spyod chas 'dzin pa ltar ya ma zung du mngon/ 'o mtsho ni rang dbang med par dbugs ring zhig shor/gnyen ston gyi go rim 'char 'god bzhin legs par grub cing mun pa'i gos kyis sa gzhi chen po lhug por bklubs/ ra ris dri ma dang bral ba'i zla ba gzhon nu zhig grangs las 'das pa'i skar tshogs kyi khrod nas mdzes dpal ngoms/ de ni tshe don gyis yun ring sgug pa'i dus tshod de red/ lung khug gi 'brog pa'i dud tshang der khang pa chen po zhig yod mod kyang nyal khri med/ des na khong gnyis khang pa'i sbug tu nyal sa bzos/ pha ma dang sring mo'ang khang pa'i zur zhig tu nyal/ tshe don nyal ma thag nas lus hril po 'dod chags kyi me lce 'bar yang pha ma gnyis dang sring mo gnyid ma khug pas yun ring bzod sgom byas/ tshe don gyis ga ler 'o mtsho'i rum du lag pa bskyangs/ mo'i lus drod kyis kho myos pa ltar gyur/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la 'o mtshos kho'i lag par 'bud rgyag btang ste phyu pas lus dam du dkris nas mgo bo btums/ tshe don gyis ga ler dgye dgye byas/ ji ltar byas kyang thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ tshe don ni rab tu khros te gnyid du yur/ de ltar dgong mo gnyis/ dgong mo gsum/ tshe don dang 'o mtsho gnyis ni phyi tshul gyi bza' tshang tsam las don gyi snying pos dben/ dus kyi 'khor lo bgrang bya phyed tsam 'das kyang tshe don gyis don 'di su la'ang shod ma myong / kho ༵ sbyang

grags la dga' ba'i mi ngo sha srab po zhig red/ khos 'jig rten 'dir 'gyur rgyu med pa'i sems dang bkug rgyu med pa'i g.yag rwa med snyam nas ngang rgyud ring pos 'o mtsho'i sems bkug thabs kho na byed kyi yod/lnga/nyin zhig lung khug gi ri grong der khur po khur ba'i thag ring gi tshong pa zhig slebs/ kho la ca lag tsag tsig 'ga' btsong rgyu 'dug pas khos lam zur du tshong zog rnams bkrams/ skyes pa dang bud med/ byis pa rnams kyang de ru 'tshang kha brgyab la/ 'o mtsho'ang de ru song / mgo la skra gzhug chen po btags pa'i pho gzhon der su las kyang stobs che ba'i gzugs stobs ldan/kho'i nag snum gyi rdzi ma mthug po dang gzengs mtho ba'i sna/ grung sha dod pa'i 'dren byed bcas mthong dus 'o mtsho'i lus la glog 'khyud pa ltar rang dbang med par pho gzhon de'i phyogs su kho na blta bar shor/ mos bltas pa tsam gyis pho gsar de ni lha sa nas yong ba yin pa rtogs/ khos mi rnams la dngos zog ngo sprod byed cing dngul rtsis brgyab/ skabs der lus po'i 'gul phyogs shig gis kho'i 'dren byed kyi lam du 'o mtsho'i 'od kyis gang ba'i mig gnyis po de mngon/ des kho'i snying du 'jags pa'i yid kyi me long gi chu'i nang du rdo 'phangs pa ltar blo lhod du gnas mi thub par gyur/ 'o mtsho ni ca lag nyo dgos med la gzhan gyi don ci'ang med kyang der yun ring bsdad/ der sdod rogs su byis pa kha shas las lhag med/ tshong pa de ni ha cang kha gsangs po yod pas/ khos byis pa re re bzhin ming dris te bye ril re ster/ de rjes 'o mtsho la bye ril sbar mo gang sprad/ skabs der 64'o mtsho zhes don yod kyis bodi sbyozlo / 'o mtshos tshong pa der ngo tsha smin mdog gis dgod tsam byas te

phyir log skabs der don yod kyis 6 de'i a gsar tsha ba la yang / da lta tshe don bsdad med/ sdes 'phya yong / zhes 'o mtsho la skyon brjod byas/ 'o mtshos ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig las lan ci'ang ma sloganyin gnyis par tshong pa de don yod tshang du yong / 'o mtshos spro sems chen pos sne len byas/ de nas rgyun du 'ong / de rjes 'o mtsho dang tshong pa de'i bar tshul min gyi 'brel ba 'dug zere ba dang / byis pa kha shas kyis tshong pa des 'o mtsho'i lag par lag gdub bskon rogs byas pa mthong zer ba sogs grong tsho'i nang gleng bya gtso bor 'gyur/nyin der tshe don log slebs/ 'on te khong tshang gi mna' ma 'o mtsho gnam la 'phur ba'am sa la 'dzul ba mi shes par gang ltar gar song cha med du song / tshe don gyis rta la sga brgyab cing sked par gri gzer nas ki sgra dang bcas ngar ngar dzig dzig gis phyin/de'i dgong mo tshe don khrag ral 'dzar 'dzar ngang log bud med de'i sems la 'dre zhugs 'dug pas tshur khrid med/ ces gang sar bshad/de nas lo mang po song / 'on te mo'i gnas tshul rgyun du khyab yong ba ste/kha shas kyis ru nag mo de/ a tsi tsi/ mo lha sar slebs rjes thog mar tshong pa de dang mnyam du bsdad kyang rjes su rgya kha che'i tshong pa zhig dang mnyam du bros pa red zer/ deng skabs rgya yul du khyi dang phag pa bzhos nas bsdad yod skad/ snying rje/ skad cha 'di gzhan la shod mi nyan/’ zer/don yod rgad pos phangs snang chen pos 6 nag mo des skyid po shes le ma red/ ma gzhi sngon gyi las red/ mo lha sar slebs rjes de sngon tshong pa des g.yug rjes gzhang btsodzi nas 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod skad/ 'o mtsho'i gzhang khang zhes lha sar jo bo mjal du 'gro myong mkhan tshos mthong myong 'dug deng skabs na tsha phog nas lus 'dug zer/ 157

bsam yul las 'das par na ning yig zam las khungs brgyud 'o mtshos grags grub tshang la sgor mo nyis stong bskur yod pa dang da lo pha yul du gzhis bskor du yong gi yin zhes pa'i yi ge zhig 'byor bas kha cig gis 'o mtsho deng skabs tshong pa chen po byas nas bsdad yod zer/ yang 'ga' res tshong pa zer yang don du gzhang btsong nas byung ba'i dngul red zer/158

gtsong rong gi slu 'brid/gciganye lam lo shas nang dpal 'byor 'khrug tu song bas bgrang bya sum cu'i sngon du sbra gur las med pa'i rtswa thang thog gi grong rdal chung chung der ngo ma gnam sa brjes pa'i 'pho 'gyur dang 'phel rgyas byung / tshong khang sang sar khyab pa dang za khang yang gang sar khyab/ dngos gnas/ nam mkha'i skar tshogs glo bur du sa la bab pa dang mtshungs/ za khang de dag gi khrod du bod rigs kyi za khang zhes sgo shing gi thog tu kha btags g.yogs pa mang dag cig phud/ dar cha sngon po bkal ba'i kha che'am rgya hud hud kyi za khang ni 'khrug cha dod shos red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni za khang de dag gis bod rigs kyi kha gshis dang mthun pa'i thug pa sna tshogs mkho 'don byed pa dang 'brel ba yod/ kha che'i za khang mang shos kyis chang dag gi nyo tshong mi byed kyang grong rdal de'i bzhi mdo khar gnas pa'i mā kun hran gyi za khang ni gzhan dang mi 'dra bar chang rag sna tshogs btsong / des na 'di ru thug pa btung mkhan yod pa ma zad/sbi rag btung mkhan de bas mang /dbang 'byor ni za khang 'di'i nang rtag par sbi rag btung du yong /khong ni las 'khyur ngal gso byas pa'i bzo pa rgan gras shig red/ khostu spyan

du a rag btung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni lo drug gi sngon du bza' zla dang kha gyes pas red/ ming sring gnyis yod pa las bu mo pad+ma nor sgron dbang 'byor la thob pa red/ khos nyin rtag par mā kun hran gyi za khang du sbi rag btung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni mā kun hran kho'i grogs po yin pas nyin rtag par sbi rag gong tshad chung chung byas te btsong gi 'dug ces mi gzhan par shod/de dus sa gzhi thams cad nag por gyur ba ma zad lo na chung ba'i bza' tsho dag snga sa nas nyal tshar/ mā kun hran gyi za khang nang sbi rag btung mkhan dbang 'byor las med/ dbang 'byor gyi gdong par sol ba bskus pa ltar nag rkyang yin zhing chang gis myos pa'i 'dren byed kyang gdang mi thub par zim zim du gyur/ kha nas kyang kha chu nar nar 'dzar/ mā kun hran gyis kho la tha mag rkang gcig sprad de me'ang spar rogs byas/ dbang 'byor gyis slar yang thengs mang bshad zin pa'i skad cha rnying pa dag shod skyor byas/ 6 khyed ni nga'i grogs po yag shos red/ ’ mā kun hran gyis sang nyin gyi tshong la bltas pa ma gtogs kho'i skad cha nyan ga la srid/ dbang 'byor gyis gla phogs kyi brgya cha lnga bcu yan 'dir skyel gyi yod/mā kun hran ni pho gzhon dzig po zhig red/ khos nam yang rang nyid kyi lus gzugs dang shin tu 'phrod pa'i dug log re gyon gyi yod/ khos da dung nye bar mkho ba'i bod skad thar thor 'ga' shes kyi yod/ za khang gi 'gan 'khur kho rang gis byas shing las ka byed mkhan bod rigs bu mo zhig glas yod/de ring phyi po yin pas bu mo de snga sa nas khyim du log zin/ ma gzhi mi rnams kyi shod srol ltar na bu mo de mā kun hran gyis dgong mo mang po zhig nyar tshar ba red zer/ ma zad grong rdal phyogs kun la nyul ba'i bud med mang dag cig khodang shod mi shes pa'i 'brel ba yod zer/ 'on te de dag ni khungs lung can nā gtam min zhing rdzun gyi gshog pa skyes pa'i gtam 'char dang yang na ngo

ma yang yin srid/6 a pha/ a pha/’ bu mo zhig rlung 'tshub 'tshub kyis 'dzul byung /dbang 'byor ni ci tshor med par da dung rang nyid kyis nam yang shod mi tshar ba'i skad cha dag shod skyor byed/ mā kran hran mgo bo btegs nas lta dus de ni dbang 'byor gyi bu mo pad+ma nor sgron red/ mā kun hran gyis zhib lta byed dus mo ni dngos gnas mdzes ma zhig red snyam/ phra zhing ldem pa'i sked skabs dang yongs su rgyas pa'i myos bum/ da dung smra shes la don go ba'i mig gnyis dang de'i thog tu ched du bris pa lta bu'i rdzi ma/ dkar zhing 'jam pa'i bzhin ras dang dmar zhing srab pa'i mchu sgros bcas kyis mā kun hran ha las pa dang dus mtshungs mo'i lang tsho bdag gir 'dzin rgyu'i 'dun pa drag po skyes kyang 'tshab 'tshub kyis don mi 'grub pas mā kun hran gyis ci'ang ma smras par bsdad/6 a pha/ 'gro/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis pa'i lag pa nas 'then/66red/ red/ dbang 'byor kha chu 'dzar 'dzar ngang langs te stod gos khug ma'i nang lag pa brgyab nas dngul lor 'ga' zang zing gis sgrog tse'i thog tu 'phangs/snye ngas rtsis rgyag dgos/ mā kun hran gyis dngul lor kha shas shig pad+ma nor sgron la bslogs te 'dra chags pos 'dzum tsam byas pa dang sgo 'gram bar skyel nas ga ler phebs dgos pa'i kha brda'ang byas/mun nag gi mtshan mo der pad+ma nor sgron gyis gom pa'ang brtan po spo mi thub pa'i pha gon bskyor nas rang khyim du log pha yi dug log phud rogs byas te nyal khri'i thog bsnyal rjes pha rgan mgyogs po sna las gnam sa gas pa lta bu'i rngur sgra sgrog bzhin rmi lam gyi zhing khams su song / pad+ma nor sgron gyis ci'ang mi mthong ba'i mun nag gi 'jig rten la lta bzhin 'brug gragadi 61 lta

bu'i rngur sgra'i khrod du gnyid kyi g.ya' tsam yang med/ ji ltar btsan gyis mig btsum nas gnyid khug thabs byas kyang rig pa je gsal nas je gsal du 'gro/sngon ma ang ki brtsis nas gnyid khug thabs byas na ang ki lnga brgya drug brgya tsam brtsis tshar dus gnyid du yur gyi yod kyang de ring des kyang phan nus ma thon/ mos rang nyid deng gi gnas babs bsam blo 'khor dus yid blong blong du gyur/ na ning zla ba dgu pa'i nang mo'i slob grogs mang che ba 'bring rim ched las slob 'bring ngam mtho rim slob 'bring la song / mo dang slob grogs lnga gang du ma tshud pas khyim du log nas pha mar skyabs bcol rgyu las gzhan gyi 'tsho lam ma rnyed/ da bar slob grogs gzhan rnams so so'i thabs shes dang 'gro lam brgyud nas 'dra min gyi las ka thob/ mo gcig pu ming don mtshungs pa'i las sgug gzhon nu red/ mo la nyin rtag par chang rag dang kha bral mi thub pa'i pha gos shig yod mod kyang khong la bu mor las ka thob pa'i thabs dang nus pa ci'ang med/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis rang nyid kyi mdun lam ni do dgong gi smag mun las kyang re ba bral ba'i nag thom me ba zhig red bsams nas brjod mi shes pa'i skrag snang zhig gis lus hril por khyab nas ba spu ma lus zing nger langs/gnyis/pad+ma nor sgron glu chung len zhing gad phyis byed/ pha rgad po 'brog glu 'ga' ldab ldib kyis len bzhin khyar khyor ngang nang du 'dzul/ kha'ang btsum mi thub pas dga' bar 'os pa'i bya ba zhig 'phrad yod pa gdon mi za/ pha rgad po shar rer song ste kho rang rgyun du sdod pa'i hra pha rnying pa de'i thog bsdad de sdo /thud glu len/ de nas cung tsam phyin rjes khos 'dzum dmul dmul gyis

8 bu mo/ de ring ngas gtam bzang zhig shod rgyu yod/ ces bshad/smyo ci red/’ pad+ma nor sgron gyis phyags ma sa la bzhag ste brel ba chen pos gtam bzang shod rgyu sgug8 dus rgyun nga 'gro sa'i mā kun hran gyis las ka byed mkhan bu mo zhig 'tshol dgos zer/ gal srid khyod song na zla ba rer sgor nyis rgya sprod sa red/spyir btang sgor rgya lhag las sprod kyi med/ de nga'i ngo la bltas pa red/ khyod sang nyin las mar 'gro rtsis gyis/ 64de/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis myur du lan rgyag ma shes/ ngo ma de ni dga' skyo zung gi bya ba zhig red/ dga' dgos rkyen pha dang gcig pa red/skyo dgos pa ni mos de sngon nas mā kun hran gyi skor skad cha mang po go myong bas byas pa red/ gal srid kho'i za khang nang las ka byed mkhan bu mo zhig gis kho dang mnyam du ma nyal na myur du las ka nas phud kyi red zer/ kha sngon zla mtsho mā kun hran gyi za khang nang las ka btsal du song dus las ku'i skor gros ma byas gong khos zla mtsho'i sked par 'thams nas 'o skyel rtsis byed kyi 'dug ces mo la shod myong / de ltar na rang nyid kyis kho'i 'dod pa dang ma bstun na sgor mo nyis rgya/ gla phogs ga la thob/ pha yi de ring gi dga' ba de stong dga' la 'gyur / ba/ 'a/ byor gyis thog mar bu mos rang nyid kyi skad cha go rjes gnam mchongs sa mchongs kyis rang nyid kyi mgrin pa nas 'chang rgyu red snyam yang de ring gdong pa nag rog ger bsam blo gtong bzhin gnas pa'i bu mos gang dran min mgo ma 'tshos/ 6 ci byas song / 66mi de yag po e yod/ 6 mi sdug po yin sa ma red/ ma gzhi de khyod dang 'brel ba ci yod/khyod la phogs sprod mkhan yod na 'grig gi red/’ 163

6 en/’ pad+ma nor sgron gyis mā kun hran gyi za khang nang las ka byed du 'gro rgyu'i khas len byas/ 'on te sems gting nas gnas tshul gang zhig 'phrad kyang rang nyid kyi lang tsho srung skyob byed rgyu'i chod sems bzhag de dus mos pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi dri ma mi 'gos pa'i spyod tshul yid la 'khor/ mo yang de lta bu'i pad+ma zhig byed 'dod/ des na pad+ma nor sgron gyis pha la rjes su mā kun hran gyi za khang nang mi yong rgyu'i re ba byas/ dbang 'byor gyis rang nyid kyi bu mor lta bzhin khas len byas/ pad+ma nor sgron snga po nas za khang nang slebs/ mā kun hran gyis dga' spro chen pos mo nang du bsus/ za khang gi nang du sgrog tse chen po lnga bsgrigs shing gyang ngos thams cad thog tu bkra shis smon tshig bris pa'i shel sgo red/ pad+ma nor sgron gyi las ka ni gad phyis byed rgyu dang za ma rnams mgron po'i mdun du skyel rgyu de red/ pad+ma nor sbyin snro ngospra nas de dag byed mi thub pa ci'ang mi 'dug za ma ni thug pa 'dra na sne/ nyi/ gyi/ mgron po dang po de slebs/ de ni lo na bzhi bcu yol tsam gyi skyes pa zhig red/ kho gdong mdog sngo nag yin zhing kha nas chang dri 'thul/kho yar 'dzul ma thag pad+ma nor sgron mthong bas mig gnyis de mur khab rjes ltar zim nas nga'i snying sdug zer nas pad+ma nor sgron gyi thog la mchongs pad+ma nor sgron gyis phu smyon pa ’ zhes tsir sgra sgrog bzhin za ma bzo sa'i khang sbug tu bros/ 6 ga re byas song /’ mā kun hran thon byung / kho myur du brgyugs nas ru bzhugs dang bzhugs ’ zer nas mi de sgrog tse'i 'gram du sdod bcugades na mi des ngag ldab ldeb kyis 6 sbi rag shel dam do khyer shog 7ces bshad/sbi rag shel dam gnyis mdun du bzhag rjes shel dam gcig kha phye rogs byas/mā kun hran khang pa'i sbug tu yong nas gzab nan gyis pad+ma nor sgron la lta tsa/ hā/ te ru za khang nang sne len byed dus mgron po 'dra min yod srid kyang

tshang mar 'dzum gyis bsu dgos pa las de ring nang bzhin byed mi rung / de ltar na ngas za khang 'dzugs thabs med/ ma gzhi khyed rgyus med pas de ring khag med/ ces bshad/ pad+ma nor sgron mgo bo gug nas bsdad/de nas skra gzhug nag po brgyab pa'i pho gzhon gnyis 'byor/ thug pa phor pa do dang mngar ja phor pa do khyer shog zer/ mā kun hran gyis thug pa bzos/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis mngar ja phor pa do po pho gzhon gnyis po'i mdun du bzhag de dus pho gzhon gnyis po des tshong rgyag rgyu'i skor gyi skad cha byed bzhin mchis pas mo la do snang ma byas/ pad+ma nor sgron khang sbug tu 'dzul nas mā kun hran gyi rogs pa byas/ cung ma 'gor bar dri zhim 'thul ba'i thug pa phor pa do khong gnyis kyi mdun la bzhag pho gzhon sna chen des mo la zhib tu lta bzhin mo kho'i zur du sdod zer/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis mgron po khong khro za rgyur skrag nas de ru bsdad/ pho gzhon des mo'i ras gos kyi 'og nas 'bur du thon pa'i nu 'bur zung la mig hrig hrig gis lag pa mo'i brang thog tu brkyangs yong / pad+ma nor sgron khros pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas myur du langs/ smyo ga re/ kha che ma gtogs gzhan gyis thug bcug gi med dam/ mos kha ya ma byas/ 8 kha che de'i bro ba bod rigs las che ba 'dug gam/’ 6 shog do dgong nged gnyis mnyam du 'gro/ kha che ma gtogs dngul med pa ma red/’ pho gzhon skam rid des am phrag nas sgor mo brgya lor chag pa zhigablangs nas sgrog tse'i thog tu brdab brdab byas/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis lta tsam byas te khang pa'i sbug tu 'dzul/ 6 wa ye/ dngul lon/ mā kun hran gyis pad+ma nor sgron la dngul lon shog zer/ pho gzhon sna chen des dngul tshur bsrings pas de len dus mo'i lag pa nas 'jus/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis shugs kyis bskor 'then zhig byas pas kho'i lag 'og nas thar/ skra gzhug nag po brgyab pa'i pho gzhon gnyis pos ha ha ho ho zer bzhin za khang nas thon1/65

ngo ma/ 'di ni 'grul pa mang ba'i za khang zhig red/ 'di ru yong mkhan gyi nang du spyi tshogs thog gi gzhon nu dang / lam bzhud kyi 'grul pa/tshong pa sogs mi 'dra min sna tshogs yod/ pad+ma nor sgron hur brtson chen pos las ka byas/ mā kun hran shin tu mgu nas mo'i dpung pa'i thog lag pas brdabs te yang yang bsngags brjod byas/ dgong mo phyi po chags dus pad+ma nor sgron nang du log mā kun hran gyis mar tsam skyel ba dang sgor mo bcu sprad/ las ka yag po 'dug ces slar yang bstod bsngags byas/ pad+ma nor sgron sgor mo bcu po lag tu bzung nas 'dur ma rgyug gis nang du 'gro/ ma gzhi sgor mo bcu ni rgyu nor chen po ci'ang min kyang de ni mor thob pa'i ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu yang dang po de yin pas sems la dga' ba rgyas te snying ldig ldig tu 'phagagasum/lcags rta'i tir sgra dang ha ha ho ho'i dgod sgra'i khrod du pho gzhon khyu gcig za khang nang 'dzul te/ za khang gi phyogs bzhir lta tsam lta tsam byas rjes sge'u khung gi 'gram du bsdad/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis zhib tu blta dus/ pho gzhon gzugs ring zhig dang pho gzhon mig chen zhig pho gzhon skam gyong zhig da dung pho gzhon 'dra chags po zhig bcas mchis/ pho gzhon mig chen des sgrog tse'i thog brdab brdab 'ga' byas te sbi rag sgam gang khyer shog zer/6 mgyogs po khyer yong / mā kun hran 'dzum dmul dmul gyis sbi rag skyel ba dang mi rer tha mag rkang re bsrings/ pho gzhon skam gyong des pad+ma nor sgron la sna gnyer zhig byas te mā kun hran la 6 bu mo ster so dod po nyar 'ardi/ bye ces bshad/ mā kun hran gyis der lan ci'ang ma byas/

cung tsam phyin rjeshā pho gzhon 'dra chags po de thab tshang nang 'dzul nas grang tshal 'ga' bzo dgos pa'i kha brda byas/ pho gzugs dod pa'i gdong pa/khra sgor sgor gyi mig gnyis/ gzengs mtho ba'i sna/ mthug tsam yin yang 'bur gzugs dod pa'i kha sha bcas nas bltas na kho ni na chung bu mos dga' po byed sa'i pho gzhon zhig red/ khos pad+ma nor sgron la 'dzum tsam byas/des pad+ma nor sgron gyi rna rtsa'ang dmar po bzos/ mo skyes pa zhig gi mdun du de ring lta bu ngo tsha sob sob yong ma myong / ma gzhi za khang nang las ka byas nas bzung mo nyin rtag par ma rabs kyi kha brda lag brda byed mkhan gyi skyes pa yod mod kyang mos de dag snga sa nas goms tshar/ ngo ma/ pad+ma nor sgron gyi sems gting nas mig mdun gyi pho gzhon 'dir dga' ba skyes pa red ces na don la gnas/ 'on te de ni 'bras bu med pa'i stong bsam red snyam dus mo'i sems las ku'i thog la rnal du phab/ rang dbang med par mgo bo gtegs nas da lta'i pho gzhon de gar yod lta dus kho pa'i sdod gnas su log zin/ mos ga ler phyi ru lta dus kho rang nyid kyi grogs po de dag mnyam du ha ha ho ho'i ngang bsdad 'dugachu tshod gnyis tsam song rjes pho gzhon de dag bzi 'dug pho gzhon skam gyong des pad+ma nor sgron gyi rkub la 'chang tsam 'ga' byas/ de nas khos za khang nang pad+ma nor sgron gyi rjes 'ded byas pas ra bzi ba'i lus po tshod 'dzin ma thub par sgrog tser rkang pa 'thog nas sa la 'gyel/ kho phar brten tshur brten byas nas yar langs byung / 6 a ma'i ro/ log 'gro/ ha las rgyu gang yod/’ des na kho'i grogs po gsum po'ang langs byung / thams cad khyar khyor ngang sgo nas thon rtsis byas/mā kun hran brel 'tshub chen pos 6 dngul rtsis rgyobs dang /’ 6 a/ pho gzhon gzugs ring des mā kun hran gyi brang nas bsdushā ste

dkrug dkrug 'ga' byas te 6 shi 'dod pa ma red dam/’ zhes sdigs sdigs byas/ dus rgyun kha lce bde ba'i mā kran hran glo bur du lkugs par gyur pa ltar ci'ang mi smra/ ngo mdog thal skyar 'gyur/ ngo ma khos spyi tshogs thog gi 'khyam po de tshor kha ya byed mi phod/ de tshos byed mi phod pa ci'ang med/ de tsho dgra ru 'gyur na kho tshong zog 'gro rgyug che ba'i bod kyi grong rdal 'dir mu mthun za khang gnyer nas sdod thabs bral/pho gzhon de dag gis rang nyid kyi dpa' blo khog la blo mos nas ha ha zhes pa'i hab dgod byas/ pad+ma nor sgron bzod sgom ma thub par mdun du rgyug nas 6 chang rin ma sprad na ga la 'grig pho gzhon tshang ma ha las nas mig chen po ldir/66gzhang tshong ma des gang zer/ ’so khyod rang kha che der de 'dra dga' na kha che'i lung par mna' mar nga / 64rtog gra ma shod/ mgyogs tsam rgya kha che'i nyal sa bzo ru song /’ pad+ma nor sgron rab tu khros nas kha sha'ang 'dar/ mos lan ci'ang kha nas ma thon/ mig nas mchi ma lhung lhung du bab/pho gzhon de dag gis pad+ma nor sgron la snying rje spu tsam mi byed par dgod sgra'i khrod dang mi tshogs kyi khrod du yal/6 ma ngu/ sgor mo brgya lhag tsam gyis nga dbul po bzo gi ma red/ mā kun hran gyis de ltar smras/ru spyi bde las khungs la snyan zhu gyis/’ pad+ma nor sgron gyi khong khro zhi thabs bral/16rdo de ltar na/ 'khyam po de tshos 'khon 'dzin byas te rtog gra de ring las

che ba yong gi red/ mā kun hran gyis rang nyid kyi lag ras blangs nas pad+ma nor sgron la sprad de mo'i mchi ma phyis zhes bshad/6 nga la yod/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis rang nyid kyi lag ras blangs nas mchi ma phyis/ sems gting gi khong khro rim bzhin zhi ba 'gyur/ sang nyin rbad de khro ba 'jag rgyu red/ dus tshod kyi pir chen pos thams cad rim bzhin yid kyi me long las bsub ste gtsang rkyang la bzo ba ni chos nyid lags/bzhi/mā kun hran gyis kha sang gi gyong gun brjed pa ltar brel 'tshub chen pos de ring gi bya ba byed/ pad+ma nor sgron yang sngar bzhin brel ba chen pos las ka byed/ ngo ma/ za khang 'di'i nang yong mkhan rgyun mi chad/bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la mdang gi pho gzhon 'dra chags po de'ang glo bur du za khang nang 'dzul/ khos tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyis las ka byed bzhin pa'i pad+ma nor sgron la 'dzum tsam byas/ pad+ma nor sgron ci shod mi shes pa'iganas su gyar nas had de lus/ pho gzhon de shar rer mā kun hran gyi mdun du song nas 6 mdang dgong dgongs pa ma tshom/ nga dngul skyel du yong ba yin/’ zhes bshad/ mā kun hran gyis mdang gi gnas tshul la khro ba spu tsam med pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis 6 snang dag med ces yang yang bshad nas dngul blangs/ pho gzhon de mar yong nas mngar ja phor pa gang nyos te sgrog tse zhig gi zur du bsdad de tha mag rkang gcig blangs nas dal bu'i ngang me spar/pad+ma nor sgron gyi yid kyi me long gi ngos nas mdang gi mi legs pa'i gnas tshul kun 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur nas mdun gyi pho gzhon 'di las dge mtshan kho na mthong / des na rang dbang med par kho la dgod tsam dgod tsastu byed

dgos sbyozlo di/ra bzhugs dang / mi pho gzhon des tshur kha brda byas shing 'gram gyi rkub stegs gcig la mdzub mo btsugs/pad+ma nor sgron rang dbang med par kho'i 'gram du bsdad///kha che/ za khang nang ga 'dra 'dug 6 zlo/ slo/ ཿ/ 'gro myong ngam/ 6 na ning sa gnas slob 'bring dang po nas thon pa yin/ las ka ma thob pas 'dir lus pa red/mi 6 las ka zhig ga ler 'tshol chog ngas rogs pa byed chog nga'i pha ngal rtsol cus la yod/ nga'i ming la rnam rgyal zer/ 6 de 'dra byung na thugs rje che/ rnam rgyal gyis ja hub gang btung / de ni mngar zhing zhim/ khos pad+ma nor sgron la lta bzhin 'dzum tsam byas/ pad+ma nor sgron ngo tsha smin pos yar langs nas gzhan du las ka byed du song /rnam rgyal gyis mgo bo kyog kyog byas/ rnam rgyal gyis chu tshod la gcig bltas/ khos phar lta tshur lta 'ga' byas te 66'dir shog dang / zhes slar yang pad+ma nor sgron la kha brda byas/ 6 do dgong mnyam du zhabs bro 'khyab tu song na e 'grig 66de/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis lan rgyag rgyu ma rnyed/ don du mo zhabs bro rgyag tu 'gro 'dod/ sgos su pho gzugs dod pa'i gzhon nu 'di dang mnyam du song na bu mo gzhan gyi mdun du gnya' zhum mi dgos/ 'on te bu mo zhig gi ngo tshas rkyen pas 66do dgong nga las ka yod ces kha nas thal/17rdo des na gza' spen pa'i dgong mo ga 'dra 'dug

pad+ma nor sgron la mu mthud mos mthun mi byed pa'i blo stobs kyis dben pas mgo bo kyog kyog gis gza' spen pa'i dgong mor zhabs bror 'gro rgyu'i khas len byas/rnam rgyal za khang nas thon/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis yud tsam mo'i mig gi longs spyod du gyur pa'i skyes pa de'i gzugs byad la mig ce rer bltas/6 shog dang / gang g.yeng yod/’ mā kun hran cung mi dga' skad gdangs kyis mo bos/ pad+ma nor sgron ngo tsha nas 'gram pa'ang dmar por gyur/:snga/chang dri 'thul ba'i 'khrab ra nas phyir thon dus pad+ma nor sgron gyi spro ba da dung 'jags med/ sems kyi mtsho mo'i rba rlabs de rang byung gi mtsho rlabs las kyang 'jags dka'/ dngos gnas/ rang nyid la 'di lta bu gang nas bltas kyang yang rtser son pa'i pho gzhon zhig dga' rogs rnyed par dga' ba skyes/ rnam rgyal gyis ngo sprod byas pa ltar na kho'i pha ni sa khul ngal rtsol cus kyi cus krang yin pa dang rnam rgyal rang nyid kyi las ka byed sa lha sar yod cing deng skabs nang du 'khor zhag la yong ba red/ dkar zhing gsal ba'i zla ba gsar pa zhig nam mkha'i sprin gseb nas dal gyis 'gro/ mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu gcig la slebs zin pas gzhung lam thog mi thar thor las ma mchis/ de dag mang che ba ni cha byed nas 'gro ba'i gzhon nu pho mo dang ra bzi nas khyar khyor ngang log 'gro ba'i pho gzhon 'ga' red/ rnam rgyal dang pad+ma nor sgron ༵༵ /ba rib zla 'od kyis brgyan pa'i gzhung lam thog lag gdang sbrel nas 6 dkon mchog gis nged gnyis ngo shes su bcug pa red/’ rna/ /la

gyis de snar+sha smra sa/ pad+ma nor sgron gyi ngo gdong shing tog ku shu ltar gyur pa rab rib zla 'od la brten yang gsal po mthong /6 khyod kyi las ka snang dag med/ ngas a pha la bshad na/ 6 ngo ma/’ pad+ma nor sgron gyi 'dren byed zung nas dga' ba'i 'od 'phro/mos rnam rgyal gyi lag pa dam du bcangs nas kho'i bka' drin tshor ba byas/rnam rgyal gyis pad+ma nor sgron gyi sked pa nas lag pa 'chang / de ltar kha bral mi thub pa'i gzhon nu pho mo gnyis pad+ma nor sgron gyi khyim gyi sgo 'gram du slebs/ des na khong gnyis byang khreg grib ma nag chil chil yod sa der song nas phan tshun dam du 'khyud/ pad+ma nor sgron mig btsum nas yun ring po 'gul tsam yang mi byed/rnam rgyal gyis rang nyid kyi lce mo pad+ma nor sgron gyi kha nang du bsrings/mos byis pas 'o ma nu ba ltar byas/ de nas yun ring phyin rjes phan tshun bral mi phod pa'i ngang nas kha gyes/pad+ma nor sgron glu chung len zhing nyal sa bzos/ lo mang po'i nang de ring lta bu'i dga' ba skye ma myong / mun nag gi mtshan mo der mo'i mig mdun du shar ba ni 'od snang kho na red/ da lta byed dus rang nyid ni bu mo rlung rta can zhig red/ slar yang rnam rgyal yid la 'khor/ kho'i nyams dang ldan pa'i gdong pa de yid la 'khor/ kho'i rab snyan gyi gtam slar yang rna lam du grags/ pad+ma nor sgron rim bzhin rmi lam gyi zhing khams su slebs/ rmi lam yang 'ja' gur dang me tog gis btum pa zhig red/ ngo ma/ pha cus krang yin pa'i rnam rgyal rgyab rtsa yod pa brten nas byung ba'am yang na rgyu mtshan gang yin ma bltos par pad+ma nor sgron gyi mjing pa sbom du song / las ka byed ska/lha snan ma lta bu'i hur brtson med/ thengs mang po snga byol rjes lus byas/

dgong mo rtag par rnam rgyal dang lhan du sbrang si 'khrab tu 'gro/ rnam rgyal gyis mo la las ka 'tshol rgyu'i khas len thengs mang byas zin/de nyin phyi dro snga po nas za khang gi sgo brgyab/ mā kun hran gyis tshal 'ga' bzos nas pad+ma nor sgron dang mnyam du za dgos zer/ pad+ma nor sgron 'dod la mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis kho dang mnyam du lto za rgyu khas len byas/ tshal sder tse lnga sgrog tse'i thog bsgrigs rjes mā kun hran gyis sbi rag shel dam gang kha phyes/ lbu ba sob sob kyis phor pa'i nang blugs/ mā kun hran gyis sbi rag phor pa gang yar bkyags te 66de ring ni ba'i skyes skar red/de ring ngas khyed las gzhan gyi mi gdan 'dren byas med/ khyed kyis ba'i ngo la bltas nas 'di zhabs dag rgyag rogs/7zhes bshad/ pad+ma nor sgron rtab rtob kyis sbi rag phor pa gang po btung / mos lo gsar gyi skabs las sbi rag btung ma myong / sbi rag gis pad+ma nor sgron gyi gdong pa de mur dmar po bzos shing lus po'ang yang thing thing du gyur/ mig mdun gyi dngos gzugs thams cad rab rib tu gyur/ de nas rgyu mtshan sna tshogs kyis pad+ma nor sgron gyis sbi rag phor pa bzhi tsam zhabs dag brgyab/ de dus pad+ma nor sgron ni rang lus rang gis tshod bzung mi thub par 'gyur/ mā kun hran gyis mo'i lag pa nas bzung ste 8 ngas khyed lta bu'i bu mo yag po mthong ma myong zhes bshad/pad+manor sgron la thungs zer mkhan med kyang rang 'gul gyis sbi rag phor pa mang dag btung / mo rbad de bzi nas mig mdun gyi dngos gzugs rnams kyang gzugs 'gyur/ de nas mos mā kun hran gyi mjing pa nas 'khyud de 6 rnam rgyal/ nga'i rnam rgyal 7zer nas ngus/ mā kun hran gyis mo la mchu sbyar/ mor dga' sdug gi tshor ba ci'ang med par thams cad dang du blangs/mā kun hran gyis mo pang du blangs nas dal bu'i ngang nyal khri'i thog bzhag kho ni sha rlon mthong ba'i spyang ki zhig ltar brel ba chen pos mos sdus

thog gi dug log ma lus bshus/ pad+ma nor sgron gyi gcer bur gnas pa'i lus po nub phyogs ri mo mkhas pa'i phul byung gi brtsams bya zhig ltar mā kun hran gyi mig mdun du mngon dus kho rang dbang med par mchil ma mid tsam byed dgos byung / 'dod chags kyis rab tu myos pa'i mā kun hran sbi rag gis za zir bzos pa'i mdzes ma'i lus thog tu mchongs/ zhogs pa'i nyi gzhon gyis khang pa'i nang du'ang ser thing thing du bzos/ pad+ma nor sgron rab rib mi lam las glo bur gnyid las sad/ mos mig phur bzhin phar tshur lta dus de ni mo'i nyal sa ma red/ mā kun hran gyi nyal khang red/ shod mi shes pa'i 'tshub cha zhig gis mos rang nyid kyi lus por bsnyabs dus dus rgyun gtan nas mi phud pa'i nang gos kyang phud zin/ lus thog la nyal chas phud pa'i dug log lheb gcig kyang ma lus/ mdang gi gnas tshul 'ga' rab rib yid la dran/ mos myur du dug log gyon te yar langs/ thog mar mos spyi bde las khungs la 'gro rgyu dran/ mā kun hran gyis 'o ma phor pa gang khyer nas 'dzum dmul dmul gyis nang du 'dzul/ 8 langs tshar ram/ kho la rgyun ldan gyi rnam 'gyur tsam las snang ba ci'ang mi 'dug6 nga spyi bde las khungs la 'gro rgyu yin/’ pad+ma nor sgron thad kur sgo ru song bas mā kun hran gyis mo'i dpung pa nas 'jus/ 6 brel ba ma byed/ dang po zhogs lto zo/ ngas skad cha shod rgyu yod/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis ci'ang ma smras par krong nger langs te kho'i skad cha sgug da spyi bde las khungs la song na nged gnyis kur phan thogs med/khyed kyi ngos nas bshad na/ bya ba 'di rnam rgyal gyis shes na khyed bskyur rgyu gtan 'khel red/ de las nged gnyis chu bde nya skyid byas na dga'/’ mā kun hran gyis mo sdod dgos pa'i lag brda byas/ mo'ang spyi bde las khungs la 'gyu ༵༵ spobs pa zhi nas rang dbang med par rkub stegs thog bsdad/ mo'i

sems la ngo ma gnas tshul 'di rnam rgyal gyis rtogs na mo'i 'ja' tshon lta bu'i mdun lam dang re ba kun rmeg med du yal rgyu red snyam nas mo'i sems gting nas drag tu 'bar ba'i khong khro'i me lce dag gnas skabs sems gting du mnan rgyu las thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ des na mos ci'ang ma smras par mdun du bzhag pa'i lto rnams shugs kyis zos/ ngo ma/ skabs der mos rang nyid kyi lar+sha tsho btsog sbag gtong mkhan mā kun hran gyi snying dmar zos pa lta bu'i bde ba jig zlo ༵ na/ hran gyis tab be hub bes zas za ba'i bu mor der lta bzhin bsgam brling gis mo'i zur du bsdad/ khos bu mo mang po de lta bur rtsed mo rtsed pas de ring yang sngar bzhin rgyal kha thob pa red/drugadabyar dus kyi dgong mo de dngos gnas yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig red/mi dmangs spyi gling nang du de bas yid dbang 'phrog de tsam gsal rgyu med pa'i zla 'od kyi 'og gi gzhon nu pho mo rnams zung dang zung gis bgrod/ de dus ni mdza' gcugs gser thag gis bcings pa'i gzhon nu tsho'i dus tshod red/ bsil 'jam rlung bu'i nang mi rnams bzi bar byed pa'i brlan bsher zhig ldan/ zla 'od dag g.yang dkar lug gi bal las grub pa ltar 'jam zhing rab rib kyi 'od snang dag rmi lam gyi zhing khams su mngon pa'i yul ljongs ltar mdzes/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis rnam rgyal gyi dpung pa nas 'jus te dal bu'i ngang 'gro/ rnam rgyal gyis pad+ma nor sgron la las ka 'tshol rgyu'i skor pha la bshad tshar ba yin zer/ pad+ma nor sgron gyi mdun lam sngar bas mdzes shing sdug la gsal lhang lhang du gyur/ mos rang nyid la las ka ga 'dra zhig thob minā spyar

la tshod dpag byas/ tshong khang gi tshong rgyag mkhan/ gzhung don khang gi yig dpar rgyag mkhan/ yang na las ka gzhan/ de dag thams cad mo'i blo la mos shing yid dbang 'phrog thub pa sha stag red/ las ka thob rjes rang nyid lji nasdu pa yod tshad bton nas gzengs su thon pa'i las 'bras bskrun rgyu'i da /sna zlo //ma blo 'khor byung / pad+ma nor sgron gyi blo rnal du bab nas lta dus spyi gling nub zur gyi spang sbug cig tu slebs 'dug sngon ma mos rang nyid kyi grogs mo nor 'dzoms dang lhan du 'dir skyid skyid byed du yong myong / de dus khong gnyis kyis rjes su ched las slob grwa gang zhig la 'gro rgyu'i skor gros byas/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis sgyu rtsal slob grwar zhabs bro sbyong du 'gro 'dod yod lugs bshad/ sngar song gi rmi lam dag yid la 'khor dus pad+ma nor sgron rang dbang med par dbugs ring shor/ de dag thams cad char rjes 'ja' gur nyi 'od kyis bcom pa'am zhogs pa'i rtswa sngon rtser 'phyo ba'i zil pa dag nyi drod kyis skam pa ltar deng gi dus su grib gzugs tsam med par yal rin pa red/khong gnyis lhan du rtswa spug der bsdad/ phan tshun 'tham res drag po byas/ rnam rgyal gyis pad+ma nor sgron 'og tu mnan nas gang sar 'o skyel/kho'i lag pa'ang da lta'i nu ma'i thog nas gos thung gi sked rags 'og nas brkyangaswā/de 'dra ma byed/ nged gnyis dngos su chang sa ma brgyab bar/’ pad+ma nor sgron dbugs hal bzhin de ltar smras shing ga ler kho'i lag 'og nas thar thabs /rdzu /rgyal gyis de bas dam du bcangs/ mo dbugs kyang btang dka'/'o/ 36 de ni bde ba dang ldan pa zhig red/ smyo snga phyi med/ nged gnyis mnyam

du sdod rgyu gtan 'khel red/ khyod kyis nga la yid ches byos/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis ci'ang mi smra/ khong gnyis kur rang nyid kyi gzhon nu'i sha khrag de 'dod pa'i bde bas zhu nas lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i chu mo la 'gyur ba'i snang ba shar la 'jig rten 'dir khong gnyis las med pa'i snang ba shar/ de nas bzung / rnam rgyal gyis rgyun du mo khrid nas rtswa sbug der yong /de ni khong gnyis kyi 'jig rten la gyur/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis dbugs hal hal gyis mo'i thog la mchongs ba'i rnam rgyal gyi kha bkag nas rang nyid kyi 'bur du thon pa'i grod par lag pas bsnyab bcug ste 6 khyod kyi phru gu/ nged gnyis mgyogs tsam chang sa ma brgyab na/’ zhes smras te rnam rgyal gyis mo la blo yid tshim thub pa'i lan zhig rgyag rgyu sgug rnam rgyal cung tsam mgo smad nas ci'ang mi smra bar gnas/ de nas khos pad+ma nor sgron gyi 'gram par 'o zhig bskyal te 6 snang dag mi dgos/ ngas a phar snga sa nas bshad tshar ba yin/ khong gis mos mthun byas zin/ zhes dal bu'i ngang smras/ 6 dngos gnas/ pad+ma nor sgron gyi chu mig ltar dngas shing gsal ba'i 'dren byed zung nas dga' spro'i 'od mdangs 'phro bzhin byis pa zhig ltar 'phag 'tshag rgyag bzhin rnam rgyal gyi mgrin par 'khyud/bdun/pad+ma nor sgron glu chung len bzhin sgrog tse phyis/ sgrog tse'i ngos nas mo'i mdzes zhal mngon pos mo rang dbang med par dgod tsam byas/ de dus za khang nang mi gcig kyang med/ dgong mo'i glog kyang spar zin/ mos rang nyid kyi sgrog tse phyis tshar rjes rnam rgyal bsu ru yong nges red snyam/ 177

mā kun hran gyi lag pa mo'i dpung pa'i thog la bzhag nas 8 do dgong sdod shog ces bshad/pad+ma nor sgron 'drogs tsam byas te 6 de 'dra ma byed/ nga rnam rgyal dang chang sa rgyag ran yod/ 6 chang sa brgyab kyang nged gnyis da dung 'brel ba byed chog na nga bud med de 'dra min/ pad+ma nor sgron sgo 'gram du song nas phyi la lta lta byas/ rnam rgyal gyi grib gzugs tsam yang ma mchis/ mdang dgong gi kha chad ltar na chu tshod phyed ka yol tshar 'dug6 mi de tshor yid ches 'ga' byed rgyu med/’ mā kun hran gyis gzhan sdug snying tshim gyis de ltar bshad/pad+ma nor sgron gyis mig log cig bltas/ spyi tshogs thog la na chung bu mo bsgyu brid byed mkhan gyi skye bo mang dag gnas mod kyang rnam rgyal de'i gras la 'a ga /rno ༵ zlo ༵/la bas sa gzhi chen po lhug por bklubs pas nyin dkar mor sha rus gsal ba'i dngos gzugs dag rab rib cha 'byed mi shes par gyur/ rnam rgyal da dung mthong rgyu mi 'dug pad+ma nor sgron 'tshab 'tshub kyis yar 'gro mar 'gro byed/ mo'i khog snying shig gis zos pa ltar shin tu blo mi bde/ rnam rgyal la stabs mi legs pa'i gnas tshul zhig 'phrad pa min nam/rlangs 'khor gyis brdzis pa/ gzhan dang rgyag res shor ba/ glo bur nad kyis mnar ba/ pad+ma nor sgron mu mthud bsam blo gtong mi phod par gyur nas 'jam zhing mnyen pa'i thod pa nas mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu'i rngul chu don/mā kun hran ni 'dod chags kyis rab tu myos pas de ring yang bu mo 'di las kho'i 'dod chags kyi zug gzer sel ba byed dgos snyam/ kho'i gdong pa da// sbyar gyur la lus kyi 'khri shing sig sig gis 'dar/ des na khos glo

bur du pad+ma nor sgron pang du bzung nas nyal khri'i thog la mnan/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis rkang lag thams cad g.yug nas 'phag 'tshag brgyab pas rkang pa kho'i brla bar la brgyab pas kho zug gzer gyi ma gzod par a ra u ru zhes pa'i sdug skad shor/ kho yun ring po 'gul tsam yang mi byed par lus po sgur nas bsdad/ pad+ma nor sgron mig gi mchi ma phyin bzhin ci'ang mi mthong ba'i mun nag gi khrod du rgyug ta mi go ba ma gtogs mo shar rer rnam rgyal gyi nang du 'gro rgyu red/ 'on kyang da dung rnam rgyal gyi sdod gnas dang kho'i pha'i ming ma shes/ glo bur du rnam rgyal gyis mo la mgo bskor ba min nam snyam pas lus hril po 'jigs yer re bar gyur/ de'i dgong mo gnyid dang bral/nyin gnyis pa pad+ma nor sgron za khang nang las ka byed du ma song / 'on te rnam rgyal gyis mo btsal du za khang nang yong gi red snyam nas mo za khang dang mi ring ba'i gyang khug cig tu langs nas za khang gi phyogs la rgyang lta byed/ snga dro nas phyi dro/ phyi dro nas dgong mor gyur te dus kyi 'khor lo skar ma gcig kyang ngal gso'ang mi rgyag de ring nyin mor phyi'i gzugs byad rnam rgyal dang 'dra ba gsum tsam zhig za khang nang du bcar bas mo de mur dga' spro dang brel 'tshub kyis snying ldig ldig gis 'phag mod kyang rjes su zhib par lta dus rnam rgyal min stabs ches cher rgyas pa'i re ba'i me phung dag dngos yod kyis meg med du bcoms/ mo phu shor ba'i lhang bu ltar gyur/de'i phyi nyin yang mo sngar nyin ltar rnam rgyal yong rgyu sgug de ring gi nyin ma'ang bzhud la nye/ nub ri'i rtse nas phyi mig lta ba'i nyi ma'i 'od snang gis lo rgyus yun ring ldan la skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i rtswa thang gi grong rdal de ser thing thing du rbazos/ de ni ngo ma mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba'i dus tshod cig red/ 'on te mi ring bar dngos med du 'gyur rgyu red/ mun nag dang grangarlung gis da lta mdzes shing gsal ba'i 'jig rten dbang sgyur dus sdud+ma

nor sgron yang 'jig rten 'dir gnas bca' ba'i srog yod dang srog med kyi dngos po gzhan dang 'dra bar mtha' yas pa'i smag mun gyi rgya mtsho'i nang lhung rgyu red/ mos rang dbang med par rang gi 'bur du thon pa'i grod par stob tsam byas dus spyir btang min pa'i 'tshub cha zhig lus hril por khyab/ mo'i kha nas rang dbang med par 6 rnam rgyal/ rnam rgyal zhes thal/6 wa ye/ ga re zer gyi yod/’ mā kun hran 'dzum dmul dmul gyis mo'i mdun du langs 'dugapad+ma nor sgron gyis thog mar bros rgyu dran/ 'on te bsam blo gzhan zhig 'khor dus khos nyin dkar po mi tshogs kyi mig mdun du rang nyid la ci'ang byed mi phod snyam nas mā kun hran la mthong chung gis mig zur bltas rjes ci'ang snang ba med pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis kha nas glu chung zhig blangs te rkang mgo dal bu'i ngang sa la brdab brdab byas/6 khyod las ka byed du yong gi min nam/ rnam rgyal sgug na za khang nang la sgug chog de min pa kho'i pha ma 'tshol na kho rnyed rgyu red/ mā kun hran gyis de ltar bshad/6 ngas de ring nas khyod kyi za khang nang gom pa mi rgyag 6 ya/ ngas u tshugs mi byed/ rjes su yong 'dod yod dus yong na 'grig 'di khyod kyi gla cha yin/ sgor mo gcig lor chag pa zhig mo la bsrings/pad+ma nor sgron gyis lta tsam yang mi byed par bsdad/ mā kun hran gyis sgor mo de dag mo'i stod gos kyi khug ma'i nang bcug rjes kha bskor nas log song / des na pad+ma nor sgron gyis da lta sgor mo bcug pa'i stod gos kyi khug mar 'chang tsam byas pa dang kha zur nas de tsam mngon rgyu med pa'i 'dzum mad1༵༵ shig snang tsam byas/

brgyad/pad+ma nor sgron gyi mig mdun du mngon pa ni ngal rtsol cus zhes pa'i bod rgya yi ge gnyis kyi shing byang sbyar ba'i rgyal sgo chen po de red/ de ring mos rnam rgyal pha yi las khungs btsal nas rnam rgyal gyi pha 'tshol rgyu dang / rnam rgyal gyi pha btsal nas rnam rgyal rnyed pa byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad pa red/ mo phar lta tshur lta byed bzhin rgyal sgo nas 'dzul ba na/ rgyal sgo srung mkhan gyi rgad po des mo bkag nas 6 bu mo ga par 'gro gi yin ’ zhes dris/ skad gdangs 'jam zhing rnam 'gyur bzang ba'i rgad po de bltas ma thag mi rnams dga' dgos pa zhig red/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis gus zhabs chen pos lce snar tsam dang pago shig 'brad tsam gyis 8 deng skabs cus krang bzhugs yod dam mi zhes sa/ 6 cus krang su zer gyi yod/’ 66 ’ mos rnam rgyal gyi pha'i ming mi shes pas lkugs par lus/6 wang cus krang lha sar tshogs 'dur phyin pa red/ bkra shis cus krang dang don 'asal cus kra( bsdad yod/ khyod kyis su 'tshol gyi yod/’ 6 /sdu ཿṭā gyi ༵// bkra shis cus krang bsdad yod/ rgad pos pad+ma nor sgron la gzhung las byed sa'i thog brtsegs khang chen ngo sprod byas pa dang bkra shes cus krang gi gzhung las khang thog brtsegs gnyis par yod ces bshade/pad+ma nor sgron gyis cus krang gzhung don khang zhes sgo yig bris pa'i khang pa zhig gi sgo dal bus brdung / mo'i snying ldig ldig gis 'phag rdoswāzlos

dang / mo'i mig mdun du shar ba ni sgrog tse chen po gnyis ltag sprod kyis sgrig cing g.yas g.yon du mi dpon gzugs dod po gnyis bsdad 'dugasgrog tse'i thog tu kha par dang yig cha/ chu phor/ snag bum bcas bzhag 'dug66su 'tshol dgos/ mi klad dmar lo che tsam des mo la kha brda byas/6 bkra shis cus krang /’ 66a'o/ nga yin/mi mig shel brgyab pa'i mi sha rgyags des mgo bo kyog kyog byas/ de'i phyi gzugs la bltas na lo sum cu'i nang bsdad yod nges red/pad+ma nor sgron gyis rnam rgyal la lo na chung ba'i pha 'di 'dra zhig yod dus rbad de ha las/ 6 rnam rgyal pad+ma nor sgron gyis skad cha bshad ma tshar gong nas bkra shis cus krang gis 6 khyed rnam rgyal gyi dge rgan yin nges red/ rgan lags bzhugs dang / bkra shes cus krang gis chu phor zhig bkru bkru byas/de'i nang du chu khol blugs te pad+ma nor sgron gyi mdun du bzhag nas/ 6 kho gtor bshig che drags/ gan lags khyed tshor rnyog gra bzo gi yod kyi red/khod lo slob chung nas thon dus rgya nag la 'gro thub rgyu'i re ba byed kyi yod ’ bkra shes cus krang gis pad+ma nor sgron la shod rgyu gang yod med mi lta bar rang nyid gcig pus gtam gleng chu rgyug rgyug byed/ ngo ma/ 'go khrid mang po zhig gtam gleng la byang chub po yod/pad+ma nor sgron gyi ngo mdog skya seng du gyur/ mdun gyi gtam gleng spel bzhin pa'i skyes pa 'di rang nyid kyi 'tshol sa min pa rtogs/ brjod mi shes pa'i ngo tsha dang khong khro zhig lus hril por khyab ste ba spu tshang ma'ang sdod mi tshugs par gyur/ tsa rnam rgyal mi nor 'dug pad+ma nor sgron gyis de las gzhan gyi skad cha gcig ma bshad par hob ste sgo nas thon/da lta bkra shes cus krang btsal du song ba'i na chung bu mo de mig nas mardo 32 lhung lhung gis 'bab cing lag pa kha nang bcug nas rgyug yong ba mthong

dus/ sgo srung mkhan gyi rgad po des/ 6 bu mo/ ga re byas song / pad+ma nor sgron gyis mu mthud bzod sgom ma thub par kha nas ngu skad thon/ lam zur du rtsed mor rol ba'i byis pa 'gas kyang bud med cig ngus pa mthong dus mtshar snang gis tshur rgyug byung / sgo srung god po des 6 ma ngu/ ngus na ci phan/ 'gro/nga'i khang pa'i nang /’ pad+ma nor sgron rgad po'i rjes su 'brangs nas khang pa'i nang 'dzul/ rgad pos khang pa'i sgo brgyab pas mtshar snang chen pos mig ldir ba'ibyis pa rnams phyi ru lus/ rgad po'i nang du kho'i bza' zla gad mo zhig 'dug rgad mo/ bu mo 'dir ja blugs/ pad+ma nor sgron sngar bas skad shugs chen pos ngus/yo bu mo/ ci byas song / yang na ngas khyod la rogs pa 'dra byed thub nga / pad+ma nor sgron rim bzhin ngu mtshams bzhag mos mdun gyi byams brtse can gyi rgan rgon gnyis la lta bzhin dogs pa'i sprin nag cig car yal nas spyir btang min pa'i yid ches shig thob/ des na mos thams cad gan rgon gnyis la bshad/rgad po ha las nas yang yang 8 snyigs ma lnga bdo ’ zhes smras/rgad mo'i gting du dib pa'i mig zung nas mchi ma'i rdog pa 'ga' lhung nas 6 las ma dag pa'i ’ bu mo de dang gdung sems mnyam skye byas/ngal rtsol cus kyi cus krang su la'ang pad+ma nor sgron gyi bshad pa'i rnam rgyal zhes pa'i bu med/ mo mgo bskor gyi 'og tu tshud pa red/rgan rgon gnyis pos mi ngan gyi gnod 'tshe phog pa'i bu mo 'dir gzhan gyi rogs pa byed rgyu ma rnyed pas sgor mo lnga bcu blangs nas pad+ma nor sgron la sprad/ mos ji ltar mi dgos bshad kyang u tshugs kyis len dgos 17tshod/

mos gtan nas dngul ma blangs/6 bu mo/ gzhan gyi rogs pa gang dgos 'dug pad+ma nor sgron gyis bka' drin tshor ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis mgo bo 'phred du g.yug g.yug byas/pad+ma nor sgron khyim du slebs rjes ci'ang ma bshad par nyal khri'i thog la 'gre ldog rgyag bzhin ngus/ bu mo'i ngu skad kyis ra bzi nas hon thor ba'i dbang 'byor rgad po bzi las dwangs/ 6 bu mo/ ci byas song / pad+ma nor sgron gyis lan ma brgyab/ skad shugs chen pos ngus/ 66na gi 'dug gam/’ dbang 'byor gyis rang nyid kyi nag cing rtsub pa'i lag pas bu mo'i thod par nyug nyug byas/ tsha ba brgyab pa'i gnas tshul ma mchis/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis mu mthud lan ma brgyab par gdong pa sngas mgor gtugs nas ngus/ ra bu mo ci byas pa yin nam/’ rgad po 'tshab nas rdo leb tsha po'i thog gi 'bu grog ma ltar gyur nas glog brnyan nang dmag shor ba'i dgra dmag gi dmag dpon zhig ltar yar 'gro mar 'gro byed/ glo bur du god po'i mig zung nas thabs shes rnyed pa'i 'od 'phro zhing de mur sgo nas thon/yud tsam song rjes dbang 'byor rgad pos grub thob rin po che gdan 'dren zhus nas slobs 'dug grub thob rin po che shar rer yong nas pad+ma nor sgron gyi nyal khri'i 'gram du slebs rjes der bzhag pa'i rkub stegs dmar po de'i thog tu bsdad cing 6 bu mo/ ga re ngu gi yod/ ces dris/ gdong pa sngas mgor gtugs nas ngu bzhin pa'i pad+ma nor sgron gyi rna lam du de tsam cha rgyus med pa'i skyes pa'i skad gdangs shig grags dus rang dbang med par ngu mtshams bzhag nas dgye dgye byas/ de na mos grub thob rin po ches mo la bya/sdu sang snying rje chen pos gzigs bzhin yod pa mthong dus mo rang dbang

med par lce snar tsam byas pa dang ngo tsha nas dgod tsam byas/ 8 bu mo/gnas tshul gang 'phrad byung /’ pad+ma nor sgron mgo bo gug nas ci'ang ma smras/khang pa'i nang 'jam thing nger gnas/ phan tshun gyi rna lam du dbugs gtong rngub kyi sgra'ang gsal po go/ grub thob rin po ches ma ṇi 'ga' gsungs te/6 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas 'dra mi 'dra los yong / 'on te bsam blo rgya che tsam btang na thams cad ha las dgos pa gang yang med/sdug bsngal yong dang mi yong gtso bo rang nyid la rag las/’ zhes smras/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis mgo bo kyog kyog byas/ bla ma langs nas 'gro rtsis byas/dbang 'byor bla ma phebs skyel byed du song / pad+ma nor sgron yang gus lugs mtshon byed tsam gyis langs tsam byas/ bla ma sgo nas thon rjes myur du nyal khri'i thog bsdad nas 8 'khor ba sdug bsngal yin na ngas rnam rgyal gyis kyang sdug bsngal de myong bcug thag gcod yin/’ zhes smras/ de dus pad+ma nor sgron gyi mig gnyis khro bas ldir zhing khu tshur dam du bsgongs 'dugadagu/pad+ma nor sgron mi tshogs kyi khrod du gnas/ 'on te mos yun ring btsal ba'i rnam rgyal gyi grib gzugs tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug sos slar yang mā kun hran la skyabs bcol rgyu las thabs med/ de ltar na rnam rgyal rnyed srid/mo mā kun hran gyi za khang nang 'gro ba'i lam bar du ngo tsha sob sob byed/ ngo ma de ni ngo tsha'i gnas las ma 'das kyang bsam blo zhib tu gtong dus rnam rgyal btsal nas dgra sha len rgyu las gal che ba'i bya ba ci'ang med/pad+ma nor sgron sngon ma ltar mā kun hran za khang gi las ka byed mkhan la 'gyur/ mā kun hran gyis dgong mo pad+ma nor sgron ma log ces bshad/ 1/snang

ngo ma ma log mos bsam na 'di ltar gyur dus rang nyid kyi lus por de ltar gces spras byed dgos pa ci'ang med pas gnas skabs kyi bde ba phran bu re byung na'ang khe bzang red snyam/ rnam rgyal gyis mo btsog pa btsog kyang bzos tshar ba red/ mos 'dren byed zim zim gyis mā kun hran gyi 'o dang phur phur dang len byas/ mā kun hran gyis mo'i smad gos sked rags dkrol ba na pad+ma nor sgron hob ste tsog tsog byas shing mā kun hran gyi 'gram par 'o zhig bskyal te na nga'i grod khog nang gi phru gu med pa bzo rogs/ de nas khyod kyis gang byas na gyis/ zhes bshad/ mā kun hran gyis sang nyin rang la sman pa ngo shes btsal nas pad+ma nor sgron gyi phru gu bkog rogs byed rgyu'i khas len byas/ pad+ma no/lhan dbugs ring zhig btang rjes dal bu'i ngang mā kun hran gyi pang du 'a lanyi/ na gnyis pa mā kun hran gyis rogs pa byas te pad+ma nor sgron khog nang gi phru gu med pa bzos/ pad+ma nor sgron ni ljang mdog can gyi lo ma ston rlung gis gtses pa ltar ngo mdog ser skya ru gyur zhing sha'ang skam rid du song /dus tshod ni ji 'dra'i 'gro mgyogs pa zhig ma red dam/ nor 'dzin gyi sgeg mo rtswa dang me tog gi mgul rgyan btags pa de rim bzhin ser po gser mdog can du 'gyur/ de nas gangs dang lhags pas rab tu bcom pas ri klung ma lus thal mdog tu bzos/ ri rtse thams cad gangs kyis g.yogs pas dngul gyi mchod rten rang byon dang gnyis su med/ de ring mgron po nyung bas pad+ma nor sgron za khang gi sgo 'gram du langs nas lam thog gi mi tshogs la lta/'di'ang mā kun hran gyis mo la bslab pa red/ khos bshad na bu mo mdzes ma zhig za khang gi sgo 'gram yod pa mthong na bung bas me tog mthong ba ltar mardoswā zlo mang dag cig za khang nang 'gugs rgyu red zer/ da dung mos mi

kun la 'dzum tsam dang rnam 'gyur legs tsam byed dgos zhes bshad/ dus rgyun mos 'dzum tsam byas pa na 'grul pa rgyun ma chad/ 'on te de ring yong mkhan su'ang mi 'dug glo bur du mi tshogs kyi dkyil nas rnam rgyal 'dra ba'i pho gzhon zhig mthong bas mo blo mi bde bar gyur/ dus tshod ring po 'di ltar song yang mos da dung rnam rgyal dgra sha len ma thub/ de nas bzung rnam rgyal gyi grib gzugs tsam yang ma mthong / de nyin de sngon rnam rgyal dang mnyam du zakhang nang sbi rag btung myong ba'i pho gzhon gzugs ring des rnam rgyal ni skad grags yod pa'i 'khyams po zhig yin pas sdod sa nges gtan med zer/khos bu mo mang po zhig mgo bskor tshar ba red/ skabs 'gar kho ni sa ud hru'u ci'i bu la brdzu/ skabs 'gar spyi bde khru'u yi khru'u krang gi bu yin zhes shod/ pad+ma nor sgron gyi thog la ngal rtsol cus krang gi bu la brdzus pa red/ ngo ma pho gzhon gzugs ring de deng skabs nyin rtag par za khang nang yong /khos thengs mang po pad+ma nor sgron dang dga' rogs kyi 'brel ba btsugs rgyu'i re ba byas/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis kha ya gtan nas ma byas/ rnam rgyal gyi grogs por kha ya byed rin med snyam/pad+ma nor sgron gyi ngo mdog shin tu mi mdzes par gyur/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i 'dren byed zung nas nga rgyal gyi me lce 'bar/mo'i gral ltar 'grig pa'i dung so dkar mos ma ne'i thog la mnan pas de ru mngon gsal gyi so rjes bzhag6 ngo mdog skyo ba/’ pad+ma nor sgron gyi mdun du rnam rgyal gyi grogs po gzugs ring de slebs 'dug khos mig gnyis zim zim gyis mo la lta/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis kho'i bzo lta 'di mthong ba tsam gyis khong khro za zhing skyug bro/'on te de ring mos sngar dran ma myong ba'i thabs shes shig yid la 'khor bas 'jo sgeg gis kho la 'dzum tsam byas shing kho dang mnyam du za khang nang 1byiltol/

pho gzhon des sbi rag shel dam do khyer shog zer/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis sbi rag shel dam kha phyes te lbu ba sob sob kyis shel phor nang blugs/ pho gzhon gzugs ring des dus rgyun rang nyid la gtan nas kha ya mi byed pa'i mdzes ma 'dis rang nyid la 'di ltar spro sems kyis zhabs zhu byed pa mthong dus sems gting nas dga' bas rab tu myos nas kha'ang btsum mi thub/ khos pad+ma nor sgron rang nyid kyi lag tu thebs pa byed rgyu'i sems shugs sngar bas che ru song /khos ngo ma bu mo 'di dang mnyam du 'tsho ba skyel bar 'dod/ pho gzhon des slar yang thengs mang bshad tshar ba'i skad cha de bshad/ 6 pad+ma/ ngas khyod la dga' nas shi grabs byed kyi 'dug ngas mi tshe gcig khyod la yag po byed chog smyo yag byung / 'on kyang rnam rgyal la dgra sha zhig ma blangs na su dang dga' rogs bsgrig mi 'dod/’ pho gzhon gzugs ring de kha mi grag par bsdad/ de nas khos slongs khyod kyi dgra sha len rogs byed/ ces bshad/ra yong gi ma red/ khyod kho'i grogs po red/ ru nga khyod kyi don du ci'ang byed 'dod/ 6 ngo ma/’ pad+ma nor sgron gyis rang nyid kyi dkar 'jam gyi lag pas pho gzhon de'i lag mgo nas dam por bcangs/tsa dgra sha ji ltar len dgos/ pho gzhon gzugs ring des 'tshab 'tshub kyis de ltar dris/8 do dgong skad cha yod/ nged gnyis lhan du glog brnyan lta ru 'gro/ de dus mā kun hran khang pa'i sbug nas phyir thon pas pad+ma nor sgron gyis lag pa myur du tshur bkum nas rtab rtob kyis yar langs/gsar du pad+ma nor sgron gyi dga' rogs la gyur pa'i pho gzhon gzugs ridi spyas sked par gri btags nas gang sar rnam rgyal 'tshol du song / za

khang dang ja khang re re bzhin btsal yang rnam rgyal gyi grib ma tsam yang ma rnyed/za grogs btung grogs 'ga' 'phrad pas de dag gis de ring rnam rgyal ma mthong zer/ 'gas lha sar phyin pa'i tshod dpag byas/ gal srid mo'i don du dgra sha ma blangs na kho nam yang mo'i 'gram du yong mi dgos zhes pa'i skad cha dag yid la 'khor dus lus hril po 'tshub cha zhig langs kyang thabs med/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snga sa nas nub kyi ri bo chen po'i rgyab nas yol zin/gnam sa'i kha dog rab rib tu gyur/ las khungs 'ga'i rgyal sgo'i thog gi tshon khra can gyi glog kyang spar zin/ pho gzhon gzugs ring des dbugs ring nar nar gyis kha che'i za khang zhig nang 'dzul nas thug pa phor pa gang dang mngar ja dkar yol gang khyer shog ces bshad cing lag pas mgo bo skyor nas bsdad/6 wa ye/ su dran gyi 'dug pho gzhon gzugs ring de'i rna lam du cha rgyus che ba'i skad gdangs shig thos/ zhin gang btsal ba'i rnam rgyal rang nyid kyi mig mdun du slebs 'dug de ni yul lha gzhi bdag gis rogs byas pa red snyam nas pho gzhon gzugs ring de'i gdong pa nas 'dzum chung zhig ngang gis shar/ de ring pad+ma nor sgron gyi don du dgra sha len thub nges yin pa'i yid ches brtan du song / rnam rgyal mgo bskor nas grong mtha' la khrid rgyu'i thabs shes kyang yid la 'khor/phogazhon gzugs ring des da dung mngar ja phor pa gang dang thug pa phor pa gang bzo dgos pa'i kha brda byas/ khong gnyis ga ler mngar ja btung bzhin don yod don med kyi gleng mol 'ga' byas/ pho gzhon gzugs ring desade ring rnam rgyal gyi gdong par thad kur lta mi phod/ ma gzhi rnam rgyal gyis snang ba ci yang mi byed kyang khos rnam rgyal gyis rang nyid kyi ngo gdong las gsang ba phyi la shor rgyu'i dogs pa byed/mgo la zhwa mo dkar po gyon pa'i kha che'i pho gzhon des thug pa pho/ 8sdu do

khong gnyis kyi mdun la bzhag pa dang 'dra min gyi sha sman blugs pa'i shel bum 'ga' yang de ru bzhagapho gzhon gzugs ring des thug pa las sha dog gcig blangs te kha nang bcug rjes 8 rnam rgyal/ do dgong nga'i a zhang gi nang du e 'gro/ :zhes dris/6 khyed rang gi a zhang / ga par yod dam/ 8 grong rdal gyi nub zur la yod/ nged gnyis skyid skyid byas nas bsdad na/ rnam rgyal gyis bsam blo zhig btang / 6 do dgong nga khom gyi med/ rjes la yong na ga 'dra 'dug 6 do dgong / nga dang bu rdzi bu mo zhig las med/ bu mo der sang dgong nas a zhang log na go skabs med/ rnam rgyal gyis bu mo zhes go dus zhi mis dmar dri tshor ba ltar gyur/khos da lta rang nas bu mo mdzes ma zhig gi mdun du slobs pa ltar mig zim zim gyis lta/ 6 yin na/ do dgong 'gro/ pho gzhon gzugs ring der thog ma'i rgyal kha thob pas blo yid tshim pa'i 'dzum chung zhig kho'i rma rjes 'ga' yod pa'i ngo gdong nas shar/grang rlung gi spu gri non pos rab tu gtses pa'i mtho sgang gi grong rdal 'dir nyi ma bzhud rjes lam thog tu ha lam mi med/ mgo dang lag pa thams cad btum pa'i bu mo gnyis brel ba chen pos lam la bzhud/ rnam rgyal dang pho gzhon gzugs ring gnyis mgo bo gug nas grong rdal gyi nub la 'gro/ grong spyal snro nub zur du slebs pas mun rbad de rub nas nam mkha'i skar tshogs khra la ༵ / byed/ kyi red/ rdo gra sgrig ma byas na/’ pho gzhon gzugs ring des rdo /sdu chen po zhig sgrug de nas khos par lta tshur lta byas pas mi su'ang mi

'dug de na khos myur du lag gi rdo de rnam rgyal gyi mgo la gtad nas brgyab pas rnam rgyal gyis 8 khyod khyod mi zer bzhin khyar khyor gyis sa la 'gyel/ pho gzhon gzugs ring des de mur gri bton nas kho'i thog la mchongs/ pad+ma nor sgron gyis rnam rgyal gyi rna cog gnyis bkog nas log dgos zer/sa la 'gyel ba'i rnam rgyal gyis glo bur rdog tho zhig brgyab pas pho gzhon gzugs ring de khyar re khyor re bzos/ rnam rgyal langs te gri bton/ lag tu gri bzung ba'i pho gzhon gnyis drag 'dzing byas/ dus chod skar ma bcu tsam phyin rjes pho gzhon gnyis zung khrag gis dmar 'dzar 'dzar bzos/ gnyis ka de tsam bde lcag 'khyug po dang ma lag myur po med pa chags 'dug glo bur du thog nas drag brda bsgrags pa'i spyi bde las khungs kyi rlangs 'khor zhig 'byor/ de dus pho gzhon gnyis po 'tshab be 'tshub bes gom pa kha shas bros mod kyang myur du spyi bde mi snas 'dzin bzung byas/'bol zhing mthug pa'i nyal khri'i thog tu lus la dug log lheb gcig ma gyon pa'i pho mo gnyis gcig gis gcig la 'khyud/ mchu dang mchu sbyar nas yun ring po song / phan tshun lus po'i thog nyug nyug dang phur phur byed/ pho gzhon des bud med de'i 'bur du thon pa'i nu ma lag pas bcangs/de nas myos pa ltar gyis nu ma 'jib 6 thag thag glo bur du sgo shugs kyis brdung / 'dod chags kyis myos pa'igazhon nu pho mo gnyis gnyid sad pa ltar gyur nas 'tshab be+e 'tshub bes gos lham gyon/ pho gzhon des sgo phyes pas lus la mtshon cha btags pa'i spyi bde'i mi sna 'ga' nang du 'dzul/6 khyod mā kun hran yin nam/mi 6 yin/ 191

//shārdo rdor sgron yod dam/’ ji sbyi ༷de'i mi sna dag thad kur khang sbug tu 'dzul/ 6 khyod pad+ma nor sgron na na/d+ma/ nor sgron gdong pa thal mdog tu gyur nas yar langs byung / pad+ma nor sgron ci'ang shod khom ma byung bar 'dzin bzung byas/6 dbeng / dbeng / zhes pa'i drag brda ni dben thing thing gi mtshan mo der grags pa'i ches gsal shos dang ches dza drag che shos kyi skad gdangs red/drag brda sgrog pa'i rlangs 'khor gyi rab tu 'bar ba'i glog 'od kyis lam zur gyi smag mun ma lus cig car rmeg med du bcom/ 192

brtse dung gis bskyur ba'i lo zla/ sbra stod rdzong ni bod gangs can ljongs kyi shar rgyud kyi tshar du dngar ba'i ri tshogs dang drag tu rgyug pa'i chu rgyun gyi bar du gnas pa'i rdzong mi che mi chung ba zhig red/ rdzong srid gzhung gi gnas sa'i sbra zhol grong rnal de g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i rjes la 'gro ba'i sbra chu'i 'gram du gnas shing de'ang mi che mi chung ba'i grong rdal zhig tu mngon/ grong rdal gyi rgyab tu a sngon gnam gyi lto ba 'bigs pa'i brag ri dkar po chu shel gyi gong bu las grub pa lta bu zhig 'gying nger langs shing / de ni 'jig rten byed pos grong rdal de'i srung skyob byed po la ched du bskrun pa ltar snang la/ de'i 'og tu 'tsho ba'i mi rnams kyis kyang gna' snga mo nas ri bo de rang nyid kyi las dbang dang 'brel ba'i rgyab ri la brtsis nas skyabs su bcol/ sbra chu sngon mo'i ska rags bcings pa'i grong rdal de'i nang du che chung mi 'dra la 'gan 'khri so so yin pa'i las khungs mang du chags kyang / rdzong slob grwa 'bring ba ni las khungs tshang ma'i nang gi che shos yin thog der lnga rig yon tan gyi g.yu ral gsig pa'i shes yon can mang du mchis pas rdzong yongs la ming grags che tsam yod pa smos med red/ slob grwa rang las mi rnams skyas do snang chen po byed dgos pa zhig ni slob grwa de'i slob spyi zur pa rgan smyon pa zhes pa de red/ ngo ma/ rdzong de'i rgan skra dkar nas gzhon so dkar bar khong ngo mi shes mkhan su'ang med/ pha ma tshos rdo miX mi

nyan pa'i byis par snye rgan smyon pa slebs 'dug ces skrag snang skul/ khos rgyun du 6 nga krang wen ge min/ nga tshe brtan bkra shis yin ’ zhes gnam sa g.yo ba'i skad cor rgyag gan smyon pa'i bod skad kyi ming la tshe brtan bkra shes dang rgya skad kyi ming la krang wen ge zer/ ming de gnyis kyi 'byung khungs bshad na/ tshe brtan bkra shis ni chung dus pha mas bla ma la 'dogs rogs zhus nas byung ba dang / krang wen ge zhes pa ni rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs khong bod ljongs mi rigs slob chen la slob sbyong byed skabs gyen log gi 'go gtso yin pa'i dge rgan zhig gis khong la btags pa red/ krang ni dge rgan de'i rus ming khong la sbyin pa dang wen ge ni rgya skad yin zhing rig gsar zhes pa'i don mchis/ rgan smyon pa zhes pa'i ming 'dogs mkhan kha gsal zhig shod rgyu med kyang de ni byung phyi shos dang khyab che shos kyi ming zhig tu snang /khong la smyon ming thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni khong lo bzhi bcur slobs kyang bza' zla bu phrug med la nyin rtag par ra bzi nas skad cha gang byung smra zhing bya spyod sna tshogs spel bas byas pa red/ gal srid khyed kyis da dung khong ji ltar byas nas rig pa tshul bzhin gnas mi thub pa'i yong khungs shes 'dod na thams cad 'go btsugs nas shod rgyu red/gcigatshe brtan bkra shis brjod mi shes pa'i dga' bde dang shod mi tshar ba'i dka' sdug gis khengs pa'i slob grwa ba'i 'tsho ba mjug sgril nas lo ngo drug tsam ring rmi lam nang yang yang 'phrad pa'i chung lte phrag 'pho sa rang yul sbra stod du las bgos byas shing rdzong nas khong gangs 'bum chus la drung yis byed du bta17 4/ kho chus la 'gro ran khar rdzong ud rtsa 'dzugs pu'u krang gis kho'i

dpung par bcangs nas che gangs 'bum chus ni de sngon zing 'khrug gi rten gzhi yin pas khyod shi nga gson gyi gral rim 'thab rtsod rgyun du mthong rgyu yod pas langs phyogs brtan po dang dogs zon cher bskyed byed dgos/’ zhes yang yang mngag bya byas/ da dung thog tu na gral rim 'thab rtsod gtan nas brjed mi rung ’ zhes pa'i gser yig brkos pa'i lcags smyug sbom po zhig tshe brtan bkra shes la sprad nas rtsa 'dzugs pu'u krang gis las byed gsar pa der bcol ba'i re ba mtshon par byas/ gangs 'bum chus kyi yig skyel ba nag ril rkang btsugs nas tshe brtan bkra shis bsu ru yong / de ni rtsed mo dang kha mtshar la dga' ba'i pho gzhon kha gsangs po zhig red/ rta phor bcibs pa'i pho gzhon gnyis ri lam kha shas brgal rjes bde zhing yangs pa'i spang thang zhig tu 'byor/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyis rtswa thang thog skar tshogs ltar bkra ba'i zil pa phrum phrum gyi me tog dkar dmar dang thag ring ri bo'i ngos kyi ser ba bab pa lta bu'i grangs las 'das pa'i me tog dkar po'i tshogs la lta bzhin sems gting nas brjod mi shes pa'i spro ba zhig skyes pas kha nas rang dbang med par chung nas shes pa'i gna' snga mo'i 'brog glu zhig thal/nag ril ha las nas kha mig gnyis ka ches cher gdangs te/ na rgan lags/ deng skabs srid jus gsar pa yod dam/’ ca ga re'i srid jus gsar pa/ 6 spyi tshogs rnying pa'i glu len chog gi e red/’ 6 ga re/ de de/ len chog gi ma red/ nga da lta kha nor shor ba red/7tshe brtan bkra shes kha skyengs nas gdong pa dmar pheg phig tu gyur/zhe ngas gzhan la shod mi srid/ nga'ang 'brog skur dga'/ khos de mur 'brog glu chung chung zhig blangs/195

rta bdun gyi khri la bzhugs pa'i 'od dang snang ba'i dkyil 'khor de nub phyogs lhun po'i rtse nas yal zhing sa gzhi chen pos rim bzhin mun nag gi lu ring bklubs/ tshe brtan bkra shis dang nag ril chus thog la 'byor/ chus ud kyi hru'u cis tshe brtan bkra shis kyi lag pa dam du bcangs nas dga' snang chen pos 6 yag po byung / lo mang po snyan zhu phul rjes da lo gzhi nas drung yig cig byung ba red/ hru'u cis khong gnyis nang du khrid nas bza' zla la thab kyi dkyil nas sha phab tu bcug nas sne len byas/de nas tshe brtan bkra shis nag ril dang lhan du sdod dgos pa'i bkod sgrig byas pas de tshe brtan bkra shes blo la bab/ nyin gcig ring mnyam 'gro mnyam sdod byas pas khong gnyis blo mthun pa'i grogs por gyur ba red/zla 'od kyis brgyan pa'i dgong mo der/ tshe brtan bkra shes dang nag ril lhan du zang zing mi tshogs kyi khrod du bskyod/ de nyin 6 brgyad gcig ’ dmagashi dus chen yin pas yul dmag 'du sbyong byas stabs chus kyi sgo ra'i nang stag 'dra ba'i pho gzhon dang me tog 'dra ba'i mo gzhon gyis khengs/gzhon nu pho mo de dag khu sim med sdod ma thub par gsar brje'i nang don mtshon pa'i sgor gzhas gsar pa 'khrab bzhin mchis/ pho mo khag so sos gzhas res mos byed bzhin 'don/ bu mos/ 6 mo'o kru'u zhi med na nga tsho ga 'dra byed kyi red/ bus/ smyo mo'o kru'u zhi med na nga tsho shi kyi red/ nga tsho shi kyi red/ bu mos/ 6 gung khran tang med na nga tsho ga 'dra byed kyi red/ bus/ tsa gung khran tang med na nga tsho shi kyi red/ nga tsho shi kyi red/ bu mos/6 bcings 'grol dmag med na nga tsho ga 'dra byed kyi red/’ bus/66bcings 'grol dmag med na nga tsho shi kyi red/ nga tsho shi kyi red/’ gzhas tshig de dag tshe brtan bkra shis kyi rna bar nyan mi bde ba'i snang ba zhig ster bdi ༵༵ zur du langs pa'i nag ril la lta tsam gyis tsa shi kyi red/ shi kyi red/

snyan rgyu 'dug gam/’ zhes smras par nag ril gyis tshe brtan bkra shes la 'then tsam byas nas skad cha de dag shod mi nyan pa'i brda byas/ 'on te bshad tshar ba'i skad cha ni 'phos zin pa'i chu dang 'phangs zin pa'i mda' red/ skad cha de dag zur du langs pa'i chus kyi gnyer pa mig chung chung des go song bas kha nas de tsam mi mngon pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig bstan/ tshe brtan bkra shis nag ril gyi rkang rjes ded nas mi tshogs kyi khrod nas phar 'gro 'gro tshur yong yong byas/ mi tshogs kyis khong gnyis la lta/ bu mo kha shas kyis mig gi mda' mo khong gnyis la 'phen bzhin yid smon pa dang ngo tsha ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma bstan/ ngo ma/ de dus 6 byung na bcings 'grol dmag mi/ ma byung rgyal khab las byed/ 'brog pa rtsam khug stong pa/ yod dang ma yod mi 'dug ces pa'i dmangs gzhas gsar pa zhig gang sar khyab pas rgyal khab las byed du gyur pa'i tshe brtan bkra shis dang nag ril bcings 'grol dmag mi dang bsdur thabs med mod kyang las rgyu las za rgyu med pa'i 'brog pa dang bsduran yid dbang 'phrog tshad ldab mang pos che bas rang nyid kyi 'tsho bar 'gyur ldog yong re byed pa'i bu mo de tshos do snang chen po los byed/ nag ril spro ba rab tu rgyas la kha'ang btsum mi thub par mi tshogs kyi khrod du mig hrig hrig gis lta/ khos tshe brtan bkra shes 'gram du yod pa sngar nas brjed pa ltar bu mo cung mdzes pa gnyis kyi bar du 'tshangs nas sgor bro'i rdog sgra dang glu sgra'i khrod du thim/ tshe brtan bkra shes ci byed 'di byed ma rnyed pas nang du log nas nyal khri'i thog la hrengs nas bsdad/ khang pa'i gyang ldebs la tshags par sha stag sbyar ba dang da dung ma'o tse tung dmag chas gyon pa'i lcags kyi dpar zhig kyang bkal 'dug khang pa chung chung de'i nang la nyal khri gnyis dang / snod chas kha shas/ 'bru rigs phran tsam las gzhan gyi rgyu nor ci'ang ma mchis/ khang pa'i zur gcig la lci ba spung / tshe brtan bkra shis kyi 17snam

blo ni rgya zhig pa'i snal ma ltar mgo mjug dang go rim mi shes par gyur nas yid la mi 'khor dgu 'khor byung / dus yun ring po phyin kyang nag ril da dung log mkhan med par tshe brtan bkra shis gnyid du yur/ myur du rmi lam gyi lam sne zin/ za ri zi ri'i rmi lam gyi khrod du nag ril log nas nyal ba tshor tsam byung / zhogs pa'i skya rengs kyi gsal mda' phran bu des sge'u khung nas dkar cha phran bu ster ba'i dus der/ tshe brtan bkra shis hob ste gnyid sad/yar langs nas sgo 'gram du rgyug rgyug byed du 'gro snyam/ de ni slob grwa'i skabs nas chags pa'i goms srol zhig yin/ khos glog bzhu spar nas 'od nag ril gyi thog la rgyag dus bsam yul las 'das pa zhig mig mdun du shar/nag ril bu mo zhig dang lhan du nyal 'dug khong gnyis ga'i khog stod phyi ru thon/ bu mo des nag ril gyi brang thog tu bsnyes pa dang / nag ril gyis mo pang du blangs 'dug gnyis ka gnyid dang bde bas bzi nas tshor snang ci'ang mi 'dug tshe brtan bkra shis la skyug bro ba'am yang na shod mi shes pa'i snang ba zhig skyes pas myur du phyir thon/shar ri'i rtse nas 'phags pa'i rta bdun dbang po'i 'od snang 'bum phrag dus gcig la rtswa thang du spros pas rtswa rtse'i zil pa re nas chem chem gyi 'od snang re 'tsher/ tshe brtan bkra shis rang byung khams chen po'i mdzes dpal gyis yid dbang 'phrog pa'am yang na da nang mthong ba'i gnas tshul gyis kha skyengs pa gang yin mi shes kyang kho da dung khang pa'i nang log mi 'dod/de dus nag ril mgo shig 'brad bzhin slebs 'dug rgan lags a grogs po/ khong khro za ba ma red dam/’ 6 nga tsho tshang ma rgyal khab kyi las byed yin pas de 'dra byas na/ ’6 hru'u ci la'ang dngos su khas len byas pa'i nal phrug drug yod/ de la/ 78 bu mo de dang mnyam du sdod rtsis yin pas/7

66red/ ma gzhi ngas de zer gyi med/mi khong gnyis nang du log de dus bu mo de gar song mi 'dugade nas cung ma 'gor bar/ hru'u ci yong nas tshe brtan bkra shis spang gzhung du 'khyam 'khyam du khrid/zi khyod kyis 6shi kyi red ces pa snyan rgyu mi 'dug ces bshad pa e na/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis ci'ang lan ma btab par bsdad kyang don du khas len byas pa yin/66de 'dra zer mi nyan/ rdzong ud kyi wang hru'u cis gzhas tshig yag po 'dug ces bsngags brjod byed myong / chab srid kyi thog nas bltas na langs phyogs kyi gnad don red/ rjes su nges par du gzab gzab byed dgos/ chus thog tu las ka ci'ang mi 'dug pas nyin ltar dus tshod 'gro thabs byed rgyu las gzhan med/ nyin gcig nag ril gyis tshe brtan bkra shis la yi ge bslab rogs zer bas de nas nyin rtag par nag ril la yi ge bslab nas durdzu tshod 'das/ nag ril lo na gzhon la rig pa rno bas yar rgyas shin tu ma gar+sha/nas zla ba gcig gi rjes su hru'u cis tshe brtan bkra shis dar dmar kung hre'i ru khag gnyis par gsham bskyod byas nas yig cha gsar pa brgyud bsgrags byed dgos pa'i bkod sgrig byas/ de'i dgong mo tshe brtan bkra shis dang nag ril dar dmar kung hre'i gnas tshul bshad nas yun ring bsdad/nag ril gyis dar dmar kung hrer cha rgyus chen po 'dug dar dmar kung hre ni de sngon gyi rdo dkar kung hre la ming gsar btags nas byung ba red/ kung hre 'di chus 'di'i sa thag ring shos kyi kung hre zhig yin zhing sa bab mtho ba'i 'brog sa skad grags can zhig kyang yin/ kung hre'i kri pu'u hru'u ci ༵ /ma

dang ru khag gnyis pa'i tud krang tshe ring thar red/ tshe brtan bkra shes dang nag ril do dgong las lhan du 'dzoms pa'i skal ba med bzhin skad cha shod rgyu kho nar mgo 'khor nas nam dkyil du slobs pa yang ma tshor/ ngo ma/ blo kha mthun pa'i grogs po'i bar sngar nas shod mi tshar ba'i skad cha yod/ 6 da lta nyal dgos ma red dam/ tsa red/ ngas mngag rgyu zhig yod/ rta nag ril ngo tsha ba'am shod mi bde ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan/6 shod dang / nam mkhar 'phur nas zla ba 'dzin rgyu dang rgya mtshor 'dzul nas rus sbal bzung rgyu min na ngas snang dag mi dgos/’ 6 khyod kyi yid la e dran/ khyod 'dir slebs nyin gyi dgong mo/ 6 a'o/ ha ha ha/ chags sred kyi 'khrab ston byas pa de e/’ 6 bu mo de dar dmar ru khag gnyis par yod/ ming la gsar brje mtsho mo zer/ ngas mo la yi ge zhig bskur rgyu yod/ 6 snang dag mi dgos/ yi ge khyer shog nag ril gyis stod gos khug ma'i nang nas yi ge bton nas che mos yi ge mi shes pas grogs pos rna 'gram du klog rogs/ tsa ya/ ngas lta tsam byed dgos/ a tsi/ 'dod gzhas/ dug rtsa min nam/ nag ril lce snar tsam byas/6 rtsed mo yin/ ngas 'phrod nges byed chog yin na/ mo ni su tshang gi bu mo sdodakhu/ming tsi tshang gi ba mo/’ smyo khung tsi e/ lo thos stong sngon gyi rang gcun lugs gso byed mkhan de ma /tshe dam/

6 yang na/ ngas khyod la gtam snyan po zhig shod dgos/ de ni lin dgag khung dgag byas ma thag red/ tud krang tshe ring thar gyis chogs par gyi thog nas khung tsi la dgag pa rgyag dgos pa'i rtsom yig cig mthong / khos rtsom de'i nang don hril po mgo mjug 'brel nas go ba ci'ang ma lon yang don gyi rdog kha ni khung tsi la dgag pa tsha nan rgyag dgos yod pa shes/ de mur khos ru khag gi yul dmag bskongs nas rang re'i ru khag gi khung tsi (don du gsar brje'i mtsho mo'i pha red )bzung nas 'thab rtsod brgyab/ ngo ma/ khung tsis kyang ma ṇi 'don myong / khung tsi'ang skrag nas bla 'dar/ rang nyid kyi las ngan krung dbyang nas kyang ha go dus ci la mi skrag khung tsis nyin rtag par 'brog dbul 'brog 'bring 'og ma'i ya nga snying rje med pa'i 'thab rtsod gzed/nyin gcig tud krang tshe ring thar gyis tshags par gyi ngos nas bsam yul las ring du 'das pa'i ched brjod cig mthong bas kho'i ngo mdog rbad de logached brjod de'i 'go brjod ni 〈〈khung tsi mo si kho la 'dug 〉〉ces pa de red/tshe ring thar gyis myur du tshogs 'du bskongs nas tshags par du dgag pa rgyag sa'i khung tsi de su'u len gyi mo si kho la yod ces bshad 'dug pas nga tsho'i khung ṭ+wāṃ la dgag pa rgyag nor byas 'dug ces khyab bsgrags byas nas khung tsi la dag la byazlo /brtan bkra shis dang nag ril sngar bzhin gtam gleng lhug po smra bzhinaganas/ blo mthun pa'i gtam gleng gi bar nas yid spro ba'i dgod sgra lhang lhang grags/skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i mkha' dbyings su nam smad du shar ba'i /the sna rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis mig gi bung ba kem kem gyis 201
