gnyis/tshe brtan bkra shis dar dmar kung hre'i ru khag gnyis par 'byor rjes/tud krang tshe ring thar gyi nang du bsdad/ tshe ring thar bza' tsho gnyis la ming sring gnyis yod pa las bu de lo nyi shu dang bu mo de lo bco brgyad la slobs/ bu mo des tshe brtan bkra shes la ja yang yang bkyag cing mig gi zur mda' yang yang 'phen/ bar du tshe brtan bkra shis dang kha brda byed sa e rnyed lta/ mo'i mgo la dmag zhwa ser po gyon pa dang de'i thog dmar 'od chem chem gyi skar ma rtse lnga zhig btags 'dug de ni 'brog pa'i bu mos skabs der ches mdzes shos la brtsi ba'i zhwa mo zhig yin pas dus la bstun pa'i dar srol zhig red/dgong mo gsal la mi gsal ba'i bzhu mar la brten nas tshogs 'du rgyag cing slob sbyong byed pa las tshe brtan bkra shes nyin mo ha lam las ka byed rgyu mi rnyed/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis bar gseng zhig btsal nas gsar brje mtsho mor nag ril gyi yi ge sprad/ mdza' glu de yig 'bru re re bzhin gsar brje mtsho mo'i rna 'gram du bskyal/ 66bya khu byug gsung skad snyan mo ma/ khyed med na dus bzhi'i dbye ba med/ bya gzhan dag med le ma red de/ bya gzhan gyi skad ngo chod le min/ gsar brje mtsho mos ngo tsha ba'i rnam 'gyur 'ga' bstan rjes mos kyang mdza' glu zhig blangs nas tshe brtan bkra shis la yig lam du bkod rogs zhes bshad/ 6 bya khu byug skye sa nags la red/ sems dkar mo'i gtad sa spang la yin/ nags tshang tshing mi skyid ma red de/ spang sngon mo nged gnyis sngon las red/ mices bya'o/tshe brtan bkra shis kyis tud krang la nyin ltar las med du bsdad na ngal rtsoX ༵ dmangs dang 'brel 'dris yong dka' bas lug rdzi dang mnyam du

phyugs 'tsho ru 'gro gi yin zhes bshad/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs dang kha bral ba'i las byed ni chu dang bral ba'i nya mo yin lugs nan bshad byas/6 'grig dang 'grig 'on kyang deng skabs kyi lug rdzi 'brog bdag gi bu mo disade pa zlo/ me da/’ tshe brtan bkra shes zhogs pa snga po langs nas lug dzi 'gro rgyur sgugakho'i sems nang sngar med kyi dga' ba rgyas/ lo bcu grangs nang byed ma myong ba'i bya ba de slar yang byed dus sems nang brjod mi shes pa'i snang ba zhig rgyas/ sked par 'ur btags 'dzer ba'i tshe brtan bkra shes lug khyu'i 'gram du 'byor zhing rogs pa 'brog bdag gi bu mo der kha brda byas/ de dus tud krang tshe ring thar gyis 'brog bdag gi bu mo de zur du khrid nas skad cha mang du bshad song /nyin byed dbang po'i 'od snang 'bum phrag gis sa gzhi ma lus lhug por brgyan dus lug ri steng du slobs/ tshe brtan bkra shes gzhi nas dal du phab khom byung bas rang nyid kyi phyugs 'tsho rogs 'brog bdag gi bu mo gser skyid la zhib tu lta khom byung / ngo gdong gor gor bco lnga'i dung zla'i rjes la 'gro zhing / mig gnyis ni ri mtho sa gtsang gi chu mig gnyis ltar dwangs gtsang zhing / dmar srab mchu sgros gsar du zhal kha bzhad pa'i me tog gi 'dab ma ltar mngon la de ru brjod mi shes pa'i bsru brid cig ldan/ tshe brtan bkra shis cung tsam ring las byed pa'i nyams shor nas hon thor te 'dam sku ltar lupa pa'i gnas tshul dag gser skyid kyis tshor bas mo mgo gug nas kha phar ba ra/tsa sdod dang / skad cha shod dang / mi gser skyid kyis ci'ang ma thos pa ltar khu sim mer bsdad/ mig gnyis dogs zon chen pos lug rgya~X nigro

phyogs la lta/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyis rang nyid kyi mdun du bsdad pa'i bu mo 'di phyags dzi yag po zhig yin nges red snyam/ da dung mo la 'di lta bu'i rang bzhirno gyi sgeg chos ldan dus gal srid mo ni dbul phongs kyi bu mo yin na pho gzhon kun gyis hab thob rgyag sa'i gnas la 'gyur nges red snyam/ de nas tshe brtan bkra shis kyis mo'i khyim gyi gnas tshul 'ga' dris kyang mos red dang ma red kyi don mtshon pa'i mgo bo kyog tsam dang mgo bo g.yug tsam las ci'ang mi smra/ smyo phyugs 'tsho dus nged gnyis la gral rim gyi dbye ba 'byed mi dgos/ gser skyid 'dzum tsam byas/ de ni yid dbang 'phrog pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig red la mos yun ring btsal ba'i 'dzum mdangs shig yin te phyogs zhen med pa'i 'dra mnyam gyi nyi 'od 'og tu 'tsho zhing rol rgyu ni mo'i rmi lam nang las mi thob pa'i 'tsho ba de yin/6 yang na/ khyod dud tshang ga 'dra zhig gi mna' mar 'gro 'dod/ gser skyid kyis lan ci'ang mi 'debs/2 ya/ shod dang / 66de/ nga tsho 'byung khungs yag po med pas su la mkho/ de las/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis mo la snying rje drag po zhig ngang du skyes/ tshang ma pha ma'i gces phrug yin na gcig pa/ nyi 'od kyi 'og dang rtswa thang gi thog tu 'tsho ba rol mkhan gcig pa/ kho tsho zur du bkar nas mthong chung byed dgos don gang yin nam/ de sngon mgar ba dang shan pa sogs kyi rigs la mthong chung byed pa yid la 'khor/ skye sa la gdam kha byed pa'i nus pa su la yod/ de dus tshe brtan bkra shes kyis rigs rgyud smra ba'i gzab chung las brgal nas rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam gyi bar snang du ci dgar 'phur bar 'dod/20/ ltar tshe brtan bkra shes nyin ltar gser skyid mnyam du mnyam 'gro

mnyam sdod dang mnyam za mnyam 'thung byas pas khong gnyis bar brjod mi shes pa'i 'brel ba zhig chags/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyis gser skyid kyi bal ltar 'jam pa'i gshes ka dang sus kyang do zla mi thub pa'i mdzes chos la bcos min gyi 'dun pa zhig ngang du skyes/ de nyin khong gnyis spang spug der bsdad nas tshe brtan bkra shes kyis khyer ba'i bag leb zos/tsa zhim po 'dug gam/’ gser skyid mgo bo kyog kyog gis bkra shis la 'dzum tsam byas/tshe brtan bkra shes mig hrig ger gser skyid la bltas nas 6 mi tshe gcig 'di 'dra za e 'dod/’ gser skyid kyis ci'ang ma go ba ltar byas nas bsdad/tshe brtan bkra shes kyi sems gting nas sa 'og nas nam mkhar 'gyur ba'i tsha rlabs lta bu'i brtse dung gi rba rlabs shig drag tu 'phyur bas khos gser skyid kyis ngal rtsol brgyab nas mkhregs por gyur pa'i lag 'go dam du bcangs/ de nas dbugs had bzhin mo dang nye bar bcar/6 min/ ma byed/ nga 'brog bdag gi bu mo/ de nyin tud krang gis nga la las don mi sna bslu brid byas na 'gro sa dmyal ba las med ces gsungs byung /mi gser skyid skrag nas ngo mdog thal skyar gyur/6 / sdo rdzun/ dang po phyugs 'tsho ru yong dus/7tshe brtan bkra shis de mur tud krang gis gser skyid zur du khrid pa'i gnas tshul yid la shar bas bya byed mang ba'i tud krang der spyir btang min pa/ khod khro zhig langs/ 6 khyed rang la 'dod pa yod na su la'ang skrag mi da sa/6/ ngas khyed kyi mdun lam med pa bzo yong /’ 205

6 khyed kyis nga la yin ches byos/’ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis slar yang gser skyid kyi lag 'go dam du bcangs nas mo'i 'gram pa'i thog la ga ler 'o zhig skyel/ gser skyid kyi mig gnyis nas bde skyid kyi mchi ma lam lam 'tsher/dgong mo phyugs rigs lhas la brgyab nas phyir log dus/ tud krang gi bu mos sha khu bskol nas kho sgug 'dug tud krang yang myur du langs nas tshe brtan bkra shes kyi sdod sar bzo skyor byas/ de ni dus rgyun rang nyid sdod sa'i thab 'gram der red/6 de ring chus thog nas lan slebs 'dug khyed myur du log shog ces bshad 'dug ’smyo ye red/’ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis tud krang tshe ring thar gyi thog la langs pa'i khong khro da dung 'jags med/8 ru khag nas sha mar nyo dgos na nyo rgyu yod/ 8 min/ nga tshos mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu las mi dmangs kyi khur po ljid du gtong mi chog tshe brtan bkra shes kyis tud kung la kha ngan zhig brgyab/6 da dung zhu rgyu zhig gda'/ bsod bkra'i pha shi nas nyin gsum red/da dung ro phyir bton ma song / gang byed kyi yod dam/ mang tshogs la bsam 'char 'dug 6 ga re'i bsam 'char/ kho rang gi pha ro nyar bar bsam 'char ci yod/galasrid khyed tshos za dgos yod na sha rul gyi red ces bshad na 'grig za ni mi dgos/ der jus gtogs med/mi tshe brtan bkra shis kyis rlung 'tshub 'tshub kyis de ltar smras/6 lags so/ tud krang tshe ring thar gyi ngo mdog de tsam mdzes rgyu med padī ///

dgong mo tshe brtan bkra shis gur dkar po de'i nang du log zla ba'i 'od snang gis gur nang du gsal lhang lhang du bzos/ khos ji ltar btsan gyis gnyid khug thabs byas kyang gtan nas gnyid mi 'gro/ gser skyid kyi mchi zhag 'khor ba'i 'dren byed zung dang khu byug gi mgrin pa'i lam las thon 'dra'i skad gdangs dag yid la 'khor/ 'gog thabs med pa'i bsru brid kyis bskul bas tshe brtan bkra shis kyis gral rim gyi langs phyogs zhes pa'i nyin ltar 'brug ltar grags pa'i skad cha dag lhag med du brjed nas bar thag mi ring ba'i gur chung shel gyi pho brang lta bu de'i phyogs su song / gser skyid ni lug khyu'i 'gram gyi gur chung de'i nang nyal yod/gser skyid kyang nyin gyi bya ba dag yid la 'khor nas gnyid ma khug par bsdad 'dug tshe brtan bkra shis mo'i sngas 'gram du bsdad nas rang nyid sang nyin log gi yod pa'i gnas tshul bshad/gser skyid kyi mig chu phrum phrum du 'bab bzhin smyo yag byung / nga la khyed nang bzhin yag po byed mkhan thug ma myong / zhes shod bzhin mchi mas mgrin pa brnangs/ de nas mos tshe brtan bkra shes kyi lag gnyis rang nyid kyi brang thog la sbyar/ rim bzhin gzhon nu pho mo gnyis kyi lus sems ma lus 'o chu skyutā spra/ hā chipadres/ gur chung de'i nang bde skyid kyi 'khun sgra las gzhan nam smad tshe brtan bkra shis rang nyid kyi gur chung nang log nas nyal bar bcoms pa na/ kho'i nyal sar nag sgong sgong zhig bsdad 'dug cung tsam min na tshe brtan bkra shis kyi glo snying lkog mar don/6 nga yin/ snoni tud krang gi bu mo'i skad gdangs red/6 a wa de/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis ci shod ma rnyed pas had de lus/6 rgan lags da lta ga par song ba yin/ 207

//sdu/sna pā btang du/ 6 ma gzhi de khyod la jus gtogs med/’ na 'brog bdag bu mo las nga drag gi red/ nga khrid 'gro rogs/’ 6 smyo lab ma shod/ 6 sku mkhyen/ ngas mi tshe gcig khyed la zhabs phyi byed chog 6 yong gi ma red/ khyod da lta log song / nga nyal gyi yin/ tshe brtan bkra shes nyal gzan gyis mgo btums nas nyal/ tud krang gi bu mo skad shugs dma' pos ngu bzhin bsdad/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyi glo snying 'bus zos pa ltar sems zang zing bzos kyang rna bar mdzub mo brgyab nas bsdad/ nam langs ran kha tud krang gi bu mo gzhi nas log song / khos bu mo de las bka' drin tshor ba'am der snying rje zhig skyes kyang thabs shes gang hā/ ཿr+sha kān byed thabs bral/ lhag par du de lta bu'i gnas tshul 'og ci'ang gsum/tshebartan bkra shis chus thog la 'byor dus/ hru'u cis nye char yig cha 'bri rgyu yod pas khyed log shog zer bshad pa yin zhes smras/ tshe brtan bkra shis yig cha 'bri rgyur mgo 'khor nas nyin du ma 'das/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyi rig gnas chu tshad cung mtho ba ma zad/ rtsom 'bri nus rtsal yang mi dman pas rig gnas chu tshad ha cang dma' ba'i chus ud kyi hru'u ci de'i blor 'bab pa'i rtsom yig 'bri thub/ hru'u cis khos bris pa'i yig cha de dag bltas rjes dpa /8 mgu nas kho la tang nang du zhugs rgyu'i zhu yig bris shog ces bshad pa

mazad/ rjes su gsham bskyod du yong ba'i rdzong gi 'go khrid kyi mdun la tshe brtan bkra shes la bsngags brjod byas/nyin zhig nag ril dang tshe brtan bkra shes ri dwags rgyag tu song / tshe brtan bkra shis kyis de sngon gsham bskyod skabs nag ril gyi mngag bya legs par bsgrubs pas nag ril gyis tshe brtan bkra shes la yongs su yid ches byed/khong gnyis ni snying nye ba'i grogs por gyur/ khong gnyis gangs kyi dbu zhwa mchod pa'i ri rtse dang / shing glang ma dang su ru/ spen ne sogs tshang tshing du skyes pa'i spang gseb bcas gang sar rkang pa na na phyin kyang ri dwags kyi rkang rjes kyang ma rnyed/ de nas khong gnyis brag khug cig tu bsdad nas ja bskol te lto bzas pa dang gtam gleng la mgo 'khor nas bsdad/ nag ril gyis myur du gsar brje mtsho mo mna' mar len 'dod byed/ da dung tshe brtan bkra shis la gnyen sgrig gi snyan zhu zhig 'bri rogs zhes bshad/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyis rang nyid de sngon gser skyid dang byung ba'i gnas tshul bshad pa dang mo mna' mar len rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod lugs bshad/ nag ril ngo mdog shin tu mi mdzes par gyur nas yud tsam kha ma grags par bsdad rjes 6 gtan nas ༷grig pyi ma red/ 'brog bdag gi bu mo/ khyod kyi mdun lam brlag rgyu da 6 sna /shā tā/sam blo btang tshar ba yin/ ci red na de red/ tsa gal srid khyed bu mo de dang 'bral thabs med na lo shas sgug na/ 6 lo shas sgug na ci phan/76 srid jus 'dra 'gyur ba song na/7 nag ril gyis rang nyid skad cha'i tshabs che'i rang bzhin drin nas lce snar tsam byas te skad kyi phreng ba'i rgyun de mur ba/sna /ril gyi kha la nyan pas tshe brtan bkra shes kyi mdun lam ni 'onā byer

stong dang ldan pa zhig tu mngon/ lo gcig ma 'gor bar kho rang tang nang du gsar bsdu byas pa ma zad chus ud kyi u yon la bsko bzhag byas/ hru'u ci rdzong thog tu tshogs 'dur 'gro dus kho lhan du khrid nas rdzong gi 'go khrid gtso bo rnams la ngo sprod byas pas tshe brtan bkra shis ni sbra stod rdzong du gsar du thon pa'i kun gyis do snang chen po byed pa'i chab srid kyi skar gsar zhig tu gyur/ wang hru'u cis kyang rtsa 'dzugs pu'u kung la tshe brtan bkra shis ni gso skyong gi mdun lam chen po yod pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pa gcig red ces shod myong / rdzong thog tu 'gro rim bzhin bu mo mang pos kho la yid mos pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa ma zad/ rdzong gi 'go khrid mang pos kyang kho la bu mo yag po zhig ngo sprod byed dgos zhes bshad/ lhag par du rdzong gsar brje u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa o lo bkra shes kyis dus rgyun kho la shin tu mthong chen byed pa dang kho'i gnyen sgrig gi gnad don thad de bas kyang mthong chen byed/nyin zhig o lo bkra shis kyis tshe brtan bkra shis rang khyim du za ma za bar khrid/ de dus/ o lo bkra shis kyi nang mi phud pa'i da dung bu mo gcig kyang 'dug tshe brtan bkra shis kyis mo ni rdzong rgyang bsgrags 'bab tshugs nas yin pa shes kyi yod/ bu mo des tshe brtan bkra shis mthong ma thag ngo tsha smin pos 'dzum tsam byas/ za ma za skabs kyang bu mo des rang nyid la yang yang lta gi yod pa tshe brtan bkra shes kyis tshor yang khos snang med ltar bsdad/de'i dgong mo o lo bkra shes kyis tshe brtan bkra shes rdzong 'gram gyi sbra chu'i gzhung du 'khyam 'khyam du khrid///sna /shu py-i tram̐ ga tshod yin/’ 21rā lo chung zlong ma red/ nag mo zhig btsal ran 'dug7

tshe brtan bkra shis kyis 'dzum tsam dang mgo shig 'brad tsam byas/ ngo ma/ khos dpon nyams phran tsam med pa'i mi rigs gcig pa'i 'go khrid 'dir sems gting nas gus bkur byed/64nga'i nang gi bu mo de ga 'dra 'dug nga'i bza' zla'i 'og ma red/’ 6 min/ nga chang sa rgyag rtsis med/ 8 ga re/ grwa pa byed kyis e/ bu mo de blo ma song ba red/ //shā bye/ /na/da dngos gnas chang sa rgyag rtsis med/’ 6 de/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis ci gang lan rgyag rgyu ma rnyed/ha lam khong gi bsam yul las 'das pa 'dra/ o lo kru'u ren rlung 'tshub 'tshub kyis log song / tshe brtan bkra shes hon thor nas bsdad/ glog shing thog tu bab pa'i sol ba'i mdog 'dzin pa'i pho rog des kho'i phyogs la ru kog kog ces pa'i sgra yang yang 'byin nas dga' spro'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyi sems gting nas ming 'dogs dka' ba'i khro ba zhig rgyas pas pho rog der rdo brgyab pas pho rog nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur zhing glog shing thog gi dkar yol de dum bu du mar bzos/6 wa ye/ ga re byed kyi yod/ chu glog bab tshugs kyi bzo pa rgad po des sna thog la zag pa'i mig shel bkyag tsam bkyag tsam byas nas yong zhing ngo mdog rdza ri ltar nag po chags 'dug6 rlung rta chag 'dug tshe brtan bkra shes kyi kha nas de ltar thal/6 ga re/ rlung rta mi 'dug rgyal khab kyi rgyu nor la gtor bshig spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gyang rtsa sngog mkhan/’ 6 ngas nor song / pho rog la rdo brgyab kyang /mi 6 'gro/ rdzong gi 'go khrid 'tshol du 'gro/ 211

6 rgan lags/ de 'dra ma gsung rogs/ ngas skyin tshab sprad chog 6 yong gi ma red/ de ring khyod skyag pa shor shor zhig bzo gi yin/’ las khungs nang 'dzul nas da bar/ tshe brtan bkra shis la 'di lta bu'i rnam 'gyur ngan pa thug ma myong / tshe brtan bkra shes yud tsam kha sha 'dar nas skad cha ma thon par lus/6 khyod las khungs gang nas yin/’ bzo pa god po des tshe brtan bkra shes glo bur du bros rgyur skrag nas kho'i dpung pa nas bzung / de tshe brtan bkra shis la dran skul byas pa ltar byung bas kho bros rgyu yid la 'khor/ sems la rgad po 'dis rang nyid kyi las khungs kyang ma shes pas bros na thar nges red snyam/ des na tshe brtan bkra shes kyis de mur rgan po 'dis mig shel med na ci gang mi mthong zhes pa'i skad cha yid la dran pas ma lag 'khyug pos /da po'i mig shel phud nas sa 'bol sa zhig tu 'phangs rjes bya 'phur ba ltar sa/ nyin shas kyi rjes/ tshe brtan bkra shis chus thog tu log khos glog shing gi dkar yol bcag pa sus kyang ma shes/chus thog tu slebs dus/ nag ril gyis gsar brje mtsho mo bsus nas bsdad 'dug chus nas kyang khong gnyis la zur du khang pa sprad pas khong gnyis khrims mthun gyi bza' tshang la gyur zin pa gdon mi za/ tshe brtan bkra shis thad kur nag ril gyi khang pa'i nang du 'dzul/ nag ril bza' tsho gnyis las med pas thog mar gser skyid kyi gnas tshul dris/ chore sa 'brog bdag tshang gi bu mo gser skyid e/ de sngon bu zhig skyes pa da/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyi ngo mdog rbad de 'gyur ba smos med kyang gsar brdo /sna mos der do snang gtan nas mi byed par mu mthud nas bshad don/

6 ru khas nas phru gu'i pha su yin gyi skad cha tsha 'dri byas kyang mo la pha ston rgyu mi 'dugatshe brtan bkra shis kyis gser skyid kyis rang nyid la bcangs pa'i gangs dkar gyi sems dang zol med kyi brtse dung la tshor snang drag po byung nas mig rtsar mchi mas brlan/gsar brje mtsho mos tshe brtan bkra shis kyi rnam 'gyur la blta tsam yang mi byed par da dung bshad don/ 6 brjed pa red/ bu mo zhig gis khyod la ca lag cig bskur byung /’ 6 sus/ gser skyid kyis e/’ 6 ga par ga par/ khyod kyi sems gting la gdeng tshod los yod/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyis myur du tud krang gi bu mo min nam snyam yang kha nas lha dngos gnas shes ma song /’ zhes bshad/6 tudabakrangagegi bumo /lhamo/’ 66mos nga la ca lag bskur ba gang yin nam/’ gsar brje mtsho mos dpog dka' ba'i 'dzum mdangs shig bstan nas gzhan gyi gtam ma smras kyang don kun der 'dus par byas/ca lag ni bal skud kyis bslas pa'i stod gos shig red/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyi mgo la glo bur du rdo gzhus pa ltar tham me thom me bzos pas kho mgo bo smad nas nag ril spos zin pa'i khang chung de'i nang du log nag ril med pas byas pa'am yang na rgyu mtshan gzhan gyis rkyen pas khang pa chung chung de skyi g.ya' ba'i stong seng du mngon/ gyang thog tu sbyar ba'i shog bu dang par thams cad tshe srog gi rgyun chad pa ltar ser por gyur pas thug tsam byas na ser ga du ma 'byung / tshe brtan bkra shes kyi yid kyi me long gi ngos su gser skyid kyi mchi mas brlan pa'i mig chen po gnyis dang mo'i da dung pha med pa'i bu ༵ snal

wal du shar/ rang nyid kyis bsnyal ba'i chang rang nyid kyis btung mi phod pa skyes pa pho'i khyad chos ga la yin/ sus kyang zur lta byed mkhan med pa'i dus der yang tshe brtan bkra shis kyi ngo mdog dmar kyang du gyur/ kho da dung mu mthud blo bag phebs kyis sdod thabs bral bas shog bu blangs nas gser skyid dang gnyen sgrig byed rgyu'i snyan zhu 'bri 'go brtsams/ thams cad sba gsang med par shog bu dkar po'i ngos su yi ge'i ri mor bkod/tshe brtan bkra shis kyis snyan zhu 'khyer nas hru'u ci'i sgo dal bur brdung /smyo yar shog hru'u cis lug sha lag pa zhig za bzhin mchis pas sgyu rtsal mkhas pas sgra snyan gtong bzhin pa ltar snang /snye hru'u ci/ nga 'dir snyan zhu zhig yod/’ 6 ga re red/’ hru'u cis snyan zhu tshur blangs nas bltas/ yud tsam song rjes bltas tshar ba'i snyan zhu zur du bzhag nas mig ldir nas tshe brtan bkra shis la bltas/ 6 ngas mi lta nor byas pa red dam/ khyod tang nang du ngo sprod byed mkhan nga red/’ hru'u ci'i gdong pa nas blo pham pa'am yid phangs pa'i mas// hā/ sna/ tā/bas med/’ 6 khyod shod mi dgos/ gtan nas 'grig gi ma red/’ 6 nga 'di las thabs shes med/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyis da lta rang bshad pa'i skad cha de slar yang bskyar bzlos byas/66'grig gi ma red/ ngas khyed kyi mdun lam la 'gan 'khur dgos/ma gzhi mos nal phrug de'i pha khyod yin zhes ma bshad pas su yin ci shes/ngas gnas tshul 'di kun la gsang ba byed chog khyed kyis snyan zhu 'di lcags thab nang g.yug 21rdo min/ nga gser skyid dang mnyam du sdod rgyu'i blo thag rdo bzhin bcad

tshar/ mo ni bu mo yag po gser 'dra po zhig red/ 8 ga par/ son ga 'dra zhig btab na 'bras bu de 'dra zhig skye/ 6 chog mchan sprad rogs/ nga'i bsam blo la 'gyur ba 'gro mi srid/’ 8 gal srid khyod g.yang sa nas rta kha gcu thabs med na rang shi yin mod/nga la'ang chog mchan sprod pa'i dbang cha med/’ hru'u ci rab tu khros nas mgo thog gi rgya zhwa ser po de g.yug nas khang pa'i nang du phar 'gro tshur 'gro 'ga' byas/ smyo khyod log rgyug ngas rdzong la snyan zhu byed chog nyin gnyis par hru'u ci rdzong thog tu song /ri chen gyi grib so gug tshar ba'i dus der/ nag ril gyis 6tsanga'i zhwa mo der lus e gda'/mi zhes skad shugs chen pos 'bod bzhin tshe brtan bkra shis kyi khang chung nang 'dzul/6 ga re'i zhwa mo/ nag ril gyis skad chung tsam byed dgos pa'i lag brda byas pa dang kho'i rna 'gram du shub shub kyis 6 mdang dgong chus kyi las byed pa tshang ma tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas hru'u cis khyod kyi gnas tshul bshad song / de ring gong thog tu snyan seng zhu ru song / chus thog nas khyod la dogs zon byed dgos zer/gzab gzab gyis ang /’ nag ril gyis tshe brtan bkra shis kyi lag 'go 'chang 'chang byas nas log song / des tshe brtan bkra shes la mtsho ltar zab pa'i grogs po'i la rgya zhig tshor snang byung bas kho'i mig rtsa mchi mas brlan zhing lus po tsha 'ur 'ur byas/nyin shas kyi rjes la hru'u ci chus thog tu phyir log khos myur du chus kyi las byed kyi tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas rdzong gi gtan 'bebs khyab bsgrags byas/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyi chus ud u yon gyi go sa phab rgyu dang / tang nas phyir 'bud kyis rdzong phag gso khang la las bsgyur bya rgyu/ da dung rjes ༵ snang

wen ge zhes pa'i ming yang spyod mi chog pa bcas red/tshogs 'du grol rjes tshe brtan bkra shes kyis hru'u ci btsal nas rang nyid dang gser skyid chang sa rgyag chog min gyi skad cha dris/6 rdzong dbu khrid kyis khyod skyob ched chog mchan thob ma song / 66de ga 'dra yin nam/’ tshe brtan bkra shis kyi mig nas mchi ma'i char rgyun lhung lhung du bab cing sems pham pa'i byis pa zhig ltar ngus/hru'u cis rang nyid kyi mdun du langs pa'i mchi mas tshos pa'i pho gzhon der lta bzhin snying rje'i tsha rlabs shig ngam ngam shugs kyis 'phyur bas mgo g.yug g.yug 'ga' byas nas 66nga la'ang thabs shes mi 'dug ngas 'di ltar thag gcod byas dus chang sa rgyag rgyu mos mthun byas na zhes bshad kyang o ༵ kru'u ren gyis gtan nas 'grig gi ma red zer/ nga la'ang skyon brjod nan gna~X byedis / rje che/ tshe brtan bkra shes khu sim pos rang nyid kyi khang chung nang log nas gnyid dang bral ba'i mtshan mo zhig bsus/ ngo ma/ gnyid kyi lha mos kyang chab srid kyi dgos mkho dang bstun pa ltar tshe brtan bkra shes kher rkyang du bskyur/ dgong mo hril po gnyid ja yun tsam yang ma khug khos 'u thug nas bzhu mar spar te ja tsha po bzos/ 'on te ja la bro ba ci'ang ma mchis/dus rgyun chu grang mo btung yang de las ldab brgyas zhim/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis bzhu mar phu brgyab ste sgo 'gram du 'khyam 'khyam byed bsam/ sgo phyes pas sge'u khung gi 'gram nas mi zhig hob ste bros song / grib gzugs la lta dus jus gtogs can gyi gnyer pa de 'dra/ tshe brtan bkra shis la lta rtog byed mkhan yin nges red/ tshe brtan bkra shes kyi 'khyam 'khyam byed 'dod kyi blo de mur med par gyur pas gcin pa zhig btang rjes khang chung nang 'dzul/'gyu/ /ka' ba'i mtshan mo de dbugs cha re re bzhin gyis zad/

bzhi/tshe brtan bkra shis kyis dga' ba'i rmi lam dang skyi g.ya' ba'i bar chad kun gangs 'bum gyi ri klung la bskyur nas rdzong phag gso khang du 'byor tho bkod du slebs/ rdzong phag gso khang du de sngon las ka byed mkhan rgya mo zhig las med/ mos sngon ma ri pin btsan rgyal ring lugs dang lkog 'brel byas skad/ mo'i ming la wang shod yun zer zhing khyo bos bskyur ba'i bud med lo chung zhig red/ phag gso khang la phag pa nyi shu rtsa grangs shig dang / phag khang ltar pa gcig dang de'i g.yas g.yon la khang chung phag khang las mtho tsam re 'dug g.yas kyi khang pa'i nang wang shod yun bsdad pas g.yon gyi khang chung de'i bdag po tshe brtan bkra shis gyur/tshe brtan bkra shis kyis brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis sdod gnas der bkod sgrig thabs chag byas/ de dus tag tag wang shod yun 'dzum dmul dmul gyis nang du 'dzul byung / mos chu khol ja dam gang dang bag leb chen po gcig khyer 'dug mos lag gi dngos po sa la bzhag nas/ 8 bag leb zo/'dir chu khol yod/’ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis wang shod yun la sdod sa bzos nas 66rgan lags/ 'dir bzhugs/’ ces bshad/8 rgan lags — wang shod yun ngu ma dgod cig byas/ mo ni dge 'os slob grwa chen mo'i phul byung slob ma zhig yin pas mo'i phugs 'dun ni slob 'bring gi dge rgan tshad dang ldan pa zhig byed rgyu de yin/ 'on te mo'i pha ma rgya mtsho'i pha rol gyi rgyal khab cig la yod pas/ dpyid ku'i gnam ltar 'gyur ba mang ba'i chab srid rlung rlabs kyis mo phyi rgyal dang lkog 'brel byed ma/shā la

brtsis nas kun gyis mthong chung dang sdig mo bya yul du gyur pas snying nye ba'i bza' zlas kyang mo 'phong phyir rdo bzhin bskyur te rang nyid kyi mdun lam btsal du song / mi gzhan smra ci dgos/ wang shod yun dga' bde'i phugs bsam gyi spyin gseb nas dri ngan 'thul ba'i phag tshang du slebs/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis 66de ring ngas las rgyu ci gda'/ 66de ring sang nyin ngal gso rgyobs/mi na ya/ las ka gda' na nga la shod rogs/’ //ya/ ngas /gas pa byed dgos pa gda' na shod shog waX /sdo dī/na zhes pa'i rgya mo de log song / tshe brtan bkra shis kyi sa rang nyid rogs pa 'di dang rjes su las ku'i nang 'cham mthun yong nges red snyam nas gnas skabs kyi dga' ba zhig skyes/de'ang tshe brtan bkra shis kyis slobs nyin ma tshod dpag byas pa ltar las ku'i nang wang shod yun dang mthun sgril gang legs byung zhing phan tshun bar gcig phan gcig rogs kyi khrod du gnas/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis rim bzhin las ku'i nang phag pa dag la'ang cha rgyus byung / phag pa re la'ang gzhan la med pa'i gshis rgyud re yod pa mthong dus ha las dang dga' tshor zhig kyang skyes/ gzhan gyis btsog par brtsi ba'i phag tshang yang dga' skyo gnyis ldan gyi 'jig rten chung chung zhig yin pa shes/nyin gcig tshe brtan bkra shis kyi pha rdo thar rkang btsugs nas bu lta ru yong / rdo thar gyis sna khung lag pas bkab nas phag tshang gi g.yas g.yon du phar 'gro tshur 'gro 'ga' byas rjes slar yang phag dri 'tshub pa'i tshe brtan bkra shis kyi khang chung nang 'dzul nas cang mi smra bar gnas shing rdzi ma gnyis kyi bkā /8 mno bsam mdud brgya dam du bcings shing ngo mdog rdza ri nag po ltar

snang / lag pa g.yon ma'i mthe bong gi sgang la sna tha sen gang blugs nas lag pa g.yas pas ga ler sna khung gi sgo ru bskyal/ de nas yun ring po tshe brtan bkra shis kyi zang zing du gyur pa'i mgo skra la bltas/ rang nyid pha ma gnyis kyi snying gi ze'u 'bru ltar gyur pa'i bu 'di mi gtsang phag pa'i rdzi bor gyur dus skyi g.ya' ba'i rmi lam zhig rmis pa ltar sems sdug tshad med skyes pa gor ma chag8 gnam sa khur/ las ka 'di ma byed/ log 'gro/ nga tsho'i pha mes tshang ma 'brog pa red/ de rang byas na yag mdog red/ 66log gi min/ 6 nga tsho'i lung pa'i mis khyod phag rdzi yin pa shes na gang bsam gyi red/nga tshos kyang mi gzhan la gdong pa ga 'dra bstan dgos sam/ 6 de ci skyon/ lug rdzi dang phag rdzi gcig pa red/’ 6 de mi 'dra/ g.yang dkar lug nag btsog phag 6 nga log gi min/ lo shas kyi rjes la las ka 'gyur ba yong srid/’ 6 khyod skyid po byung na 'grig ngas u tshugs mi byed/ gzhan dag ngas byed dgos pa gang e 'dug rdo thar thabs zad pa'i dbugs ring zhig btang ‘/tsamadang dgong bshad pa'i gser skyid ma bur lta tsam byed rogs/ ngo ma/ nga la 'gan yod/’ 6 nga tsho'i nang du khyod kyi mna' mar khrid na 'grig nga phar slobs nas gangs 'bum la 'gro chog 6 de gong rim nas chog mchan thob mi srid/’ 'grig ‘ 6skyon med/ khyod kyi spun chung ba'i mna' ma yin zhes bshad na 66spun chung ba/ ge 219

6 rtog gra ma shod/ de 'dra skrag dgos pa ci'ang med/ 6 a pha yag byung / tshe brtan bkra shis kyi mig mtha' nas mchi phreng rnyikhor zhing yun ring sgug pa'i 'dun pa zhig mngon du 'gyur ba'i dga' snang sa/ de nas zla shas rjes la/ ru khag gi tud krang tshang ma rdzong du tshogs 'dur slebs 'dug tshe brtan bkra shis la pha yul gyi tud krang gis khyim gyi yi ge zhig dang sha mar phran tsam zhig 'khyer 'dug tud krang gis phag tshang la lta bzhin yid thang chad bzhin mgo bo g.yug g.yug gis log song / rtswa thang gi dwangs shing gtsang ba'i mkha' dbugs kyi khrod nas yong ba'i 'brog pa des phag tshang gi dri ngan sna bar bzod mi thub pa 'dra/ 6 slob grwar lo mang po de 'dra song yang mtha' mjug phag rdzi zhes pa ni khos tshe brtan bkra shis la bshad pa'i skad cha gcig pu de red/tshe brtan bkra shis kyis gzhan gang la'ang bsam blo gtong khom med paragyur du yi ge kha phyes nas lta dus/ 6 de nyin nga gangs 'bum du song ba yin/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la gser skyid ru khag gi tud krang gis gsar brje'i las byed g.yang la 'then mkhan la brtsis nas 'thab rtsodayang yang byas pas der mu mthud 'tsho thabs bral nas 'u thug nas rdzong gzhan gyi 'brog bdag dud tshang zhig la mna' mar sprad 'dug byis pa de'ang nad phog pas sman bcos ma byung bas tshe las 'das tshe brtan bkra shes rbad de hon thor nas 'jim sku ltar 'gul med du gyur cing mig gnyis srog dang bral ba'i bem gzugs zlum po gnyis su mngon la mgrin pa'i lam nas ci'ang smra mi thub par ga ler sa thog tu 'gyel/ de nas tshe brtan bkra shis kyis rang nyid kyi mgo bo dam du bcangs nas ngus/ mchi ma'i phreng ba ༵ pyodong g.yas g.yon nas dbyar gyi shwa 'od rgyas ltar lhung /

8 ga re byas byung / wang shod yun 'tshab 'tshub kyis 'dzul byung /tshe brtan bkra shis kyis lan ma btab par mu mthud ngus/tsa ngu rgyu ci gda'/ khyed tsho'i mi rigs la 6sdug na mchi ma mi gtong ba/skyes pa pho yi chags tshul red/ skom na na chu mi 'thung ba/ bre ser 'brong gi chags tshul red ces pa'i dpe med dam/ tshe brtan bkra shes mgo bo bkyag nas lta dus wang shod yun gyi thog la don med kyi khong khro zhig langs pas seng ge khros pa'i ngar skad kyis 6 khyod rgyugakhyod la jus gtogs med ces bshad nas mgo bo gug nas bsdad/wang shod yun gyi sems grang mor gyur nas sna khung skyur mo chags nas ji ltar byas kyang bzod sgom ma thub par mchi ma nar nar du shor zhing yid skyo ba'i ngu skad don/tshe brtan bkra shes kyi rna yi bu gar wang shod yun gyi ngu skad lhang lhang gis grags dus khos rang nyid kyi sdug bsngal cig car brjed nas wang shod yun la kha phyogs/ 6 nga nor ba red/ ma ngu/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis phyogs gcig nas rang nyid kyi mig chu 'phyin bzhin phyogs gzhan nas wang shod yun gyi mchi ma phyis/wang shod yun ngu mtshams bzhag tshe brtan bkra shis kyis yi ge'i nang don bshad/ wang shod yun khu sim mer mchi ma bton bzhin gnas/ tshe r+shartan bkra shes ni rjes dran dang bsam gzhigs kyi mtsho mor gnas pa'i nya mo ga lta/ /sna rte/ na gyi bya ba kun bsam brjod kyi yul las ring du 'das pas bkra ma shis pa'i don de byung rjes tshe brtan bkra shis dang wang shod yun sngar bas mthun 'grig tu gyur/ deng skabs khong gnyis bar shod mi tshar ba'i skad cha mchis/ wang shod yun gyis rang nyid cha rgyus che ba'i rtsom rig smra /rdo tshe

brtan bkra shis kyis bod kyi lo rgyus bshad/ de dus khong gnyis gas dri ngan 'thul ba'i phag tshang yang drod skyid kyis khengs shing shes rig gis khyab pa zhig yin pa'i tshor snang drag po byung /de nas zla shas kyi rjes su/ bod kyi lo gsar dang dpyid gsar dus chen zla ba gcig la 'khel bas sbra stod rdzong gi gong 'og kun du dus chen gyi dga' bdesakhyab cing sgo ra'i thog dar dmar rlung gis lhab lhub tu g.yo bar byas/dug log gsar rkyang gyon pa'i byis pa rnams shog sbag rgyag bzhin su las kyang dga' snang rgyas/ ngo ma/ skabs de dus mi rnams kyis 'thab rtsod kyi me lce dang sdug bsngal gyi mig chu ring du brjed pa 'dra bas dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs kyis khong tsho dang 'grogs/ ma gzhi drag chas 'dzin pa'i dmag mi dang yul dmag gang sar khyab mod/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dma' shos la gnas pa'i phag gso khang gi wang shod yun yang kha nas de tsam go rgyu med pa'i gzhas chung 'don bzhin brel ba chen pos ca'o tsi bzo byed kyi sha gtsab bzhin mchis/ de ni rgya lo'i gnam gang gi dgong mo yin pas rgya mi rigs la gna' snga mo nas nang mi lhan du 'dzoms nas ca'o tsi za ba'i lugs srol yod pa red/ca'o tsi bzos tshar rjes wang shod yun gyi nang la mgron po gnyis dus gcig tu slebs/ gcig ni tshe brtan bkra shis dang gcig ni wang shod yun dang pha yul gcig pa'i glog bzo rgad po de red/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis rgad po de mthong ma thag de nyin rang nyid kyis glog shing gi dkar yol bcag pa sogs yid la lham mer shar bas ngo tsha sob sob tu gyur nas sa 'og la 'dzul thub na ci ma rung snyam/ skabs der wang shod yun gyis khong gnyis phan tshun ngo sprod byas pas tshe brtan bkra shis kyis u tshugs kyis 'dzum tsam byas/ glog bzo rgad pos sna thog tu zag pa'i mig shel yar bkyag tsam byas nas 6 mthong myong myo) ༵dug yid la dran gyi mi 'dug tshe brtan bkra shis kha skyengs nas nang

don gyis dben pa'i mgo bo g.yug g.yug byas/ des na glog bzo rgad pos 6 tshe sngon gyi ngo shes yin gyi red/ zer nas tshe brtan bkra shis dang lag pa dam du bcangs/glog bzo rgad po des a rag dkar po shel sbug gang khyer 'dug khang pa chung chung de'i nang zas kyi dri zhim lhang lhang du 'thul zhing / lcags thab nang gi me 'ur 'ur du 'bar bas lcags thab kyi phyi ru'ang dmar por gyur/khang pa'i phyi logs su rus zug rgyag pa'i grang rlung ldang yang nang du dro skyid kyi dpyid dpal shar ba dang gnyis su ma mchis/ yun ring po khang chung de'i nang dga' spro'i gtam gleng gis khyab pas yud tsam la mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu gnyis zin/ glog bzo rgad po log ran song zer/ tshe brtan bkra shis dang wang shod yun gyis kho sgo 'gram bar skyel/ glog khang rgad po des 〈〈rig gnas gsar brje chen po ha cang yag po 'dug〉〉ces pa'i gzhas 'don bzhin khyar khyor ngang log song /de nas wang shod yun gyis tshe brtan bkra shis la glog bzo rgad po de'i gnas tshul bshad/ de sngon/ mo dang 'brel ba yag pa'i pha yul gcig pa mang po yod kyang deng skabs kho las lhag med zer/ tshe brtan bkra shis kyis de sngon glog shing thog gi dkar yol gtor ba'i gnas tshul bshad pas/ wang shod yun bgad shor nas tsog tsog byed mi thub par lag pas grod khog mnan nas bsdad/wang shod yun a rag gis cung bzi bas dga' ba rab tu rgyas nas ngo mdog mtshar sdug rnam par bkra ba'i me tog dmar po'i 'dab ma ltar gyur/de dus tshe brtan bkra shis kyis wang shod yun gyi mig zung hrig hrig gis rang nyid la lta bzhin yod pa tshor bas cung kha skyengs nas gdong pa gzhan du kha phyogs/ 223

6 nga la ltos dang / wang shod yun tshe brtan bkra shis dang nye bar bcar/8 da lta nga log ran song / tshe brtan bkra shis rtab rtob kyis de ltar smras/ 6 do dgong gtong gi min/ wang shod yun dal bu'i ngang tshe brtan bkra shes kyi brang thog tu bsnyes/rim bzhin tshe brtan bkra shis kyis kyang thams cad brjed nas wang shod yun dang 'thams/ khong gnyis yun ring po mchu yi sbrang rtsi 'jib res kyis gnas/ chab srid las 'gul gyis spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dma' shos la 'phangs pa'i gzhon nu pho mo gnyis po des thun mong ngal rtsol gyi 'dris gshib khrod du brtse dung dang drod skyid rnyed/de nas nyin shas kyi rjes su/ rdzong gsar brje'i u yon lhan khang gis chog mchan sprad pas tshe brtan bkra shes dang wang shod yun khrims mthun gyi bza' zlar gyur/ rdzong der phan tshun kha rtsod tsam med pa'i mdza' mthun gyi bza' tshang zhig 'phar snon byung /yang lo shas song rjes/ bcos bsgyur dang sgo mo 'byed pa'i dus rabs gsar pa zhig tshe brtan bkra shis bza' tsho gnyis kyi mig mdun du shar bas khong gnyis dga' ba 'bum gyis myos/ khong gnyis kur srid jus don 'khyol byung nas khong bza' tsho gnyis rdzong slob 'bring du bkod sgrig byas shing tshe brtan bkra shis rdzong slob 'bring gi slob spyi gzhon par bsko bzhag byas pa dang wang shod yun rgya yig dge rgan byas/ lo gnyis kyi rjes su wang shod yun ljar pan du gnyen 'phrad du song / thog mar tshe brtan bkra shes la wang shod yun gyi mdza' sems 'o mas 'tshos pa'i yig chung chu bo'i rgyun ltar bar med du 'ardi/ snang lo phyed song rjes yi ge je nyung du song nas rim bzhin yi ge gcig

kyang med par gyur/ tshe brtan bkra shes blo mi bde bar gyur nas nyin rtag par yig zam khang du yi ge yod med lta ru thengs kha shas bskyod/ 'on te lo gcig tsam song yang ci'ang go rgyu med/ lo phyed gnyis kyi rjes su bsam yul las 'das par tshe brtan bkra shis la wang shod yun gyi yi ge zhig 'byor/yi ge'i nang don sus kyang ma rtogs kyang de nas bzung tshe brtan bkra shisaspyo 'tshub 'tshub tu gyur nas rig pa tshul bzhin gnas mi thub par gyur/slobaspyi gzhon pa'i go sa'ang rang byung gis med par gyur zhing gang sar skad grags chod pa'i 6 dge rgan smyon par ’ gyur/nye char spra stod rdzong gi rdzong dpon gzhon par gsar 'dems byung ba'i nag ril gyis rdzong la tshe brtan bkra shes rgya nag la sman bcos su khrid rgyu'i gros 'go bton pas rdzong gi 'go khrid tshang mas mgrin gcig tu mos mthun byung ba red/ 'on kyang sman bcos kyi grub 'bras ji ltar 'byung min da lta sus kyang tshod dpag byed thabs bral/225

phyi bltas/gcigatshe ring lha mos lug ri la bskyur nas dbugs hal hal gyis rgyug na ning gi skya rtswa dang da lo'i sngo rtswa lhan du gnas pa'i rtswa gseng nas tshe ring lha mo'i brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyi rdog sgra sag sag tu grags/ dal bur ldang ba'i dpyid kyi rlung bu zhig mo'i dkar 'jam gyi ngo gdong nas grang bsil bsil gyis brgyud de phyugs rigs dkar nag gis khengs pa'i rgyab kyi ri gseng du yal/mo'i nag snam gyi mgo skra rkang kha shas shig 'od 'tsher ba'i thod pa'i ngos su rlung gi 'gros bzhin ling ling gi gar la rol zhing / mo'i ras gos nag po dang phyi ru bton pa'i nang lwa dkar po de rlung phyogs dang bstun nas ri rtse'i dar lcog ltar lhab lhub tu g.yo/tshe ring lha mo thog mar shang srid gzhung dang thag nye ba'i chu 'go kha zhes pa'i gnas der slebs/ mos rdo pha bong zhig gi thog la bsdad nas g.yas g.yon du bltas/ mo'i sems gting nas rbad de ha las nas kha nas rang dbang med par dpyid rlung zhes thal/ ngo ma/ dpyid rlung ni de 'dra'i shugs drag che ba la ang / dgun gyi ral gri ji ltar rno yang dpyid kyi lha mo'i mdun du rno ༵༵༵ gyi so nyil ba ma zad rang gzugs kyang ston ma phod par dngos med

du yal/ mi ring ba'i dus la/ 'di ru skyi g.ya' ba'i 'khyags rom gyi 'jig rten zhig tu grub/ sngo mo chu yi sgra zhig rngams mthug pa'i 'khyags rom gyi 'og nas khrog khrog tu grags yong bas/ de las gcig pur 'gul skyod du gnas pa'i chu mo zhig yod pa tshod dpag bya thub/ 'on kyang de ring 'di ru mig la bsku rgyu'i gangs 'khyags kyang ma mchis/ brag dmar po spyang ki'i kha lta bu las mer mer du thon nas chu rdo hrag drug gis khengs pa'i chu lam brgyud/ skye stobs kyi shag sgra rgyun mi chad par mdun nas mdun du rgyug chu 'gram gyi spang gzhung kun tu sa la 'byar ba'i dpyid 'go'i me tog ser po de thar thor rdu skyes pas/ mi rnams la rnam par bkra ba'i dbyar dus kyi ngo mtshar sngon blda byas/ tshe ring lha mos ri mtho po'i zur nas yal ba'i rkang lam kyag ge kyog gi der yang nas yang du blta/ glo bur du/ mo'i me tog gi 'dab ma ltar dmar mdangs bkra ba'i mchu sgros de bde skyid kyis bzo 'gyur nas mngon par mdzes pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig tu gyur/ bar thag ga tshod kyis bskal yang mos rin chen dbang 'dus kyi gzugs dbyibs nor mi srid/ de mur/ mo'i yid kyi me long gi ngos su skar tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i mdang dgong gi dus ne dran/ bde skyid kyi dran gso'i khrod du gnas pa'i tshe ring lha mo'i mig zitsha zim du gyur/ sa gzhi chen pos rim bzhin mun nag gi gos gyon/ grangs las 'das pa'i skar tshogs dpag tshad grangs med kyi gnas nas mig 'tsher 'tsher gyis lta/ lha skyid dang tshe ring lha mo nyal kha'i ma ṇi kha 'don byas rjes rang gnas su nyal/ rag kong chung chung de'i nang 'od lham lham byed pa'i tshe lce de yang mtha' mjug gi me lhab cig sngar med kyis mched tsam byas pa dang me lce je chung du song nas rim bzhin gsal mda' tsam yang med par gyur/lha skyid kyi sna khung nas grags pa'i dal lhod snyom pa'i rngur sgra de je che na12 trī che

ru song / 'on kyang tshe ring lha mor gnyid kyi g.ya' tsam yang med/ mo'i mig mdun du yang yang shar ba ni rin chen dbang 'dus kyi pho nyams dod po'i gdong pa dang gnam sa ltar yangs pa'i brang kha red/tshe ring lha mo ga ler langs rjes rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis sgo nas thon/6 nga de 'dra sgug pa yin/’ 6 a ma gnyid ma khug pas nga yong ma phod/ tshe ring lha mos bde skyid ngang rin chen dbang 'dus kyi pang du bsnyes/rin chen dbang 'dus kyis mo'i nag snam gyi mgo skra dang dkar 'jam gyingo shar byil byil byas/ de nas rin chen dbang 'dus kyis tshe ring lha mo pang du blangs nas mi ring bar gnas pa'i kho pa nyal sa'i lug srung gi gur chung der kha gtad nas rgyug song /de dus/ nam mkha'i skar ma ma gtogs gsal mda' yod pa'i dngos po ci'ang ma mchis/ nyin gcig dka' las brgyab pa'i mi rnams sngar nas rmi lam gyi zhing du slebs zin/ thams cad 'jam thing nger gnas pas ches phra'i skad gdangs kyang gsal cha ha cang che/ lug gi ldan rgyag pa'i sgra de gna' bo'i rol dbyangs shig ltar rin chen dbang 'dus dang tshe ring lha mo'i rna yi bu gar sim/ skabs skabs grags pa'i khyi'i zug skad kyis snying 'jag gi 'jig rten dum bu brgya phrag tu bzos/tshe ring lha mos ci'ang mi smra bar rin chen dbang 'dus kyi brang spu tshom bu skyes pa'i brang thog tu nyal nas bsdad/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis ci'ang mi mngon pa'i bar snang la bltas nas mno bsam 'ba' zhig gi khrod du gnas/dus kyi 'khor lo chu tshod gcig tsam song / na chung gnyis kyi kha nas gzhi nas skad cha thon/22/na chen dbang 'dus kyis tshe ring lha mo'i ngo gdong phur phur byed

bzhin dbugs ring zhig btang / smyo a phas nga la myur du mna' ma len rtsis 'dug 'on kyang nga'i sems la khyod las med/ 6 nged gnyis kyi bya ba khyod kyi phas gtan nas mos mthun bya mi srid/’ tshe ring lha mo'i skad gdangs las yid thang chad pa'i nyams shig mngon yong /6 a phas zla ba 'di'i nang du bkra tshang gi bu mo len zer/ 'on te nga'i sems thag rdo bzhin bcad zin/ smyo nged gnyis kyang gzhan ltar bros 'gro zer e yin/’ 6 nged gnyis kyi pha ma rgan rgon la bu phrug nged gnyis las med pas 'u ma thug na /snas bzlos med/ 8 sang nyin nged gnyis mnyam du 'gro nas shang thog nas chang sa'i dpang yig len/ de ltar na nged gnyis kyi bza' tshang gi 'brel ba khrims lugs kyis khas len byas tshar bas/ nga la mna' ma gzhan len mi chog tshe ring lha mo dga' snang chen pos 6 ngo ma e zhes smras pa dang mos bsamablo zhig btang rjes 6 de ltar na'ang khyod kyi phas mos mthun byed kyi ma red ’ ces bshad/66de dus mos mthun med kyang mos mthun bya rgyu red/ 6 en/’ tshe ring lha mo lha yi bdud rtsis myos pa bzhin mig zim zim gyis rin chen dbang 'dus kyi skyes pa pho'i lus po sgugarin chen dbang 'dus kyis tshe ring lha mo'i lus por dam du 'khyud nas sna rtsa nas mchu sgros bar 'o byas/ de nas rim bzhin na gzhon pho mo gnyis kyi lus sems ma lus chu la 'gyur nas dbyer med gcig tu 'dres/ 229

tshe ring lha mo dran shes kyi mtsho las bral te mdun gyi rkang lam la lta dus/rin chen dbang 'dus 'gram du slebs tshar 'dug khos lag tu ca lag blugs pa'i khug me zhig khyer 'dug tshe ring lha mos rin chen dbang 'dus kyis khyer ba'i dngos po kha g.yos nas 6 ci red ’ ces dris/64mar ril gnyis yod/’ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis de las rgyu mtshan ma smras/rin chen dbang 'dus dang tshe ring lha mo shang thog tu slebs/ 'brog khul gyi shang chung chung der gzhi rgya che ba'i 'dzin chas ci'ang med/ 'on kyang khang pa star pa lnga drug de spyir btang 'brog dmangs kyi sa mdog can gyi khang pa dang bsdur na/ gyang ngos kyi rdo zho dang thog steng gi lcags shog las nyi 'od kyi 'og tu gnas pa'i gangs ri ltar 'od dkar po lam lam byed/ de las 'di ru srid gzhung zhig gnas pa'i rngam zil yang ngam ngam shugs kyis mngon/rin chen dbang 'dus dang tshe ring lha mo gnyis kyis khang mig dang po de'isgo brdung pas/ mig shel brgyab pa'i pho gzhon nyams dod po zhig thon byung / de ni gsar du rdzong thad gtogs sde tshan nas gsham gtong byas pa'i shang krang nor bu red/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis de sngon ngo phran bu shes kyi /da/ khos myur du 6 nged gnyis gnyen sgrig dpang yig len mkhan yin ’ sa bas/gri/ ga gi red/ dmangs srid las rogs pa sngo rdo btsal dgos/7shang krang nor bus khong gnyis sngo rdo sdod sar khrid/ lam bar du khong gnyis kyi ming dang grong tsho sogs gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul dris/khang pa zhig gi sgo 'gram du slebs dus shang krang nor bus sngo rdo zhes bos podī ༵༵/ myur du sgo phyes pa dang 6 shang krang yar phebs ’ zer bzhin ngo

gdong chu rdo sngon po lta bu'i mi zhig gis mgo shig brad brad byas/shang krang nor bus smyo khyod kyis dus rgyun gnyen sgrig byed mkhan ngo ma dpang yig len du yong gi mi 'dug ces shod kyi 'dug kyang / de ring gzhon nu 'di gnyis rang nyid ngo ma slobs 'dug rjes su gnyen sgrig byed mi ngo ma ma yong par pha ma nye 'brel gyis tshab len byas na dpang yig ma sprod/ rang mos yin min sus shes/ las ka de yin ’ zhes bshad/sngo rdo yang nas yang du 6 lags so lags so zhes smras/shang krang kha phyir bskor ba dang sngo rdo'i 'dzum mdangs dang g.yo gzugs de mur bsdus/ 6 nang du shog sngo rdo hra pha rkub stegs sheg gi thog la zur sdod cig byas te tha mag rkang gcig la me spar/ dpon nyams chen pos/ 6 khyod gnyis/ chos lha'i bu dang lha skyid kyi bu mo/ gnyen sgrig byed kyis e/ pha mas mos mthun byas e song ’ 66de/’ rin chen dbang 'dus kha grag rgyu ma rnyed par bsdad/tsa wa ’ tshe ring lha mo mgo bo gug nas gnas/6 pha mas mos mthun med na/ rjes su mo rtog gra yong gi red/khyod gnyis pha ma dang mnyam du shog 6 shang krang gis nged gnyis yong na khrims dang mthun zer/mi rin chen dbang 'dus kyis de ltar smras pa dang sems nang 'u thug na shang krang btsal dgos snyam/8 de red/ de red/ 'on te ngas chos lha rgad po dang skad cha zhig bya dgos/ nyin shas rjes la shog de dus ngas dpang yig sprad chog rin chen dbang 'dus kyis mar ril gnyis po de blangs nas sngo rdo'i mdun gyi sgrog tse'i steng du bzhag rjes/ 6 sems mtshon byed tsam yin/ de ring drin can khyod kyis cis kyang rogs pa gnang rogs/9 231

sngo rdo'i kha zur nas de tsam mngon rgyu med pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig 'khyug tsam byas/ de nas shin tu dka' ngal che ba'i bzo zhig bstan rjes/64ci byas na drag gam/ 8 de ring shang krang gis mos mthun byas stabs/ khyed kyis dpang yig gnang rogs/’ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis re ba chen pos de ltar bshad/6 ya/ 'o na da lta sprad chog yin na'ang chos lha rgad pos nga la kha rdung gtong rgyu nyag cig red/ shang krang gis bka' slob gnang ba las byung ngam/ yang na re ba drag pos yid 'gul lam/ de min na mar ril gyi mthu las byung ba brjod dka' yang / rin chen dbang 'dus dang tshe ring lha mo la khrims dang mthun pa'i gnyin sgrig gi dpang yig thob/ dpyid rlung gi khrod du/ gdong la dpyid dpal bzhad pa'i rin chen dbang 'dus dang tshe ring lha mo lag gdang sbrel nas shang thog nas kha gyes/ nyi ma lde bzhin bsdad pa'i rgad mo gnyis kyis khong gnyis kyi rgyab la mdzub mo btsugs nas mug mug gis bshad pa brgyab/brtse dung gis myos pa'i gzhon nu gnyis kyis de dag la snang ba tsam mi 'jogarin chen dbang 'dus dga' snang dang skrag snang gi khrod du khyim la 'dzul/ kho'i pha chos lha rgad po ngo gdong 'dzum mdangs kyis khengs nas bsdad 'dug sna khung gi 'og tu sna tha 'gos pa dang sen mo'i thog sna tha mer mer blugs 'dug bu slebs 'dug chos lha rgad po'i 'dzum mdangs sngar bas mngon gsal du gyur/ 8 da nang sgrub sde rin po che yi drung du phyin nas bag skar blta rogs zhus pa yin/ tshes bcu drug la ngo ma bag skar rtse gra zhig k+ta/ /go~X/nga nyin nas nye 'brel rnams yong rogs zer nas gnyen ston gyi gra 23〉na chen dbang 'dus kyis bde skyid kyi khrod du lhung ba'i pha rgad po'i skya

phyed sngo phyed kyi mgo skra dang thod pa'i thog gi rtswa mi skye ba'i lung shur lta bu'i gnyer ma'i phreng ba la lta bzhin cis kyang khong gi dga' bdes myos pa'i sems zho bzhin chags pa de dar ba lta bur dkrug mi phod kyang / da lta gzhan gyi thabs sne gcig med pa'i dus la slebs/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis mig btsum/ mchi ma mid nas sems thag bcad/ tsham tshom med par am phrag sbug nas gnyen sgrig dpang yig blangs nas pha rgad po'i mdun du bzhag rjes/6 a pha/ gtan nas dgongs pa ma 'tshoms/ da nangs tshe ring lha mo nged gnyis gnyen sgrig gi dpang yig blangs tshar ba yin/ sna ga re/’ chos lha god po yud tsam ring hon thor nas lus/ de nas rab tu khros pa'i mtshon rtags su lus po 'dar sig sig tu gyur/ sgrog tse'i steng du bzhag pa'i gnyen sgrig dpang yig de dum bur dbral nas rin chen dbang 'dus kyi ngo gdong la brgyab/ seng ge khros pa'i ngar skad kyis 6 nga mos mthun med ces smras/re mos mthun med na thabs shes med/ khrims kyis khas blangs tshar ba da/ 6 skyag pa'i khrims/ khyod nag mo de dang mnyam du sdod mi chog 6 de 'gyur ba gtong thabs med/’ 6 khyod/ khyod/ song / de ring nas nged gnyis bar pha ngo bu ngo med/ba'i mig gis mthong sar slebs ma yong / rin chen dbang 'dus kyis rgyu mtshan bgrangs/ gnas lugs bshad/'on kyang thams cad kyis rgad po'i sems kyi gangs 'khyags bzhu mi thub/chos lhas de'i dgong mo rang gi bu rin chen dbang 'dus nang nas btsan 'bud byas/rin chen dbang 'dus 'u thug nas lha skyid ma bu'i nang du spos 13 tāng /

de dgong nas bzung tshe ring lha mo'i ming don mtshungs pa'i khyo bor gyur/rin chen dbang 'dus kyis ha lam nyin re thengs re pha chos lhar lta ru song yang chos lhas thengs gcig kyang rin chen dbang 'dus nang du 'dzul ma bcug pa ma zad/ rin chen dbang 'dus mthong ma thag bar nas myos pa ltar 'gyur/chos lha las ldog phyogs su gyur pa zhig ni lha skyid rgad mo dga' thag chod/mi thug tshad la rin chen dbang 'dus kyi dge mtshan chu rgyug rgyug shod/ da dung mo rkang btsugs nas bkra shis chos gling dgon du chos mjal du song nas lha bla maḥ spra la bde skyid kyi tshe mjug dang mag pa yag po zhig gnang bar thugs lha skyi / snad/ mo'i las ka ni chos byed rgyu kho na yin/ rgyun du kha nas ma ṇi 'bral med dang lag tu lag bskor 'bral med du gnas thog nangs dgong gnyis la phyag dang bskor ba rgyun mi chad/ lha skyid kyi gzugs po sngar bas je thang tu song thog ngo gdong nas dmar mdangs rgyas/ mo'i chos dad kyi 'du shes kyang je rgyas su song / mos rin chen dbang 'dus la lha sar chos mjal du khrid rogs zhes bshad pas/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis da lo'i dgun kha lha sar khrid rgyu'i khas len byas/chos lha rgad po'i sdod gnas su gson shugs je chung du song / dus rgyun du khung nas 'byur ba'i lhog lhog gi du ba de'ang rim bzhin mthong dka' bar gyur/ nyin zhig chos lha snying nad drag pos mnar nas nyal sar lus nas lus po 'gul mi thub par gyur/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis thog mar chos lha kho'i khyim ste lha skyid kyi nang du bsu rtsis byas kyang god pos rtsa ba nas 'gro rogs ma byas/ 'u thug pa'i rin chen dbang 'dus phar spos nas pha la nad gswāswā /nga sri zhu sgrub/ 'on kyang chos lhas kho la skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma

bshad par nyin ltar ngo nag rog ger gnas/ chos lha rgadayo'i mgo skra lug gi bal ltar dkar rkyang gyur/ mig gnyis gting du jib/ mkhur ra'i rus pa phyi ru mngon stabs brag zur gnyis dang mtshungs/ gang nas bltas kyang skrag dgos pa zhig tu gyur/de nyin/ chos lha rgad po'i rig pa cung dwangs su phyin pas/ rin chen dbang 'dus la khyim mtshes rgad po bkra shes 'bod dgos pa'i kha brda byas/bkra shis 'byor rjes/ chos lha rgad pos bkra shis kyi lag pa nas bzung ste/ru nga shi song na nga'i phyi nang gi dngos po tshang ma bkra shes chos gling dgon par 'bul rogs ’ zhes bshad/bkra shes kyis rin chen dbang 'dus kyi gdong par lta tsam byed pa las ci'ang ma smras par bsdad/66kho la khab gcig kyang sprod kyi min/ : chos lha rgad pos sems thag chod pos de ltar smras/66nga la mi dgos/’ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis pha rgan po'i lus po skyi g.ya' ba der lta bzhin mig nang mchi ma ko ro ro 'khor/ chos lhas rin chen dbang 'dus kyi gdong par mig hril hril gis lta bzhin 6 khyod/ nga'i kha la ma nyan/ lha skyid ces pa'i bdud mo de'i bu mo dang mnyam du bsdad ces shod bzhin yid shin tu pham pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/skabs der/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis la kha'i nyi ma lta bu'i pha rgad po'i thog la'ang ngar zhig langs stabs kha nas rang dbang med par 8 lha skyid de sngon khyod kyi bza' mo min nam ’ zhes thal/6 nga'i bza' mo/ nga'i bza' mo red/’ chos lha rgad po'i gting du dib pa'i mig nang nas mchi ma'i gong bu gnyis thon rjes/ lus po 'phag tsam byas pa dang mig rim bzhin btsum song / de nas kho la dga' skyo chaga~X snang

du ma ster ba'i 'jig rten la mig bltas ma byung / nam yang nam yang mi mngon pa'i 'jig rten la bud song /rin chen dbang 'dus kyis rgad po'i 'das 'jug legs par byas/rgyu dngos tshang ma rgad po'i kha chems ltar dgon par phul/rjes kyi 'tsho ba'i nang / rin chen dbang 'dus tshang gi 'tsho ba dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyas/ nang mi kun bde skyid kyi dpal la rol/ de dus mi rnams kyis bdud mo'i bar chad ces pa rdzun rdzun nag red zer/ lha skyid kyis mi tshe /cig chos byas pas/ mkha' 'gro min na bdud mo gtan nas yin mi srid ra/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyi sems nad gcig pu ni pha rgad po sems sdug gis khengs bzhin 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du phyin pa de red/ spyi tshogs kyi thog la'ang rin chen dbang 'dus kyis pha 'chi lam du btang bar ngos 'dzin byed mkhan yang yod/ dus tshod ni yud tsam yud tsam gyis yol 'gro la/ mi ni yud tsam yud tsam gyis rgas 'gro zhing / spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa ni dus bzhi brje 'gyur las grub pa'i gom 'gros dang bstun nas 'gyur ba nas 'gyur ba'i khrod du gnas mod kyang / sa gzhi chen po gcig pur 'gro ba mis dpog dka' ba'i tshe srog cig mnga' bas nam yang rang gzugs mi 'gyur bar snying nger gnas/gnyis/lha skyid kyis mi lo nyi shu 'tsho ba bskyal ba'i pha yul gyi ri lung la brtse ba chen pos bltas/ rngam brjid kyi chag la ri bo de khams gsum zil gnon gyi rgyaX /6 chen po stag seng gi gdan thog tu bzhugs pa 'dra zhing / ri rtse'i brag

gseb tu gnas pa'i bkra shes chos gling dgon pa de rin po che'i rgyan char byur dmar gyi khra btab pa ltar dmar ser khob ber chags/ brag nag po khang chen brgyab pa lta bu'i ngos nas babs pa'i rbab chu des rlabs dkar zegs ma stong phrag g.yas g.yon gyi rtswa thang steng du gtor/ mtha' yas pa'i rtswa thang gi steng du me tog dkar dmar 'ja' shar ba ltar bzhad cing / phyugs rigs dkar nag rtswa thang gi stong du yang na mngar zhim rtsi bcud la rol/ yang na dal gyis rgyu/ yang na ngur rgyang dang 'ba' ldir byed/ lha skyid ni na chung ma'i mig khra gor gor gnyis kyi nang du mchi ma med mer gang / sna khung skyur mo chags/chung nas da bar gyi bya ba dran shes kyi me long ngos su rab rib tu shar/ tshe srog bstsal ba'i pha yul la brjod mi shes pa'i yid kyi 'phreng ba zhig skyes stabs/'od 'tsher ba'i mig chu rdog dog 'ga' sna gdong g.yas g.yon nas ga ler 'dril byung / 'on te/ mos gral bstar 'grig pos ya so dkar po ma ne'i thog la shugs kyis mnan nas sems thag rdo bzhin bcad pa'i bzo zhig bstan rjes/ rgyab kyi khur po de khur skyor zhig byas te kha bskor nas shar rer rgyang ring la blo phyogs nas lam la bzhud song /gnas bskor gyi lam bur dka' spyad kyis bsnyegs pa'i lha skyid kyis bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams kyi stod smad bar gsum rkang pas 'jal/ bod kyi rtsa che'i gnas mchog du mar thod pa gtug mjug tu/ lha skyid gangs ri dkar po glang chen gyi mche ba lta bu'i tshar du dngar ba dar gyi yol ba bres ltar rgyun mi chad par dpyangs pa'i stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi yul gru ru slebs/rgyang nas lta dus mtha' yas pa'i thang chen gyi steng du rtswa sngo thing nger mngon yang 'gram du bcar nas lta dus rtswa thar thor las skyes med/ rtswa skyes sa'i sa dang rdo zhib kyang mig mdun du wa ler mngon rgyu yod/ yul 'dir ches ngo mtshar ba zhig ni gcer bur mngon pa'i ri bo de tsho rtsi shing me tog gi gosdu /nga

yongs su bral yang ri bo phal cher gyi rtse mo gangs 'khyags kyis bzung bas/dar dkar gyi la thod bcings pa'i mi chen 'ga' dang 'dra/ bod la gangs can ljongs zhes pa'i rjes grub kyi ming 'di thob dgos pa'i rtsa ba'ang 'di ru thug pa 'dra/ lha skyid kyang mnyam du yong ba'i a mdo mgo log gi gnas bskor ba de tsho dang 'dra bar/ dngul dkar gyi mchod rten gsham 'dra'i gakās mchog gangs rin po che la lta bzhin mig nas dad pa'i mchi ma phrum phrum du 0ralha/ skyid kyis 'tsho ba slong mo la brten nas gangs ri bskor/ gangs rin po che yi 'og tu rdo brkos nas 'tsho ba skyel ba'i pha yul khams khyung po nas yin pa'i pho gzhon gangs srung dang ngo shes/ gangs srung gis rgyun du lha skyid la rogs pa byed gang thub byed pa dang / khong gnyis kyi pha yul bar sa thag cung nye bas kha lugs 'dra tsam yod stabs/ gzhon nu pho mo gnyis dbar gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'dris gshib dang brtse dung byung /lo phyed kyi rjes su/ gangs srung gis ngo sprod byas pa brgyud/ lha skyid gangs rin po che'i 'gram gyi dud tshang phyug po zhig gi nang du lug dzir bsdad/lha skyid kyi las ka ni nyin mo lug dzir 'gro rgyu dang mtshan mo lug lhas nang du nyal nas lug srung rgyu de red/ dud tshang des lha skyid la lus drod pa'i gos dang grod pa 'grangs pa'i lto sprad pas/ pha yul bskyur nas chags rten med pa'i lha skyid kyi 'dod blo gnas skabs ring de tsam gyis tshims/ zer brgya 'bar ba'i nyin byed dbang po nub kyi gangs ri rta so 'dra ba'i grib nas yal/nyi 'od la brten nas byung ba'i gsal cha dag rim bzhin nyam dmas su song nas mig dang thag ring tsam gyi dngos gzugs kun rab be rib be las mi mthong / 'bur du thon pa'i dngos po gzhan med pa'i thang sder rta rgyug sa lta bu /sdu pha bong nag po 'brog pa'i sbra gur lta bu zhig nag rog ger gnas/ de

ni 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal pos gangs ri'i shel rdzong phab dus bzhag pa'i dmag sbra yin skad/ rgyun du de la bskor ba brgyab na bu la dpa' rtsal rgyas shing bu mo la rgyu nor 'khor zer/ skabs der lha skyid kyis sngar bzhin dmag sbra rdo pha bong la 'gyur ba'i gsang ba mi shes kyang myur du nyin ltar bskyar zlos byed pa'i bskor ba de rgyag bsam/ mos sems kyi gting nas ge sar rgyal po'i mdzad pa dang 'brel ba'i rdo pha bong der su la'ang shod mi phod pa'i re ba bcol yod/ mos nyin ltar dmag sbra des sa mtha' nas 'khyam pa'i mo la nor dang bde skyid kyi dngos sgrub sbyin pa'i re ba rtse gcig tu byed/ deng gi 'tsho ba'i nang re ba 'di dag thob thabs bral ba'i mdzes ldan 'ja' tshon du mngon yang / yul dus kyis tshod 'dzin mi thub pa'i rmi lam gyi khrod du mo'i re ba kun mngon mngon rjen rjen gyi gzugs su grub/ rmi lam gyi khrod du gangs srung yang mo dang mnyam du bde skyid kyi dpal la rol/ lha skyid kyis blo rtse gcig tu sgrim/sems nang du mngon mdzes kyi re ba ma lus sgom/ kha nas mug mug gi gsol ba btab ste rdo smug po der thod pa gtug rjes bskor lam der zhugs/8 lha skyid/ skyes pa zhig gis dbugs kyi rgyu ba myur pos po'i 'gro lam bkag 'dug6 khyod/’ lha skyid skrag nas bskor 'drogs shig byas rjes/ rim bzhin blo bde lhod du gyur/skyes pa de tshur rgyug nas lha skyid kyi lag 'go nas bcangs/ 64nga rkang btsugs nas khyed dang 'phrad du yong ba yin/ skyes pa de'i skad gdangs las zol med kyi brtse dung zhig mngon/ lha skyid skrag snang chen pos phyogs bzhi la bltas/ mo'i blo bde ru bcug pa zhig ni g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun gang la'ang rkang gnyis mi'i mig ma mchis/ dkar dkar gyi lug dag ci'ang ma mthong ba ltar ga ler ga ler mdun nas mdun du skyod/ des na lha sbyishā /sa

ci'ang ma smras par mgo bo gug nas bsdad/6 khyod nga'i bza' mo gyis/ ngas thabs shes gang yod kyis khyod 'tsho ba yag po bskyal thub pa byed kyi yin/’ skyes pa des dbugs hal hal gyis lha skyid pang du blangs nas sa thog tu bzhag pa dang / myos pa ltar gyis mo'i mchu yi sbrang rtsi'i mngar zhim nyams su myong /k+taskyid skabs sheg ring ci bya mi shes par gyur nas skyes pa de'i thams cad dang du blangs/ glo bur du/ mo gnyid sad pa ltar gyur/ skyes pa des brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis mo'i ska rags bshig pa tshor/ de dus mos 'tshab 'tshub kyis 6 phar song / ngo tsha/ zhes smras nas nus shugs gang yod kyis ཿphag 'tshag brgyab pa na/ skyes pa des kyang u tshugs ma byas par langs nga /skyes pa des slar yang lha skyid kyi lag mgo nas bcangs te 8 nga do dgong yong gi yin/ khyi bkag rogs ’ zhes bshad/6 khyi rdung mkhan la khyi bkag e/ go ma myong / lha skyid kyis brtse ba chenapos skyes pa der blta tsam byas rjes gad mo lhang lhang dgod bzhin lug khyu'i rjes su gom stabs yang pos rgyugaskyes pa des yun ring pos dal bur rgyu ba'i bal ldan gyi khyu dang de'i rjes la bsnyegs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab g.yog mor 'khod kyang lang tsho'i mdzes sdug su la'ang ji mi snyam pa'i lha skyid kyi lus por hon thor nas bltas/lha:da kyi gzugs po rim bzhin mun nag gi khrod du mthong rgyu med par gyur pas/ skyes pa de gzhi nas 'gul tsam byas byung /dgong mo der/ dog mo sa gzhis gdan bting zhing / a sngon nam mkhas thog bkab pa'i khrod du skye 'gro kun gnyid kyi zhing khams su bskyod kyang /lha/10 'gre ldog mang po brgyab nas myur du rmi lam gyi zhing khams la bskyod

'dod kyang rig pa je gsal du 'gro/ mos mig cer nas bgrangs kyis mi lang ba'i skar tshogs la bltas/ pha yul dang chu khri ri stong gis brgal ba'i yul 'dir 'dris cha ldan pa'i dngos po zhig rtsa ba'i cha nas ma mchis kyang nam mkha'i skar ma'i chags stangs gcig pu pha yul dang gcig mtshungs su mngon/skabs der mo'i mig mdun du rang dbang med par drin can gyi pha ma dang /rang nyid mchil ma'i rdzas bzhin bskyur ba'i lo gnyis kyi bza' rogs chos lha wa ler mngon/ rang nyid kyis brtse dung dang nus shugs yod tshad phul ba'i skyes pa des mo sdug bsngal gyi mtsho ru 'phangs/ mi zad pa'i mchi ma ster/glo bur du khyi'i zug skad tsha nas tsha ru song / gang zhig sgo khyi ngar ma des khyur mid du gtong la nye ba 'dra/ sems khral zhig gis lha skyid kyi lus hril po tsha zing zing du gyur/ de ni mo la dmigs nas yong ba'i gangs srung yin nges red/ ge sar gyi dmag sbra zhes pa'i pha bong de'i 'gram du khos khyi bkag dgos pa'i mngag bya byas kyang mos gtan bya ma thub/ ma gzhi mos sems kyi gting nas skyes pa sems rtsa 'khol po der gzhan med kyi brtse sems bcangs/kher rkyang du gnas pa'i mos dran mang shos ni gangs srung red/ 'on kyang mos bsam na/ gangs srung dang mnyam du bsdad na 'khyags pas 'khyags pa bsro mi thub pa'i dpe ltar sems gting gi re ba thams cad 'ja' ltar yal rgyu red/de'ang yongs su shod mi shes/ lha skyid kyis las la yid ches/ tshe sngon gyi bskos pa bzlos mi phod/ gangs srung gis khyi bkag rogs zhes pa'i skad cha der slar yang bsam blo gtong dus/ bu mo zhig gis khyi bkag nas skyes pa nang du khrid na ngo tsha snyam/ gangs srung thabs zad nas slar yang phyir log pa 'dra/ khyi'i ngar skad 'jags nas 'jam thing nger gyur/'tshab 'tshub kyi rdog sgra dang bcas par gangs srung lha skyid kyi sngas mgo'i 'gram du slebs/241

6 khyi/ lha skyid kyi kha nas rang dbang med par de ltar thal/6 ri bong gi ro bsgrugs nas 'phangs pas khyi gnyis po de'i phyogs la rgyug song /’ lha skyid kyis gangs srung bkag kyang mi khogs/ don du mtha' gcig tu 'gog kyang mi 'dod/ gangs srung ni tshe sngon nas bskos pa min nam snyam/rang spyad kyi kha dang 'tsham pa'i so min nam snyam/ gangs srung lha skyid kyi rum du 'dusnan/ sa mchog gangs rin po che la dmigs pa'am/ yang na pha yul la re ba chad nas sa 'khyam rdo 'khyam du yong ba'i gzhon nu gnyis bgrangs yas skar tshogs kyi mig 'og tu gzhon nu la gtogs pa'i brtse dung dang drod skyid rnyed/zla shas kyi rjes su/ gangs rin po che dang mi ring ba'i gnas shig tu/gangs srung dang lha skyid las grub pa'i dud chung zhig gsar snon byung / gangs srung gi rdo yon du thob pa'i lug drug cu dang lha skyid la rdzi glar thob pa'i lug lnga ni dud tshang de'i 'tsho rten du gyur pa'i rgyu nor yod tshad red/ gangs srung gi brtse sems dang bsam shes la brten nas/ zas gos dka' ngal chen po yod ༵'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du'ang lha skyid kyis gcig sems gcig 'brel gyi bde skyid ra/ de nas lo shas kyi rjes su/ sa cha der dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byas/gangs srung dang lha skyid la nor lug dang rgyu nor gyi bgo bsha' thob/ gangs srung shang krang du bskos pas mi rnams kyis re ba byed sa dang gus bkur byed sar gyur/ yang lo shas song rjes/ gangs srung dang lha skyid la bu mo gcig skyes/ de'i ming la tshe ring lha mo zhes btags/chab srid kyi dus rnam dpyid gnam ltar 'gyur ba kho na'i khrod gnas kyaX 4/2gangs srung 'gro wa mo las mkhas shing sdod ri bong las tsog pas/

khong tshang la brdab gsig chen po ci gang ma byung bar/ de tsam 'khyags ltogs med pa'i 'tsho bar rol rgyu rnyed/de ni bgrang bya du ma'i rjes kyi gnas tshul red/ 8 rig gsar ’ gyi me lces chos lugs dang 'brel ba yode pa'i dngos po kun thal ba'i rdul du brlags kyang / rang byung sa rdo las grub pa'i gnas ri gcig pu dpog par dka' ba'i chos lugs kyi zhwa mo phud pa ma gtogs gtor brlag gi lag rjes ma bzhag pas/ gangs dkar ti se ri bo de sngar mus bzhin mtho po'i sprin gseb tu gnas/ dus kyi 'gyur ba ni dpog dka' bas/ rdza ri'i rtse mo gangs 'khyags kyis btums pa der slar yang rin po che yi mtshan gsol/ bod kha ba can gyi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dang / tha na rgya gar dang bal po sogs nas yong ba'i dad ldan gnas mjal ba dag gangs rin po che yi mtha' skor la lho sprin lta bu'i 'du 'god 'tshub/ 'gying nger gnas pa'i gangs dkar ti si'i ri bos kyang bgrang bya du ma'i ring kha ya byed mkhan med pa'i kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba mjug 'gril/lo lnga bcu tsam zin pa'i lha skyid kyi ngo gdong nyi 'od rlung lhags kyis gtses pas sngo nag tu gyur/ mo'i mgo skra yun ring bkru ma myong ba 'dra bar dreg pas 'tshos pa ma zad skra rnams go rim med pa'i nag zing zing du gyur/mo'i lag tu lag bskor zhig bzung / kha nas 'don pa rgyun mi chad/ mo brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis gangs ri'i bskor lam nang du bskyod/ mo'i sems kyi gting nas lo gcig gi sngon du grongs pa'i tshe gcig 'grogs pa'i bza' rogs gangs srung myur du bde ba can gyi zhing khams la skye ba'i smon lam rtse gcig tu btab/ blo rtse gcig tu sgrim drags pa dang gom pa spo myur bas/ lha skyid kyis mdun gyi mi zhig gi rkang par rting gnon thebs/ 66dgongasdu 44 ma

'tshoms mi des phyir bltas byung / mi de'i ngo ther ther thang chen lta bu dang / sna zur zur sta re lta bu sna rtse nas nam yang yal dka' ba'i 'od 'tsher ba'i rngul chu rdog po babs pa mthong dus/ lha skyid rbad de ha las nas skabs gcig ring ci bya gtol bral gyi gnas su lhung / mi de'ang yun ring po kha mig mnyam du gdangs nas 'jim sku ltar 'gul med du gnas/lha:da kyis thams cad zil gnon gyi gangs rin po che dang mi de'i lo zla'ikang rjes su gyur pa'i gnyer ris shig shig gi ngo gdong la lta bzhin de sngon gyi chags sdang thams cad bye ma'i 'chang bu bzhin rang bzhin du zhigatsa khyod chos lha min nam/7tsa yin/ khyod/ khyod lha skyid red/7 chos lha gtam smra mi thub par lus/chags sdang thams cad zur du bskyur dus khong gnyis bar bshad mi tshar ba'i skad cha mchis/lha skyid kyis rang nyid pha yul dang kha bral nas stod phyogs su yong lugs dang deng gi 'tsho ba sogs ji ma ji bzhin de sngon rang nyid 'phong phyis rdo bzhin bskyur ba'i skyes pa der smras/chos lhas de sngon rang nyid kyi byed stangs la 'gyod pa drag po byas nas mchi ma 'dzag kho'i rgad mo lo gcig gi sngon la tshe ma zin zer/lha skyid kyis rgan po zhig gi mig chu la lta bzhin/ zhe 'khon thams cad brjed par byas/chos lha dang lha skyid zla phyed tsam ring mnyam du gangs ri bskor/ rgyus ༵ ཿtrī sprad pa'i mi rnams kyis khong gnyis tshe gcig 'grogs pa'i bza' tshang 243 skyid kyis pha yul gyi gnas tshul go dus/ chung lte khrag 'pho sa'i pha

yul la log 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag po zhig ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes/ chos lhas kyang lha skyid pha yul du log nas khong tsho dang mnyam du 'tsho ba bskyal rgyu'i re ba byas/ khos lha skyid kyi tshe mjug skyid po yong ba byas nas rang nyid lo chung dus kyi nor 'khrul de bya spyod dngos la brten nas 'gyod bshags bya rgyu yin zhes bshad/ lha skyid kyis da lta'i dus su chos lha'i re bar khas len bya thabs bral yang skyes pa'i pha yul du 'dun pa je cher 'gro ba dang g.yar ba'i pha yul la sun snang zhig dbang med du skye yong /zla phyed tsam ring gros mol yang yang byas mthar/ bu mo tshe ring lha mor de tsam mos mthun med kyang ma'i bsam 'dun las ma ldog pas/ lha skyid ma bu gnyis kyis phyugs zog dang khyer mi bde ba'i dngos po kun dngul la bsgyur/chos lha yong sa'i gnas bskor ba'i rlangs 'khor nang bsdad nas stod phyogs kyi gangs ri dang rtswa thang / dud rogs bcas la bral mi phod pa'i brtse ba 'chang bzhin/ lha skyid kyi gcer bur sa ru zag nas ngu skad thog mar bsgrags sa'i gnas der dmigs nas yong /pha yul gyi srid gzhung gis lha skyid ma bu gnyis kyi 'tsho ba'i thad 'os 'tsham bkod sgrig byas/ gnyen nye yul mi rnams kyi rogs ram 'og khang pa thog gcig ma zhig brgyab/ khong gnyis kyis stod phyogs nas khyer ba'i dngul gyis thon skyed la mkho ba'i 'bri bcu nyos/ chos lha ni lha skyid ma bur rogs ram byed che shos red/ des na/ lha skyid ma bu gnyis kyi 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs po zhes brjod dka' yang zas gos kyi thad dka' ngal ci gang ma 'phrad/desan lo gcig gi rjes su/ chos lhas u tshugs mthar skyel byas pas/chos lha tshang dang lha skyid tshang dud gcig tu byas/ khyim tshang der bde skyid kyi dgod sgras khengs/ rgan rgon gnyis gas rang nyid kyi tshe smad skyid po zhig yong rgyu yin pa'i yid ches byas/245

rin chen dbang 'dus dang tshe ring lha mo gnyis so so'i pha ma'i ngo la bltas pa las/ sems kyi gting nas de tsam mi bde bar gyur/ 'on kyang 'dris gshib kyi khrod du rim bzhin rgyus mnga' lon pa ma zad/ brtse dung gi ljang bu zhig kyang bde ldan ngang rim bzhin rgyas/ khong gnyis gas chung nas phan tshun ming tsam go ma myong ba'i pho mo gnyis chu khri ri stong brgal nas khang pa gcig gi nang du 'dzoms rgyu byung ba ni bzlos thabs med pa'i tshe sngon gyi las yin gyi red snyam/ thog mar gnyis ku'i sems su sbas nas gcig sems gcig gis ma shes pa'i gsang ba de dkar gsal zla 'od kyi 'og ri rtse'i me tog gi dkyil du rim bzhin mi gnyis la gtogs pa'i longs spyod du gyur/des na/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis pha chos lhar kho dang tshe ring lha mo chang sa rgyag rgyu'i re ba byas/ bsam tshul de rgan rgon gnyis po'i bsam thog la rta brgyugs pas/ chos lhas de mur dgod sgra lhang lhang gis mos mthun byas shing lha:da kyis skad cha de go dus ngo gdong dga' 'dzum gyis mi shong bar gyur/bkra shes rten 'brel gyi bya ba de lo gcig gi rjes la bya rgyu'i gtan 'khel/za 'og gi ri mo lta bu'i bod byang thang gi dbyar dus dang mar khu byug 'dra'i bod byang thang gi ston dus rim bzhin yol nas skya ther ther gyi dgun kha'i 'jig rten de tshur bsus/ dus rgyun dang mi 'dra ba zhig la lo der rlung gi rgyu ba shin tu chung / nam mkha'i dbyings su sprin thog sprin brtsegs/ sa cha mtho dma' kun tu yal mi thub pa'i lhog lhog smug rlangs kyis khengs/ nyin mang po ma so/nga bar/ a sngon gnam gyi rkub brdol ba ltar/ gangs kyi me tog lhab be lhub be grangs las 'das pa'i bye'u chung 'phur ba ltar sa gzhi'i ngos su gcig thog gnyis brtsegs kyis lhung / sa gzhi chen po rim bzhin de tsam sgang gshong med pa'i skya ling ling zhig tu 'gyur/ skabs de'i nag thig ni 'chi bkā/ ḍi kha ru 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa'i spu nag gi phyugs zog kho na red/ yul

mi kun ci bya gtol bral gyi gnas su gyar/ 'brog pa'i 'tsho rten du gyur pa'i phyugs rigs dkar nag re re bzhin srog yod nas srog med du 'gyur/gangs thog mar bab dus/ chos lha hur brtson chen pos yar rgyug mar rgyug gis gangs 'gog phyugs skyob kyi thabs sna tshogs btsal/ 'on kyang / kho'i bya thabs tshang ma rang byung khams chen po'i mdun du phru gu'i rtsed mo nus med 'ba' zhig tu mngon/ de nas chos lha ni rdo tsha po'i steng gi 'bu grog ma bzhin 'tshab 'tshub thabs zad kyi gnas su gyar/ de rjes chos lha nad tshabs chen mnar ba bzhin ngo mdog 'gyur nas dbugs ring 'ba' zhig gtong /mtha' mjug chos lha'i gshes ka je sdug tu song nas lha skyid ma bu ltas ngan du brtsis nas ngan dmod sna tshogs byas/ thengs gcig rin chen dbang 'dus kyis bkag 'gog ma byas na/ chos lhas lha skyid la rgyag rdung byed rtsis byas/ lha skyid kyang sems 'tshab nas me 'bar yang / mo la bya thabs kyis dbul/ de las mo'i sems kyi gting nas skyo ba dpag med skye dgos pa zhig ni/ chos lhas rang nyid la bsam shes spu tsam mi bya bar thob par dka' ba'i bdeskyed kyi 'tsho ba rim bzhin yal 'gro ba de red/ des na/ 'das zin pa'i yid skyo ba'i bya ba dag kyang thengs mang po yid la 'khor 'khor gyis lkog tu yid skyo ba'i mig chu yang yang shor/ngo ma/ gzhon nu ni blo rgya yangs/ bya thabs mang / nyin gcig rin chen dbang 'dus kyis rlangs 'khor zhig glas nas khong tshang gi phyugs zog shi 'phro rnams rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i sa cha gzhan du dbor/dus kyi pho nyas dpyid ka bsus/ spyir btang min pa'i drod rlung zhig gis dgun dus ci zhig gis kyang bzhu mi thub pa'i gangs 'khyags ma lus gzugs med du bcom/ ngo ma/ che 'byung bas 'byung ba 'joms/ zhesdu sna'i

bod kyi gtam dpe de ci mi bden/ sa gzhi'i steng du sngon med kyi rtswa dang me tog skyes/ 'on te rtswa thang gi steng la rol ba'i phyugs zog shin tu nyung bas/mi rnams kyi mig mdun du de sngon gyi dar rgyas mngon rgyu med pas sa cha de sngon ma las rgya che ru song ba'i stong sang sang gi snang ba zhig ster yong / rin chen dbang 'dus kyis sa cha gzhan du dbor ba'i phyugs zog dag gson por gnas stabs/ dud tshang gzhan dang bsdur na khong tshang ni phyug po yin/thon skyed rgyu cha bor nas las med du 'gyur ba'i mi tsho gcig gis gangs skyon gyi 'byung rkyen thad rang byung khams las 'das pa'i 'grel bshad sna tshogs byas/ rdzun gyi gshog pa skyes pa'i gtam yan sna tshogs skyag dong nang gi sbrang nag bzhin gang sar zang zing du lding / gtam yan nang gi khyab che shos ni sngags pa bdud nag drag 'dul gyi rmi lam de red/bdud nag drag 'dul ngo mas thengs mang bshad pa'i rmi lam 'di ltar te/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyi skabs su/ 'gro ba sems can la gnod che ba'i gangs bdud cig slob dpon rin po che yi rdzu 'phrul la 'jigs nas stod phyogs grangs las 'das pa'i gangs ri'i khrod du bdud kyi mche ba lta bu'i gangs ri zhig la brdzus nas bgrang bya du ma de ltar song / nam zhig la/gnam sa g.yo ba'i rlung 'tshub cig dang mnyam du bdud mo bser bu rlung du sprul nas rgyu thengs ba/cig gis chag la ri bo'i thog tu slobs shing re zhig byams dang snying rje can gyi g.yang dkar lug cig la brdzus nas bsdad/ da lo ston khar/ bdud mo des rang gzugs bstan/ gangs 'khyags kyi ka ba lta bu'i mche ba ring po de gtsigs gtsigs/ ske la btags pa'i ser ba'i phreng ba de gon skyor/ mgo la zang zing du gnas pa'i gangs kyi ral pa de gsig gsigagangs 'khyags las grub pa'i gshog pa chen po de rdeb deb bcas byas pa na/a rdo18 nam mkha' la sngar 'khor ma myong ba'i sprin gyi dmag sgar brgyab/ dog

mo sa la sngar 'bab ma myong ba'i gangs kyi dug mda' 'phangs/ thog mar babs dus gangs de sen mo tsam/ de nas babs pa'i gangs de phor pa tsam/de nas babs pa'i gangs de thug pa bskol sa'i snod tsam/ de nas babs pa'i gangs de 'brog pa'i sbra gur tsam/ de dus/ sngags pas 'gro ba sems can gyi bde sdug la bsam nas shugs kyis phu btab pas gangs je chung nas je chung du song /gtam yan smra ba pos rmi lam der 'grel bshad byas don/ stod nas yong ba'i bdud mo de lha skyid yin pa dang / gal srid sngags pa'i mthu la ma brten na/ yul mi rnams sbra gur lta bu'i gangs 'og tu 'jig rgyu red/skabs der chos lhas bgrang bya du ma'i sngon du sa smad kyi bla ma des bshad pa'i lha skyid bdud mo yin pa'i skad cha de yang yang dran/ da lo da dung chos lha'i yid gdon gyis bslus pa ltar/ kha nas sngags yig bzlo zhing lag gi stangs stabs sna tshogs kyis bdud 'dul ba'i bzo bstan nas gangs gshog skyes pa'i bdud mo zer nas lha skyid thog la dmod cing ngar/ thengs gcigalha skyid kyis ja tsha po phor pa gang blugs nas brtse ba chen pos chos lha la sprad pa na/ chos lhas dug mthong ba bzhin ja dang phor pa mnyam du lha skyid kyi thog la 'phang / 64a tsha tsha/ lha skyid kyi kha nas dbang med du skad ngan shor/ tshe ring lha mo'i ngo mdog dmar nag tu gyur nas cung tsam min na chos lha'i thog la mchongs/ lha skyid kyi ngo mdog rbad de log nas kha sha lheb lheb tu 'dar yang kha nas skad cha ma thon/chos lha nyin re bzhin ngar je che dang gtam je mang du gyur zhing /mjug tu rang nyid kyis gangs rin po che yi mdun du bzhag pa'i dam bca' rnams mchil ma'i rdzas bzhin bskyur nas lha skyid ma bu dang dud so sor bgo rgyu'i gtam 'go bton/ rin chen dbang 'dus kyis pha la kha ta slob ga~X sdus

kyang 'bras bu ci'ang ma smin/ lha skyid kyi ngos nas bshad na'ang khyim gcig gi nang du mu mthud nas chos lha'i ngan smrar bzod sgom bya thabs bral/lha skyid ma bu slar yang de sngon gyi khang chung nang spos/ skyid sdug mang po brgyud tshar ba'i lha skyid kyi sems la sdug bsngal gyis khengs kyang mi mang po'i khrod du sdug gi mchi ma khog pa'i nang du mid/ rang gis rang la gdeng 'jog byas dus/ yul la gnod pa skyel ba'i gangs gshog skyes pa'i bdud mo de mi rnams kyis ngos 'dzin bya rgyu'i thad rbad de nor 'dug snyam/chos lhas lha skyid ma bu phud rjes/ sngags pa bdud nag drag 'dul gdan zhu byas nas khang pa'i nang gegs sel byas/tshe ring lha mo bzod sgom byed thabs bral ba'i gnas la slebs/ dus rgyun mo'i dkar zhing 'jam la dmar mdangs bkra thog 'dzum mdangs mi yal ba'i ngo gdong de deng gi char rid cing rtsub par gyur thog nam yang nag rog ger gnas/ gal srid chos lha ni rin chen dbang 'dus kyi pha min na sngar nas kho dang khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzing zhig byas tshar/ smyo bu mo ga par 'gro gi yin/ lha skyid kyis bos kyang ma go ba ltar tshe ring lha mo brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis phyin song / sgo'ang ma brdung bar ngo gdong lho sprin 'khor bzhin bdud nag drag 'dul gyi nang du 'dzul/bdud nag drag 'dul gyes stag ltar khros pa'i bu mo mthong dus/ myur du mdun gyi dpe cha 'don mtshams bzhag pa dang mig shel zur du phud de rtab rto1 spyas ltangs rjes/ u tshugs kyis sgam brling gi bzo zhig bstan/ 6 las ka 6)la/ sa ka los yod/’ tshe ring lha mos khos bkram pa'i gtam yan gyis khong ma bu gnyis la bzos pa'i lus sems kyi gnod 'tshe zhib tu bshad pa daX /50da lta sngags pa rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i gtam yan rang nyid kyis

'gan 'khur nas de'i bag chags med pa bzo rogs zhes bshad/bdud nag drag 'dul yud tsam kha ma grags par bsdad rjes/ ji mi snyam pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan nas 8 khyod kyis rgyal khab kyi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus ma shes sam zhes bshad de nor 'khrul thams cad tshe ring lha mor yod pa'i bzo bstan/tshe ring lha mo ngu bzhin kho'i thog la mchongs nas smyo nged gnyis rdzong thog rtu 'gro/ sus chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus gtor bshig byas min skad cha 'dri zhes bshad de bdud nag drag 'dul gyi lag 'go nas 'jus te phyir 'khrid par rtsom/6 ga re/ ga re/ khyod khyod/ bdud mo/ bdud nag drag 'dul skrag snang chen pos skad ngan shor/skabs der/ rin chen dbang 'dus der yong / khros bdud nag drag 'dul la sdang mig gcig bltas pa dang / tshe ring lha mo phyi log tu khrid/bdud nag drag 'dul mgo bo gug nas bsdad song /rin chen dbang 'dus dang tshe ring lha mo'i bar gyi brtse dung de rang byung gi gnod 'tshe chen po'i tshod bgam byas pa brgyud sngar bas 'gyur med sra brtan du gyur nas phan tshun skad gcig tsam yang kha bral thabs med pa'i gnas la slebs/dengagi char/ khong gnyis gnyen sgrig bya rgyur chos lhas myos pa ltar ngo rgol byas/ lha skyid kyis mtha' gcig tu rgyab skyor byas/khong tsho'i grong tshor/ rdzong gis btang ba'i las don tshogs chung 'byor nas lha skyid bdud mo dang gangs kyi 'byung rtsa red ces pa'i gnas tshul la brtag zhib byas/ las don tshogs chung gis mang tshogs kyi tshogs chen 2rdozlos

gnyis 'tshogs nas tshan rig dang srid jus rgyas par bshad nas rmongs dad kyi lta ba de tshor dgag rgyag tsha nan byas/ gtam yan bzo mkhan gyi mi sna'i 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded kyang byas/ sngags pa bdud nag drag 'dul rdzong thog tu khrid/ de na mi mang che bas da lo gangs chen bab dgos pa'i rang byung gi rgyu rkyen shes nas lha skyid ma bur lta tshul ci'ang med par gyur/ de sngon rang nyid kyis long gtam bshad nas mi bzang po sdug bsngal bzos par 'gyod bshags byas/ 'on kyang chos lha dang bcas pa'i god po kha shas kyi bsam blo 'gyur ma thub pas/ kha nas sngar bzhin smra mi yod kyang sems gting nas da dung lha skyid bdud mor sgom/nyin bcu grangs kyi rjes su/ bdud nag drag 'dul ngo mdog thal skyar gyur nas phyir log 'dug kho shar rer lha skyid ma bu'i sdod gnas su song /nang du 'dzul ma thag dus rgyun gyi rngam zil spu tsam med par thab zur du bsdad nas 6 ngas nor 'khrul ngos len zhu/ khyed ma bur dgongs dag thugs bden zhu ru yong ba yin zhes bshad/lha skyid 'tshab 'tshub kyis yar langs nas 6 gdan thog tu bzhugs zhes bshad nas rang dbang med par gus gus zhum zhum gyi rnam 'gyur zhig kyang bsdushā /ma — tshe ring lha mo khros nas ma la mig log cig bltas pa dang ji mi snyam pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan nas bsdad/bdud nag drag 'dul gyis lha skyid ma bu'i mdun du ngu ngag dang bcas par ngos len zhus pa dang dgongs dag yang yang zhus thog lha skyid ma bur re ba ci yod kyi skad cha'ang dris/lha skyid kyis rtab rtob kyis re ba med ces bshad ma tshar gong / tshe ring lha ༵༵ 6 mang tshogs tshogs chen thog tu de ring ltar thengs gcig byed
