rogs zhes bshad pas bdud nag drag 'dul gyis de mur khas len byas/de nas nyin shas kyi rjes la/ grong tsho'i tshogs chen 'tshogs/ bdud nag drag 'dul gyis rang nyid kyi nor 'khrul ngos 'dzin ma byas ka med byung /kha bde can 'gas/ 6 lha skyid skyid skyid ma bzhag pas/ bdud nag nag nag rang gis bzos/’ zer/gsum/chos lha chung nas dwa phrug tu lus pa ni ya nga snying rje'i gnas las ma 'das kyang / kho'i phyi ma'i yul du gshegs pa'i pha ma gnyis pos kho la rgyu nor gyi bzhag pa mi dman pa bzhag yod thog chos lha chung nas las ka 'jon zhing za mkhas btung mkhas can zhig yin stabs/ deng gi lo nyi shur slebs pa'i chos lha ni pho hreng phyug po zhig red/ des na/ nye ba'i char rgyu nor bdag po rgyag rogs mna' ma zhig len rgyu ni chos lha'i gal che'i las 'gan zhig tu gyur/mi gang mang mang zhig gis rang gi bu mo'am rang gi sring mo chos lhar sprod 'dod byas kyang / chos lha ni lha bla mar bslu med kyi dad pa byed mkhan zhig yin pas/ mtha' mjug gtan 'khel gyi dbang cha de bla mar phul/ chos lha rkang btsugs nas bkra shes chos gling dgon du song zhing / bla mas khor mna' ma su len dgongs lam nas gzigs rogs zhes zhus/ mgo la skra rkang gcig kyang med pa'i bla rgan des phreng ba bzung nas kha mug mug 'ga' byas rjes/6 bde rab tshang gi bu mo lha skyid mna' mar blangs na yag po yong srid ces 'dzum dmul dmul gyis bshad/bde rab kyis kyang kur kor med par/ bu mo lha skyid chos lhar mna' mar sprad/ chung nas cha rgyus med pa'i gzhon nu gnyis glo bur du bza~X sbyang

chags/ 'on te skabs de dus kyi bza' tshang phal cher de ltar yin stabs de la ha las dgos pa med la/ chos lhas lha skyid kyi bco lnga'i dung zla'i rjes la 'gro ba'i ngo gdong thog gi skad smra shes pa lta bu'i mig khra gor gor gnyis dang /de'i rgyan du grub pa'i ri mo mkhas pa'i pir gyis bris 'dra'i dzi ma ring po dang kri ga chen po de mthong dus/ dga' bde zhig chos lha'i ba spu'i khung bu re re bzhin du sim/ lha skyid kyis kyang thengs dang po mig zur gyis ga ler chos lhar lta dus/ gzugs ring zhing sbom pa/ ngo gdong che la mig sna kha gsum mngon par gsal ba'i pho rgod cig gi gzugs brnyan mngon/ 'tsho ba dngos kyi khrod du'ang phan tshun yongs su blo mgu/ 'bral mi phod pa'i brtse dung zhig rtsa ba tshugs nas 'bras bu smin/ lha skyid kyi ngo gdong nas nam yang bde skyid kyi 'dzum mdangs mi yal/ chos lha'i kha nas yid tshims pa'i glu chung rgyun mi chad/ bkra shis chos gling dgon gyi bla rgan de dgongs pa rdzogs/ chos lha dang lha skyid kyis rang nyid kyi bde skyid la bsam bzhin sems sdug dpag med byas/ lha skyid kyi grod pa 'bur du thon/ chos lha dga' thag chod nas nyi ma rer thengs re blta/ skabs 'gar chos lhas lha skyid kyi grod pa nan tan gyis rna ba nyan pa dang brtse ba chen pos 'o byas rjes/ byis pa zhig ltar spro ba rab tu rgyas pa'i ngang nas gnam lding sa mchong byed/nyin zhig 'od dang snang ba'i bdag po lhog lhog sprin nag gi 'og tu ma sgrib par/ zim zim gyi char chung zhig yun ring babs/ byis pa 'ga' gcer bur phyi ru rgyug nas 8 nyi shar char 'bab ’ ces dga' 'bod byas/ de nas tshon ldan gyi 'ja' gur phub/ mi phal che ba sgo la thon nas dga' snang chen po byas/ dgong mo/ 'ja' rim bzhin yal ba dang / rta dkar po sha stag ba/shā sna'i sa smad kyi bla grwa lnga lha yi pho nya ltar khong tsho'i grong tshor 'byor/

thog mar rgan rgon dang / de nas mi tshang mas bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i bkra shis rten 'brel du brtsis nas/ 'tshang kha shig shig gis bla ma mjal du song /mi mang pos bla ma der mngon shes thogs pa mi 'dug zer/chos lhas chen du bla grwa rnams rang nyid kyi khyim du gdan 'dren zhus/ bla ma dbu che la mchu to mthug po des/ yun ring po lha skyid kyi gdong la bltas/lhanyid ngo tsha nas mgo bo gug bla ma des bla ma zhig gi cha nas lha skyid dang 'gram pa sbyar ba dang mo'i gdong pa phur phur byas/ bla mas zur du kha skyengs nas langs pa'i chos lha mthong bas/ myur du lha skyid ltar kho la 'gram pa sbyar/gdong pa phur phur byas/ bla ma des yud tsam bsdad rjes/ glo bur du ngo 'dzum mdangs kyis khyab bzhin langs byung / 6 bkra shes bde legs ’ zer bzhin dar dkar gnyis blangs nas lha skyid dang chos lha'i sko la bkon rjes/lha skyid sbrum du zhugs pa ni skye bo phal pa min par sprul sku chen po zhig red ces smras/ nyin shas kyi rjes la/ bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas pa chos lha dang bcas pa'i yul mi tsho'i gya nom pa'i 'bul ba bsnams nas dbus nyi ma lha sa'i phyogs su phyin song / lo gcig gi rjes su/ bla ma de 'di nas phyir log dus sprul sku dngos su ngos 'dzin byed kyi yin zer ba dang / de'i bar ma dang byis pa gtsang sbra la do snang byas nas btsog grib ma shor ba dgos pa'i mngag bya yang yang byas/skad cha dag rlung gshog skyes pa bzhin phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la khyab/ yul mi tshang mas chos lha bza' tsho bla ma la brtsis nas gus bkur byas/chos lha spobs pa rab tu rgyas nas sa thog tu gom pa'ang spo mi shes par gyur/ khos lha skyid la btsog grib phog rgyur skrag nas/ nyin ltar rang shātā ngo

mas thab las byas nas lto bzo ba dang / lha skyid ha lam phying dkar bting pa'i khang pa'i sbug nas kha bral du mi 'jugalha skyid kyang nyin ltar gsol ba smon lam btab nas sprul sku rin po che de bde ldan gyis mi yul du byon nas 'gro ba sems can la phan 'dogs rgyu'i re ba byasanyi/ na zhig gi snga dror/ lha skyid skye gzer brgyab/ grong tsho'i nang gi gon skra dkar nas gzhon so dkar bar chos lha tshang gi sgo 'gram du pus mo sa la btsugs nas sprul sku chen po 'jig rten mi yul du byon rgyu sgug chos lha dga' bas myos nas kha zum mi thub par yar rgyug mar rgyug byed pa dang lha skyid kyi kha la de sngon bla mas gnang ba'i byin rlabs blugs/ lha skyid kyi lus nas dmyal khams bco brgyad la slobs pa lta bu'i gzer chen brgyab kyang sems dga' bdes khyab/ gzer chen rgyag thengs re la skad ngan dbang med shor yang /bzo 'gyur ba'i ngo gdong nas bde skyid kyi 'dzum mdangs yongs su ma yal/kun gyi bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la/ lha skyid kyi skye sgo nas dmar 'dzar 'dzar gyi khrag dang mnyam du lhung ba ni/ dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad la nye ba'i bu mo zhig ja yun tsam gyi rjes su bu mo de'i dbugs kyi rgyu ba yongs su chad nas srog med bem por gyur/chos lha'i sems glo bur du dga' ldan lha yi zhing khams nas dmyal khams bco brgyad la lhung nas ngo mdog thal skyar gyur zhing gnas skabs ring kha'ang grag mi shes pa'i lkugs par gyur/lha skyid kyi lus sems gnyis ka sdug bsngal gyis bzung nas lus kyi ba spu re re bzhin nas khrag dang mchi ma chad med bzhur ba'i snang ba byung /sgo 'gram du pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs pa'i mi rnams rim bzhin thar thoX ༵༵ langs byung / kha cig gi ngo gdong skyi g.ya' bar 'gyur/ kha cig

dbang med du skad ngan shor/ kha cig gi gdong pa las ngo tsha ba'i bzo bstan/kha cig gi kha zur nas de tsam mngon rgyu med pa'i 'dzum chung zhig bstan/nyin shas kyi rjes su/ mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba rim bzhin snying 'jags su gyur/ bla ma'i lung bstan don la mi gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan la dbye zhib sna tshogs byas/ dbye zhib kyi 'bras bu khag gnyis te/ gcig ni bla ma rdzun ma yin pa dang / gcig ni rkyen bar chad byung ba de red/sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba'i lha skyid yun ring drag skyed ma byung bar nyal sar lhung / de nyin grong mi khyim mtshes la mig thad kur mi lta la so bar nas skad cha shod pa'i chos lha nyi ma mang po'i nang khyim mtshes kyi pho mo rgan gzhon gyi mdun du mgo bo dgye dgye byed pa'i spobs pa'ang bral/lo gcig gi rjes su/ chos lha dang lha skyid kyi 'tsho ba rgyun ldan du 'gyur/rgyun ldan dang bral ba zhig ni de sngon lung bstan mkhan gyi bla ma de khong tsho'i grong tshor 'byor nas gur phub ste sgar brgyab/de sngon 'tshang kha shig sheg gi mi de tsho de ring thar thor las bla ma'i mdun du 'gro mkhan mi 'dugami thar thor dang thug 'phrad grub rjes/ bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas pa shar rer chos lha tshang du song / bla ma nang du 'dzul ma thag blo pham mdog gis 6 bar chad red/ nga'i mi lam nang rmis byung / 'on kyang bar thag ring bas thabs ma byung ’ zhes smras nas dbugs ring nar nar byas/bla ma des yud tsam ring mig btsum nas bsdad rjes/ chos lha dang lha skyid kyi mgo la lag pas byil byil 'ga' byas te sems sdug ma byed/ thams cad tshar ba red/ da dung bar chad gcig 'dug pas rkyen sel rim 'gro bya dgos zhes bshad/nyin gnyis pa/ bla grwa lnga po chos lha tshang du spos nas sku rim byas/25/sa

lha sku rim gyi rdzas la mkho ba'i ri rtse'i gangs 'khyags len du chag la ri rtser song / sa thag ring bas/ chos lha nyin gsum tsam log mi thub/ mtshan dkyil tsam la slebs/ mi rnams kyi sna khung nas sgra mtho dma' sna tshogs kyi rngur sgra grags/ mi zhig rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis lha skyid kyi nyal sar slebs/mi des lha skyid kyi mgo dang 'gram par 'o bskyal ba dang lag pa mo'i rum nang du bcug nas bud med kyi mtshon rtags su gyur sar dmigs/ da dung shugs kyis mo'i rum nang 'dzul e thub lta/ lha skyid mtha' gcig tu 'gog rgol byas pas kho'i mtha' 'jug gi bsam don ma 'grub/ 'on kyang mos skad gtan nas rgyag ma phod/dgong mo gnyis pa la yang de ltar byung / lha skyid kyis 'dod chags kyis myos pa'i mi de ni bla ma phud pa'i mi bzhi las gcig yin nges red snyam/dgong mo gsum par/ lha skyid kyis lag pa thab dreg bskus nas sgug bsdad/mi de dgong mo sngon ma bzhin 'byor bas lha skyid kyis 'gog rgol byed zhor du thab dreg mi de'i gdong par bskus/ nyin gnyis par/ bla grwa de dag gis rngam rngam dzig dzig gis gyer 'don byed/ lha skyid kyis zhib tu blta dus/gdong par thab dreg 'gos pa ni grwa pa bzhi po min par/ gral 'gor bsdad pa'i bla ma de red/ lha skyid rbad de ha las/ sems kyi gting nas bla ma rdzun ma yin pa thag gis bcad/ de sngon gyi dad sems ma lus 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ chos lha slebs rjes gnas tshul bshad nas grong pa khyim mtshes kyi khrod du kho'igadong ris dmar rjen du bzo dgos snyam/ bla ma de'i mdang dgong gi byed stangs las 'das pa'i da lta'i sgrob nyams de mo'i mig mdun du yang yang mngon dus sems kyi gting nas spyir btang min pa'i khong khro'i me lce zhig 'bar/ mos myur du bla ma'i chos yig klog pa'i skad gdangs kyis ru gral 'aswāswā ṭā rdzun gdong nag khyod/ mdang gi bya ngan mi dran nam zhes thengs kha

shas skyo/ pa/ bzhi po tshor snang ci'ang med kyang bla ma de'i mig chung chung gnyis hril hril gyis 'khor ba dang / mdzub mos gdong par thug tsam byas pas mdzub rtse'i du dreg mig mdun du shar stabs/ kho'i ngo mdog tshang ma loga'on kyang khos sdod skyor zhig byas pa dang ngo mdog sngar mus bzhin 'gyur ba dang / lha skyid la mig brda zhig brgyab nas chos 'don pa'i skad gdangs kyis 8 ma mang ma mang kha ma mang / gzi byur rngan pa sprod dgos ang zhes thengs shas smras rjes ci'ang byung med pa ltar chos yig gyer 'don gyi gral du zhugs/log la spya sdi// chos lha log 'dug bla ma des myur du langs nas chos lha phyi yud tsam song rjes/ bla ma de 'dzum dmul dmul gyis phyir log nas rang nyid kyi sdod gnas su bsdad/chos lha'i gdong gi 'dzum mdangs yongs su bsdus pa ma zad/ lha skyid kyi thog la rnam 'gyur grang shur shur gyur 'dug lha skyid kyis thengs kha shas kho la gnas tshul shod rtsis byas kyang / chos lhas rna ba gtan nas ma khom pa'i bzo bstan nas skad cha nyan rogs ma byas/ de'i phyi nyin/ bla grwa de tshos chos lha la byin rlabs gang mang sprad rjes/ khong tsho'i khyim nas kha bral/ bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa phyir thon nas yun ring ma song gong / chos lhas lha skyid la 'gram lcag tsha thag chod cig brgyab cing kha nas mgo mjug med par 6 bdud mo ngo tsha rgyu med pa ’ zhes bshad/lha skyid kyis ci yin mi shes/ ha las hon thor/ yud tsam song rjes gzhi nas ngu ngag dang bcas par/ 66gari byas pa red dam/ 66ga re byas minakhyod kyis los shes/ bla ma'i sdom pa bslog rtsis byed mkhan/ ngo tsha rgyu med pa/’ 259

6 bla ma de rdzun ma red/ ngas shod dgos/’ 8 bdud mo/ kha tshums/ de ring nas nged gnyis mnyam du sdod thabs med/ khyod rang khyim du log 6 nged gnyis bla gon gyi dgongs pa ltar mnyam du bsdad pa red/ 66de dus kyi khyod dang deng sang gi khyod mi 'dra zer/ khyod deng skabs mi ma red bdud mo red zer/ rin po che des kyang khyod dang mnyam du bsdad na tshe srog la'ang bar chad yod zer/ lha skyid kyang khros nas chos lha'i thog la ngar gtam bshad/ kho ni legs nyes mi shes pa'i blun po red ces smras /chos lha sngar bas khros nas lha skyid kyi thog la mchongs nas rgyag rdung byed rtsis byas/ lha skyid tshur rgyug nas che nga sod ces pa'i ngar skad gnam sa g.yo ba bsgrags/ nyin gnyis par/ shar ri'i rtse nas dal gyis 'phags pa'i nyin byed dbang pos yangs pa'i nor 'dzin 'od snang gis mdzes par byas 'dugaloganyis tsam mnyam du bsdad pa'i chos lha dang lha skyid bza' tshang kha 'thor nas sha kha kha dang gri so so'i lam du song / chos lhas rgyu nor bgo stangs thad rang nyid mi pham pa'i bsam blo gang mang btang nas sgug mod kyang / lha skyid kyis rtsam khug gcig las ma khyer bar song / chos lhas ring nas ring du 'gyibazhin pa'i lha skyid kyi gzugs por lta bzhin cung kha skyengs nas kha 'gul tsameji'agul tsam byed pa las skad cha tshig gcig kyang shod mi thub par lus/ lhoskyid kyis ga ler g.yas g.yon du lta dus/ skye stobs kyi rtswa ljang khrod du dkar/dmar gyi me tog bkra/ bung bas mgrin glu len zhing phye leb gshog 'gyur ngom/lhung lhung gi chu chung zhig rtswa thang gi dkyil nas shag shag gis rgyug 'on te/lha skyid kyi mig nang du mang nas mang = 'gro ba ni mig chu kho na'o/ / 260

skra gzhugagacig gnam lha pho lo bcu bzhir slebs dus gang sar khyab pa'i nad yams shig gis kho'i pha ma gnyis dang nang mi kun 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du btsan gyis khrid/ pha shi khar da dung byis pa yin pa'i gnam lha la lta bzhin ldab ldib kyi skad cha re zung bshad kyang de don sus kyang ma rtogs/ ngo ma gnam lhas pha shi kha'i kha chems kyi don ma rtogs pa red/des na glo bur du byung ba'i bar chad des gnam lha ni chags sa brten sa med pa'i dwa phrug cig la gyur/ de dus rang nyid ltar chags rten med pa'i rgad po lha srung gis kho 'tshol du yong / lha srung gis kho'i mgo la byil byil 'ga' byas te 6 a mye'i bu e byed ces dris par/ gnam lhas mgo bo 'phred la g.yugs te 8 min zhes tshig thag chod pos bshad/ gnam lha'i a zhang rab tu khros nas gnam lha la mig log cig bltas pa dang lha srung la ngo srung ba'i 'dzum mdangs shig bstan te 6 kho 'gro gi red/ 'gro sa yag po 'di 'dra yod dus/’ zhes bshad/ 6 nga a zhang gis khrid rogs/’ 8 khyed a mye lha srung mnyam du song na dga'/ a zhang khyim du grod pa mi 'grang / 6 ngas phyugs dzir 'gro chog 66a zhang gi khyim la phyugs dzir 'gro mkhan ga tshod 2)spyas

dgos yod/’ 6 nga khrid rogs/’ gnam lhas snga dro zhig ngus rjes nyin gung tsam la gzhi nas lha srung gi bu tshab byed rgyu khas len byas/ 6 nga rgad po shi khar bu thob pa red/ lha srung dga' thag chod nas rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed/lha srung ni sa mtha'i mi 'khyam zhig red/ lha chu rtswa thang la gnyen nye bu phrug gcig kyang med/ kho la rgyu nor gyi 'byor pa nges can zhig yod mod kyang tshang mas kho la mthong chung byed/ go tshul la kho'i rgyu nor ni rku jag byas nas byung ba red zer/ sngon ma lha srung dang mnyam du rku jag la zhugs myong ba'i rgad po zhigagis bshad pa ltar na/ nyin zhig lha srung kho gnyis kyis tshong pa chen po zhig gi tshong khang gtor nas g.yu byur sgam gang brkus/ khos sgam de khur nas ci'ang mi mthong ba'i mun nag gi khrod nas brel ba chen pos bros/ lam gzar sa zhig la slobs dus glo bur du ki hi hi zhes pa'i sgra grags shing kho'i lus thog tu rdo kha shas bab/ kho skrag thag chod nas sgam de ru bskyur nas phyi bltas mi slog par srog mgo ci thon bros/ rjes su go thos ltar na lha srung gis dkrog brda brgyab ste g.yu byur sgam gang po de khos sger bdag byas zer/ des na gnam lha'i sems su lha srung ni g.yo sgyu can gyi wa mo zhig tu mngon/ da dung lha srung la skyi g.ya' dgos pa'i ngo gdong zhig mchis/ kha cig gis dred mong gis zos nas byas pa red zer/ kha cig gis rgyab 'dre brgyab nas byas pa red zer/ kho'i skyi g.ya' ba'i ngo gdong de pha ma tshor byis pa rnams la skrag snang skul byed la mkho/ des na gnam lha chung dus nas lha srung la mi dga'/ ma gzhi lha srung gi rngan pa la dmigs nas chu len rogs thengs kha shas byed myong mod kyang tshang mar chu snod kyi nang la gcin btang / dus rgyun gnam lhas lngasrung gis a ra dkar po byil byil gyis 'gro ba mthong dus khos rang nyid kyi gcin pa btung ba red bsam nas khong dgod shor bzhin yod/ ci 26chosamayul las 'das pa'i chag sgo des gnam lha lha srung gi bu tshab mi

byed ka med du gyur kyang khos lha srung la mngon brtsi lkog 'gal tsam las sems gting nas brtsi bkur byed ma myong / lha srung gis kho la thug pa blugs dgos pa'i bka' phab dus khos ga ler mchil ma lha srung gi phor pa'i nang la bsho/thug sdor mang ba rang nyid kyi phor pa'i nang blugs shing nyung ba god por blugs/nyin zhig rgad po lha srung gis sgam 'og nas stong skud nag po'i skra gzhug cig blangs te a slog mang po byas te zhib lta byas/ de nas gnam lha mdun du bos nas mgo nas mjug bar mig hrig hrig gis bltas/ 6 'di pha gad pos nga la bzhag pa red/ 'dis rkyen dang bar chad bzlog thub/ ngo ma red/ 'di min na nga sngar nas mi yul las kha bral tshar yod kyi red/ deng khyod nga'i bu yin pas sku gzhug 'di khyod la sprod/ 6 sku gzhug 'dis bar chad gang sel thub/ 6 ltos dang / nga'i gdong pa/ 'di gang byas pa red/ khyed kyis 'di'i skor skad cha mang po go myong yod kyi red/ ngas dag 'bud byed ma myong / da shi khar dag 'bud byed dgos pa ci'ang ma mchis/ shi tshar dus chos rgyal gyi mdun la gsal po red/ 'on te de ring ngas khyod la drang po bshad na/ nga'i pha yul smad nas red/ nga chung dus 'di 'dra ma red/ dzig dang dpa' blo khog grong tsho yongs kyi ang dang po'i gras la slebs/ dgong mo zhig nga grong tsho'i nang gi bu mo mdzes shos de'i rjes la song ba yin/ ngas ji ltar bshad kyang mos kha ya mi byed/ dngos gnas mdzes ma zhig red/ deng sang bu mo de 'dra mi 'dug mos nga la khyed kyis dred phrug bzhon nas slebs 'dug na ngas bza' mo byed zer/ ngas dred phrug bzhon nas yong ma thub na dred tshang nang shi yang mi 'gyod ces bshad de mna' skyel ba yin/ nyin gnyis par ngas sked par gri gzer nas dred tshang nang song ba yin/ de dus nga ni skrag rgyu dang 'jigs rgyu med pa'i mi zhig red/ dred tshang nang dred phrug gnyis ༵༵ mi

'dug ngas mchongs thengs gcig gis dred phrug chung ba der gri bsnun te de ru bsad/ dred phrug che tsam de'i rna gnyis lag pas bzung nas thog tu bzhon/skabs der stabs ma legs pa zhig la dred ma slebs 'dug gnam sa g.yo ba'i ngar sgra bsgrags te nga sbar mo gang byas te khung bu'i phyi ru 'phang / nga langs khom med par dred mong de ba'i sar rgyugs yong ste nga brla 'og tu mnan/6 phig phig mi 'phyi ba'i skad cig byung bas dred mong des nga yod pa brjed pa ltar gyis de ru g.yeng / de dus ngas ga ler gri bton te shugs kyis dbugs lhem lhem byed pa'i dred mong de'i dpung 'og la bsnun pas dred mong de 'o dod chen po zhig dang bcas par ring du bros song / ngas slar yang dred tshang nang nas dred phrug khrid du 'gro rtsis byed dus dred pha slebs 'dug nga rgyal gyis myos pa'i dred mong de'i mdun du nga la nus stobs ci'ang ma mchis/ mi ring bar dred mong des nga sa thog tu mnan/ nga'i ngo la dred mong gis sbar mo brgyab/ 'di ltar gyur pa red/ zer tshul la dred mong gis lta dus mi ngo de lhab lhub tu 'bar ba'i me lce ru snang bas mi la gnod dus thog mar ngo lpags bshu tshul yod/ de dus nga'i mig mdun du shar ba ni khrag mdog can gyi 'jig rten de red/ rgyu mtshan ci yin mi shes par dred mong des nga sa kong nang bud nas phyin song / rjes su mi rnams kyis bshad na mi ro dang mnyam du bza' rgyu'i sgog pa 'thu ru song ba red zer/ dred mong song rjes nga bros yong bayin/ de dus nga'i mgo la skra gzhug 'di brgyab yod pa des nga srung skyob byas pa red/ rjes su bu mo des nga la lta ru thengs kha shas yong myong /’ lha srung gi gdong pa yongs nas 'dzum mdangs kyis khyab/ mdzes ma des kho la lta ru yong ba'i dus de lha srung gi mi tshe'i brgyud rim nang ches yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig yin nges red/26/ nyin gza' skar 'phrod sbyor legs pas lha srung rgad pos chu tsha 'jam

nang bul blugs nas gnam lha'i mgo skra ral pa sig sig de gtsang rkyang bkrus pas nag snum shig shig tu gyur/ de nas skra gzhug nag po de gnam lha'i skra la brgyab/ gnam lhas glo bur de nyin rang nyid byis pa zhig nas skyes pa pho zhig tu 'gyur ba'i snang ba skyes/ des na gnam lha byis pa zhig ltar chu 'gram du rgyug nas dwangs gsal chu mo me long byas te rang nyid kyi gzugs brnyan la bltas pas rang nyid 'tshar longs chen po byung yod pa de ra 'phrod byung /de'i dgong mor lha srung nad gang gis kyang ma gtses par 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du gshegs/ gnam lhas rang nus gang yod kyis gshin po'i rjes 'jug byas/ de ni gson la sdod skabs zhabs zhu ma byung ba'i kha gsab red/spra /sna //sdu sdo rdo khang chung chung de dang de'i nang gi rgyu nor yod do cog gi gnyis/skra gzhug gis gnam lha dzig tu btang ba'am yang na gnam lha lha srung 'das po'i rgyu nor yongs kyi bdag por gyur pa gang yin mi shes par grong tsho'i nang gi mi tshang mas gnam lhar brtsi bkur byed/ de sngon kho la ltag khung yang mi lta ba'i bu mo de tshos kho la zur mig yang yang lta/ lhang lhang gi mdza' gru'ang kho'i rna 'gram du grags/de nas bzung / mun rub rjes gnam lha la phyin ma tshar ba'i lam dang las mi tshar ba'i bya ba yod/rjes su gnam lha ma smad gsum yod pa'i dud tshang zhig la mag par bsdad/ rgad mo der pha so so yin pa'i bu mo me tog lta bu gnyis yod/ bu mo che ba'i ming la zho mtsho dang chung ba'i ming la zho 'bel zer/ rgad mos ༵ snatsho

a ne byed rgyu yin pas gnam lha zho 'bel gyi mag pa yin zer/ skad cha de gnam lha'i blo la ma song / zho mtsho la zho 'bel las kyang yid dbang 'phrog pa'i 'dren byed zung dang skyes pa cig car bslu ba'i lus kyi stangs stabs shig ldan/ ngo ma bshad na gnam lha thog mar zho mtsho'i lung bzang phu chu'i sgra dbyangs lta bu'i snyan 'jebs mdza' sku'i yid dbang 'phrog ste mo'i mag pa byed rgyu yid la 'khor ba red/ zho mtshos ma rgas kyi skad cha go dus mig rtsar mchi ma 'khor bzhin nag snum gyi skra ring po de pang du bzung nas mi thams cad ha las dgos pa'i skad cha zhig bshad/ 6 nga bud med ming don mtshungs pa zhig byed 'dod pa las btsun ma mi byed/ skabs der gnam lha'i kha zur nas de tsam mngon rgyu med pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig shar/ des na lo drug cur nye ba'i rgad mo de'i ngo skyur mor gyur te 6 nga rgan mos tshe sngon las ma dag pa'i bya ba gang byas pa yin nam/ bu mo 'di 'dra zhig skyes 'dug ces bshad de dbugs ring nar nar 'byin/ de nas bzung gnam lha bud med gnyis kyi bdag po la gyur/dgong mor bud med gnyis po gnam lha'i g.yas g.yon du nyal/ zho 'bel ni ci'ang mi smra la 'gul tsam yang mi byed/ zho mtshos gnam lha'i rum nang du lag pa brgyab/ gnam lhas nam stod zho mtsho dang mnyam du nyal/nam smad zho 'bel dang mnyam du nyal/ de nas lo gcig gi rjes la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas/ zho mtsho la bu zhig dang zho 'bel la bu mo zhig skyes/gnam lhas lag g.yas pas bu bzung / lag g.yon mas bu mo bzung nas ha ha zhes dgod/ 8 phu gu shor yong /’ zho mtsho tshur brgyugs nas rang gi bu bang du blangs/ zho 'bel khog stod dmar hreng du bton nas khu sem pos bzhon ma'i nu ma las 'o ma 'jo/ mo'i dmar mdangs rgyas pa'i lus por 'o ma ༷spyar ba'i dkar thigs kyis gang / zho mtsho dang zho 'bel gyi ma gas des

shing phor nag nag chung chung zhig gi nang zho ldag bzhin mchis/ gnam lha'i khyim tshang dga' spros khengs/skar ma khra chil ler song dus 'brog pa'i dud tshang gi phyugs las gzhi nas byas tshar/ lag tu 'o zo khyer ba'i zho mtsho dang zho 'bel gnyis gzhi nas khyim du 'dzul/ thab thog gi thug pa khol nas dri zhim gang sar 'thul/ zho mtshos gnam lha nas 'go btsugs te rim bzhin thug pa blug zho 'bel brgyugs nas ngu bzhin pa'i bu mo tshur blangs nas nu ma sprad/ de tsam gsal sbyo med pa'i mar me de spra gur gyis bkag ma thub pa'i rlung bu'i khrod du sig rig 'du/ /'u 'a 'u/ khyi'i ngar zug gis grong tsho chang chang de 'ur chil chil du bzos/ de nas rta yi 'tsher skad/ lhas raglo nadro phyugs kyi rdang kā/shārnyipa zlos /ga sgra/ da dung byis pa'i ngu sgra dang bud med kyi skad ngan khong tsho'i grong tsho jag pas bzung / gnam lhas thug phor sa la bzhag cing skra gzhug dkri skyor byas te lag tu sked gri bzung nas jag tshogs kyi khrod du mchongs/ bde lcag 'khyug pos gri phar bsnun tshur bsnun kha shas byas pas jag pa mi gsum de ru bsgral/ gnam lha'i mgo la'ang gri kha shas phog kyang rjes su lta dus skra gzhug gi skud pa re gnyis bcad pa las kho'i mgo la rma med/lha srung gis bzhag pa'i skra gzhug nag po de gzhan dang mi 'dra/ gnam lhas skra gzhug nag po der zhib par lta bzhin rang nyid rgas dus bu la sprad rgyu'i thag brjo d+ngha/na lha chu rtswa thang smug pas khengs/ ra lug gis 'ba' ldir dang byis pa'idagod sgra mnyam du 'dres/ lung kyog gi ri grong de spro skyid kyi rnam pas khengs/ de'i dus thag ring nas de tsam mngon mi che ba'i rta pa tsho gci/ tshor

rer gnam lha'i sbra 'gram du yong / kho tsho ni dmag chas ser po gyon pa'i dmag mi tsho gcig red/ dmag mi sha rgyags tsam dang gdong pa dkar tsam des gnam lha'i lag gnyis nas dam por 'jus nas go brda mi 'phrod pa'i skad cha kha shas bshad/ dmag mi gzhan 'gas rta thog nas rtswa sgye zhig phab/de'i nang du ja dang bye ril tha mag sogs blugs 'dug skad sgyur gyis bshad pa ltar na gnam lhas de sngon bsad pa'i jag pa gsum po ni ngo log zing 'khrug gi gte po red zer/ skad sgyur pho gsar de'i gdong pa 'dzum shig shig gis 66de ring ying krang wang ching lags rkang btsugs nas jag 'dul dpa' bo khyed la 'tshams 'dri byed du phebs pa red/ ces bshad/ de nas dmag dpon des gnam lha'i khyim gyi gnas tshul dang lo rgyus zhib phra dris/ kho la bud med gnyis yod pa mthong dus cung blo ma bde ba byung na'ang skabs der bod kyi 'brog khul la rgyun du mthong rgyu yod pa'i goms srol rnying pa zhig yin pas ha las snang de tsam ma byas/ dmag dpon des gnam lha 'i dpung pa la rdeb deb 'ga' byas te 6 pho gzhon dzig po zhig 'jig ces bsngags brjod byas shing chus la las byed byed du 'gro dgos zer/ 88nga yong le ma red/ yi ge mi shes/ gnam lha 'tshab 'tshub kyis de ltar smras/ 8 der skyon med/slob grwar 'gro chog 6 nga la gnam lhas thab 'gram du phreng ba bgrangs nas sgur rer bsdad pa'i rgad mo dang da dung chung chung yin pa'i byis paganyis por lta tsam byas/ dmag dpon des mgo bo g.yug g.yug byas te/6 byas na g.yug shog khyed la gzhan gyi dka' ngal gang 'dug ces bshad/6 dka' ngal stong skud nag po'i skra gzhug gsar pa zhig dmag dpon des deb chung bton nas tho brgyab rjes slar yang kho'i lag pa nas 'ju tsam byas te log rtsis byas/ gnam lhas gang mgyogs mar ril gnyis blangasanadī spyazlog dpon der sprad/ dmag dpon des lag pa g.yug g.yug gis

gtan nas mi khyer/ dmag lwa ser po gyon pa'i dmag mi lnga po rta pho lcag gis skul nas phyin song / skabs der lo na chung ba'i bod rigs skad sgyur des phangs snang chen mdog gis kho la lta tsam lta tsam byas/zla ba gcig gi rjes la dmag dpon des bskur ba'i skra gzhug nag po de gnam lha'i lag tu 'byor/ zhe lo bco lnga zin dus a phas khyod la sprod/’ gnam lhas bu'i mgo la tshad tshad 'ga' byas/ bu'ang 'dzum tsam 'dzum tsam byed/ gnam lhas bu la 'o zhig byas te skra gzhug gsar pa de ras shig gi nang btums nas sgam 'og tu legs par bcugagasum/'ur 'ur ldang ba'i dgun lhags kyis gangs dang sa rdul gnam du khyer bas bar snang gi dbyings su rab be rib ber gyur/ rtswa thang gi steng du rus gzugs 'bur du thon pa'i rta 'gas 'brad rgyag bzhin sa steng du mi mngon pa'i zas 'tshol/ phyugs rdzi 'ga' gong bas mgo btum zhing lus 'khums 'khums byas nas bkres ltogs kyis mnar ba'i phyugs khyu'i rjes la bsnyegs/gnam lhas thab 'gram du lpags gdan zhig gi thog bsdad cing mdun du me mang dag cig bskongs te da lo lo brgyad la slebs pa'i bu dang bu mor pags tsag bzos/ lo sum cu ma zin pa'i gnam lha phar bltas na lo bzhi bcu la yol ba'i mi zhig dang 'dra/ thod pa'i steng gi gnyer ma'i nang thal rdul dang snum gyis gang bas thag ring nas lta dus kyang shin tu gsal po yod/rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i las 'gul des mi rnams kyi bgrang bya stong phrag nang chags pa'i goms srol la rdab gsig bzos/ kha sang dgon pa gtor/ de ring dpe cha mer bsregs/ da dung bla mar 'thab rtso16 spyad/

gnam lha'i ngos nas de dag las kyang tang sangs dgos pa zhig ni kha sang skyes pa skra slas mi chog pa'i khyab bsgrags byas/ gnam lha rang dbang med par lag gtab skud shor nas stong skud nag po'i skra gzhug der stob tsam byed dgos byung / dpung dar dmar po brgyab pa'i gzhon nu 'ga' 'ur chil chil gyis gnam lha tshang gi khang pa'i nang du 'dzul/ 'o mtsho rtab rtob kyis langs nas smyo bzhugs dang bzhugs mi zhes bshad/ 6 rnyog gra ma shod/ da dung skra mi gcod pa gang yin/ ming la bde chen zhes pa'i pho gzhon gdong ring des skad shugs chen pos sdig mo byas/ 6 ngas gsar brjer ngo rgol byed ma myong /khyed kyis de 'dra'i ngar byed dgos pa ci yod/’ gnam lha bzod ma thub par langs byung / 6 khyed kyis rnying gtor gsar 'dzugs ma byas na gsar brjer ngo rgol byas pa red/ 8 mgyogs po skra chod/’ da dung byis pa'i ngo gzugs ma yal ba'i bu mo des rang gi skra thung thung de gabyug bzhin de lta ra smras/gnam lha ni dngos gnas mi u tshugs can zhig red/ tsha 'jam ji ltar byas kyang khos skra gcod rgyu khas mi len/ dmar srung dmag gis btsan shed kyis kho'i mgo ru 'chang bas gnam lha rab tu khros nas lus po'ang 'dar sig sig gis gri shubs nas bton/ 6 da dung thug tsam gyis dang / khyed kyi sdug snying grang mo de khyi la sprad thag gcod yin/ zho mtshos gnam lha'i sked pa nas bzung / dmar srung dmag dag 'u thug nas log song /de nas dus tshod phran tsam ma phyin gong dmar srung dmag tsho gcig gis gnam lha bzung nas khrid/ bu rnam bkras 6 a pha a pha ’ zhes 'bod bzhino rjes su rgyug ngu skad lhang lhang grags/ skyi g.ya' ba'i byis pa'i 'o dod des gnam lha yang yang phyi mig lta dgos byung / sngar nas ngu ma myong ba'i pho rgod deswā /sdu rtsa mchi mas brlan/

de nas zla ba gcig gi rjes su gnam lha phyir log kho rang nyid sgo 'gram du slebs ma thag zho mtsho dang zho 'bel gyis lag g.yas g.yon nas 'thams te ngus/ kho gnyis kyi ma rgan des rang nyid kyi gces par 'dzin pa'i mag pa la lta tsam yang byed khom med par khu sim pos 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du phyin pa red/ zho mtsho dang zho 'bel ngos nas ma shi ba las sdug che ba ni ro sa 'og tu mnan pa de red/ dmar srung dmag gi dpon po des ro bya la ster na gcig nigatsang sbra med pa dang gnyis ni chos lugs dang 'brel ba'i rmongs dad kyi byed stangs shig red zer/ zho mtsho ngus nas dmar srung dmag gi dpon po bde chen gyi rkang pa nas 'thams kyang rdog tho gzhus nas song / mo'i a ma rgan mo de 'gos nad shi ba'i ro ltar sa nag po'i 'og tu btsan gyis sbas/ci'ang mi mthong ba'i mun nag gi mtshan mo der gnam lhas rta khrid nas song / ro sa 'og nas bton rjes gra sgrig byas pa'i sgye mo chen po'i nang blugs pa dang sa sngar mus ltar bzos rjes ro rta la bkal nas lha yul dang nye shos yin pa'i ri rtse'i dur khrod kyi phyogs su song /rjes su gnas tshul shes mkhan ma byung bas rnyog gra ci'ang ma thon/ zho mtsho dang zho 'bel gnyis kyis mkha' dbyings su lding ba'i rgod po la lta bzhin ma rgas bya rgod kyi gshog par bzhon nas lha yul la skye rgyu red bsam nas gdong pa la shod mi tshar ba'i dga' snang zhig skyes/ gnam lhas dbugs ring zhig btang /de dus gnam lha'i mgo la skra'ang med pas skra gzhug ga la yod/ wang ching gis sprad pa'i skra gzhug nag po de'ang dmar srung dmag gis 'phrog nas lham btsems byed byas pa red/ gnam lhas nyin ltar a cor zhwa mo dreg pas tshos pa zhig gis mgo btum/ grong tsho'i nang du gnas tshul che chung ci byung yang khos mig tsam mi lta/ khong tsho'i grong tsho'i dmar srung dmag gi 'a/ /da

yong nas gnam lha rdzong du khrid/ rdzong dmar srung dmag gi 'go khrid kyis kho la tha mag kyang sprad de byams brtse che mdog byas/ des gnam lha'i blo dogs rim bzhin sel/ glo bur du dmar srung dmag gi 'go khrid des gdong gi 'dzum mdangs bsdus te nan tan gyis 6 wang ching ni mi lpags gyon pa'i spyang ki red ’ ces bshad/ 8 a wang ching /’ 6 sngon ma khyed la skra gzhug sprad mkhan de/ skra gzhug rgyag pa ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi goms srol rnying pa red/ da lta khyed la skra gzhug bskur dgos pa'i log spyod kyi ngo bo e shes/’ tsa ngas skra gzhug bskur rogs zer myong /’ che de khyed la khag med/mang tshogs dkyus ma go rtogs med pa rang red/ 8 yen ’ dmar srung dmag gi 'go khrid des gnam lha ngo mdog rdza ri ltar 'gyur ba mthong dus 6 de ring khyed rdzong du shog zer dgos don ni wang ching la ther 'don bya rgyu'i ched du red/ de ni langs phyogs kyi gnad don zhig yin pas ther 'don byed /ngas nga tshos bslab chog ces mdzub mo sgrog tse'i thog brdabs te nan tan sa ba//ma/ lha'i sems mtha' yas pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du lhung / wang ching / rdzong ud kyi hru'u ci'ang 'thab rtsod bya yul du 'gyur/thams cad mi rtag pa ru grub snyam nas/ chos la gtan nas dad pa mi chog pa'i dus der gnam lha'i blor chos la sngar byung ma myong ba'i mi phyed pa'i dad pa zhig skyes/ wang ching la 'thab rtsod dang ther 'don byed pa'i tshogs 'du de de sngon rdzong ud kyi tshogs khang zhig gi nang du 'tshogs/ de ni dmar srung dmag 'go khrid kyis rkang btsugs nas bkod sgrig byas pa red/ gang yin zhe na/ de sngon wang ching gis tshogs khang 'di'i nang du rdzong de'i dpon po che shos sheg gi ngos nas dmangs la bkod 'doms byed myong / rdung bkyig byasapaswā /zlo ching tshogs khang gi zur zhig tu sgur sgur byas nas sdod du bcug de

ring dgag rgyag dang ther 'don byed mkhan gyi mang tshogs sku tshab rnams tshogs ra'i mdun gral du bsdad/ gnam lha'ang de'i gras la yod/ wang ching gis kho mthong min la ma ltos par gnam lhas wang ching mthong ma thag skrag cing sdug nas mgo bo dgye dgye byed mi nus par 'gyur/ de sngon dmag chas ser po gyon pa'i pho gzhon nyams chen de de ring nad kyis mnar ba'i rgad po zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis/ da lta de sngon rang nyid la lta rtog byed myong ba'i mi zhig la 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa yid la 'khor dus gnam lha'i yid blong blong du gyur cing thod pa nas rngul chu thon/yang na wang ching ni mi lpags gyon pa'i sbyang ki dngos yin pa 'dra/ de minan de ring 'thab rtsod dang ther 'don byed po rnams ni 'khrab rtsal byang chub pa'i 'khrab ston pa rkyang rkyang red 'dug gnam lhas de dag mthong dus 'tshab sha zhig langs/ dmar srung dmag gi dpon po de yong nas gnam lhas ther 'don byed dgos zhes bshad/ gnam lha khyar khyor ngang wang ching gi mdun du song / wang ching mgo bkyag tsam byas pas kho ngo shes nas 'dzum tsam byas te mu mthud mgo bo gug gnam lha blo khog che che byas te 6 kho re/khyed kyis nga la ’ zhes bshad rjes mu mthud skad cha ma thon/ gnam lhas de mur dred mong dang 'thab pa'i lha srung rgan po dang khong gis sprad pa'i stong skud nag po'i skra gzhug de yid la 'khor dus rang nyid ni mi tha shal zhig red snyam nas ngo tsha zhig dang gnongs 'gyod cig lus hril por khyab/ des na gnam lhas blo khog chen po'i sgo nas tshogs ra la kha phyir bskor te/ 6 sku gzhug de ngas sprad rogs zhes bshad pa yin/ kho dang 'brel ba med/ nyes pa yod na nga la yod/ nyes chad dgos na nga la chod/ zer/ de ma thag tshogs ra hril po 'ur chil chil du song / gnam lha de ru 'dzin bzung byas/ nyin shas kyi 'thab rtsod nang dga' sdug med pa'i wang ching gnam lha la lta 2)/na

mig nang mchi mas gang /bzhi/bar med du ldang ba'i dpyid rlung dang phyogs med du khyab pa'i nyi ma'i 'od snang gis dgun gyi gangs 'khyags bzhus te lhung lhung mdzes pa'i chu rgyun la sgyur/ sa gzhi chen pos dgun chas phud/ khab rtse ltar gyi rtswa chung yang skye stobs kyi rtsa ba rgyas te sus kyang bkag mi thub par gang sar thon/ da lta rang ma'i mngal nas lhung ma thag pa'i be'u 'ga' khyar khyor ngang ma'i rjes la bsnyegs/ cung ma 'gor bar gom tshugs brtan pos 'gro thub/gnam lhas gzugs po rang nyid las mtho ba'i bu rnam bkra mthong dus lus hril po shod mi shes pa'i bde bas khyab/ pho lo nyer gsum/ dngos gnas rnam par bkra ba'i lo tshod/ kho'i lus thog la rang nyid kyi stobs dang ma'i mdzes chos gnyis ka mnyam du 'dzoms/ gnam lhas bu la blo tshim pa brgya dang yid mi tshim pa gcig yod/ yid mi tshim pa de ni mgo thog tu skra gzhug med pa de red/ de ni dus kyis bzos pas bu la khag ci yod/ ma gzhi srid jus lhod du btang bas gsar pa mang du thon/ chos dad rang mos yin zhes las don ru khag gis khyab bsgrags byas/ 'on te mi mang che bas lkog lkog sun sud kyis chos byed pa las mngon gsal gyi byed sgo spel mi nus/ gnam lhas las don ru khag la rkang btsugs nas skyes pas skra slas chog min gyi skad cha dris mod kyang g.yo sgyu che ba'i las byed des lan ci'ang ma btab/ skras gnam lha la chag sgo mang po de ltar bzos dus tan tig mi byed ka med red/bu rnam bkras kyang lo che ru 'gro rim bzhin phas rgyun du shod pa'i ngo mardo/ ḍi skra gzhug nag po sprin nag 'tshub pa lta bu zhig 'dogs par 'dod/

nyin zhig rnam bkra chus thog tu ja nyo bar 'gro dus mgo la skra gzhug dmar po dang nag po brgyab pa'i pho gzhon 'ga' bya pho rog gi 'gros rgyag pa bzhin 'gro ba mthong / ma gzhi pho gzhon de dag gi mgo la btags pa'i skra gzhug de rnam bkra'i sems nang gi skra gzhug las cung nyams zhan tsam yod kyang de'ang shin tu yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig red/ ri dang khang par dar lcog dgos pa bzhin mgo la skra dang skra gzhug yod na gzhi nas rlung rta 'phel nges red snyam/ chus srid gzhung gi chags sa ru skra gzhug 'dogs dus de la dogs pa dang the tshom byed rgyu ci yod snyam/ des na rnam bkras ja nyo rgyu pha ri'i ri la bzhag nas gang sar sku gzhug nyo ru rgyug 'on te tshong khang nang gtan nas nyo rgyu med pas skabs der pho gzhon mgo la skra gzhug nag po brgyab pa zhig gis wa zhwa zhig sprad na skra gzhug nag po gcig btsong dgos zer/ rnam bkras kyang rgyal khab kyi tshong khang nang gong tshad gtan la 'bebs pa'i ca lag ga re nyos nyos bzhag ste skra gzhug lag tu thebs ched wa zhwa zhig sprad rgyu'i khas len byas/rnam bkra ni rig gnas gsar brje'i rjes su lha chu rtswa thang la skra slas mkhan gyi skyes pa dang po de red/ mi tsho'i bstod smad ci bgyis la ma bltos par rnam bkra'i sems nang du rang nyid dzig tu song ba'i snang ba skyes shing grong tsho'i nang gi bu mo mang dag cig gis kho la lkog nas yang yang lta ba mthong /gnam lha ni phyogs bzhi nas rang gi bu'i mgo la yang yang bltas te gdong pa 'dzum mdangs kyis khyab/ bu'i skra gzhug mar blangs nas rang nyid kyi mgo la tshad tshad byas te rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed/lo bzhi bcu ma zin gong skra dkar po thon pa'i zho mtshos pha'i ngo la lta tsam dang bu'i ngo la lta tsam byas te mo'i sems nang gnam sa mgo rting log pa'i lo rabs nang gi gnam lha'i myong ba yid la 'khor te 6 sku sla mi nyan/’ zhes brjod/ 6 a ma khyed skrag mi dgos/: zer ba na/ zho mtsho gnam ༵ 71 lta

tsam lta tsam byas/ de'i nang du bu la kha ta byed dgos pa'i nang don zhig 'dus yod tshod red/ 6 kho rang slas bcug las byed de tshos srid jus la 'gyur ba yong gi ma red zer/mi zho mtsho thabs zad nas khros pa'i tshul gyis sgur rer bsdad/ pha'i rgyab skyor thob pa'i rnam bkra 'dzum tsam byas pas kho'i gral star 'grig po'i dung so dkar mo phyi ru mngon/ zho 'bel ni ci'ang mi smra bar khyim las byed bzhin mchis/ rnam bkra'i sring mo gsal sgron ni nam langs nas zog rdzir phyin/ spyir na nyin mo khyim du bsdad pa'i dus med/yang lo gcig gi rjes su dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu la gong chen po sprad/ grong tsho'i nang gi skyes pa mang po zhig phyi ru tshong rgyag tu song / 'on te gnam lhas rnam bkra phyi ru tshong rgyag par 'gro mi dgos zhes mdzub mo ker nas tshong gi skyon bgrang / 6 gcig ni brtan po med/ gnyis ni sdig pa yod/ gsum ni de las 'brog pa yag po zhig byed dgos/ zer/ rnam bkra nyin bzhin gtam rnyog mang du 'gro ba'i pha rgan gyi kha la de tsam nyan 'dod med kyang de ring tshong mi rgyag rgyu'i khas len byas/ lha chu rtswa thang thog bu mo mdzes shos ha lam sgrol ma yin gyi red/rnam bkra dang sgrol ma chung byis pa'i dus nas mnyam 'tshar bas khong gnyis chung dus gcig pha dang gcig ma yin pa'i rtsed mo rtsed myong / des na gyis pa tsho'i khrod du rnam bkra'i sgrol ma'am sgrol ma'i rnam bkra zhes 'bod tshul yod/ 'on te khong gnyis ka rim bzhin chen po chags te nu 'bur rgyas pa'i lus phra ma zhig dang kha la spu rdzob skyes pa'i pho gzhon zhig la 'gyur dus phan tshun de tsam skad cha mi shod par gyur/ 'on kyang rnam bkras rgyun du sgrol ma'i skor gyi skad cha go dus gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i tshor snang yong gi yod/ pho sar 'gas sgrol ma yod sar rnam bkra dang bu mo gzhan gyi skor gleng skabs sgrol ma nyinā /zlo polha mi bde bar 'gyur/

char ba babs/ 'brug sgra grags/ gnam sa kha 'thab/ mun pa'i gos kyis sa gzhi chen po lhug por g.yogs/ lung bzang phu ru zog bor 'tshol du song ba'i rnam bkras gom stabs chen pos gsal lhang lhang byed sa'i phyogs su 'gro/ de ru phun grags ming sring gnyis bsdad yod/ phun grags ni sgrol ma'i ming po red/ rnam bkra khyis rmug rtsis rmug rtsis kyi nang la phun grags kyi sbra nang du 'byor/ skabs der phun grags bsdad med par sgrol ma gcig pu yin/mos nyin ltar yid la 'khor ba'i rnam bkra glo bur gnam nas bab ltar mo'i mig mdun du slebs dus ngo tsha nas 'dzum tsam byed pa las ci'ang mi smra bar thab zur du sgur nas bsdad/ zhe phun grags ga par phyin song / 6 dgun mtsher la a mar lta ru phyin song / rnam bkras lus thog gi char pa btsir btsir byed bzhin de ring gi yong tshul bshad/ de rjes gnyis ka thab 'gram me bsro bzhin 'o ja btung / rnam bkras sgrol ma'i dmar srab kyi mchu 'dab dang dkar la dmar mdangs rgyas pa'i gdong pa la lta bzhin byis pa'i dus kyi gnas tshul dag slar yang yid kyi me long gi ngos su khra lham med shar nas lus yongs tsha 'ur 'ur du gyur/ 6 sgrol ma/ nged gnyis kyi chung dus yid la e gda'/ tsa de brjed 'gro mkhan khyed yin gyi red/’ sgrol ma cung khros nas mchu kyog bzhin de ltar smras/ de nas yud tsam ring gnyis ka ci'ang mi smra bar sdod skabs rnam bkras ngo mdog dmar por gyur pa'i sgrol ma'i lag pa nas 'jus te tshur 'then pas mos dal bu'i ngang rang nyid kyi mgo bo rnam bapo'i brang thog tu bzhag de'i rjes su byung ba ni gzhon nu pho mo zung gis snying gtam dang / dam bca'/ kha chad bcas red/ 277

lnga/rin chen dang po'i mdog gi mdzes pa'i nor 'dzin bu mos dngul dkar zhun ma'i gos kyis gzab mchor rab tu spras zhes rtog bzo la dga' ba'i snyan ngag smra ba dag spro ba rab tu brtas mod kyang / rtswa chu 'tshol bsnyegs la brten nas 'tsho ba rol ba'i sa mtho'i mi rigs dang de ga'i 'tsho rten du gyur ba'i phyugs zog dkar nag la chag sgo ru gyur te gang sar 'chi bdag gi zhags pas 'dzin pa'i 'khun sgra dang 'phag 'tshag gis khyab/gnam lhas nam mkha'i dbyings nas dbyugs yong ba lta bu'i lhab lhub gangs kyi me tog la lta tsam dang lhas ra'i nang nyin mang lto chag nas 'chi bdag gi 'jigs snang 'og tshud pa'i nag nag gi nor dang dkar dkar gyi lug la lta bzhin spyir btang min pa'i brel ba zhig gis lus hril po khyab/ston kha nyar ba'i gzan rtswa ma lus sprad tshar/ mi zas 'bru rigs kyang lug gis lug za/ phan tshun lus steng gi dkar 'jam bal spu zos te lus dmar rjen du gyur ba'i lug 'ga' nyam dma' pos 'dar skad rgyag bzhin zur du spungs pa'i rang rigs kyi bem ro dag la lta/ bem ro'i thog kha bas g.yog pas mi che mi chung ba'i rdo pha bong 'ga' dang 'dra/ zu a pha/ da lta ci byas na drag rnam bkra ni rdo leb tsha po'i thog gi 'bu grog ma zhig ltar 'tshab 'tshub tu gyur/ mig rtsa mchi ma 'khor ba'i zho mtsho dang zho 'bel gnyis lus la dreg pas tshos pa'i pags rtsag re gyon zhing mgo zla mang bkru ma myong bas nag zing du mngon/ zho mtshos kha sang nyin gang lug lpags bshus/ de ring lag pa'ang na/ mos rang gi bza' zla dang bu'i gnam sa lta bu'i lus stobs dkā ༵༵nga dus cung blo bde bar gyur/

gnam lhas glo bur du ston kha yong ba'i tshong pa rgyags pa de yid la 'khor bas dug zos pa ltar blo mi bde bar gyur cing shod mi shes pa'i khong khro zhig ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes/ tshong pa de dngos gnas mi kha nag cig red snyam/6 pha ro za rgyu/ khyed kyis e dran/ ston kha bshas nyo mkhan gyi tshong pa de mi kha nag sol ba lta bu/’ hon thor nas krong nger langs pa'i rnam bkra pa'i skad chas gnyid dkrogs pa ltar bzos/ 66o/ kho'i yid kyi yol ba'i ngos su ston kha'i gnas tshul dag kha sang byung ba ltar dran nas dngos gnas tshong pa de mi spyir btang ba zhig ma red snyam/ khos da lo gangs zhod yod pa shes/ ma mtha' yang gangs chen 'bab srid pa'i tshod dpag byas/ de dus rang nyid mi 'dod par ngar ngar dzig dzig byas pa'i gnas tshul dag yid du shar dus kha skyengs nas ngo tsha shur shur du 'gyur/6 wa ye/ skyob gso len du shog grong tsho'i kru'u rin gyis skad shugs chen pos 'bod/ de ring ni skyob gso len thengs lnga pa red/ 6 rgyal khab drin can/’ gnam lhas de ltar kher lab byed bzhin sgye mo zhig khyer nas song / grong tsho'i kru'u ren gyi sgo 'gram na mi mang du tshogs/ mchu mug mug dang gzugs chung chung yin pa'i bud med cig gis ngu skad ches cher brgyab nas 66da ngo ma sprang mo chags song zer ba gnam lhas thos skabs sems gting nas skyo ste mo'i phru gu bzhi po de mig nang 'khor 'khor byed/ 8 ngu rgyu ci yod/ nged tshang gi thob skal khyed kyis khyer zhes bshad/ bud med de dga' thag chod nas 6 khyed kyi bshad pa ngo ma yin na ngas len thag chod yin/’ 6 khyespya kyiswā blangs/ zhes gnam lha rgyab lag byas nas gom stabs dal po'i ngang sna na/ lha khyim du slebs rjes da lta'i gnas tshul rnams bshad/ rnam bkra ni ci'ang mi smra bar nag rog ger bsdad 'dug zho mtsho ngar langa~X /sa

snye mo la ci'i don du sprad/ nga 'gro nas tshur len yong /mi zhes mos lag g.yas pas sgye mo bzung nas 'gro rtsis byas/ 66khyed kyis ci shes/ gom gang song na ngasakang pa gcog thag gcod yin/ mi gnam lha ni rab tu khros pa'i g.yag rgod cig dang 'dra/ zho mtshos rang nyid kyi khyo bo'i gshis ka la cha rgyus yod pas dal bu'i ngang phyir log nas khu sim mer gdan thog tu bsdad/6 da lta zog chas bzo ran/mi rnam bkras dran skul byas pas pha ma gnyisangar zhi nas ja yi lhab ro'i nang rtsam pa blugs nas dkrug dkrug byas/ru da dung nyin shas phyin rjes 'di'ang sprad rgyu mi rnyed/ gnam lha yang bskyar sdug skad shor/ gnam lha tshang gi gson rten shi rten ni zog sems can red/nor lug phyed ka tag tag shi zin/ bod rnying pa yin na sprang rgyug khyer nas 'gro rgyu las gzhan gyi las med/ 'on kyang deng skabs gnam lha slar yang lhas ra'i nang du rgyug srog chad la nye ba'i g.yag rog po zhig gi mdun du hon thor ba ltar lus/yul lha gzhi bdag khros pa'i rtags su rtsis na'ang 'dra/ rang byung gnam gshes kyi 'gyur ldog la brtsis kyang rung / don gyi rdog kha bstan na/nyin mo mtshan gyis bslus/ mtshan mo nyin gyis bsus/ gangs rgyun chad med par 'bab/ lhab be lhub be 'phur zhing g.yo ba'i gangs kyi me tog gis bar snang hril po btsan gyis 'dzin dus gnam sa gnyis la bar mtshams med par 'gyur/ sgo zog gi bem ro grangs las 'das pa zhig lhas ra dang de'i zur du spung / ngo ma/ gshin rje'i khrims rar 'byor ba dang gnyis su ma mchis/'on kyang khyi 'khyam de dag da lo las bzang ba yong ma myong / gangs khrod du gcig gis gcig ded nas 'gre ldog rgyag bzhin rtsed mor rol/ gangs zhon chen po 'dir dga' po byed mkhan sha gzan gyi bya khyi tsam las ma mchis/gakāswā ༵ pho lo bzhi bcu las yol yang 'di lta bu'i gangs skyon mthong ma myong /

de los yin/ kha sang gegs skyob tu yong ba'i las byed cig gis bshad na nga tsho'i rtswa thang thog lo rgyus thog mthong dkon pa'i gangs chen babs tshul krung dbyang gi gsar 'gyur las 'dzam gling la khyab bsgrags byas pa red zer/de ltar yid la 'khor dus gnam lha 'jigs nas ba spu zing mod kyang gsar 'gyur des 'dzam bu gling gis bod byang thang du lha chu rtswa thang zhes pa zhig yod pa rtogs rgyu red bsam nas cung blo bde bar 'gyur/6 yang gnyis shi 'dug 6 bsha' rgyu red/ gnam lhas zho mtsho la lta tsam byas te dal bu'i ngang de ltar bshad/ don du kho'i sems skad cig tsam yang dal por gnas mi thub/ rnam bkras gri gnyis khyer nas slebs byung /kho'i rngam zhing rdzog pa'i skra gzhug de de ring cung 'khyog cing de 'dra'i mdzes rgyu med par snang / rnam bkra'i ngo mdog kyang sngon ma dmar mdangs rgyas pa las da cha sngo nag tu gyur/ de nas gnam lha tshang gi mi kun gcig rjes gnyis mthun kyis thon byung / nam mkha'i dbyings nas lha 'dres gtor ba'i gangs kyi me tog dag 'tshang kha rgyag bzhin sa la 'bab/ da lta dmar sgong nger gnas pa'i zog ro dag myur du gangs 'og tu btums nas mtha' yas pa'i rtswa rnying 'dir gangs las ci'ang mi mngon pa'i skya ther ther gyi 'jig rten zhig tu drug zla ba bdun pa'i rtswa thang ni za 'og sa ru brgyan pa ltar shin tu yid dbang 'phrog dkar dmar me tog gi khrod du/ rnam bkra rta pho lcag gis skul nas mdun du bskyod/ ngo ma/ da lo las rtswa kha bzang ba dang me tog mang ba byung ma myong / dgun gyi gangs zhod chen po de'i 'bras bu 'dra/ dri/ skyo

dgos pa zhig ni da lo'i rtswa thang gi thog la nor lug nyung /rnam bkra phun grags tshang gi sbra 'gram du rta babs/ phun grags kyis khong nang du bsus nas 'o ja blugs te sne len byas/ da lo 'o ja yod pa'i dud tshang nyung na yang phun grags tshang la 'bri dang ma mo re gnyis bzho rgyu yod nges red/ phun grags ma bus kho la na ning lta bu'i rnam 'gyur mi ston/ phun grags kyi ma gos sbra zur du bsdad nas blo rtse bsgrims nas bal las byed pa las kho la kha ya gtan nas mi byed/ rnam bkras zla ba 'di'i nang sgrol ma khrid rgyu yin lugs shod dus dus rgyun kha lce bde ba'i phun grags lan tshig ma rnyed par lus/ rgan mos lag nang gi bal las bzhag ste/ 6 nga tsho'i bu mo tshong pa rab brtan la sprad rgyu byas tshar/’ 6 na ning byas pa'i kha chad/ rnam bkra'i mgo la glo bur du rdo brgyab pa ltar bzos/ 6 na ning dang da lo mi 'dra/7des na rnam bkras rang nyid kyi khyim la da cha mi rer cha snyoms nor lug gsum re las med pa yid la dran dus dngos gnas na ning nor brgya dang lug stong yod pa'i gnas tshul yid la 'khor/ 'on te sgrol ma khong gnyis chung nas chags pa'i nya chu'i brtse dung de rgyu nor la brten nas byung ba zhig e yin/rnam bkra'i ngo gdong la sdug bsngal gyi sprin nag 'khrigs/ phun grags kyis mig tsha deb 'ga' byas te/ 6 da tshar ba red/ nga tsho 'grig ma song / zhes bshad ma thag rnam bkra hob ste langs nas 6 ten zhes gzhan ci'ang ma smras par thon/ rta thog tu mchongs nas rta la lcag tshan tsha thag chod gnyis gzhus/ thams cad bzo mkhan rta rkyang po 'di yin pa 'dra/ phun grags kyi ma rgas kyis rnam bkras 'thung khom ma byung ba'i 'o ja la lta bzhin khrel dgod cig byas te/ 6 'o ja'ang med par da dung mna' ma len rgyu dran ’ zhes bshad/glang ru'i spang gzhung zhig la rgya chas gyon pa'i mi 'ga' zhig me tog gi khroX |2 nyal nas sbi rag btung bzhin mchis/ phu wa ye/ 'di ru shog dang /’

rnam bkras zhib tu lta dus de tsho ni tshong cog rtsig brgyab nas sdod mkhan gyi mi gsum po de red/ khong tsho'i pha yul gang nas yin min mi shes kyang mi mgo brdungs nas 'tsho ba skyel ba'i mi 'khyam de tshor kho gtan nas mi dga'/ de'i nang du phun grags ma bu gnyis kyis gal che 'dzin pa'i tshong pa rab brtan zhes pa de'ang 'dug shog mal gsos nas sbi rag btung dang /’ rnam bkra la spro ba chen pos sbi rag blug pho gzhon lpags pa btsong rgyu e yod/’ rab brtan gyis rnam bkra su yin gtan nas ngo mi shes/ 6 med/’ 6 mug lpags yod kyi red/’ mug lpags zhes pa go dus da lo'i gangs zhod chen po yid la 'khor nas rnam bkra'i ngo nag rog ger song nas 6 btsong gi min ’ zhes bshad/ 6 dbyug shog 'brog pas mug wags zer ba go dus rnam rtog byed kyi 'dug rab brtan gyis kha spu byil byil 'ga' byas te 8 byas na ngas khyed tshor lung pa 'di'i bu mo mdzes shos sgrol ma'i skor bshad chog ces mo'i ma dang ming pos sgrol ma gang mgyogs kho'i mna' mar ster rgyu khas len pa'i skor sogs bshad pas/ rnam bkra'i snying la dug mda' phog pa ltar ngo gdong ser por gyur te smra sgo las tshig 'bru gcig ma thon par lus/dgong mo der phun grags ma bu gnyis kyis ga tshod sgug kyang sgrol ma log mkhan med/ nyin gnyis pa phun grags rdzong la song dus mi kha shas kyis zer na bu mo de 'dra zhig shar rer lha chu rtswa thang la 'gro sa'i lam ded nas phyin song zer/ phun grags lam de ded nas song yang su'ang ma thug dgong mo mun pa rub dus gzhi nas khyim la 'byor/ phun grags kyis thog mar kho phyi la 'gro ring sgrol ma log slebs yod pa'i re ba byas mod kyang khyim du 'byor dus re ba dag 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ ma rgad mo gtan nas sdod mi thub par 6 da ci byas na drag ces yang yang smra/ 6 thams cad nga rgad mos bzos song / rgad mo 'gyod gdung drag pos rab tu mnar bas yang yang ngu zhing rang ༵༵ kyi

mgo la khu tshur gzhu/phun grags mtshan mor mtsho lha rin po che'i drung du phyag mo zhus/ mgo dkar kyang chags pa'i bla rgan des lag mgor brgyus pa'i ba so'i phreng ba de tshur blangs nas lag gnyis kyi bar du phreng rdog 'ga' phar tshur btang rjes mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed bzhin zhe mo sdug tsam gda'/ yin na'i sang nyin gang sar skad cha dris dang / zhes bshad/phun grags ma bu'i sems gting gi re ba ha lam shi/ sang nyin gang sar 'tshol zhes pa der re ba phra mo zhig bcol/ mtsho lha rin po che ni mngon shes thogs med kyi bla ma zhig red zer srol yod/ de'i dgong mo khong gnyis gnyid thun gcig kyang ma khug rgad mo'i mig lam du bu mo'i gzugs ris yang yang shar/ skabs skabs 'jigs snang skyes te 6 phun grags/ phun grags/7zhes bu la 'bod tsam ma byas na blo mi bde/ rgad mos bskyod tshar ba'i bgrang bya drug cu nye ba'i mi tshe'i shul lam ring mo'i nang 'di lta bu'i dgong mo ring po 'phrad ma myong /nyin gnyis par grong tsho gzhan gyi rdzi bo zhig gis bu mo de 'dra zhig brag steng las lhung nas ku co bsgrags pa thos zer/phun grags brag rtsar slebs dus bya rgod 'ga' de ru lding ba mthong /spyang ki 'ga' mi mthong bas 'dur ma rgyug gis bros/ lug 'dra spyang gis zos pa min nam/ yar yar 'gro dus sgrol ma'i dug log mthong / sgrol ma ya sgrol ma/ khyed kyis ci bsam pa red/ sprin dkar gyi lto ba 'bral ba'i rgod tshang gi brag rtse nas mchongs dus khyed kyis a ma rgad mo'i skya phyed sngo phyed kyi dbu skra brjed pa yin nam/ thams cad 'di bzhin khyed kyis snying rje med par tshar bcad pa red/ 'di ltar mchongs na lcags kyi lus ldan yang thal bar 'gyur rgyu /tā ces smre sngags shor/ mi ring bar sgrol ma'i lce mig thams cad bya yis

bton zin/ ngo sha'ang spyang gis zos/ khrag ral ral dzar dzad gyi mi ro 'di rangagi mdzes sdug ldan pa'i sring mo yin par shes/ phun grags bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul 'dis dngangs shing 'jigs nas gom pa'i 'degs 'jog byed mi shes par dal bu'i ngang sa la 'gyel nas bzi thom thom du gyurarje/ sa su brag rtse la phyin nas lta dus der rkang rjes kyis khengs/ mos brag rtse la bzhag pa'i gsal la mi gsal ba'i rkang rjes grangs las 'das pa de dag las gzhon nu ma des brag rtse nas mchongs kha'i 'gal 'du'i phung por gyur pa'i bsam blo de mtshon la de'i nang du mos mi tshe la bcol ba'i re ba dang re ba de dag las dbang gis meg med du tshar bcad pa dag mtshon yod/nyin shas nang gnam lha gtan nas blo bde bar gnas mi thub/ lhag par du zho mtsho'i rnam shes bor ba'i bzo dang rnam bkra 'dzum tsam yang mi byed pa'o gdong pa mthong dus snying la rno gri phog pa ltar na zug dang dngangs skrag zhig lus por khyab/ rang nyid kyi bu rnam bkra gang nas bltas kyang stong tham pa'i mgo la ma slobs kyang brgya tham pa'i rjes la ma lus tsam zhig yod mod kyang / phun grags khos kha dan tshig la mi gnas/ gal srid mi gzhan la de 'dra byas na sor 'jog ga la byed/ gang ltar phun grags ma bu la gnya' zhum dgos pa'i skad cha zhig ma bshad na ma 'grig snyam/ 'on te sgrol ma phyi ma'i lam du song ba ha go dus/ khong khro ma lus skad cig nyid du zhi/phun grags ma bus sgrol ma'i ro rnyed pa'i nyin gnyis pa'i zhogs pa mtsho lha rin po che gdan drangs nas gshin po'i rjes 'jug byed bzhin pa'i skabs der sems sdug gis mnar ba'i gnam lha rta pho lcag gis skul nas phun grags sdod sa'i grong tshor rgyug yong / gnam lhas mchod me'i zhal 'debs sgor lnga dang mchod mar grod ril gcig bzhag phun grags ma bus gnam lhazi /ma

mkha' lta bu'i khog pa de mthong dus/ rgad mo gnongs 'gyod drag pos rab tu mnar nas yang yang ngus/ phun grags ci yang shod mi shes par rwa co'i sbug tu 'dzul ba ltar dbugs kyang gtong mi nus par lus/grangarlung ldang ba'i ston mjug gi nyin mo der rnam bkra smyo ba ltar shar rer brag rtser song / brag srubs su skyes pa'i me tog dmar skya de ston rlung gis skam rnyid du bzos/ mig mdun du shar ba'i ri bo dang rtswa thang ni mdog ser por gyur zhing me tog dang rtswa chung gi mgul rgyan btags pa'i dbyar gyi bu mo sngo ljang can de kha sang gi rmi lam du gyur ba shes/ rnam bkras g.yang gzar gyi brag ri gshin rje'i mtshon cha lta bu dang brag ngos su skad ngan sna tshogs 'byin pa'i bya tshogs dag mthong dus lus tsha 'ur 'ur du gyur te sgrol ma'i mchi mas 'tshos pa'i gdong pa khra lham mer yid la shar nas rang dbang med par 6 sgrol ma/mi zhes bos/ de nas rnam bkra de mur bsdad de sa rdos bzos pa'i 'jim sku ltar 'gul tsam yang mi byed/ zang zing du gyur ba'i mgo skra rlung gis ded nas rtswa ngan skyes pa lta bu sngar bas zang zing du gyur/ de ltar dus tshod snga dro nas phyo dror slebs te brag rtse nas kyang nyi ma'i 'od mi mthong bar gyur/ skabs der gnam lha dang zho mtsho gnyis dbugs hal bzhin rngul chu phrum phrum gyi ngang rnam bkra'i gam du slebs/ gnam lhas 6 bu log 'gro/ da sems sdug byas kyang phan pa med/’ zer/ zho mtshos rnam bkrar 'thams nas nga'i bu zhes ngus/ 'on te rnam bkra ni srog dang bral ba ltar kha mi grag la 'gul tsam yang mi byed/ shar ri'i rtse nas grang zug rgyag pa'i zla ba zhig mngon/ nam mkha'i dbyings su mig 'byed btsum la ngal ba'i skar tshogs kyis khengs/ gnam lha bza' tshos tsha 'jam ji ltar bshad kyang sa rdo la gtam smraswā 36 ltar rnam bkra ni zur zhig tu nag rog ger bsdad/

rnam bkra glo bur du langs byung / 66a pha/ a ma/ da log 'gro/ rnam bkras dal lhod ngang de ltar bshad/ zho mtshos cung blo mi bde ba'i ngang da lta shi ba ltar kha mi grag pa'i bu la lta tsam lta tsam byas/bdun/de nas lo ngo gcig tsam song rjes/ lo na nyi shu rtsa lnga la slobs pa'i rnam bkra'i mig lcibs las gsal la mi gsal ba'i gnyer ris 'ga' mchis pas kho'i lo tshod dngos dang bsdur na cung rgas nyams dod du snang yang / kho'i mgo la gsar du brgyab pa'i skra gzhug nag po des kho'i gzugs po de sngar bas nyams 'gyur ldan pa zhig tu snang /lo der rnam bkras rdzong dngul khang nas sgor khri gnyis kyi dngul bun blangs nas sger tshong zhig tu gyur/ de ni kho 'u thug nas btsal ba'i lam bu zhig red/ gangs skyon chen pos khyim gyi sgo phyugs thams cad ming gi lhag mar bzos pas mdun du yod pa'i lam bu ni tshong rgyag rgyu kho na las thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ khos byang nas bsgrubs pa'i bal dang rang yul nas nyos pa'i dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu de grong rnal nang khe che tsam ragarnam bkras rgyun du rang nyid kyi mgo la bcings pa'i skra gzhug nag po der shin tu gces spras byed/ rang nyid kyi a myes dang pha gnyis ka skra gzhug nag po'i rogs ram thob myong zhing / lhag par khong tshong brgyab nas yun ring ma song yang tshong la lam 'gro yag po byung ba ni skra gzhug nag po de las byung ba red snyam/ bstan grags ni dma' rim slob 'bring nas thon rjes 'bring rim ched las slob grwar bskyod ma thub pas khyim du log nas tshong brgyab pa red/khos grong khyer nang cha rgyus che zhing ngo shes mang thog rgya skad kyang rgya18 /se

stabs rnam bkra la dgos pa'i rogs pa de red/ 'on kyang rnam bkra'i blo la mi 'bab sa gcig pu ni kho'i su lu shig shig tu bzos pa'i skra thung thung de red/rnam bkras kho la gal te khyed kyis skra bslas te skra gzhug nag po zhig brgyab na tshong la lam 'gro yong nges red ces rang nyid kyi bsam tshul ma gsang drang por bshad dus bstan grags kyis nyan rgyu lta zhog de las 66khyed kyi skra bcad nas nga'i skra ltar bzos na grong khyer nang gi mi tshos nga tshor mthong chung byed mi srid mices lan bslog de nas bzung kho gnyis sus kyang su la skra'i skor phan tshun slob gso rgyag thabs bral/ rnam bkra dang bstan grags kyis rgya kha che'i tshong pa zhig gi lag nas bu lon sgor mo khri gcig len rgyu yod mod kyang tshong pa des khag 'dogs sna tshogs btsal nas bu lon mi sprod/ de ring brtsis na bstan grags bu lon gyi rjes la thengs bcu tsam song zin/thengs gcig rnam bkra rab tu khros nas shar rer song nas kho'i ngar lcags kyi gong bu 'dra ba'i khu tshur gyis sgo rdung / sgo phyes song / bu lon len sa'i tshong pa gnyis pos bod rigs bu mo zhig la a rag blud nas bsdad 'dugakho gnyis 'dod chags chang gis rab tu myos nas ngo dmar dmar dang mig chung chung du 'gyur/ bu mo des glo bur du 'dzul yong ba'i bar ngar dzig dzig gi pho gzhon de mthong dus skrag pa'ang ngo tsha ba gang yin mi shes par mgo sgur nas bsdad/ tshong pa gnyis pos kyang rnam bkra'i mgo thog gi dpa' dar lta bu'i skra gzhug dang sked par gzer ba'i gri ring la zur mig re bltas rjes ngo mdog dmar dmar de glo bur du khrag skam pa ltar skya seng seng du 'gyur nas dgod tsam dgod tsam gyis 6 sdod dang sdod dang zhes bshad/ rnam bkras rgya skad shes la ma shes 'ga' brgyab ste bu lon gyi skor bshad/ rgya kha che'i tshong paganyis po des 'u thug pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas skad cha mang dag bshad kya'e /sna bkras rgya skad de dag gi don mi go/ smyo rnyog gra ma shod/ dngul khyer

shog rnam bkras gri shubs nas sngo chem chem gyi gri phyed tsam bton nas gom pa kha shas mdun du spos/ tshong pa gnyis pos thabs zad pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis phan tshun lta res byas rjes gcig gis nyal khri'i 'og nas brgya lor chag pa cig blangs nas rnam bkrar sprad/ rnam bkras dngul rtsis rgyag dus sgor mo khri gcig tag tag yod/ khos de dag am phrag nang bcug ste shar rer sdod gnas su log khyed 'jon po byung / do dgong ngas sne len byas te zhabs bro rgyag tu 'gro/ bstan grags kyis rnam bkrar de ltar bshad/6 min/ nga mi 'gro/ ngas bro 'khrab mi shes/ 6 'gro/ do dgong yin gcig min gnyis 'gro/ tshong pa zer ba des 'dra mi 'dra mang tsam shes na dga'/7 rnam bkras lan rgyag rgyu ma rnyed par dgong mo zhabs bro'i mtshan tshogs la 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel byas/ rnam bkra'i sems nang gi zhabs bro'i mtshan tshogs zhes pa ni zla 'od kyi 'og tu me spung gi mtha' bskor nas lag pa sbrel te 6 gangs stod mtho po/ gangs stod mtho po/ zhes 'gro rgyu de red snyam na yang do dgong kho'i mig mdun du shar ba ni de tsam gsal rgyu med pa'i rab rib kyi glog 'od dang / bar snang du 'khor ba'i dkar dmar khra thig gis brgyan pa'i sgor hril hril de dang des 'khrab ra hril por bzhag pa'i 'gul skyod can gyi grib gzugs dag red/ rnam bkras zhabs bro rgyag mi shes pas sdod sa zhig bzung nas ga ler sbi rag btung / bstan grags ni bro 'khrab mkhan gyi khrod du ngo shes mang zhing khros ngo skya 'bag 'bag bzos shing mig spu phra mo bris pa'i bu mo zhig gi sked par bcangs nas zhabs bro la rol/rnam bkras bstan grags la zhib tu lta dus/ kho'i lus po bu mo der 'byar gang thub byed pa dang mo'i rna rtsar shub shub byed/ rnam bkras phar lta tshur lta byed dus zhabs bro rgyag mkhan gyi khrod du skyes pa mgo skra slas pa phar zhog bod chas gyon pa'ang gcig kyang med/ des na rnam bkra'i blo la rang nyid ga~X pu

'khrab ra'i zang zing rnam pa dang ma 'phrod pa'i snang ba zhig shar te/ cung 'dug bzod mi bde bar gyur/ khos khang pa'i zur zhig la lta dus de ru bu mo dug log dkar rkyang gyon pa zhig bsdad 'dug mo la dmar zhing srab pa'i mchu sgros dang / ri mo mkhas pa'i sor rtse nas thon 'dra'i rdzi ma/ rdzi ma gnyis kyibar du mdzes rgyan spras pa lta bu'i rme ba zhig da dung 'di dang de sogs glo bur du rnam bkra'i lus hril po glog brgyab pa bzhin tsha 'ur 'ur du 'gyur/ e ma/ mo'i byad bzhin sgrol ma dang 'dra ba la/ rnam bkra 'jim sku ltar 'gul tsam mi byed par mig hur rer bu mo de la bltas/ bu mo des 'brog pa'i pho gzhon zhig gis rang nyid la hur hur gyis lta ba mthong dus khros pa'i tshul gyis mig log bltas/ a tsi/ mig log lta stangs kyang sgrol ma dang gcig mtshungs red/ rnam bkra'i yid kyi dbang po rab tu 'phros nas de bas gyur hār gyis bltas pa dang / mig nang du brjod mi shes pa'i brtse dung zhig sa drobyen/ grags 'tshab 'tshub kyis slebs byung / rnam bkras bstan grags la da lta byung ba'i gnas tshul bshad pas/ khos ra 'brog pa rang red/ lkugs pas lha mthong ba red ’ zer/ rnam bkra'i bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni da lta'i bud med de dang bstan grags gnyis kyis 'brog pa la 'dzin pa'i lta stangs gcig pa yin pas sems gting nas ma dga' kyang ci'ang ma smras/lha pha gi'i bu mo de/’ rnam bkras da dung mo rang gcig pur bsdad pa'i bu mo dug log dkar rkyang gyon pa der mdzub mo btsugs/ 6 mdzes pa la ni bu mo de sgrol ma dang gcig 'dra red ces zer/ 66ga re/ bu mo der khyed sems shor ba min nam/ gal te khyed kyi sems nang yod na nga la thabs shes yod/ 'gro dang /’ rnam bkra bstan grags kyi rjes su 'brangs nas gos dkā/ spyan pa'i bu mo'i phyogs su song / tsa zhabs bro zhig brgyab na 'grig gi

red dam/ bu mo des bstan grags la sdang mig cig bltas rjes langs nas sdod sa gzhan zhig tu spos/ rnam bkras bu mo de'i 'khris su phyin nas ru khyed dang nga tsho ngo shes byas na 'grig gam ’ zhes bshad pas bu mo de hang sangs pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig dang bcas te 'khrab ra'i sgo nas thon/ rnam bkras mu mthun rjes su 'gro skabs bu mo de gyang zur zhig tu langs nas bsdad de 6 khyed kyis nga rjed 'ded byas nas ci byed/’ ces khros pa'i tshul gyis smras/ 6 ngas khyed la ’ 6 ga re/ rnyog gra bshad na ngas spyi bde 'bod kyi yin/ zer nas bu mo de gom stabs mgyogs pos song stabs/ rnam bkras 6 nga mizhis zer ba las gzhan gang yang ma thon par lus/ rnam bkra'i da lta'i dran sdug gis mnar ba'i lus po dag grang zhing bsil ba'i rlung gi khrod du tshul bzhin gnas par gyur/ 'on kyang ci'ang mi snang ba'i mun nag gi 'jig shānades rnam bkra la bsam gzhigs dang 'char snang gi bar snang rgya chen po ga spra/'i/ dgong mo rnam bkra gnyid dang bral/ gyon chas dkar po gyon pa'i bu mo de dang sgrol ma res mos kyis kho'i mig mdun du gsal ba dang / kho'i sems la dug log dkar po gyon pa'i bu mo de dang sgrol ma'i rnam sprul 'ba' zhig red snyam/ des na gal srid bu mo des mos mthun byas na mo dang 'grig rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la bu mo de ni rang nyid sdod sa'i 'grul khang gi zhabs zhu ba red 'dug des na khos ched mngags bu mo der 6 shog dang / nga'i nyal khang nang chu khol yang mi 'dug zer bas/ bu mo de shar rer rnam bkra'i rjes la yong / rnam bkras nyal khang nang 'byor ma thag sgo mar mnan te zhu ba 'then pa'i tshul gyis 6 nga khyed dang ngo shes sheg byed 'dod pas khyed kyis khas len dgos/7 ba'i ming tsam mi 'dri bar/’ 6 khyed kyi ming la sgrol ma ma red dam/7 8 sus bshad ༵༵ /7

bu mo de'i ming la yang ngo ma sgrol ma yin pa shes dus rnam bkra'i sems dga' lhang lhang du gyur nas 'dren byed zung nas spyir btang min pa'i 'od mdangs shegaphyung / 6 da lta ngar las ka yod/’ sgrol mas sgo phyes te yud tsam rang sar langs rjes slar phyi bltas shig bslogs te mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig bstan/de nas zla ba gsum tsam phyin rjes rnam bkra'i lhag bsam dang ngang rgyud ring po la brten nas kho gnyis dbar zol med kyi brtse dung zhig rim bzhin chags/phyi nyin rnam bkra dang bstan grags lhan du zi ling la tshong rgyag tu 'gro rgyur gtan 'khel nas gra sgrig byas te sdod skabs sgo rdung byung / gom pa'i rdog sgra dang sgo rdung stangs la bltas na rnam bkras rang nyid kyi mdza' mo sgrol ma yin par rtogs/ sgrol mas slar yang skra dang skra gzhug gcod nas grong khyer nangagi gzhon nu 'dra po zhig bzo dgos zhes lab nges red bsam nas rnam bkra cung blo mi bde bar gyur/ skabs der sgrol mas dra phan chen po zhig gi nanganas sha bag leb mang thag chod cig bton nas de rnams khyed gnyis kyi lam rgyags yin zer ba dang / rnam bkrar kha phyogs te 8 nged gnyis phyi la 'cham tsam byed par 'gro zer bas/ rnam bkra 'phral du yar langs te kho gnyis mnyam du phyir thon/mu khyed kyis nga dran pa e gda'/ 6 dran dang dran/’ gzhon nu pho thozung dal bu'i ngang zla 'od kyis khyab pa'i snum nag gi lam chen thog bskyod/nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'dren byed ches cher gdang ba'i skar ma dag khong gnyis la gzigs pa'i tshul la bltas na rtse gcig tu khong gnyis bde skyid thob pa'i smon lam rgyag pa dang mtshungs/ 6 ngo ma skra chod/ de ring rgya chas gyon duswā sdus skra ring po bzhag na de bas mig snang mi mdzes ’ de ring rnam bkra rgya

chas rgyu spus legs gsar rkyang zhig gyon yod/ 'on te khos skra gzhug gcod thabs bral/ de sngon rang nyid kyi pha gnam lha skra gzhug gi don du myong ba'i dka' sdug dag yid la 'khor dus gal srid skra bcad na rang nyid kyi pha la ngo log byas pa dang khyad par ci yod snyam/ 6 grong khyer nang skra bslas na mis mthong chung byed kyi red/ mi shod mi dgos/ rnam bkra ma dga' bas sgrol mas mu mthun ma smras/ rnam bkra chung nas bud med la mthong chung med kyang dus rgyun pa'i bslab bya las ma'i kha tar nyan mi 'dod/ de bas skra dang skra gzhug gcod rgyu'i skor shod mkhan byung tshe des na sgrol mas ci'ang mi smra/rnam bkras kyang ci'ang mi smra bar 'jam thing thing gi lam thog tu dal bu'i ngang bskyod/ dbyar gyi gnam ni byis pa'i ngo gdong ltar 'gyur ba che/ nam mkha'i mthongs su sprin nag khengs shing rna ba 'gas pa'i 'brug sgra'ang sgrog gzhon nu pho mo gnyis zim zim char pa'i khrod du gcig gis gcig la 'thams nas yun ring langs/ sgrol mas rnam bkra'i rtsub hrag hrag gi kha nas skyes pa pho zhig gi blo stobs dang nus pa tshor/zla phyed kyi rjes su rnam bkra dang bstan grags gnyis zi ling nas phyir log rnam bkras sgrol ma la gyon chas dpe gsar 'ga' nyos 'dug de sngon rnam bkras spus ka yag sdug las dpe gsar yin min dang bzo legs nyes la rtsa ba nas mi lta/ de ring sgrol mas kyang yid la 'khor ma myong ba'i gyon chas dpe gsar 'ga' nyos 'dug de bas kyang mi rnams kyi bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni sgrol ma'i mig mdun du shar ba'i rnam bkra la 'brog pa'i g.ya' phran tsam yang ma mchis/ yun ring por gal cher brtsi ba'i skra gzhug nag po de gar song med par gyur/ kho'i skra de deng gi grong khyer nang gi gzhon nu tshos dga' po byed pa'i bzo lta zhig bzos 'dug lus la'ang deng skabs byang 'brog khul du 'khrug shos yin pa'i grong rdal 'di ru'ang ma dar ba~X /sa

kyi rjes la ches cher bsnyegs pa'i gyon chas dpe gsar zhig gyon 'dug sgrol mas rang gi mdza' bo gshis ka gyong la 'gyur dka' ba der bsam bzhin mthong ma myong ba'i ngo mtshar gyi dngos po zhig mthong ba ltar 'dren byed zung ches cher gdang / des na mo'i mgo bo dal bu'i ngang rnam bkra'i dro skyid kyi brang thog tu bzhag nas smyo nged gnyis slad ji ltar byed ’ ces skad gdangs dma' la brtse dung chen pos bshad pas/ rnam bkras sgrol ma'i 'gram par ga ler 'o zhig skyel te 66nga khyed dang kha 'bral mi phod pas gang mgyogs gnyen sgrig byed rgyu red/ nga'i pha ma gnyis kyang grong khyer la bsu rgyu yin zer skabalha/ sgrol ma'i 'dren byed zung dal lhod ngang zum ste blo yid tshims par gyur rna/ ma bkras skra gzhug rnying pa de rtsa che'i dngos po gzhan dang mnyam du sgam nang du nyar/ rjes su kho la bu skyes te chen po chags dus bstan rgyu yin zer/ de nas rnam bkra'i mgo la ras skud du ma las grub pa'i skra gzhug med kyang / kho'i a mye dang pha nas brgyud pa'i sems kyi skra gzhug de pha yul gyi ri mtho sar gnas pa'i dar lcog ltar nam yang kho'i sems kyi mkha' ru lhab lhub tu gnas nges/294

pha ma'i shul bzhagagacigalha chos ni sa mtho'i gna' grong 'di ru lte khrag 'phos shing rim bzhin pha ma'i brtse skyong gi 'og tu ci'ang sems khral mi dgos pa'i byis pa'i dus skabs sogs rim pa brgyud nas kha la spu rdzob skyes pa'i pho gzhon zhig la 'tshar longs byung / kho la spun sring gzhan med la/ skye rga na 'chi'i mi tshe'i chos nyid las ma 'das par kho lo nyi shu'i thog la pha grongs pa dang / lo sum cu tham pa'i thog ma rgan mo'ang 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du song /ma grongs khar kho'i lag 'go nas dam por 'chang bzhin brtse ba chen pos kho'i gdong la yun ring bltas nas 6 ci mgyogs bza' mo zhig 'tshol/nad na tsha sogs byung na rogs pa byed mkhan yod/ pha ma gnyis kyis khyod la khang pa 'di las gzhan gang yang bzhag med/ khang pa 'di gzhan la btsong mi nyan zhes bshad rjes ga ler mig btsum nas mi yul dang kha bral/ma grongs pa'i sdug bsngal de lha chos kyi lus sems nas lo phyed tsam ma yal/ lhag par du 'od snang dang bral ba'i dgong mor rang nyid gcig pu khang pa chen po 'di'i nang du nyal dus yun ring gnyid mi khug de sngon a ma yod dus mgo sngas thog tu bzhag ma thag ma'i skad cha'ang nyan ma tshar bar ba~X spyad

kyis hur sgra dang bcas par rmi lam gyi zhing khams su slebs/ dgong mi gcig ring ngo ma shi ba ltar ci'ang mi go/ ci'ang mi tshor/ de ni sems khral dang yongs su bral ba'i dus skabs sheg red/ deng skabs snga nyal dang phyi nyal ji ltar byas kyang gnyid kyi pho brang gi sgo nas las sla por 'dzul mi thub/ dben 'jags nag thom gyi khor yug nang kho'i rig pa je gsal thog mgo mjug dang steng 'og snga phyi sogs brjod dka' ba'i bsam blo sna tshogs 'khor/ skabs 'gar lhags rlung brgyab nas khang pa'i phyi nang nas tshag sgra khob sgra grags dus spyir btang min pa'i skrag snang zhig skyes nas gnyid kyi g.ya' tsam med par gyur/ skabs skabs kho 'u thug nas langs te nyin mo ltar ja tsha po bzo dgos byung / mas khang pa 'di ma btsong zhes kha chems bzhag kyang khang pa chen po 'dis kho la ster ba ni gnyid dang bral ba'i mtshan mo dang skrag snang sna tshogs las dge mtshan ci'ang ma mchis snyam/ 'on te ma'i bza' mo zhig 'tshol dgos pa'i mngag bya de kho'i bsam thog tu song / de sngon kho bud med la mi dga'/ gang yin zer na kho'i pha lo chung dus dga' ldan byin chags gling gi sgrig la zhugs nas grwa pa byed myong bas/ khong 'tsho bzhugs skabs rgyun du 'jig rten 'khor ba dang ring du bral zhing skye ba dman pa'i bud med med pa'i dgon pa'i 'tsho bar bsngags brjod byed/ de'i rkyen pas khos dgon pa'i 'tsho bar yid smon zhig dang bcas par bud med dang mnyam du bsdad nas khyim tshang bca' rgyu'i bsam blo 'khor ma myong / kho ni bgrang bya sum cur song yang bud med kyi dri mas ma gos/ dga' ldan byin chags gling gi grwa gsar krog krog tsha po de tshor de lta bu'i sdom gtsang yin min sus shes/ lha chos kyis mtshan mo mang po nyal sar 'gre log byas rjes/ kho'i yid kyi me long gi ngos su thengs mang shar ba ni mtsho dpal red/ mo ni dgon pa'i shing bzo bkra tshe'i bu ༵ byed/ dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi dang spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab sogs gang

nas bltas kyang mo ni rang nyid kyi kha dang 'tsham pa'i so red snyam/ mtsho dpal gza' nyi mar kho'i khang 'og gi lam zur du khyim nas bzos pa'i phye mar 'bo sogs pa'i rgyun spyod shing chas tsag tsig khrom la 'don bzhin yod/ dus rgyun mos lha chos mthong dus yang yang kha brda byed pa tsam ma zad/ thengs mang por kho las ja dang chu khol slong myong /de ring yang gza' nyi ma yin pas mtsho dpal yang dus rgyun ltar lha chos kyi khang pa'i 'og tu khrom bton/lha chos kyi sems nang sngar med kyi skrag snang dang dga' snang zhig lhan du skyes/ khos shod rgyu'i skad cha gra sgrig byas nas mtsho dpal gyi khrom bton sar song / khog snying 'tshab nas ldig ldig gis 'phag pa'ang khros phyi nas tshor snang byung / thams cad lha chos kyi bsam 'dun las ma 'das/ mtsho dpal 'dzum dmul dmul gyis 66de ring yang chu khol zhig sprad rogs zer/lha chos 'tshab 'tshub kyis chu blugs sa'i kung tsi chen po de khyer nas nang du log kho'i lus po tsha zing zing du gyur nas rngul chu'ang thon/ ngo ma/ kho skyes nas 'di ltar 'tshab myong ba mi dran/ bud med ces pa de ngo ma shugs chen po red/ khos sgrog tse'i nang nas gra sgrig byas pa'i yi ge de blangs/ yig khug nang do dgong gi glog brnyan pa se gcig dang / mdza' yig shog lho gcig blugs yod/ shog lho'i ngos su bris pa ni deng skabs dar bzhin pa'i rgya mi'i skad cha dmar dmar rjen rjen dag ma yin par gna' snga mo nas dar zhing deng skabs kyang gson por gnas pa'i dmangs gzhas shig red/ 8 sked pa phra mo ldem ldem ma/ ldem rogs thig phra'i ska rags yod/ ko lham dkar chung mdzes mo ma/ mdzes rogs lham sgrog 'ja' tshon yod/ mgo bo nag chung skra bzang ma/ bzang rogs wa zhwa gra chen yod/’ lha chos rtab rtob kyis yig 297

khug lag mthil du bcangs nas sgo ru 'gro bar brtsams/ sgo 'gram du slebs dus gzhi nas dang tsi'i nang du chu khol blugs rgyu brjed pa shes/6 chusol 'dir yod/ lha chos kyis chu khol dang yi ge sa la bzhag rjes mtsho dpal gyi ngo gdong la lta tsam yang byed ma phod par 'tshab 'tshub kyis rang khyim du dbugs hal hal gyis rgyug nang du slebs rjes/ las 'gan grub nas blo bde ba'i dbugs ring zhig btang /phyi dro/ lha chos kyis skra bkrus nas skra snum byugs te 'od 'tsher ba zhig bzos thog dug log gtsang ma zhig gyon nas glog brnyan blta sa'i sgo 'gram du song / khos glog brnyan khang chen gyi sgo 'gram du langs nas yang yang rgyang lta byed bzhin mtsho dpal yong rgyur sgug kho'i yid kyi me long gi ngos su mtsho dpal gyi gzugs brnyan sna tshogs shar/ mo'i skra ring po brag steng nas lhung ba'i rbab chu lta bu dang / phyi gos gur phub pa ltar bkyags pa'i nu 'bur/gom 'gros ltar ldem ldem du g.yo ba'i sked skabs bsam blo gtong bzhin kho'i lus hril po tsha zing zing du gyur thog myur du mo dang 'o chu bzhin dbyer med du 'dres na snyam/ yang bsam blo gzhan zhig gis kho'i rig pa rnal du phab bcug deng skabs rang nyid kyi lus la 'di lta bu'i gnon par dka' ba'i 'dod chags kyi me zhig 'bar yong don gang yin snyam/nyi ma nub kyi ri bo grwa pa'i mgo lta bu'i rgyab tu gab/ yangs pa'i sa gzhi chen pos ga ler mun nag gi gos ring mgo mjug med pa de lhug por gyon/glog brnyan lta mkhan gyi mi gcig rjes gnyis mthun kyis slebs yong / na chung pho mo zung dang zung byas nas slebs/ spre'u ltar gnam mchongs sa mchongs kyis rgyug pa'i byis pa tsho dang tsho byas nas slobs/ mi rgan dang mi dar ma 'ga' dal dal lhod lhod ngang re re gnyis gnyis kyis yong / khang pa'i nang nadī ltos brnyan bstan pa'i sgra phyi ru grags/ lha chos kyi ngo gdong brel 'tshub

kyis khyab bzhin chu tshod la yang yang lta bzhin rgyang lta bar med byas/ 'on kyang mcho dpal gyi grib so tsam yang rig rgyu med/ kho'i sems kyi gting nas rim bzhin khong khro dang sdug bsngal gyi rlangs pa 'phyur/lha chos ni nad drag pos mnar ba'i nad pa zhig ltar gom pa ljid po spos nas phyir log rtsis byas pa na/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la/ glog 'od kyi 'og nas mtsho dpal dang mthong ma myong ba'i bud med cig 'tham res byas nas slebs yong gi 'dugalha chos dga' thag chod nas rang dbang med par 6 mtsho dpal zer bzhin mdun du rgyug pa na/ mtsho dpal gyis kho ngo mi shes pa ltar kha ya ma byas par mthong ma myong ba'i bud med de dang 'tham skyor zhig byas nas glog brnyan khang chen gyi phyogs su thad kur phyin/ glo bur du/ mtsho dpal gyis stod gos khug ma'i nang nas yig skogs shig blangs nas rgyab tu 'phang byung / de nas shar rer bud med de dang mnyam du ha ha ho ho'i dgod sgra'i khrod du glog brnyan khang chen nang du 'dzul/lha chos kyis phar lta tshur lta zhig byas pa dang sbrags/ myur du yig skogs sgrug khos yig skogs de sbar mthil du dam por bcangs nas mun nag gi mtshan mor rgyug ma 'dur gyis nang du rtab rtob kyis logalha chos kyis yig skogs de lha sku'i 'og tu bzhag nas/ lag gnyis brang khar thal mo sbyar te kha mug mug gis gsol ba smon lam btab/ ma gzhi mtsho dpal gyi grang shur shur gyi rnam 'gyur gyis kho'i lhab lhub tu 'bar ba'i brtse dung gi me spung thog tu ya nga med pa'i brtse med kyi chu bshos yod kyang / khos da hāzlo /shā /dril gyis yig skogs nang du kho la gtam bzang zhig bshad yod yig skogs kyi nang du khos blugs pa'i glog brnyan pa se de dang ri~X'

yig shog lho de las mi 'dug ltos dang / khos bris pa'i mdza' glu'i 'og tu yig phreng gcig bris pa ste/ na khyod la khang stong zhig las med pas nga gso thub kyi ma red/ lha chos kyi ngo mdog thal skyar gyur/ sems khong nas bsam tshul sna tshogs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'dra bar 'khrug ngo ma red/ nga la khang stong zhig las med/ 'on kyang ngas mo 'khyag tu mi 'jug ltogs su mi 'jug sus kyang mi mthong ba'i gnas der lha chos byis pa zhig ltar ngus/mchi ma'i char rgyun gyis lag tu bzung ba'i mdza' yig shog lho de rlon pa rlon kyang du bzos/yud tsam song rjes/ lha chos ngu mtshams bzhag nas mtsho dpal la 6 'dre mo bdud mo zhes dmod mo bor/ lha chos kyis khang pa gnyis thog gi sge'u khung nas phyi ru bltas/ kho'i mig mdun du shar ba ni mtha' yas pa'i mun nag gi 'jig rten 'ba' zhig red/ skabs der skyug bro ba dang yid du 'ong ba mnyam du mun nag gis btums nas bzang ngan cha 'byed mi shes/thag ring gi zhabs bro'i ra ba nas grags pa'i deng gi shin tu 'khrug cha dod pa'i bro gzhas kyi sgra gdangs skabs skabs mtho la skabs skabs dma' tsam byas nas kho'i thos 'dzin gyi bu gar lhung /lha chos kyis yid pham pa'i dbugs ring zhig btang rjes/ khang pa'i sgo dang sge'u khung dam du brgyab/ ngo ma/ kho la dbang ba ni pha mas bzhag pa'i khang stong 'di tsho red/ khos glo bur du 'jig rten phyi mar gshegs pa'i drin can pha ma gnyis dran nas spyir btang min pa'i skyo snang zhig dang bcas par mchi ma'i char rgyun mu tig gi phreng ba chad pa ltar gyur/glog bsad/ nyal chas gyon nas gan rkyal du bsdad kyang / sgug pa'i gnyid kyi mdza' mo 'byor rgyu med par rig pa je gsal je gsal du 'gro/khordi chid pa'i nang du skabs 'gar ldem ldem du 'gro ba'i mtsho dpal dang /
