skabs 'gar zhing khams gzhan du slebs pa'i pha ma sogs mi sna dang bya dngos sna tshogs gdon 'dre'i bro gar 'khrab bzhin zang zingadu mngon/ do dgong yang kho la bsu bar yong mkhan ni gnyid dang bral ba'i mtshan mo zhig red/gnyis/bod byang thang gi dkyil rgyud du gnas pa'i sa cha 'dir grang ngar shin tu che/ skyag rdzun shod mkhan gyis 'di ru gcin pa gtong dus gcin sa thog tu ma slebs gong gnam nang du 'khyag par 'gyur zer/ gang ltar 'di ni grang ngar che ba'i sa cha zhig yin pa smos med red/ lha chos chung dus nas zhogs pa snga po langs nas phyi la 'khyam 'khyam du 'gro ba'i goms gshis yod/ des na/de ring yang kho snga po langs te sngar rgyun ltar phyi la dwangs gtsang gi mkha' rlung gtsang ma longs su spyod par 'dod/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la/ kho'i sgo 'gram du mi zhig lus 'khum 'khum byas nas bsdad 'dug su yin nam/mgo dung ltar dkar ba'i rgad mo zhig gnyid shor grabs byas 'dug 'khum 'khum du bsdad pa'i mi des lha chos sgor thon par tshor bas 'tshab 'tshub kyis langs byung /lha chos kyis zhib tu lta dus/ de ni rgad mo zhig ma yin par lang tsho dar la bab pa'i bu mo lo chung zhig red/ mo'i mgo la ba mo brgyab nas skra dkar po chags pa ma zad/ rdzi ma phra mo pir gyis bris 'dra de dang mig spu ring po gral star 'grig po dag gis kyang ba mo'i gos gyon 'dug la/ mo'i lus la tshar gyi phyu pa phyi la ras gos nag pos g.yogs pa zhig gyon zhing de'i thog thal rdul gang sar 'gos 'dugalha chos kyis zhogs pa'i snang rlung gi khrod du sig sig 'dar bsdo 0hā mo

der lta bzhin 6 khyod 'dir ci yin zhes dris/ 6 nga chab mdo nas lha sar gnas bskor du 'gro mkhan yin/ mdang dgong rlangs 'khor kha lo bas 'dir phab byung / nga la ngo shes med la dngul yang mehā pag 'dir bsdad pa yin/ de ring rlangs 'khor rnyed na lha sar 'gro mkhan 6 /da/ la rogs pa med dam/’ 8 med/’ bu mo des mgo bo gug nas bsdad/lha chos kyis glo bur du mi yul la rogs med lus pa'i bu mo der snying rje drag po zhig skyes nas/ mo khyim du khrid nas ja tsha po zhig sprad rgyu dran/ gnas (skokā bkā lto sbyin na dge ba lhag par che zhes de sngon grwa pa yin pa'i pha rgan sa ཿ/ chozlo kyi/ sa bu mo de sdod du bcug rjes/ khos me spar nas ja bskol rtsis byas pa na/ bu mo des kyang yar rgyug mar rgyug gis kho la rogs pa byas/ja tsha po btung zhing lto zos rjes/ bu mo de'i 'khyags nas mdog 'gyur ba'i ngo mdog rim bzhin slar gsos byung / mo'i sgor tsam yin pa'i gdong pa'i thog lhad dang bral ba'i chu mig lta bu'i mig gnyis dang / mi che mi chung ba'i sna tsog tsog gcig da dung sha rtsa dkar la dmar mdangs rgyas pa'i mkhur tshos gnyis bcas ldan/ dmar srab kyi kha sha 'gul tsam byas pas gral star 'grig po'i dung so dkar mo phyi ru mngon/ gang nas bltas kyang na chung bu mo'i lang tsho'i gzi byin phyi ru wal wal shar/lha chos kyis bu mo de'i phyi'i rnam pa blor bab nas mo dang skad cha shod 'dod kyi 'dun pa zhig kyang skyes nas/ 6 bu mo khyod kyi ming la ci zer/’ bu mo de 'dzum tsam byas rjes na 'dzum dpal zer mi zhes lan btab/30khro ming yag po 'dug khyod la rogs pa'ang med par gnas bskor du

'gro ba gang yin/ 'dzum dpal ci'ang mi smra bar gdong pa smad nas bsdad/6 bros yong ba e yin/ pha yul bskyur nas gnas bskor du 'gro ba /gas yul gzhan du bros 'gro mkhan bu mo mang po yod pa lha chos kyis mthong nga / 6 yen 'dzum dpal ngo mdog skyo pos mgo bo kyog kyog byas/8 bros dgos don gang yin nam/ 'dzum dpal yud tsam ring ci'ang mi smra bar bsdad/ glo bur du byis pa zhig ltar ngus/me / chos dngangs skrag skyes nas 6 ngu mi nyan/ shod mi 'dod na skyon da 643 / /sha/ da chog na ning nga tsho'i pha yul la dge ma'i dgon rnying zhig yod pa de bskyar du bzhengs/ dud tshang mang pos 'tshang kha shig shig gis bu mo dgon par bzhag nga'ang a mas dgon par 'jog rgyu'i khas len byas 'dug mkha' 'gro mas ngas rjes ma sangs rgyas bstan par phan thogs yong zhes gsung byung zer/ 'on kyang nga dge ma byed 'dod gtan nas med/ nga ni khra 'tshub 'tshub kyi 'jig rten 'tsho bar zhen/ der brten ngas dge ma bya rgyu gtan nas khas ma blangs kyang a ma'i sems rdo las grub pa ltar 'gyur ba 'gro gi mi 'dug dngos su sdom pa blangs nas dge ma byed pa'i dus nye ru nye ru song stabs/ nga 'u thug nas bros yong ba yin/ nga tsho'i pha yul nas lha sar bros pa'i bu mo mang po yod/ da dung tshong rgyag nas sdod mkhan gyi skyes pa'ang yod/ ngas khong tsho rnyed rjes ji ltar 'tsho ba bskyal dgos min thad bsam blo gtong rgyu yin/ gces pa'i pha yul bskyur nas 'gro dgos dus sems pa skyo'ang / nga la thabs shes de las med/’ skad cha bshad tshar bas/ 3/sdom

dpal cung ngo tsha ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan nas gdong pa'i thog dbang med du babs pa'i mchi ma phyis/lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal la snying rje zhig skyes nas mo la rang nus gang yod kyis rogs pa bya rgyu'i 'dun pa drag po zhig ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes/6 de 〉nga khyod nga'i nang du ngal gsos/ sang nyin rlangs 'khor btsal nas lha sar ༵ ba/ ku' drin che/’ 'dzum dpal gyi 'dren byed zung nas bka' drin tshor ba'i mchi ma ko ro ror gyur/phyi logs su rlangs 'khor 'tshol du 'gro bzhin pa'i lha chos kyi sems gting nas glo bur du brel ba chen po zhig langs/ ngo ma/ rang nyid kyis rang nyid byams snying rje can gyi sangs rgyas la brtsis nas ngo mi shes pa'i sa mtha'i mi 'aḥm zhig nang du bzhag gal srid mo ni rkun ma dang khram pa 'dra yin na gang k+ta /chos 'tshab 'tshub kyis nang du 'dzul dus/ me tsha po zhig brgyab pas khang pa'i nang drod chil ler dus rgyun thal rdul gyis khengs pa'i ca dngos rnams gtsang rkyang phyis 'dug la/ 'dzum dpal gyis da dung thab phyis shig bzung nas langs 'dug6 rgan log 'dug7 'dzum dpal gyis kho la yid dbang 'phrog pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig bstan pa dang / myur du kho'i phor pa'i nang du ja tsha po gang blu/ ༵/sa kyi sems dro sob sob tu gyur/ rang nyid kyis mi bzang ngan par brtsis pa la kha skyengs/ gal te rang nyid la bza' mo zhig yod na nyin ltar 'di lta bu'i 'tsho ba bskyal chog snyam/ glo bur du mtsho dpal dran/ deng skaXsdu /sa gza' nyi mar yang kho'i khang 'gram du khrom mi 'don/ kho mthong

dus ngo mi shes ltar gyis ltag pa dgye dgye byas nas 'gro/ kho dang mo'i bar de lta bu'i rgyang thag yod dam/ 6 bya rgod po 'phur sa mtho ba la/ lus grib so 'jog sa dma' ba la/’ mtsho dpal gyi thog la khong khro chen po zhig langs/'dre mo/ mo la ha las rgyu ci yod/6 rgan lags/ ja/ 'dzum dpal gyis ja bkyag pas lha chos kyi bsam blo'i 'khor mtshams bcad/ lha chos kyis stod gos khug ma'i nang nas sgor nyi shu bton nas 'dzum dpal la bsrings nas 6 ngas de ring lha sar 'gro mkhan gyi rlangs 'khor 'dra e gda' bltas kyang ma rnyed/ khyod sang nyin 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor nang song / sgor nyi shus pa se nyo thub ces smras/'dzum dpal gyis dngul ma blangs par yud tsam ci'ang mi smra bar bsdad/lha chos kyis bu mo ngo tsha nas dngul len ma phod pa red bsams nas 6 snang dag med/ nged gnyis ngo shes pa ni las red/ khyod rjes ma phyug po chags dus nga ma brjed na 'grig ’ ces bshad/'dzum dpal gyis glo bur du pus mo gnyis ka sa la btsugs nas 6 rgan/khyed ni mi yag po zhig red 'dug nga khyed kyi bza' mo byas na e 'grig de sbyor ma sdong na g.yog mor nyar na e 'grig ngas mi tshe gcig khyed la g.yog rjod 'thaḥs/ cad bsam yul las ring du 'das pas/ lha chos skabs gcig ring ci'ang smra mi shes pa'i 'jim sku ltar gyur/6 gal srid zla re zla gnyis kyi rjes la/ khyod la nga mi mkho na nga 'gro chog 'dzum dpal ngu ran 'dugalha chos kyis rang nyid kyi mdun du pus mo btsugs pa'i bu mo nā/ lta

bzhin/ 'dzum dpal gyi re bas khengs pa'i mig chen po gnyis mchi ma mer mer gang nas rang nyid la bltas 'dug kho'i sems gting nas brtse sems shig dang snying rje zhig skyes/ 'dzum dpal gyi sngar gyi lo rgyus mi shes pa ma gtogs mo mtsho dpal las ldab mang pos yag pa 'dug snyam/ mos grong khyer nang gi bu mo ltar gzab mchor gyis brgyan nas phyi ru song na tshang mas mig rub rgyag sa'i bud med mdzes ma zhig yin nges red/ de dus mtsho dpal mo'i skyag pa gtong sar slebs kyi ma red/lha chos rang dbang med par 'dzum dpal gyi lag bzung nas yar 'then pa na/ mo kho'i 'gram du bsdad/ lha chos kyi yid kyi dbang po 'dzum dpal gyis cig car 'phrog pas/ kho'i lag g.yon mas mo pang du blangs pa na/mos rang 'gul gyis lha chos kyi de tsam che rgyu med pa'i brang ngos su bsnyes nas bde skyid kyi snang bas mig gnyis zim zim du btsum/ lha chos kyi lus steng nas sngar med kyi 'dod pa'i tsha rlabs shig cis kyang gnon mi thub par dgung du 'phyur bas/ khos rtab rtob kyis mo nyal khri'i thog tu mnan rjes mo'i dmar srab kyi mchu yi pad mo las sbrang rtsi 'jib bzhin mo'i ska rags dgrol bar sprirtsams nas myur du mo dang lhan du 'o chu bzhin 'dres rgyu'i 'dun pa drag po sa/ 8 sgo'ang brgyab mi 'dug 'dzum dpal gyis shugs kyis lha chos phyir phud rgya/ ༵༵ /dang 'dzum dpal khrims kyi 'gro lugs gang yang brgyud mi dgos par ming don mtshungs pa'i bza' tshang du gyur/nyin shas nang lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal la rgya chas gsar rkyang zhig nyos thog gza' nyi mar/ 'dzum dpal gyis rgya chas gsar rkyang de gyon/ mo'i phra zhiX spyazlo pa'i gzugs byad rgya chas kyi 'og nas phyi ru mngon/ na chung ma'i

rtags mtshan du gyur pa'i nu 'bur zung mthug tsam yin pa'i stod gos kyi 'og nas kyang mngon gsal dod pos 'bur du thon/ na chung ma'i lang tsho'i gzi dpal ma lus sus kyang 'gog ma thub par skye bo kun gyi mig mdun du wa ler shar/ lha chos dang 'dzum dpal khrom gzhung du bskyod/mtsho dpal gyis lam sum mdo kha zhig tu shing chas khrom du bton nas 'dugalha chos kyis ci'ang mi smra bar de ru song nas langs tsam byas pa dang ji mi snyam gyi rnam 'gyur gyis mtsho dpal la lta tsam byas/'dzum dpal gyis lus po gug nas phye mar 'bo zhig la 'chang tsam 'chang tsam byas/6 'gro/ go med/ spus ka yag mo med/ lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal la 'gro dgos pa'i kha brda byas/lha chos kyis mtsho dpal gyis ga ler 'dzum dpal la lta gi yod pa mthong /lha chos dang 'dzum dpal mdza' brtse'i dpung gdang gshib nas mug mug gis gsang gtam smra bzhin dal gyis mdun du song /lha chos kyis hob ste phyi mig cig bltas pa na/ mtsho dpal gyis mgo bo bsrings nas kho'i phyogs la bltas 'dug khros phyi bltas byed pa mthong bas de mur sa la bsdad song / skabs der lha chos kyi yid du mngar zhim sprang rtsi sem bzhin bde skyid kyis khyab/lam thog tu/ lha chos ngo shes 'ga' dang 'phrad pas tshang mas khos mdzes ma zhig khrid 'dug pa mthong bas ha las snang byas/ kha shas khyi mig ches cher gdang nas 'dzum dpal gyi lus la chags mig zim zim byed/ mi gcig gis kho'i rna 'gram du 6 da bar bu mo 'dir bsgugs bsdad ༵ /da/

bsod bde 'dug ces shub shub smras/de ltar gyis lha chos dang 'dzum dpal gyi 'tsho ba rgyun ldan can du 'gyur/lha chos grong lhan gyi ar las ru khag tu las kur bskyod/ 'dzum dpal khyim du bsdad nas nang las byas/ khong gnyis mdza' gcugs gser skud kyis dam por bcings nas mig btsum thengs gcig la zla ba lnga tsam song zin/dgun gyi spu gri rnon pos rab tu gtses pa'i yul de'i dgun dus rim bzhin yol nas/ kun gyi yid kyi brtan pa cig car 'phrog pa'i bod byang thang hā /byar kha de gzab mchor gyis rab tu brgyan pa'i lha mo zhig ltar dal gyis gsum/ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin bu mos sna tshogs me tog gi mgul rgyan btags pa'i dus 'di ni bod byang thang gi dbyar dus red/ lo gcig dus gcig gi rta rgyug dus chen shar bas gnam bo'i grong khyer gyi phyogs gang sar bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i dga' bdes khyab/ skra yi lan bu brgya phrag du ma bslas pa'i 'brog mo 'ga' dkar dmar rgyan chas khra 'tshub 'tshub byas nas ldem ldem gyis yong tshe/ skra ser ser mig sngo sngo yin pa'i phyi rgyal ba 'ga' mi phal mo ches mi go ba'i bya skad byi'u skad brgyab nas dpar chas bzung nas 'brog mo tsho'i 'gro lam bkagade nyin lha chos nang du bsdad/ khos 'dzum dpal rta rgyug thang du ltad mo lta ru gtong / 'gro ran khar/ 'dzum dpal gyis mo chu tshod gnyis las mi 'gor bar log yong zer/307 mchog bdun gyi khri la bzhugs par grags pa'i nyin byed dbang pos

phyi mig yang yang lta bzhin nub kyi ri bo mi mgo skra med lta bu'i rgyab tu gab/lha chos kyis sge'u khung nas yang yang phyi la lta/ 'dzum dpal da dung log mkhan mi 'dug chu tshod gnyis kyis mi tshad chu tshod brgyad zin/mun nag gi yol ba nag pos sa gzhi g.yogs/ nam mkha'i dbyings su skar ma je mang du song bas/ byis pa 'ga' mtshar snang gis nyin mo skar ma de tshog par phyin pa red ces dri ba bton/ grong khyer gyi phyogs gang sar nam mkha'i skar ma la 'gran pa'i glog sgron grangs las 'das pa spar/ 'on kyang grong khyer gyi mtha' la gnas pa'i de tsam mthong rgyu med pa'i ri bo dang mtha' yas pa'i rtswa thang dag cha 'byed mi shes pa'i nag thom thom du gyur/lha chos kyi sems la dngangs 'tshab cig skyes pas khos myur du sgo las thon nas glog 'od kyi 'og nas rgyang lta byed dus/ lam thog tu zang zing mi yis khengs kyang 'dzum dpal gyi grib gzugs tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dugalha chos kyi sems sngar bas 'tshab nas khos khang sgor sgo lcags brgyab nas 'dzum dpal btsal du song /rta rgyug thang nas log pa'i mi sna tshogs lam thog tu gang / mi mang po zhig ra bzi nas gom bgrod khyar khyor spo zhing kha nas ldab ldib smra/mtsho dpal yang ra bzi nas grwa pa pho gzhon gnyis kyis skyor nas log yong / lha chos kyi sems nang du spyir btang min pa'i dga' snang zhig skyes/grwa pa'i sdom pa bslog na shi dus dmyal ba las 'gro sa med skad/ mo snying rje/mo shi dus dmyal bar mnar med du mes bsreg chus btso/ 'khyags gong du bsgyur/ mtha' yas la bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal re re bzhin myong dus/ mos nor bu'i nor nyams ma chod pa'i 'gyod pa skye rgyu red/ yud tsam ring 'dzum dpal gar song med pa'i 'tshub cha brjed nas sems nang dga' bde kho nas khyab/309

mtshan mor/ rta rgyug thang chen de nyin mo ltar gsal thing nger gnas/gnas skabs brgyab pa'i stabs bde'i tshong khang sna tshogs dang za khang 'dra min da dung las gnyer byed bzhin mchis/ rgya kha che'i lug sha mes bsreg sa der gzhan las 'ur zing che/ nub zur gyi spang thang du/ sgor gzhas rgyag mkhan tsho gsum tsam 'dug gzhon nu pho mo de tsho de 'dra'i spro mdog la/༵ kā swā/ ༵ sdusam la 'phur dus/ nam mkha' 'ja' yis khengs song / bro la ga par phyin kyang 'dzum dpal mthong rgyu mi 'dug 'dzum dpal nang du log tshar ba min nam/ lha chos kyi sems nang re bas khengs bzhin nang du log 'on kyang khang sgor da dung rang nyid 'gro ran khar brgyab pa'i sgo lcags chen po de nag rog ger bsdad 'dug lha chos la gzhan gyi thabs shes med pas nang du mo brgyab nas 'dzum dpal sgug sems kyi nang du mi dran dgu dran byung / gang sar rgyug pa'i rlangs 'khor smyon pa de tshos mo brdzis nas gang zhig tu sbas pa min nam/ glo bur du nad drag po zhig gis mnar nas gang zhig tu 'gyel ba e yin/ lha chos 'tshab nas ra rgan ser bas ded pa bzhin yar rgyug mar rgyug byas/ yang bsam blo gzhan zhig 'khor bas lha chos kyingo mdog gzhan zhig tu gyur/ bud med de don du ga 'dra zhig yin nam/mo'i gnas tshul ngo ma da dung gsal po ma rtogs/ rang nyid ngo ma lug lta bu'i lkugs pa red/ gang nas yong min mi shes pa'i sa mtha'i mo 'khyam zhig la de lta bu'i yid ches byas nas tshe gcig lus gcig gi bza' mo yong rgyu'i re ba byas/ thams cad mtsho dpal gyis khong khro bslangs nas bzos pa red/ bud med des pha ma dang gnyen nye bskyur nas bros pa ltar de ring kho bskyur nas bros pa e yin/ lha chos brel ba chen pos rang nyid kyi cung rin thang yod pa'i da~X ༵ blugs sa'i sgam de'i 'gram du rgyug sgam gyi lde mig mo la sprad ma

myong bas mos sgam gtor ba e yin/ rag gi sgo lcags de 'gul tsam yang ma byas pa ltar da dung sgam thog tu bsdad 'dug lha chos kyis 'then tsam byas tshe sgo lcags ngo ma gtor mi 'dug lha chos da dung blo ma bde bar lde mig blangs nas sgam nang gi ca lag re re bzhin rtsis bsher byas pas tshang ma chad lhag med par bsdad 'dug de nas lha chos kyis khang pa'i steng 'og kun du ca lag tshang yod med bltas/glo bur du sgo rdung byung /lha chos kyis 'tshab 'tshub ngang sgo phyes bas/ mgo la skra gzhug chen po brgyab pa'i pho gzhon zhig gis 'dzum dpal skyor nas langs 'dug khong gnyis kyi lus nas chang dri 'thul/ 'dzum dpal bzi nas ci'ang mi smra bar ha ha ho ho'i bgad mo sha stag dgod/lha chos kyi kha nas re zhig skad cha ma thon yang / sems kyi gting nas spyir btang min pa'i khong khro chen po zhig langs/pho gzhon de na re/ 6 nga dang 'dzum dpal pha yul gcig pa yin/ de ring glo bur du mnyam du 'phrad pas skyid skyid byas nas chang tog tsam btung bas ༵ bzi 'dug nga da lta log 'gro gi yin/’ pho gzhon de kha phyir bskor nas /dzum dpal khyar khyor gyis rgyug nas 6 khyod ma log nga'i nang du sdod sa sbyad 7ces smras/ mo ni byis pa zhig ltar gom tshod bzung ma thub par sa la 'a la/pho gzhon de phyi bltas slog nas/ khos sa la 'gyel ba'i 'dzum dpal la lta tsam dang ci'ang jus gtogs med pa lta bu'i lha chos la lta tsam byas/lha chos kyi sems nang gnon par dka' ba'i khro bas khengs pas/'dzum dpal sa la 'gyel dus dga' ba phran bu zhig kyang skyes/ 311

pho gzhon des shin tu ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis 6 khyod kyis bza' mo bdag po rgyag gi min nam/ des lha chos kyi khong khro'i me spung gi khrod du skam shing bsnan pas/ 8 khyod jus gtogs med/’ ru 'dzum dpal gyis mi skyag pa 'dra ba zhig rnyed 'dug pho gzhon des lha chos kyi thog la dzig dzig byas/8 khyod rgyag res rgyag 'dod pa e red/ lha chos bar nas mdun du gom pa kha shas song /6 hen/ mi des lha chos la kha ya ma byas par shar rer log phyin song /lha chos kyis sa la 'gyel ba'i 'dzum dpal la jus gtogs ma byas par nang du 'dzul nas sgo shugs kyis brgyab/ sems nang 'dzum dpal gyis sgo rdung rgyu sgug tha na sgo rdung tshe myur du sgo mi phye snyam/ 'on te/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la chu tshod phyed ka sgug kyang sgo rdung mkhan mi 'dugalha chos kyis sgo ga ler phye ba na/ lto slong mkhan gyi phru gu gnyis kyis 66nag mo zhig ra bzi 'dug ’ zer nas 'dzum dpal la lus bsher byed par brtsams/ mo ni sngar bzhin tshe srog gi rgyu ba chad pa bzhin ci'ang mi tshor/6 ga re byed kyi yod/’ lha chos kyis ngar skad brgyab pas/ byis pa gnyis po mgo bor sbar mo bkab nas bros song /lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal gyi lus nas 'then 'then byas nas 4 'dzum dpal/ 'dzum dpal ’ zhes bos kyang mo ra bzi thag chod pas a lan tsam yang mi bya/ lha chos thabs zad pas mo pang du blangs nas nang du khyer nas nyal khri'i thog tu bsnyal/ 'dzum dpal de mur rngur sgra rgyag bzhin gnyid kyi lam du zhugs/ skabs skabs de tsam gsal rgyu med pa'i gnyid lab re gnyis kyardo spyas/

lha chos kyi sems ni rgya 'tshings pa'i bal sgong zhig ltar go rim dang bral yang gnyid ces pa'i g.ya' tsam yang med/lha chos zhogs pa nam langs dus gzhi nas gnyid khuga'adzum dpal snga po langs nas gad brgyab/ ja bskol rjes/ lha chos kyi lus la dkrug dkrug byas nas 66longs dang / nyi 'od khyod kyi mgo la phog 'dug ’ ces smras/lha chos glo bur du gnyid sad/ 6 nyi 'od nga'i mgo la phog kyang khyod dang 'brel ba med/’ 66khongasdo ma za/ nga kha sang pha yul gyi mi dang 'phrad pas chang phran bu btung ༵ // ༵/ nga btung 'dod na thungs/ nga'i bza' mo mi yong nged gnyis de sngon kha chad yod/ khyod pha yul gyi mi de dang mnyam du rgyug 'dzum dpal ci'ang mi smra bar mig mtha' mchi mas gang nas yud tsam bsdad rjes/ u tshugs kyis 'dzum mdangs shig bstan nas/ 6tsang de ring nas chang mi btung / nga tsho zhing pa yin pas khyed tsho 'brog pa dang mi 'dra bar bying satung rgyur dga' po yod/ khyed kyis ma 'dod na rjes ma ngas chang gcod ga smyo phyi drags pa red/ sa mtha'i mi 'khyam la blos 'khel thabs bral/nged gnyis kyi 'brel ba de mtshams yin/ lha chos mgo btum nas 'dzum dpal la kha ya ma byas/ myur du gnyid rdzu btab nas rngur skad rgyag khul byas/'on kyang kho'i sems nang du 'dzum dpal gyis de las che ba'i 'gyod bshags byas nas kho la re ba rgyag rgyur sgugakhang pa'i nang 'jam thing nger/ khab gcig sa la zag kyang de'i sgra rna bar lhung rgyu red/ mtshan mo gcig lhag tsam khong khro byas mthar lha ༵༵ kyi

khong khro cung zhi/ 'dzum dpal ga re byed kyi yod dam/ dus tshon ring po phyin song / lha chos kyis ga ler nyal chas kyi gseng nas lkog lta byed dus/ 'dzum dpal mthong rgyu mi 'dug lha chos myur du langs nas khang pa'i steng 'og tshang mar bltas kyang 'dzum dpal ma rnyed/ phyi'i rgyal sgo nas thon te g.yas lta g.yon lta byas kyang 'dzum dpal gyi grib gzugs kyang ma mchis mo ngo ma pha yul gyi mi de dang mnyam du song ba yin nam/ khos rang nyid kyis bshad pa'i skad char 'gyod pa skyes/ yang 'dzum dpal gyis ca dngos 'dra khyer song med dam snyam pas/ khos khang pa'i phyogs gang sar bltas rjes ca lag yod tshad tshang tshang rug rug red/ phor cog thog gi kho'i ja phor gyi 'og tu yi ge zhig bzhag 'dug nged gnyis bza' tshang byed pa'i las med na nga lha sar 'khyam 'gro gi yin/ 'dzum dpal/ lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal gyis bzhag pa'i yig chung la lta bzhin sna khung skyur mo chags nas mig nas mchi ma'i phreng ba re re bzhin sna gdong g.yas g.yon nas lhung /nyin gcig ring / lha chos kyis gang sar 'dzum dpal btsal yang ma rnyed/ mo 'jig rten 'di nas rlangs par 'gyur nas yal ba 'dra/ de nyin nas bzung / 'dzum dpal lha chos kyi 'gram nas med par gyur pas/ khos spyi/yang pha mas bzhag pa'i khang pa chen po de bsrungs nas dus 'da' bar bzhi/6 nam nyi ma ring res thung res/ chu gad pa dma' res mtho res zhes pa'i gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe ci la mi bden/ da lam rgya zog bod du 'aswā/sdu pa'i gzhung lam chen po'i thog tu gnas pa'i gna' bo'i grong khyer

der tshong zog dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar 'phel rgyas byung / lha chos kyi drin chen pha mas bzhag pa'i khang stong de tsho 'khrug cha che ba'i khrom lam gyi zur du gnas pas tshong gnyer mkhan gyis shin tu dga' po byed/ khang pa de dag lha chos kyis bltas na bskam rgyu med pa'i dngul gyi chu 'go'am dbyar dgun chad med brtan pa'i 'bri drus ma dang 'dra/ kho'i khang pa gla 'dod byed mkhan tshong pa 'tshang kha shig shig red/ rjes su lha chos kyis bsam gzhigs dang sdur ba yang yang byas pa brgyud 'og gi khang mig gsum po de gla rin mtho shos dang lo phyed kyi khang gla snga sprad thub mkhan gyi tshong pa gsum la g.yar/ de tsho ni rus ming ma yin pa'i rgya kha che'i tshong pa gnyis dang ming la dpa' grags zhes pa'i khams pa'i tshong pa zhig red/ lha chos kyis dpa' grags zhes pa'i mi de mthong ma thag de sngon 'dzum dpal dang mnyam du chang btung mkhan gyi mi de dran pas kho la khang gla mi gtong snyam yang / dpa' grags kyis deng skabs 'dzum dpal gyi gnas tshul shod rgyu yod thog khos 'dzum dpal khrid yong rgyu'i khas len byas pas lha chos dga' thag chod nas khang pa gcig dpa' grags la khang gla btang / rgya kha che gnyis pos tshong zog tsag tsig btsong sa'i tshong khang btsugs pa dang / dpa' grags kyis ja khang btsugs/ ja khang nang du las ka byed mkhan tshe g.yang zhes pa'i bu mo zhig 'dug pas des kyang 'dzum dpal ngo shes kyi 'dugade sngon lha chos las kur 'gro sa'i grong lhan gyi ar rgyag mnyam las de rgya yulanas yong ba'i ar po rgyag mkhan dang 'gran rtsod ma thub par gyur mod kyang lha chos kyi 'tsho bar dka' ngal ci'ang ma 'phrad/ gang yin zer na/ kho la thob pa'i khang gla de las byed rtse gra zhig gi gla phogs las kyang mang / des na khos nyin ltar dka' ngal ci'ang rgyag mi dgos par zas zhim po dang gos yag po yod pa'i 'tsho ba bskyal rgyu byung / de lta bu'i bde bde lhod lhod kyi zlordo ba

bskyal nas lo gcig tsam song bas/ lha chos kyi gdong pa dkar po chags zhing sha'ang rgyags par gyur/ mig mthar gang ba'i chu ris lta bu'i gnyer ma dag kyang bkrus nas dag pa bzhin mi mngon par gyur/ deng skabs mi sus kho mthong rung rnam 'gyur yag po bstan mkhan sha stag red/ khos gzhan gyi brtsi bkur thob pa'i skyid snang tshor/ de'ang dngos po'i longs spyod ltar mi la bde ba sbyin pa'i bsam pa'i rgyags phye zhig red/ deng skabs lha chos kyi gdong par 'dzum chung mngon bzhin lag tu phreng ba bzung nas dal bu'i ngang dga' ldan byin chags gling la bskor bar 'gro rgyu las gzhan gyi las ka med/ 6 grod pa rgyags dus chos dran ’ zhes pa ci la mi bden/zhin shas nang byung ba'i gnas tshul kha shas kyis lha chos blo mi bde bar gyur/ sems khral zhig lus kyi grib gzugs ltar kho dang nyin mtshan ltos med sdo sdi ga/da/ sems khral slong mkhan yang khang pa btsong rogs zer mkhan gyi mi nyin gcig dpa' grags glo bur du 'dzul yong / rum nang nas dar dkar zhig blangs nas lha chos kyi mdun du bzhag pa dang / kha 'tsher 'tsher byas nas tsa nged gnyis tshong zhig brgyab na gang 'dra 'dug ’ zer/lha chos kyis mgo ma tshod pas/ 6 tshong ga re rgyag rgyu 'dug 8 khyed la pham mi sprad/ji dpa' grags kyis dgod tsam byas nas gab tshig smra ba'i bzo bstan/6 nga la btsong rgyu ci'ang med/ 6 ya/ ngas thad kur shod/ khyod kyi khang pa 'di tsho nga la tshongs dang /7bsam yul las 'das pa'i skad cha des lha chos kyi mgo la btsog chu blugs pa ltar gyur/ 6 min/ btsong gi min/ rnam 'gyur grang shur shur gyiswā sdus/

dpa' grags kyang ha las/ kho'i bsam yul las 'das pa 'dra/6 gong tshad kyang gleng gi min nam/’ dpa' grags kyis u tshugs kyis 'dzum mdangs shig kyang bstan/6 khang pa 'di nga ma shi na tshong mkhan med/mi 66byas na ngas skad cha de bshad med pa'i khongs su gyis/mi dpa' grags kyi ngo mdog de tsam mdzes rgyu med par gyur nas log song /kho'i khang pa gla mkhan gyi kha che'i tshong pa gdong nag des kho la khang pa btsong rogs zhes thengs gnyis tsam bshad/ thengs dang po khos bod skad dag deg brgyab nas khang pa tshong rogs zhes bshad pa red/ thengs gnyis pa khos skad sgyur khrid nas khang pa btsong na phan 'bras che tshul gang mang mang bshad/de min gzhan gyi khang pa btsong rogs zer mkhan rgyun mi chad/khang pa btsong rogs zer mkhan mang rim bzhin du/ khos khang pa'i rin bang la ngos 'dzin je mthor song / nyin la bsam rgyu mtshan la rmis rgyu khang pa las med/ ma rgan grongs kha'i 6 khang pa ma btsong zhes pa'i kha chems dran dus/ ma rgad mo la mngon shes 'dug snyam/ 'das zin pa'i pha ma'i bka' drin lhag par tshor/ drin can pha ma gnyis pos dka' ba sna tshogs myangasanas chung nas rang nyid gsos/ tshe las 'das kyang rgyu nor gyi 'byung khungs ltar gyur pa'i khang pa bzhag gal te dngul mang po zhig bzhag kyang zad pa'i nyi ma yod/ lam zur gyi khang pa ni ma rtsa shi rgyu med pa'i nor bu 6 dgos 'dod kun 'byung ’ red/ khos thengs mang pha ma dran nas mig chu lhung lhung shor/ pha ma gnyis 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du byon zin pas drin lan 'jal thabs bral/ khos byed thub pa ni dga' ldan byin chags gling la mchod 'bul byas nas 'gro drug gang zhig tu gnas pa'i pha ma gnyis po sdug 317

brdolare las bral nas bde ba 'ba' zhig thob pa'i gsol ba smon lam 'debs rgyu bye tsho/gas dus bde brtan snying yin pas lha chos kyi khang pa 'phrog mkhan med kyang khos rgyun du khang pa'i bde 'jags la sems khral byed/ dgong mo mang por blo mi bde bar gnyid khug dus khang pa gzhan gyis 'phrog pa'i rmi lam 'khrug des na/ kho dga' ldan byin chags gling du song nas byin 'bar sprul sku mjal te/ deng gnyid mi khug pa'i gnas tshul bshad nas byin rlabs dang sku rim zhus/ byin 'bar sprul sku ni dga' ldan byin chags gling gi sprul sku yang gnyis pa red/ sprul sku ang dang po sgrub sde sprul sku rig gsar skabs skya la bab pas dgon pa'i nang mi sdod kyang dad pa byed mkhan shin tu mang po yod/ byin 'bar sprul skus dgon pa'i phyi nang gi las kur do dam byed pas/dad ldan mang pos khong la thogs pa med pa'i mngon shes yod zer/byin 'bar sprul skus mig btsums nas cung bsdad rjes/ lag gi ba so'i phreng ba'i phreng rdog kha shas yar nud mar nad byas/ de nas dbugs ring zhig btang nas 6 yag po mi 'dug ces bshad/sna chos skrag nas snying kha nang nas don ran/ 6 rin po che/ ga re red 'dugabyi na 'bar sprul skus lha chos dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba sems can la byams dang snying rjes khengs pa'i bzo zhig bstan rjes/ 6 khyod kyi ma rgan mo'i rnam shes 'dre la 'gyur nas khang rnying der 'khor 'dug gnyid mi khug pa don chung chung red/ sdug na khyod kyi tshe la bar chad yod srid/ yag shos byas na khang pa gzhan la tshongs/7lha chos ni mgo la rdo phog pa'i byi'u zhig ltar nang du log ma rgad mo'i rnadi spyazlo 'dre la 'gyur zer ba de ji ltar bsam blo gtong yang kho'i blo la 'gro

thabs bral/ ma rgad mos mi tshe gcig la dge ba byas/ sdig pa spang / lus kyi shakhrag 'jib mkhan gyi shig kyang gsod mi phod/ de lta bu'i mi zhig bde ba can gyi zhing khams la mi skye bar 'dre la 'gyur na rgyu 'bras zer ba sus yid ches/ las rgyu 'bras zer ba med na byin 'bar sprul sku dang bcas pa'i bla ma grwa pa de tsho la'ang mi rnams kyis dad pa byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med/ de ltar bsam dus blo cung bde rung / dus rgyun byin 'bar sprul skur mngon shes yod lugs kyi skad cha dag dran dus/ lha chos de mur 'bu grog ma rdo tsha po'i thog bzhag pa ltar gyur/ gal srid ngo ma de ltar yin na/ lha chos mu mthud bsam blo gtong mi phod par gyur/lha chos dga' ldan byin chags gling gi sprul sku yang dang po sgrub sde sprul sku mjal du song / lha chos kyi skad cha dang po rang nyid kyi ma deng skabs 'gro drug gang du yod med dris par/ sgrub sde sprul skus yud tsam mig zim zim gyis ci'ang mi smra bar zhal gnam la bltas nas bsdad rjes/ 'dzum dmul dmul gyis 6 khyod kyi ma 'das ma byang phyogs kyi phyug po'i dud tshang zhig tu pho lus thob 'dug 9zer bas lha chos kyi sems dga' lhang lhang du gyur/ skad cha gnyis pa kho'i khang pa btsong dgos min skor dris par/ sgrub sde sprul skus bsam blo yang mi btang bar tsa khang pa yag po de 'dra btsong na khyod lkugs rtags red zer/ lha chos kyi sems thog tu mnan pa'i khur po ljid po gcig de mur rlangs par 'gyur nas gar song cha med du yal/nyin shas nang / lha chos kyi khang pa btsong rogs zer mkhan tsha rlabs sheg 'gyur/ mi de dag tshang ma byin 'bar sprul sku dang 'brel ba yod mkhan sha stag red/ u tshugs che shos kyi mi de ni byin 'bar sprul sku'i spun chung red/lha chos rbad de ha las/ gsang ba rtogs/ rin po ches kyang kho'i khang par dmigs yod pa red/ kho skrag nas thod pa'i thog nas rngul chu sran rdo/ rlom

mang po 'od hrog ger don/pha mas bzhag pa'i khang pa 'di gcig byas na rgyu nor gyi 'byung khungs yin pa smos med thog gnyis byas na deng skabs sdug dang sems khral gyi chu 'go lta bur gyur/ deng skabs lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal brjed nas snying nye shos khang pa kho na lus/ mtshan mo'i rmi lam gyi khrod du 'dzum dpal gar med gyur nas khang pa kho na yang yang mngon/ skabs 'gar kho'i khang pa je dzig je mdzes su song nas rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon gyi bzhugs yul pho brang po ta la lta bur gyur/ de dus lha chos kyi kha zur nas 'dzum mdangs mngon/ de lta bu'i rmi lam nyung nyung red/ mang che ba ni 'jigs snang skye dgos pa sha stag ste/dper na/ sa 'gul byung nas rang nyid kyi khang pa thal rdul sbar mo gang la 'gyur/ lha chos yid shin tu skyo nas yun ring ngus/ gnyid sad dus/ mchi mas sngas mgo rlon rkyang bzos 'dug yang dper na/ khang pa btsong rogs zer mkhan gyi mi de tsho dang byin 'bar sprul sku dang bcas pa kha nang mche ba ring po re skyes nas kho'i thog la mchongs/ kho skrag thag chod nas skad ngan shor ba dang glo bur du gnyid las sad/ snying da dung ldig ldig gis 'phagalus hril po rngul chus tshos nas da lta rang chu nang nas thon pa lta bur gyur/deng skabs lha chos zas gos thad dka' ngal med kyang khang pa shor bar dogs pa'i sems khral chen po yod/nyin gcig lha chos kyi khang sgo drag tu rdung byung bas/ khos sgo phyes nas bltas tshe/ 'og gi dpa' grags kyi ja khang nang las ka byed mkhan gyi tshe g.yang red 'dugatshe g.yang dga' mchongs rgyag bzhin 66'dzum dpal slebs 'dug ces skad brgyab/32/ byas dbyar rnga thos pa bzhin lha chos dga' thag chod/ myur du 'dzum

dpalakhyim du bsu rgyu dran/ 'on te kho'i klad pa'i nang myur du kho'i khang pa 'dre lag brkyangs mkhan gyi mi de tsho re re bzhin shar/ 'dzum dpal yang ga 'dra yin nam/ khang pa dang 'brel ba e yod/ mo la'ang tshod bgam ma byas na mi 'grig de mur 'dzum dpal myur du nang la bsu rgyu'i bsam blo med par gyur/ 66lha chos/’ 'dzum dpal gyi gdong par 'dzum mdangs kyis khengs bzhin mdun du gom pa kha shas spos kyang / lha chos kyi rnam 'gyur ci'ang med pa'i ngo mdog mthong bas mo myur du tshod shor nas langs bsdad/66'dzum dpal slobs 'dug nga'i nang du shog ang / nga da lta las ka zhig yod/ lha chos rtab rtob kyis sgo nas thon/dpa' grags dang tshe g.yang rbad de ha las nas mig chen por gdang /'dzum dpal gyi ngo gdong nas skyengs pa dang skyo ba sogs kyi rnam 'gyur shar tsam shar tsam byas rjes mos dpa' grags dang tshe g.yang la bltas nas bgad mo dgod pa'i bzo skyo po zhig bstan/'dzum dpal tshe g.yang gi rogs pa byas nas dpa' grags kyi ja khang nang las ka byas nas bsdad/lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal 'phrad dus spyir btang gi ngo shes shig ltar dgon tsam byed pa las snying nye ba'i gtam ci'ang mi gleng / don du kho'i sems kyi gting nas 'dzum dpal la re ba bcangs yod/ 'on kyang mo la dogs pa'ang yod/ ji ltar byas nas 'dzum dpal gyi sems ngo ma rtogs thabs thad kho la thabs shes ci'ang med/ mig gis mthong ba thams cad phyi tshul gyi 'khrab ston yin srid/ mig gis mi mthong ba'i 'dzum dpal ngo ma de kho'i gzhal bya min/yud tsam la zla shas yol mod kyang / lha chos dang 'dzum dpal gyi 31spyal

bar 'phel rgyas ci'ang ma byung thog lha chos kyis de'i thog la bsam blo gtong rgyu je nyung je nyung du song /lnga/deng skabs lha chos dang 'brel ba yag shos kyi mi ni khams pa dpa' grags red/ lha chos kyis bltas na dpa' grags ni grogs bsgrigs rung ba'i mi zhig red/ de sngon rang nyid kyis kho'i khang pa btsong rgyu'i re bar khas len ma byas kyang / dpa' grags kyis de'i thog la bsam tshul spu tsam med thogakho'i thog la sngon ma las rnam 'gyur yag thams cad dpa' grags lta bu'i bkām shes can yin na 'jig rten 'di'i thog tu 'gal zla phyed ka nyung du 'gro rgyu cadado/ na du dpa' grags ni lha chos la a rag bslab mkhan gyi dge rgan red/dpa' grags kyis rtag par lha chos kho'i ja khang gi spug na bos nas a rag blugadang thog lha chos kyis a rag gi ro myang tsam myang tsam las mang po btung mi thub mod kyang deng skabs kho rgyun du a rag gis bzi nas lha yul la slebs pa lta bu'i spro skyid tshor/ lhag par du kha ngo mtshar ba'i khams mo tshe g.yang gis snyan 'jibs ldan pa'i chang gzhas rgyun mi chad pa len dus lha chos chang btung 'dod je cher 'gro/nye char/ lha chos kyis khang gla phran bu phab rgyu'i bsam gzhigs byas kyang dpa' grags kyis khas len mi byed/lha chos kyis dngul bton nas chang rin rtsis rgyag dus/ dpa' grags kyis 6 dkon mchog gsum 7zhes pa'i mna' chen po bskyal nas dngul skar gardi/ sgring mi len/

lha chos kyis gang nas bltas kyang dpa' grags ni gtong phod che la sger sems chung ba'i mi zhig red/dus tshod nyin gung la slobs/ lha chos dro lto zos rjes/ dpa' grags kyi za khang nang du a rag btung du 'gro bsam pa na/ sgo thung byung / bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la mtsho dpal dang mo'i a ma red/mtsho dpal gyi ma kha brad brad byas shing ngo gdong 'dzum gyis khengs/mtsho dpal cung kha skyengs nas dgod tsam dgod tsam byas/ deng skabs mo'i khyo ga grwa log des mo bskyur nas rgya gar du phyin pa red/ go thos la rgya gar du rgad mo phyug po zhig dang mnyam du bsdad yod skad/mtsho dpal gyi ma bud med kha bde po des sems bzang can gyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs bstan nas lha chos dang mtsho dpal gnyen sgrig na yag lugs 'tsham lugs chu rgyug rgyug bshad cing de sngon bu mos nor bu'i nor nyams ma chod kyang da lta nor bu ngos 'dzin thob dus phyi med zer/mtsho dpal ci'ang mi smra bar mgo bo gug nas bsdad/lha chos kyi yid kyi me long gi ngos su de sngon glog brnyan khang gi sgo 'gram gyiganas tshul dag glog brnyan bstan pa ltar wa ler shar thog deng skabs kho'i khang par re ngan 'chang mkhan gyi mi sna tshogs mig lam du 'khor/ des na lha chos rlung 'tshub 'tshub tu gyur nas 6 yong gi ma red 7ces bshad/mtsho dpal gyi mas 'grel bshad kha shas byas kyang lha chos kyi rnam 'gyur je mkhregs tu phyin/mjug tu mtsho dpal gyi ma rnam 'gyur grang shur shur gyis log yid pham pa'i mtsho dpal mig mtha' mchi mas gang bzhin ma'i rjes la 'brangs/mtsho dpal song ma thag dpa' grags kyis sbi rag sgam gang pang nas slobs 'dug de ring mnyam du skyid po zhig sdod/glu dpa' gragastu sdus

skad shugs chen pos de ltar smras/ chang bkyag mkhan tshe g.yang yang khrid 'dug de'i dgong mo lha chos ra bzi nas ji ltar nyal yang mi shes/zhogs pa gnyid sad dus/ lha chos kyi nyal chas nang tshe g.yang yang nyal 'dug gnyis ku'i lus la gos lheb tsam yang ma gyon par gcer bu red/ lha chos kyi lus hril po 'jigs yer yer du gyur/ mdang gi gnas tshul dran gso byed dus/ thog mar chang btung ba'i gnas tshul 'ga' dran yang rjes su ji ltar byas min gtan nas mi dran/ tshe g.yang yang gnyid sad song / bu mo des lha chos la zur mig cig bltas nas ngo tsha smin mdog gis kho'i brang stong du bsnyes/ lha chos skrag nas smra mi shes par gyur/ tshe g.yang blo khog je che red/mo'i lag gcig gis kho'i tshor ba rno ba'i gnas der nyug lha chos kyi lus pos rim bzhin tshor ba rnyed thog da lta'i sems khral dang skyo snang yang 'ja' ltar yal nas myur du bu mo de lus 'og tu mnan nas mo dang 'o chu bzhin 'dres/lha chos nyin shas nang 'dzum dpal la gdong pa bstan mi shes pa'i sems kyi khur po zhig byung mod kyang / nyin shas song rjes ga ler ci'ang med par gyur/lha chos kyis dpa' grags dang tshe g.yang nas rnyog gra bslang rgyur skraga'on te tshe g.yang gis de'i skor la gtam sne tshig gcig ma gling / sngar bzhin kho la 'dzum zer spro bzhin chang gzhas len/ dpa' grags kyis gnas tshul tshang ma ha go ba'i bzo bstan nas dpog dka' ba'i dgod chung zhig bstan pa las ci'ang mi smra/ sngar bzhin kho ja khang nang gdan drangs nas chang bkyagalha chos kyis dpa' grags la yongs su yid ches byed/ rang nyid la grogs po 'di 'dra zhig rnyed par sems gting nas dga' tshor rgyas/mi ring bar/ kun gyi bsam yul las 'das pa'i bya ba zhig byung ba ste/lha rdo14 kyis kho'i khang pa dpa' grags la btsong rgyu byas thog tshong rgyag gi gan

rgya'ang bzhag gan rgya'i nang don gtso bo ni/ dpa' grags kyis khrom ra'i gong tshad ltar lha chos kyi khang pa nyo rgyu dang / lo bco lnga'i nang dngul cha tshang sprad tshar ba bya rgyu/ 'on kyang khang pa lha chos tshe las 'das rjes gzhi nas dpa' grags kyis rtsis len bya rgyu dang bdag dbang thob rgyu/ gal srid lo bco rdo'i sngon du lha chos tshe las 'das na mu mthud bun 'jal mi dgos pa sogs da/ tshong der skad grags chen po byung / dpa' grags rbad de myos pa red zer/ lha chos khe thag chod pa red zer/ mi mang pos tshong yag po brgyab 'dug ces shod dus lha chos dga' thag chod nas kha'ang btsum mi thub par gyur/ mi 'gas dpa' grags la khyod shi tshar dus gzhi nas khang pa thob rgyu red ces shod dus/ dpa' grags kyis dgod dgod byas nas 66des na nga'i bu rgyud la 'jog rgyu red ces ku re smra/yang mi mang pos bsam blo drug gsum bco brgyad btang rjes/ khams pa dpa' grags kyis khang pa snga tsam thob rgyu dang rin nyung tsam sprod rgyu'i ched du lha chos lkog gsod byed pa'i nyen kha yod ces shod/tshong gtan 'khel rjes/ dpa' grags pha yul du log song / dpa' grags ni lkog g.yo gshom mkhan zhig mi 'dra/ kho'i ja khang de tshe g.yang dang 'dzum dpal la rtsis sprad/ lo phyed tsam phyin yang dpa' grags log mkhan mi 'dug mi tshos dpa' grags kyis chab mdor ja khang zhig btsugs nas bsdad 'dug zer/ des na rim bzhin dpa' grags kyis lha chos la lkog g.yo yod pa'i dogasi pa byed mkhan je nyung je nyung du song /'dzum dpal dang tshe g.yang gi ja khang nang slebs snga shos kyi mgron po ni lha chos red/ kho'i las 'gan gtso bo ni ja btung rgyu dang lto za rgyu minā snar

chang rag btung rgyu de red/ deng skabs lha chos chang rag med na mi tshe mi 'gro/zhogs lto dang mnyam du a rag dkar po btung dgos/ a rag yud tsam btung rjes kho'i thal skyar gyur pa'i ngo mdog las dmar mdangs rgyas/ rgyun du smra brjod la mi mkhas pa'i kha nas kyang rdzogs rgyu med pa'i skad cha yod/ tshe g.yangakho'i 'gram du bsdad nas chang gzhas lhang lhang gis a rag bkyag pa dang thengs mang po a rag gi rin ma blangs/ 'on te 'dzum dpal gyis nam yang kho'i thog la rnam 'gyur yag po zhig mi bstan/ lha chos kyi sems gting nas skyo lhang lhang 'byung / yag sdug la ma bltos par khong gnyis bza' tshang byed myong / sha khrag 'dres pa'i 'brel ba yod dus/ mo'i rnam 'gyur sdug po 'di 'dra/ lha chos kyis bsam blo gtong rim bzhin mig chu shor grabs byed/lha chos zhogs pa gdong pa phur phur byas rjes thog mar dran pa ni khang 'og gi ja khang yin yang 'dzum dpal gyis rnam 'gyur grang shur shur dang mig log 'dzer 'dzer bya rgyur skrag lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal gyis de ltar khong khro za dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan tshod dpag thub/ tshe g.yang gis chang rin ma blangs pa'ang nyung tsam byas nas blangs pas red/ khos thengs mang po 'dzum dpal gyis tshe g.yang la chang rin cha tshang len dgos pa'i kha brda byas pa go/ 'on te rgyu mtshan ci yin mi shes par tshe g.yang gis 'dzum dpal gyi skad cha rna rgyab kyi rgyu~X hā/ k+ta//sa/ ṭ+wāṃ dag gis rkyen pas 'dzum dpal rim bzhin lha chos kyi mi 'du/mas pa dpa' grags phyin nas lo gcig phyin yang da dung log mkhan 'dzum dpal dang tshe g.yang gi ja khang sngar bzhin tshong brinalo 'dugalha chos rbad de ra bzir gyur/ grong tsho stod smad tshang mas mngon lkog ci ri/sdu sdus tsa ra bzi lha chos 7zhes 'bod/

dgong mo a rag btung rgyu mang drags pas/ lha chos nyin gung la slebs dus gzhi nas langs/ kho'i khang sgo dal bur brdung byung / tshe g.yang min nam/ lha chos kyi sems skyid lhang lhang du gyur/ ngo ma/ tshe g.yang gis kho la dga' gi yod pa 'dra/ de sngon gyi 'brel ba de byung tshun/ mo'i mig chen po gnyis kyis kho la yang yang lta/ lkog tu kho'i nang du yong nas blo khog chen pos kho'i mgrin par 'khyud nas mig zim zim dang dbugs hal hal byed/skabs der lha chos kyis dus rgyun a rag gis tshos nas tshor ba rtul ba'i lus po tsha zing zing du gyur/ lha chos kyis brel ba chen pos sgo phye tshe/ tshe g.yang min par 'dzum dpal red 'dug skrag snang zhig dang bcas par yud tsam ring lha chos kyis ci'ang smra ma shes/'dzum dpal shar rer 'dzul nas nyal khri'i zur du bsdad nas gzab nan gyis 6 nged gnyis de sngon bza' tshang yin pas ngas khyod la sems bzang yin/ khyod kyis a rag mang po de 'dra ma btung / mu mthud 'di ltar btung na khyod kyi tshe la'ang gnod pa yong srid/7zer/lha chos kyis 'dzum dpal gyi dge rgan lta bu'i gzab nan gyi bzo de mthong dus yin mi dga'/ tshe la gnod pa'i skad cha de go dus dmod ngan brgyababyung snyam nas khong khro'i me lce dgung la 'byur/ 64ngas chang rin skar gcig kyang nyung mi srid/ nga'i tshe dang khyod 'brel ba med/’ 'dzum dpal log song / mo'i gdong par chang lan la chu thob pa'i sdug gis gang /lha chos 'dzum dpal gyi rjes 'brangs nas ja khang du song ba na/ 'dzum dpal gyis ja khang gi sgo nis lha chos bkag ste ru nga tsho'i ja khang nang rjes ma ma yong rogs/ khyod kyi ra bzi ba'i bzo lta des mgron po gzhan dag dkrogs kyi 'dug ’ ces bshad de ngo gdong nag rog ger bsdad/ 327

lha chos khros nas ci zhig lan rgyag dgos min la bsam blo gtong skabs tshegayang rgyug nas 'dzum dpal la mig log cig bltas nas lha chos kyi lag 'go bzung nas 'dzum dmul dmul gyis nang du khrid/skye bo phal mo che'i ngos nas bshad na de ring ni rgyun ldan gyi nyin mo zhig red/ shar phyogs ri bo'i rtse nas dal gyis 'phags pa'i nyin phyed dbang po'i 'od snang gis yangs pa'i nor 'dzin mdzes par brgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings su bal ldan lug gi gzugs ldan pa'i sprin dkar re 'ga' las ma mchis pas phal cher bar sngo thing nger snang / skye bo phal mo che zas gos kyi ched du grong khyer gyi phyogs ga ge mo zhig tu rang las brel/'dzum dpal dang tshe g.yang gi ja khang nang mi yis khengs/tshe g.yang brel ba chen pos yar rgyug mar rgyug byed/'dzum dpal gyi blo rnal du phab mi thub/ ga re byas sam/ bsam blo las ga'i thog la 'jog mi thub/ khog pa'i nang du zing zing du 'gul ba'i 'bu srin stong phrag mang po 'dzul ba ltar/ ngo ma ga re byas pa red/ blo bde ru mi bcug mkhan su red/ lha chos red 'dug dus rgyun kho yong nas a rag btung rgyur skrag kyang de ring kho dran/ 'di ni rgyun ldan gyi gnas tshul zhig ma red/ nyi ma gnam dkyil la slebs kyang kho da dung mi yong ba ga re yin nam/kho ga par phyin pa red/ mo myur du thog khar song nas lta dus lha chos sdod sa'i khang par sgo lcags brgyab 'dug bsam blo gtong dus/ mdang dgong chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la lha chos ra bzi nas dus rgyun ltar khyar khyor gyis log song / 'dzum dpal bsam blo gtong rim bzhin 'tshab nas sna rtse nas rngul rdog 'od 'tsher ba zhig don/ ra bzi de ga par phyin pa red/ 'dzum dpal myushā ༵ ja khang nang log nas lha chos gar med du gyur pa'i skor tshe g.yang la

bshad dus/ tshe g.yang gis ra bzi gar song sus shes zer ba dang mu mthud skyes pa 'ga' dang chags gtam sna tshogs bshad nas bsdad/ thabs zad pa'i 'dzum dpal sngar bas blo mi bde bar gyur/ sems gting nas sngar med kyi skrag snang zhig skyes/glo bur du nyen brda sgrog pa'i rlangs 'khor zhig ja khang gi sgo 'gram du kha bkag pas 'dzum dpal gyi bsam blo'i gtong mtshams bcad/ mi tshang ma ha las pa'i 'dren byed ches cher gdangs nas rlangs 'khor gyi mtha' bskor/lha chos mdang dgong dgon pa'i 'gram gyi gsang spyod cig gi i khung nang zag nas shi 'dug zer/'dzum dpal kho shi ba'i gtam ngan thos pas ngus/tshe g.yang yud tsam ring ci'ang smra mi shes pa'i 'jim skur gyur/spyi bde'i mi sna de tshos g.yas rgyug g.yon rgyug byas nas par brgyab/ da dung 'dzum dpal dang tshe g.yang la skad cha sna tshogs dris/ ha lam khong gnyis kyis lha chos bsad pa'i dogs pa byed kyi yod pa 'dra/spyi bde mi sna'i mdun du tshe g.yang skrag nas ngu ran 'duga'adzum dpal rim bzhin rig pa rnal du phab pas gzab nan du gnas/spyi bde mi sna de tsho brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis rlangs 'khor btang nas log song / kho tsho da dung yong gi yin zer/'on kyang nyin shas song yang de'i skor la jus gtogs byed mkhan mi 'dugayang nyin shas song rjes/ thag ring 'brog khul nas lha chos 'das pa'i nye 'brel 'ga' slobs nas ca lag re re bzhin rtsis len byas thog dga' ldan byin chags gling la mchod 'bul yang byas/ byin 'bar sprul skus mgo g.yug g.yug gis 66gal srid 'das po des nga'i kha la nyan nas khardo ri~X de

btsong yod na kho shi tshod slebs med/ snying rje ba la/ snyigs ma'i sems can de tsho ’ zer bzhin 'jig rten lag mthil du yod pa'i bzo zhig bstan/lha chos kyi shi rkyen thad shod tshul sna tshogs rdzun gyi gshog pa skyes nas gang sar khyab nas zla ba gcig tsam song rjes/ jus gtogs tsha ba'i mi rnams kyis rim bzhin skyid cing sdug pa'i mi yul du lha chos zhes pa'i mi spyir btang ba zhig byung myong ba brjed/khams pa dpa' grags slebs nas khang pa rtsis blangs/ kho la khe chen po thob/ khang pa rgyag skyor phran bu dang rgyan bzo phran bu byas pas lo brgya'i khang rnying des dus rabs kyi gzab mchor spras nas mdzes sdug ldan par gyur/khang gla'ang de mur ldab 'phar byung /tshe g.yang sngar bzhin ja khang btsugs nas bsdad/ tshong je yag red/'dzum dpal kha je nyung je nyung / rgyun mi chad par ma ṇi 'don/ nyin gcig mos rang nyid la yod pa'i rgyu nor ma lus dga' ldan byin chags gling la phul rjes/ rgya zog bod du 'grim sa'i gna' bo'i grong khyer dang kha bral nas tshang tshing nags khrod du gnas pa'i pha yul du logago thos la/ pha yul du slebs rjes 'dzum dpal tsham tshom med par stong lo'i dge grong de ru dge ma byas/ dmar ser rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i gna' bo'i dgon rnying de'i nang chos la snying rus che ba'i dge ma kha dog mtshar ba zhig kun gyis do snang bya yul la gyur/ mo'i chos ming la kun grol dbang mo zer/330

snyim /smra 'byin sbyir+sha pa/ da~Xl lhadzoms/༵duna~X ga /sa ༷/da pa/ ga~X rdo khye tshe ring /lang tsho'i 'bab chu/sngusna pa/ma/khan/ trī /r+sha//sna // kā/nga /snasnoswāX :khamakhan/ ṭā trī/k+taḥswā nāḥ tānā hā spyanā yi/ snam sgrig khang /skyu/ ༷zlo snan// rnyiX ༷khyeXr+shasngu/soso'i zhin hwa dpe tshong khang /snatā chi/ba/samakhan/ me+e 5༵༵ ༵sdi hu'e stu~X ༵dedīkā+o yod kung si/༷/ :shā 7 thengs/khroX/ṭī/ ṭ+wāṃ shāḥ/ dro dū / sdi /dri trī dris/swā/ po brgyab/snatāk+tar+shasna// /rdo/byeX7/ 03—826 lo 92 29
